&#x20;               "Couple",

&#x20;               "Family",

&#x20;               "Group"

&#x20;           ],



&#x20;           default="Unknown"

&#x20;       )



print(

&#x20;           "Pre-process - Lead time \& Service Level Computation"

&#x20;       )



&#x20;       return df



\# =========================================================

&#x20;   # Step 5.3 Client \& Driver Behaviour - FIT

&#x20;   # =========================================================



&#x20;   def \_fit\_clientdriver\_behaviour(self, df):



&#x20;       # Client average rating



&#x20;       self.client\_stats = (

&#x20;           df.groupby(

&#x20;               "client\_email"

&#x20;           )\["final\_rating"]

&#x20;           .mean()

&#x20;           .reset\_index()

&#x20;       )



self.client\_stats.columns = \[

&#x20;           "client\_email",

&#x20;           "client\_avg\_rating"

&#x20;       ]



def client\_label(r):



&#x20;           if r <= 2:



&#x20;               return "Client - bad review"



&#x20;           elif r == 3:



&#x20;               return "Client - neutral review"



&#x20;           else:



&#x20;               return "Client - good review"



self.client\_stats\["client\_segment"] = (

&#x20;           self.client\_stats\[

&#x20;               "client\_avg\_rating"

&#x20;           ]

&#x20;           .apply(client\_label)

&#x20;       )



print(

&#x20;           "Feature Engineering - "

&#x20;           "Client \& Driver Statistics fitted"

&#x20;       )



\# =========================================================

&#x20;   # Step 5.3 Client \& Driver Behaviour - TRANSFORM

&#x20;   # =========================================================



&#x20;   def \_apply\_clientdriver\_behaviour(self, df):



&#x20;       df = df.merge(

&#x20;           self.client\_stats\[

&#x20;               \[

&#x20;                   "client\_email",

&#x20;                   "client\_segment"

&#x20;               ]

&#x20;           ],



&#x20;           on="client\_email",



&#x20;           how="left"

&#x20;       )



df\["client\_segment"] = (

&#x20;           df\["client\_segment"]

&#x20;           .fillna(

&#x20;               "Client - unknown"

&#x20;           )

&#x20;       )



return df



\# =========================================================

&#x20;   # Step 5.4 Bad Client \& Driver - FIT

&#x20;   # =========================================================



&#x20;   def \_fit\_bad\_clientdriver(self, df):



&#x20;       df = df.copy()



df\["is\_bad\_rating"] = (

&#x20;           df\["final\_rating"]

&#x20;           .isin(\[

&#x20;               0,

&#x20;               1,

&#x20;               2

&#x20;           ])

&#x20;           .astype(int)

&#x20;       )



\# -------------------------

&#x20;       # Client bad rate

&#x20;       # -------------------------



&#x20;       self.client\_bad\_stats = (

&#x20;           df.groupby(

&#x20;               "client\_email"

&#x20;           )

&#x20;           .agg(

&#x20;               total=(

&#x20;                   "final\_rating",

&#x20;                   "count"

&#x20;               ),



&#x20;               bad\_count=(

&#x20;                   "is\_bad\_rating",

&#x20;                   "sum"

&#x20;               )

&#x20;           )

&#x20;           .reset\_index()

&#x20;       )



self.client\_bad\_stats\[

&#x20;           "client\_bad\_rate"

&#x20;       ] = (

&#x20;           self.client\_bad\_stats\[

&#x20;               "bad\_count"

&#x20;           ]

&#x20;           /

&#x20;           self.client\_bad\_stats\[

&#x20;               "total"

&#x20;           ]

&#x20;       )



top\_10\_bad\_clients = (

&#x20;           self.client\_bad\_stats

&#x20;           .sort\_values(

&#x20;               "client\_bad\_rate",

&#x20;               ascending=False

&#x20;           )

&#x20;           .head(10)

&#x20;       )



self.top\_bad\_clients = (

&#x20;           top\_10\_bad\_clients\[

&#x20;               "client\_email"

&#x20;           ]

&#x20;           .tolist()

&#x20;       )



print(

&#x20;           "Feature Engineering - "

&#x20;           "Bad Client Driver Statistics fitted"

&#x20;       )



\# =========================================================

&#x20;   # Step 5.4 Bad Client \& Driver - TRANSFORM

&#x20;   # =========================================================



&#x20;   def \_apply\_bad\_clientdriver(self, df):



&#x20;       df = df.copy()



df = df.merge(

&#x20;           self.client\_bad\_stats\[

&#x20;               \[

&#x20;                   "client\_email",

&#x20;                   "client\_bad\_rate"

&#x20;               ]

&#x20;           ],



&#x20;           on="client\_email",



&#x20;           how="left"

&#x20;       )



df\["client\_bad\_rate"] = (

&#x20;           df\["client\_bad\_rate"]

&#x20;           .fillna(0)

&#x20;       )



df\["is\_top\_bad\_client"] = (

&#x20;           df\["client\_email"]

&#x20;           .isin(

&#x20;               self.top\_bad\_clients

&#x20;           )

&#x20;           .astype(int)

&#x20;       )



\# Store for UI



&#x20;       df.attrs\[

&#x20;           "top\_10\_bad\_clients"

&#x20;       ] = self.top\_bad\_clients



return df



\# =========================

&#x20;   # Step 5.5 Top Comment Memory Store

&#x20;   # =========================



&#x20;   def \_top\_comment(self, df):



&#x20;       from collections import defaultdict



&#x20;       df = df.copy()



df\["comment"] = (

&#x20;           df\["comment"]

&#x20;           .fillna("")

&#x20;           .astype(str)

&#x20;       )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;       # RATING LEVEL

&#x20;       # =====================================================



&#x20;       rating\_db = (

&#x20;           df.groupby(

&#x20;               "final\_rating",

&#x20;               dropna=False

&#x20;           )\["comment"]

&#x20;           .value\_counts()

&#x20;           .groupby(level=0)

&#x20;           .head(10)

&#x20;           .groupby(level=0)

&#x20;           .apply(

&#x20;               lambda x:

&#x20;                   x.index

&#x20;                   .get\_level\_values(1)

&#x20;                   .tolist()

&#x20;           )

&#x20;           .to\_dict()

&#x20;       )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;       # CLIENT LEVEL

&#x20;       # =====================================================



&#x20;       client\_db = (

&#x20;           df.groupby(

&#x20;               "client\_email",

&#x20;               dropna=True

&#x20;           )\["comment"]

&#x20;           .value\_counts()

&#x20;           .groupby(level=0)

&#x20;           .head(10)

&#x20;           .groupby(level=0)

&#x20;           .apply(

&#x20;               lambda x:

&#x20;                   x.index

&#x20;                   .get\_level\_values(1)

&#x20;                   .tolist()

&#x20;           )

&#x20;           .to\_dict()

&#x20;       )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;       # STORE

&#x20;       # =====================================================



&#x20;       df.attrs\[

&#x20;           "top\_comments\_rating"

&#x20;       ] = rating\_db



&#x20;       df.attrs\[

&#x20;           "top\_comments\_client"

&#x20;       ] = client\_db



print(

&#x20;           "Pre-process - "

&#x20;           "Step 5.5 Top Comments Memory Built"

&#x20;       )



return df



\# =========================================================

&#x20;   # Step 5.6 Top Comment Clustering - FIT

&#x20;   # =========================================================



&#x20;   def \_fit\_top20\_comment(self, df):



&#x20;       import re



&#x20;       from sentence\_transformers import (

&#x20;           SentenceTransformer

&#x20;       )



&#x20;       from sklearn.cluster import (

&#x20;           AgglomerativeClustering

&#x20;       )



print(

&#x20;           "Feature Engineering - "

&#x20;           "Step 5.6 FIT Comment Clustering"

&#x20;       )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;       # 1. ONLY BAD REVIEWS

&#x20;       # =====================================================



&#x20;       df\_bad = df\[

&#x20;           df\["final\_rating"].isin(\[

&#x20;               0,

&#x20;               1,

&#x20;               2

&#x20;           ])

&#x20;       ].copy()



\# =====================================================

&#x20;       # 2. CLEAN COMMENTS

&#x20;       # =====================================================



&#x20;       df\_bad\["comment"] = (

&#x20;           df\_bad\["comment"]

&#x20;           .fillna("")

&#x20;           .astype(str)

&#x20;           .str.lower()

&#x20;       )



def clean\_text(text):



&#x20;           text = re.sub(

&#x20;               r'ðÿ\\S\*',

&#x20;               ' ',

&#x20;               text

&#x20;           )



&#x20;           text = re.sub(

&#x20;               r'\[^a-z0-9\\s]',

&#x20;               ' ',

&#x20;               text

&#x20;           )



&#x20;           text = re.sub(

&#x20;               r'\\s+',

&#x20;               ' ',

&#x20;               text

&#x20;           )



&#x20;           return text.strip()



df\_bad\["comment\_clean"] = (

&#x20;           df\_bad\["comment"]

&#x20;           .apply(clean\_text)

&#x20;       )



\# Remove empty comments



&#x20;       df\_bad = df\_bad\[

&#x20;           df\_bad\["comment\_clean"].str.len() > 0

&#x20;       ].copy()



\# =====================================================

&#x20;       # 3. COUNT COMMENT FREQUENCY

&#x20;       # =====================================================



&#x20;       comment\_counts = (

&#x20;           df\_bad\["comment\_clean"]

&#x20;           .value\_counts()

&#x20;       )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;       # 4. TOP 20 COMMENTS

&#x20;       # =====================================================



&#x20;       top20\_comments = (

&#x20;           comment\_counts

&#x20;           .head(20)

&#x20;       )



if top20\_comments.empty:



&#x20;           print(

&#x20;               "Step 5.6 - "

&#x20;               "No valid bad-review comments found"

&#x20;           )



&#x20;           self.comment\_embedding\_model = None



&#x20;           self.comment\_cluster\_centroids = {}



&#x20;           self.comment\_cluster\_samples = {}



&#x20;           self.comment\_cluster\_labels = {}



&#x20;           self.comment\_cluster\_cache = {}



&#x20;           self.comment\_business\_category\_cache = {}



&#x20;           self.top20\_comments = \[]



&#x20;           return



self.top20\_comments = (

&#x20;           top20\_comments.index.tolist()

&#x20;       )



print(

&#x20;           f"Step 5.6 - Top "

&#x20;           f"{len(self.top20\_comments)} "

&#x20;           f"comments selected"

&#x20;       )



for i, comment in enumerate(

&#x20;           self.top20\_comments,

&#x20;           start=1

&#x20;       ):



&#x20;           print(

&#x20;               f"  {i:02d}. "

&#x20;               f"{comment} "

&#x20;               f"(count="

&#x20;               f"{top20\_comments\[comment]}"

&#x20;               f")"

&#x20;           )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;       # 5. SENTENCE TRANSFORMER

&#x20;       # =====================================================



&#x20;       print(

&#x20;           "Step 5.6 - "

&#x20;           "Loading SentenceTransformer..."

&#x20;       )



self.comment\_embedding\_model = (

&#x20;           SentenceTransformer(

&#x20;               "all-MiniLM-L6-v2"

&#x20;           )

&#x20;       )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;       # 6. EMBED TOP 20 COMMENTS ONLY

&#x20;       # =====================================================



&#x20;       embeddings = (

&#x20;           self.comment\_embedding\_model.encode(

&#x20;               self.top20\_comments,



&#x20;               convert\_to\_numpy=True,



&#x20;               normalize\_embeddings=True,



&#x20;               batch\_size=20,



&#x20;               show\_progress\_bar=False

&#x20;           )

&#x20;       )



print(

&#x20;           f"Step 5.6 - Generated embeddings "

&#x20;           f"for {len(self.top20\_comments)} "

&#x20;           f"comments"

&#x20;       )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;       # 7. CREATE 10 CLUSTERS

&#x20;       # =====================================================



&#x20;       n\_clusters = min(

&#x20;           10,

&#x20;           len(self.top20\_comments)

&#x20;       )



if n\_clusters == 1:



&#x20;           clusters = np.zeros(

&#x20;               len(self.top20\_comments),

&#x20;               dtype=int

&#x20;           )



&#x20;       else:



&#x20;           cluster\_model = (

&#x20;               AgglomerativeClustering(

&#x20;                   n\_clusters=n\_clusters,

&#x20;                   metric="cosine",

&#x20;                   linkage="average"

&#x20;               )

&#x20;           )



&#x20;           clusters = (

&#x20;               cluster\_model

&#x20;               .fit\_predict(

&#x20;                   embeddings

&#x20;               )

&#x20;           )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;       # 8. STORE CLUSTER LABELS

&#x20;       # =====================================================



&#x20;       self.comment\_cluster\_labels = dict(

&#x20;           zip(

&#x20;               self.top20\_comments,

&#x20;               clusters

&#x20;           )

&#x20;       )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;       # IMPORTANT

&#x20;       #

&#x20;       # Initialise cache with the top 20 comments.

&#x20;       #

&#x20;       # The full training dataset will be added to this

&#x20;       # cache when \_apply\_top20\_comment() is called.

&#x20;       # =====================================================



&#x20;       self.comment\_cluster\_cache = dict(

&#x20;           self.comment\_cluster\_labels

&#x20;       )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;       # 9. STORE CLUSTER CENTROIDS

&#x20;       # =====================================================



&#x20;       self.comment\_cluster\_centroids = {}



&#x20;       self.comment\_cluster\_samples = {}



for cluster\_id in sorted(

&#x20;           set(clusters)

&#x20;       ):



&#x20;           cluster\_mask = (

&#x20;               clusters == cluster\_id

&#x20;           )



cluster\_embeddings = (

&#x20;               embeddings\[

&#x20;                   cluster\_mask

&#x20;               ]

&#x20;           )



\# Mean embedding



&#x20;           centroid = (

&#x20;               cluster\_embeddings

&#x20;               .mean(axis=0)

&#x20;           )



\# Normalize centroid



&#x20;           centroid\_norm = np.linalg.norm(

&#x20;               centroid

&#x20;           )



if centroid\_norm > 0:



&#x20;               centroid = (

&#x20;                   centroid /

&#x20;                   centroid\_norm

&#x20;               )



self.comment\_cluster\_centroids\[

&#x20;               cluster\_id

&#x20;           ] = centroid



\# ---------------------------------------------

&#x20;           # Store sample comments

&#x20;           # ---------------------------------------------



&#x20;           cluster\_comments = \[



&#x20;               self.top20\_comments\[i]



&#x20;               for i in range(

&#x20;                   len(self.top20\_comments)

&#x20;               )



&#x20;               if clusters\[i] == cluster\_id

&#x20;           ]



self.comment\_cluster\_samples\[

&#x20;               cluster\_id

&#x20;           ] = cluster\_comments\[:3]



print(

&#x20;           "Feature Engineering - "

&#x20;           "Step 5.6 FIT Top Comment "

&#x20;           "Clustering completed"

&#x20;       )



print(

&#x20;           f"Step 5.6 - "

&#x20;           f"{len(self.comment\_cluster\_centroids)} "

&#x20;           f"clusters created"

&#x20;       )



\# =========================================================

&#x20;   # Step 5.6 Top Comment Clustering - APPLY

&#x20;   #

&#x20;   # CACHE OPTIMIZED VERSION

&#x20;   # =========================================================



&#x20;   def \_apply\_top20\_comment(self, df):



&#x20;       import re



&#x20;       print(

&#x20;           "Feature Engineering - "

&#x20;           "Step 5.6 APPLY Comment Clustering"

&#x20;       )



df = df.copy()



\# =====================================================

&#x20;       # 1. CLEAN COMMENTS

&#x20;       # =====================================================



&#x20;       df\["comment"] = (

&#x20;           df\["comment"]

&#x20;           .fillna("")

&#x20;           .astype(str)

&#x20;           .str.lower()

&#x20;       )



def clean\_text(text):



&#x20;           text = re.sub(

&#x20;               r'ðÿ\\S\*',

&#x20;               ' ',

&#x20;               text

&#x20;           )



&#x20;           text = re.sub(

&#x20;               r'\[^a-z0-9\\s]',

&#x20;               ' ',

&#x20;               text

&#x20;           )



&#x20;           text = re.sub(

&#x20;               r'\\s+',

&#x20;               ' ',

&#x20;               text

&#x20;           )



&#x20;           return text.strip()



df\["comment\_clean"] = (

&#x20;           df\["comment"]

&#x20;           .apply(clean\_text)

&#x20;       )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;       # 2. CHECK WHETHER MODEL EXISTS

&#x20;       # =====================================================



&#x20;       if (

&#x20;           self.comment\_embedding\_model is None

&#x20;           or not self.comment\_cluster\_centroids

&#x20;       ):



&#x20;           df\["cluster"] = -1



&#x20;           df\["business\_categories"] = (

&#x20;               "Other / Acceptable Stay"

&#x20;           )



&#x20;           df\["sample\_comments"] = None



&#x20;           return df



\# =====================================================

&#x20;       # 3. UNIQUE NON-EMPTY COMMENTS ONLY

&#x20;       # =====================================================



&#x20;       unique\_comments = (

&#x20;           df.loc\[

&#x20;               df\["comment\_clean"].str.len() > 0,

&#x20;               "comment\_clean"

&#x20;           ]

&#x20;           .drop\_duplicates()

&#x20;           .tolist()

&#x20;       )



if not unique\_comments:



&#x20;           df\["cluster"] = -1



&#x20;           df\["business\_categories"] = (

&#x20;               "Other / Acceptable Stay"

&#x20;           )



&#x20;           df\["sample\_comments"] = None



&#x20;           return df



print(

&#x20;           f"Step 5.6 - Applying clustering to "

&#x20;           f"{len(unique\_comments):,} unique comments "

&#x20;           f"from {len(df):,} rows"

&#x20;       )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;       # 4. CHECK CACHE

&#x20;       #

&#x20;       # Only comments that have NEVER been processed

&#x20;       # will be sent to SentenceTransformer.

&#x20;       # =====================================================



&#x20;       comments\_to\_embed = \[



&#x20;           comment



&#x20;           for comment in unique\_comments



&#x20;           if comment not in self.comment\_cluster\_cache

&#x20;       ]



cached\_count = (

&#x20;           len(unique\_comments)

&#x20;           -

&#x20;           len(comments\_to\_embed)

&#x20;       )



print(

&#x20;           f"Step 5.6 - Cached comments: "

&#x20;           f"{cached\_count:,}"

&#x20;       )



print(

&#x20;           f"Step 5.6 - New comments requiring "

&#x20;           f"embedding: {len(comments\_to\_embed):,}"

&#x20;       )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;       # 5. ONLY EMBED NEW COMMENTS

&#x20;       # =====================================================



&#x20;       if comments\_to\_embed:



&#x20;           embeddings = (

&#x20;               self.comment\_embedding\_model.encode(



&#x20;                   comments\_to\_embed,



&#x20;                   convert\_to\_numpy=True,



&#x20;                   normalize\_embeddings=True,



&#x20;                   batch\_size=128,



&#x20;                   show\_progress\_bar=False

&#x20;               )

&#x20;           )



\# =================================================

&#x20;           # 6. BUILD CENTROID MATRIX

&#x20;           # =================================================



&#x20;           cluster\_ids = list(

&#x20;               self.comment\_cluster\_centroids.keys()

&#x20;           )



centroid\_matrix = np.vstack(

&#x20;               \[

&#x20;                   self.comment\_cluster\_centroids\[

&#x20;                       cluster\_id

&#x20;                   ]



&#x20;                   for cluster\_id in cluster\_ids

&#x20;               ]

&#x20;           )



\# =================================================

&#x20;           # 7. COSINE SIMILARITY

&#x20;           #

&#x20;           # Both embeddings and centroids are normalized.

&#x20;           #

&#x20;           # Therefore:

&#x20;           #

&#x20;           # cosine similarity = dot product

&#x20;           # =================================================



&#x20;           similarity\_matrix = (

&#x20;               embeddings

&#x20;               @

&#x20;               centroid\_matrix.T

&#x20;           )



\# =================================================

&#x20;           # 8. FIND BEST CLUSTER

&#x20;           # =================================================



&#x20;           best\_cluster\_indices = (

&#x20;               np.argmax(

&#x20;                   similarity\_matrix,

&#x20;                   axis=1

&#x20;               )

&#x20;           )



unique\_cluster\_labels = \[



&#x20;               cluster\_ids\[index]



&#x20;               for index in best\_cluster\_indices

&#x20;           ]



\# =================================================

&#x20;           # 9. UPDATE CACHE

&#x20;           # =================================================



&#x20;           for comment, cluster\_id in zip(

&#x20;               comments\_to\_embed,

&#x20;               unique\_cluster\_labels

&#x20;           ):



&#x20;               self.comment\_cluster\_cache\[

&#x20;                   comment

&#x20;               ] = cluster\_id



print(

&#x20;               f"Step 5.6 - Added "

&#x20;               f"{len(comments\_to\_embed):,} "

&#x20;               f"comments to cluster cache"

&#x20;           )



else:



&#x20;           # =================================================

&#x20;           # IMPORTANT

&#x20;           #

&#x20;           # No new embeddings required.

&#x20;           # =================================================



&#x20;           print(

&#x20;               "Step 5.6 - All comments already cached."

&#x20;           )



&#x20;           print(

&#x20;               "Step 5.6 - Skipping "

&#x20;               "SentenceTransformer embedding."

&#x20;           )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;       # 10. COMMENT -> CLUSTER LOOKUP

&#x20;       # =====================================================



&#x20;       df\["cluster"] = (

&#x20;           df\["comment\_clean"]

&#x20;           .map(

&#x20;               self.comment\_cluster\_cache

&#x20;           )

&#x20;           .fillna(-1)

&#x20;           .astype(int)

&#x20;       )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;       # 11. BUSINESS CATEGORIES

&#x20;       # =====================================================



&#x20;       def extract\_business(text):



&#x20;           labels = \[]



\# -------------------------

&#x20;           # Room Cleanliness

&#x20;           # -------------------------



&#x20;           if any(

&#x20;               keyword in text



&#x20;               for keyword in \[



&#x20;                   "dirty",

&#x20;                   "unclean",

&#x20;                   "hair",

&#x20;                   "bedsheet",

&#x20;                   "bathroom dirty"

&#x20;               ]

&#x20;           ):



&#x20;               labels.append(

&#x20;                   "Room Cleanliness Issue"

&#x20;               )



\# -------------------------

&#x20;           # Room Condition / Maintenance Issue

&#x20;           # -------------------------



&#x20;           if any(

&#x20;               keyword in text



&#x20;               for keyword in \[



&#x20;                   "broken",

&#x20;                   "damaged",

&#x20;                   "not working",

&#x20;                   "does not work",

&#x20;                   "did not work",

&#x20;                   "air conditioning",

&#x20;                   "aircon",

&#x20;                   "a c",

&#x20;                   "ac not",

&#x20;                   "shower",

&#x20;                   "water pressure",

&#x20;                   "hot water",

&#x20;                   "toilet",

&#x20;                   "bathroom",

&#x20;                   "leak",

&#x20;                   "leaking",

&#x20;                   "maintenance",

&#x20;                   "light not",

print(

\# =====================================================

&#x20;       # 8. CREATE 10 CLUSTERS

&#x20;       # =====================================================



&#x20;       n\_clusters = min(

&#x20;           10,

&#x20;           len(self.top20\_comments)

clusters = (

&#x20;       self.comment\_cluster\_cache = dict(

&#x20;           self.comment\_cluster\_labels

\# =====================================================

&#x20;       # 11. STORE CLUSTER CENTROIDS

&#x20;       self.comment\_cluster\_centroids = {}



&#x20;       self.comment\_cluster\_samples = {}



for cluster\_id in sorted(

&#x20;           set(clusters)

&#x20;           cluster\_mask = (

&#x20;               clusters == cluster\_id

&#x20;           )

&#x20;               embeddings\[

&#x20;                   cluster\_mask

&#x20;           centroid\_norm = np.linalg.norm(

&#x20;               centroid

if centroid\_norm > 0:



&#x20;               centroid = (

&#x20;                   centroid

&#x20;                   /

&#x20;                   centroid\_norm

&#x20;               )



self.comment\_cluster\_centroids\[

&#x20;               cluster\_id

&#x20;           ] = centroid



\# =================================================

&#x20;           # Store sample comments

&#x20;           # =================================================



&#x20;           cluster\_comments = \[



&#x20;               self.top20\_comments\[i]



&#x20;               for i in range(

&#x20;                   len(self.top20\_comments)

&#x20;               )



&#x20;               if clusters\[i] == cluster\_id

self.comment\_cluster\_samples\[

&#x20;   def \_apply\_top20\_comment(self, df):

df = df.copy()

def clean\_text(text):

&#x20;           text = re.sub(

&#x20;               r'\\s+',

&#x20;               ' ',

&#x20;               text

df\["comment\_clean"] = (

\# =====================================================

&#x20;       # 2. CHECK WHETHER MODEL EXISTS

&#x20;       if (

\# =====================================================

&#x20;       # 3. ENSURE CACHE EXISTS

&#x20;       #

&#x20;       # IMPORTANT:

&#x20;       # Older feature\_engineering.pkl files may have been

&#x20;       #

&#x20;       # This prevents:

&#x20;       # AttributeError:

&#x20;       if not hasattr(

\# =====================================================

&#x20;       if (

&#x20;           not self.comment\_cluster\_cache

&#x20;           and getattr(

&#x20;               self,

&#x20;               "comment\_cluster\_labels",

&#x20;               None

&#x20;           self.comment\_cluster\_cache = dict(

&#x20;               self.comment\_cluster\_labels

&#x20;           )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;       # 5. UNIQUE NON-EMPTY COMMENTS ONLY

&#x20;       # =====================================================



&#x20;       unique\_comments = (

&#x20;           df.loc\[

&#x20;           ]

&#x20;           .drop\_duplicates()

&#x20;           .tolist()

&#x20;       )



if not unique\_comments:



&#x20;           df\["cluster"] = -1



&#x20;           df\["business\_categories"] = (

&#x20;               "Other / Acceptable Stay"

&#x20;           )



&#x20;           df\["sample\_comments"] = None



&#x20;           return df



print(

&#x20;           f"Step 5.6 - Applying clustering to "

&#x20;           f"{len(unique\_comments):,} unique comments "

&#x20;           f"from {len(df):,} rows"

&#x20;       )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;       # 6. FIND COMMENTS NOT IN CACHE

&#x20;       # =====================================================



&#x20;       uncached\_comments = \[



&#x20;           comment



&#x20;           for comment in unique\_comments



&#x20;           if comment not in self.comment\_cluster\_cache

&#x20;       ]



cached\_count = (

&#x20;           len(unique\_comments)

&#x20;           -

&#x20;           len(uncached\_comments)

&#x20;       )



print(

&#x20;           f"Step 5.6 - Cached comments: "

&#x20;           f"{cached\_count:,}"

&#x20;       )



print(

&#x20;           f"Step 5.6 - New comments requiring embedding: "

&#x20;           f"{len(uncached\_comments):,}"

&#x20;       )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;       # 7. EMBED ONLY NEW COMMENTS

&#x20;       # =====================================================



&#x20;       if uncached\_comments:



&#x20;           embeddings = (

&#x20;               self.comment\_embedding\_model.encode(



&#x20;                   uncached\_comments,



&#x20;                   convert\_to\_numpy=True,



&#x20;                   normalize\_embeddings=True,



&#x20;                   batch\_size=64,



&#x20;                   show\_progress\_bar=False

&#x20;               )

\# =================================================

&#x20;           # 8. BUILD CENTROID MATRIX

&#x20;           # =================================================



&#x20;           cluster\_ids = list(

&#x20;               self.comment\_cluster\_centroids.keys()

&#x20;           )



centroid\_matrix = np.vstack(

&#x20;               \[

&#x20;                   self.comment\_cluster\_centroids\[

&#x20;                       cluster\_id

&#x20;                   ]



&#x20;                   for cluster\_id in cluster\_ids

&#x20;           )



\# =================================================

&#x20;           similarity\_matrix = (

&#x20;               embeddings

&#x20;               @

&#x20;               centroid\_matrix.T

&#x20;           )



\# =================================================

&#x20;           # 10. FIND BEST CLUSTER

&#x20;           # =================================================



&#x20;           best\_cluster\_indices = (

&#x20;               np.argmax(

&#x20;                   similarity\_matrix,

&#x20;                   axis=1

&#x20;               )

&#x20;           )



unique\_cluster\_labels = \[



&#x20;               cluster\_ids\[index]



&#x20;               for index

&#x20;               in best\_cluster\_indices

&#x20;           ]



\# =================================================

&#x20;           # 11. ADD NEW RESULTS TO CACHE

&#x20;           # =================================================



&#x20;           for comment, cluster\_id in zip(

&#x20;               uncached\_comments,

&#x20;               unique\_cluster\_labels

&#x20;           ):



&#x20;               self.comment\_cluster\_cache\[

&#x20;                   comment

&#x20;               ] = cluster\_id



\# =====================================================

&#x20;       # 12. COMMENT -> CLUSTER LOOKUP

&#x20;       # =====================================================

&#x20;           .astype(int)

&#x20;       )

8/28/2026, 12:16:42 AM



Yes. If business\_categories is produced by Feature Engineering and then effectively looked up/joined by client\_email, you should not count every repeated row as a separate business-category occurrence.



For example, if one client has 50 hotel records and the same business\_categories is attached to all 50 rows, a direct value\_counts() would count that category 50 times. If your intention is client-level feedback/category counting, EDA should first reduce the data to the unique client\_email + business\_categories combinations.



There is also a separate bug in your current code: fig1 uses rating\_counts, which always contains final\_rating, even when target\_filter == "reservation\_status\_label".



Below is a revised eda\_page.py that keeps your existing structure but fixes the business-category counting to use unique client/category combinations.



\# =========================================================

\# src/eda\_page.py

\# =========================================================



import pandas as pd

import numpy as np

import plotly.express as px



from dash import html, dcc, Input, Output



from preprocess import DataProcessor



print("Load EDA Page")



\# =========================================================

\# REVERSE MAPPINGS

\# =========================================================



REVERSE\_MAPPINGS = DataProcessor.REVERSE\_MAPPINGS



\# =========================================================

\# PREPARE EDA DATA

\# =========================================================

\#

\# IMPORTANT:

\#

\# app.py has already done:

\#

\#     DataProcessor.transform()

\#     FeatureEngineer.transform()

\#

\# Therefore this function ONLY prepares display labels.

\#

\# It does NOT:

\#     - fit anything

\#     - transform anything

\#     - engineer features

\#     - modify df.attrs

\#

\# =========================================================



def prepare\_eda\_data(df):



&#x20;   df = df.copy()



&#x20;   # =====================================================

&#x20;   # SERVICE LABEL

&#x20;   # =====================================================



&#x20;   if "final\_rating" in df.columns:



&#x20;       df\["service\_label"] = df\[

&#x20;           "final\_rating"

&#x20;       ].apply(

&#x20;           lambda x:

&#x20;               "Bad"

&#x20;               if x in \[0, 1, 2]

&#x20;               else "Neutral"

&#x20;               if x == 3

&#x20;               else "Good"

&#x20;               if x in \[4, 5, 6]

&#x20;               else "Unknown"

&#x20;       )



&#x20;   else:



&#x20;       df\["service\_label"] = "Unknown"



&#x20;   # =====================================================

&#x20;   # ENCODE LABELS

&#x20;   # =====================================================



&#x20;   for col, mapping in REVERSE\_MAPPINGS.items():



&#x20;       if col in df.columns:



&#x20;           df\[col + "\_label"] = (

&#x20;               df\[col]

&#x20;               .map(mapping)

&#x20;               .fillna("Unknown")

&#x20;           )



&#x20;   return df



\# =========================================================

\# CREATE EDA LAYOUT

\# =========================================================

&#x20;           df\["hotel\_label"]

&#x20;           .dropna()

&#x20;           .unique()

&#x20;       ]



&#x20;   else:



&#x20;       branch\_options = \[]

&#x20;   # LAYOUT

&#x20;   return html.Div(\[

&#x20;       # =================================================

&#x20;           # -------------------------------------------------



&#x20;           dcc.Dropdown(

&#x20;                   {

&#x20;                       'label': 'Final Rating',

&#x20;                   },

&#x20;                   {

&#x20;           dcc.Dropdown(

&#x20;                   {

&#x20;                       "value": "Good"

&#x20;                   {

&#x20;                       "value": "Neutral"

&#x20;                   },



&#x20;                   {

&#x20;                       "label": "Bad (0-2)",

&#x20;                       "value": "Bad"

&#x20;                   }



&#x20;               ],



&#x20;               value="All"

&#x20;           # -------------------------------------------------

&#x20;           dcc.Dropdown(

def register\_callbacks(app, df):



&#x20;   # =====================================================

&#x20;   # PREPARE ONCE

&#x20;   # =====================================================



&#x20;   df = prepare\_eda\_data(

&#x20;       df

&#x20;   )



&#x20;   print(

&#x20;       f"\[INFO] EDA dataframe ready: {df.shape}"

&#x20;   )



&#x20;   # =====================================================

&#x20;   # CALLBACK

&#x20;   # =====================================================



&#x20;   @app.callback(



&#x20;       Output('kpis', 'children'),

&#x20;       Output('rating\_chart', 'figure'),

&#x20;       Output('service\_by\_hotel', 'figure'),

&#x20;       Output('service\_level\_hotel', 'figure'),

&#x20;       Output('service\_level\_meal', 'figure'),

&#x20;       Output('service\_level\_market\_segment', 'figure'),

&#x20;       Output('service\_level\_distribution\_channel', 'figure'),

&#x20;       Output('service\_level\_deposit\_type', 'figure'),

&#x20;       Output('service\_level\_customer\_type', 'figure'),

&#x20;       Output('service\_level\_season\_group', 'figure'),

&#x20;       Output('service\_level\_country\_group', 'figure'),

&#x20;       Output('service\_level\_adr\_group', 'figure'),

&#x20;       Output('service\_level\_previous\_cancellations\_group', 'figure'),

&#x20;       Output('service\_level\_days\_in\_waiting\_list\_group', 'figure'),

&#x20;       Output('service\_level\_guest\_group', 'figure'),

&#x20;       Output('service\_level\_is\_top\_bad\_client', 'figure'),

&#x20;       Output('customer\_comment', 'figure'),



&#x20;       Input('target\_filter', 'value'),

&#x20;       Input('service\_filter', 'value'),

&#x20;       Input('branch\_filter', 'value')

&#x20;   )



&#x20;   def update\_dashboard(

&#x20;       target\_filter,

&#x20;       service\_filter,

&#x20;       branch\_filter

&#x20;   ):



&#x20;       # =================================================

&#x20;       # FILTER DATA

&#x20;       # =================================================



&#x20;       dff = df.copy()



&#x20;       # -------------------------------------------------

&#x20;       # TARGET

&#x20;       # -------------------------------------------------



&#x20;       target\_column = target\_filter



&#x20;       # Safety check

&#x20;       if target\_column not in dff.columns:



&#x20;           target\_column = "final\_rating"



&#x20;       # -------------------------------------------------

&#x20;       # SERVICE FILTER

&#x20;       # -------------------------------------------------



&#x20;       if (

&#x20;           service\_filter

&#x20;           and service\_filter != "All"

&#x20;       ):



&#x20;           dff = dff\[

&#x20;               dff\["service\_label"]

&#x20;               == service\_filter

&#x20;           ]



&#x20;       # -------------------------------------------------

&#x20;       # BRANCH FILTER

&#x20;       # -------------------------------------------------



&#x20;       if branch\_filter:



&#x20;           if "hotel\_label" in dff.columns:



&#x20;               dff = dff\[

&#x20;                   dff\[

&#x20;                       "hotel\_label"

&#x20;                   ].isin(

&#x20;                       branch\_filter

&#x20;                   )

&#x20;               ]



&#x20;       # =================================================

&#x20;       # KPI

&#x20;       # =================================================



&#x20;       total = len(dff)



&#x20;       if (

&#x20;           total > 0

&#x20;           and

&#x20;           "final\_rating" in dff.columns

&#x20;       ):



&#x20;           avg\_rating = dff\[

&#x20;               "final\_rating"

&#x20;           ].mean()



&#x20;       else:



&#x20;           avg\_rating = 0



&#x20;       good = len(

&#x20;           dff\[

&#x20;               dff\["service\_label"]

&#x20;               == "Good"

&#x20;           ]

&#x20;       )



&#x20;       neutral = len(

&#x20;           dff\[

&#x20;               dff\["service\_label"]

&#x20;               == "Neutral"

&#x20;           ]

&#x20;       )



&#x20;       bad = len(

&#x20;           dff\[

&#x20;               dff\["service\_label"]

&#x20;               == "Bad"

&#x20;           ]

&#x20;       )



&#x20;       kpis = \[



&#x20;           html.Div(

&#x20;               f"Total: {total}"

&#x20;           ),



&#x20;           html.Div(

&#x20;               f"Avg Rating: {avg\_rating:.2f}"

&#x20;           ),



&#x20;           html.Div(

&#x20;               f"Good: {good}"

&#x20;           ),



&#x20;           html.Div(

&#x20;               f"Neutral: {neutral}"

&#x20;           ),



&#x20;           html.Div(

&#x20;               f"Bad: {bad}"

&#x20;           )



&#x20;       ]



&#x20;       # =================================================

&#x20;       # TARGET DISTRIBUTION

&#x20;       # =================================================



&#x20;       if target\_column == "final\_rating":



&#x20;           rating\_counts = (

&#x20;               dff\["final\_rating"]

&#x20;               .dropna()

&#x20;               .value\_counts()

&#x20;               .reindex(

&#x20;                   \[0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6],

&#x20;                   fill\_value=0

&#x20;               )

&#x20;               .reset\_index()

&#x20;           )



&#x20;           rating\_counts.columns = \[

&#x20;               "final\_rating",

&#x20;               "count"

&#x20;           ]



&#x20;           fig1 = px.pie(

&#x20;               rating\_counts,

&#x20;               names="final\_rating",

&#x20;               values="count",

&#x20;               title="Final Rating Distribution",

&#x20;               hole=0.4

&#x20;           )



&#x20;       else:



&#x20;           target\_counts = (

&#x20;               dff\[target\_column]

&#x20;               .dropna()

&#x20;               .value\_counts()

&#x20;               .reset\_index()

&#x20;           )



&#x20;           target\_counts.columns = \[

&#x20;               target\_column,

&#x20;               "count"

&#x20;           ]



&#x20;           fig1 = px.pie(

&#x20;               target\_counts,

&#x20;               names=target\_column,

&#x20;               values="count",

&#x20;               title="Reservation Status Distribution",

&#x20;               hole=0.4

&#x20;           )



&#x20;       fig1.update\_traces(

&#x20;           textinfo="percent+label"

&#x20;       )



&#x20;       # =================================================

&#x20;       # SERVICE BY BRANCH

&#x20;       # =================================================



&#x20;       if (

&#x20;           "hotel\_label" in dff.columns

&#x20;           and

&#x20;           target\_column in dff.columns

&#x20;       ):



&#x20;           branch\_df = (

&#x20;               dff

&#x20;               .groupby(

&#x20;                   \[

&#x20;                       "hotel\_label",

&#x20;                       target\_column

&#x20;                   ]

&#x20;               )

&#x20;               .size()

&#x20;               .reset\_index(

&#x20;                   name="count"

&#x20;               )

&#x20;           )



&#x20;       else:



&#x20;           branch\_df = pd.DataFrame(

&#x20;               columns=\[

&#x20;                   "hotel\_label",

&#x20;                   target\_column,

&#x20;                   "count"

&#x20;               ]

&#x20;           )



&#x20;       fig2 = px.bar(

&#x20;           branch\_df,

&#x20;           x="hotel\_label",

&#x20;           y="count",

&#x20;           color=target\_column,

&#x20;           barmode="group",

&#x20;           title=(

&#x20;               "Final Rating by Hotel"

&#x20;               if target\_column == "final\_rating"

&#x20;               else "Reservation Status by Hotel"

&#x20;           )

&#x20;       )



&#x20;       # =================================================

&#x20;       # HELPER FUNCTION

&#x20;       # =================================================



&#x20;       def safe\_histogram(

&#x20;           data,

&#x20;           color\_column,

&#x20;           title

&#x20;       ):



&#x20;           if (

&#x20;               target\_column not in data.columns

&#x20;               or

&#x20;               color\_column not in data.columns

&#x20;           ):



&#x20;               return px.bar(

&#x20;                   title=title

&#x20;               )



&#x20;           return px.histogram(

&#x20;               data,

&#x20;               x=target\_column,

&#x20;               color=color\_column,

&#x20;               barmode="group",

&#x20;               title=title

&#x20;           )



&#x20;       # =================================================

&#x20;       # SERVICE LEVEL CHARTS

&#x20;       # =================================================



&#x20;       service\_level\_hotel = safe\_histogram(

&#x20;           dff,

&#x20;           "hotel\_label",

&#x20;           "Service Level by hotel"

&#x20;       )



&#x20;       service\_level\_meal = safe\_histogram(

&#x20;           dff,

&#x20;           "meal\_label",

&#x20;           "Service Level by meal"

&#x20;       )



&#x20;       service\_level\_market\_segment = safe\_histogram(

&#x20;           dff,

&#x20;           "market\_segment\_label",

&#x20;           "Service Level by market segment"

&#x20;       )



&#x20;       service\_level\_distribution\_channel = safe\_histogram(

&#x20;           dff,

&#x20;           "distribution\_channel\_label",

&#x20;           "Service Level by distribution channel"

&#x20;       )



&#x20;       service\_level\_deposit\_type = safe\_histogram(

&#x20;           dff,

&#x20;           "deposit\_type\_group",

&#x20;           "Service Level by deposit type"

&#x20;       )



&#x20;       service\_level\_customer\_type = safe\_histogram(

&#x20;           dff,

&#x20;           "customer\_type",

&#x20;           "Service Level by customer type"

&#x20;       )



&#x20;       service\_level\_season\_group = safe\_histogram(

&#x20;           dff,

&#x20;           "season\_group",

&#x20;           "Service Level by season"

&#x20;       )



&#x20;       service\_level\_country\_group = safe\_histogram(

&#x20;           dff,

&#x20;           "country\_group",

&#x20;           "Service Level by country"

&#x20;       )



&#x20;       service\_level\_adr\_group = safe\_histogram(

&#x20;           dff,

&#x20;           "adr\_group",

&#x20;           "Service Level by average daily rate"

&#x20;       )



&#x20;       # FIXED COLUMN NAME

&#x20;       service\_level\_previous\_cancellations\_group = safe\_histogram(

&#x20;           dff,

&#x20;           "previous\_cancellations\_group",

&#x20;           "Service Level by previous cancellations"

&#x20;       )



&#x20;       service\_level\_days\_in\_waiting\_list\_group = safe\_histogram(

&#x20;           dff,

&#x20;           "days\_in\_waiting\_list\_group",

&#x20;           "Service Level by days in waiting list"

&#x20;       )



&#x20;       service\_level\_guest\_group = safe\_histogram(

&#x20;           dff,

&#x20;           "guest\_group",

&#x20;           "Service Level by guest group"

&#x20;       )



&#x20;       # =================================================

&#x20;       # TOP CLIENT FILTER

&#x20;       # =================================================



&#x20;       if service\_filter == "Bad":



&#x20;           rating\_mask = \[0, 1, 2]



&#x20;       elif service\_filter == "Neutral":



&#x20;           rating\_mask = \[3]



&#x20;       elif service\_filter == "Good":



&#x20;           rating\_mask = \[4, 5, 6]



&#x20;       else:



&#x20;           rating\_mask = \[

&#x20;               0,

&#x20;               1,

&#x20;               2,

&#x20;               3,

&#x20;               4,

&#x20;               5,

&#x20;               6

&#x20;           ]



&#x20;       # =================================================

&#x20;       # TOP CLIENTS

&#x20;       # =================================================



&#x20;       if (

&#x20;           "client\_email" in dff.columns

&#x20;           and

&#x20;           "final\_rating" in dff.columns

&#x20;       ):



&#x20;           top\_clients = (

&#x20;               dff\[

&#x20;                   dff\[

&#x20;                       "final\_rating"

&#x20;                   ].isin(

&#x20;                       rating\_mask

&#x20;                   )

&#x20;               ]

&#x20;               .groupby(

&#x20;                   "client\_email"

&#x20;               )

&#x20;               .size()

&#x20;               .reset\_index(

&#x20;                   name="count"

&#x20;               )

&#x20;               .sort\_values(

&#x20;                   "count",

&#x20;                   ascending=False

&#x20;               )

&#x20;               .head(10)

&#x20;           )



&#x20;       else:



&#x20;           top\_clients = pd.DataFrame(

&#x20;               columns=\[

&#x20;                   "client\_email",

&#x20;                   "count"

&#x20;               ]

&#x20;           )



&#x20;       fig\_top\_clients = px.bar(

&#x20;           top\_clients,

&#x20;           x="client\_email",

&#x20;           y="count",

&#x20;           title=(

&#x20;               "Top 10 Clients "

&#x20;               "(Filtered Ratings)"

&#x20;           ),

&#x20;           text="count"

&#x20;       )



&#x20;       fig\_top\_clients.update\_layout(

&#x20;           xaxis\_title="client\_email",

&#x20;           yaxis\_title="Count of Ratings"

&#x20;       )



&#x20;       # =================================================

&#x20;       # BUSINESS CATEGORY SUMMARY

&#x20;       # =================================================

&#x20;       #

&#x20;       # IMPORTANT:

&#x20;       #

&#x20;       # FeatureEngineer provides:

&#x20;       #

&#x20;       #     client\_email

&#x20;       #     business\_categories

&#x20;       #

&#x20;       # The same client may appear in many booking rows.

&#x20;       #

&#x20;       # Therefore:

&#x20;       #

&#x20;       #     DO NOT count every row.

&#x20;       #

&#x20;       # Instead:

&#x20;       #

&#x20;       #     1. Keep client\_email

&#x20;       #     2. Explode business\_categories

&#x20;       #     3. Remove duplicate

&#x20;       #        client\_email + category

&#x20;       #        combinations

&#x20;       #     4. Count unique clients per category

&#x20;       #

&#x20;       # Example:

&#x20;       #

&#x20;       # Client A -> Cleanliness

&#x20;       # Client A -> Cleanliness

&#x20;       # Client A -> Cleanliness

&#x20;       #

&#x20;       # becomes:

&#x20;       #

&#x20;       # Client A -> Cleanliness

&#x20;       #

&#x20;       # and therefore counts as 1 client.

&#x20;       #

&#x20;       # =================================================



&#x20;       if (

&#x20;           "client\_email" in dff.columns

&#x20;           and

&#x20;           "business\_categories" in dff.columns

&#x20;       ):



&#x20;           df\_business = (

&#x20;               dff\[

&#x20;                   \[

&#x20;                       "client\_email",

&#x20;                       "business\_categories"

&#x20;                   ]

&#x20;               ]

&#x20;               .dropna(

&#x20;                   subset=\[

&#x20;                       "client\_email",

&#x20;                       "business\_categories"

&#x20;                   ]

&#x20;               )

&#x20;               .explode(

&#x20;                   "business\_categories"

&#x20;               )

&#x20;           )



&#x20;           # Remove empty categories

&#x20;           df\_business = df\_business\[

&#x20;               df\_business\[

&#x20;                   "business\_categories"

&#x20;               ].notna()

&#x20;           ]



&#x20;           # -------------------------------------------------

&#x20;           # IMPORTANT:

&#x20;           #

&#x20;           # One client/category combination = one count

&#x20;           #

&#x20;           # This prevents repeated vlookup values from

&#x20;           # inflating the business-category count.

&#x20;           # -------------------------------------------------



&#x20;           df\_business = (

&#x20;               df\_business\[

&#x20;                   \[

&#x20;                       "client\_email",

&#x20;                       "business\_categories"

&#x20;                   ]

&#x20;               ]

&#x20;               .drop\_duplicates(

&#x20;                   subset=\[

&#x20;                       "client\_email",

&#x20;                       "business\_categories"

&#x20;                   ]

&#x20;               )

&#x20;           )



&#x20;           # -------------------------------------------------

&#x20;           # Count unique clients for each category

&#x20;           # -------------------------------------------------



&#x20;           business\_summary = (

&#x20;               df\_business

&#x20;               .groupby(

&#x20;                   "business\_categories"

&#x20;               )\[

&#x20;                   "client\_email"

&#x20;               ]

&#x20;               .nunique()

&#x20;               .reset\_index(

&#x20;                   name="count"

&#x20;               )

&#x20;               .sort\_values(

&#x20;                   "count",

&#x20;                   ascending=False

&#x20;               )

&#x20;           )



&#x20;       elif "business\_categories" in dff.columns:



&#x20;           # -------------------------------------------------

&#x20;           # Fallback if client\_email is unavailable

&#x20;           # -------------------------------------------------



&#x20;           df\_business = (

&#x20;       data\["comment"] = (

&#x20;           data\["comment"]

&#x20;           .fillna("")

&#x20;           .astype(str)

&#x20;       )



\# =========================================================

&#x20;   # STRUCTURED FEATURES

&#x20;   # =========================================================



&#x20;   structured\_features = \[



&#x20;       "hotel",

&#x20;       "meal",

&#x20;       "market\_segment",

&#x20;       "distribution\_channel",

&#x20;       "deposit\_type",

&#x20;       "customer\_type",

&#x20;       "season\_group",

&#x20;       "country\_group",

&#x20;       "adr\_group",

&#x20;       "previous\_cancellations\_group",

&#x20;       "days\_in\_waiting\_list\_group",

&#x20;       "guest\_group",

&#x20;       "client\_segment",

&#x20;       "is\_top\_bad\_client",

&#x20;       "client\_bad\_rate"



&#x20;   ]



\# =========================================================

&#x20;   # MAKE SURE STRUCTURED FEATURES EXIST

&#x20;   # =========================================================



&#x20;   for data in \[

&#x20;       train\_df,

&#x20;       val\_df,

&#x20;       test\_df

&#x20;   ]:



&#x20;       for col in structured\_features:



&#x20;           if col not in data.columns:



&#x20;               data\[col] = "unknown"



\# =========================================================

&#x20;   # COMMENT TOPIC LEARNING

&#x20;   #

&#x20;   # IMPORTANT:

&#x20;   #

&#x20;   # TF-IDF and SVD are FIT ONLY ON TRAINING DATA.

&#x20;   #

&#x20;   # Validation and test are TRANSFORMED using

&#x20;   # the already-fitted objects.

&#x20;   # =========================================================



&#x20;   print()

&#x20;   print("==============================")

&#x20;   print("COMMENT TOPIC LEARNING")

&#x20;   print("==============================")



self.comment\_tfidf = TfidfVectorizer(

&#x20;       max\_features=5000,

&#x20;       ngram\_range=(1, 2),

&#x20;       min\_df=3

&#x20;   )



self.comment\_svd = TruncatedSVD(

&#x20;       n\_components=30,

&#x20;       random\_state=42

&#x20;   )



print(

&#x20;       "Fitting comment TF-IDF on training data..."

&#x20;   )



train\_comment\_tfidf = (

&#x20;       self.comment\_tfidf.fit\_transform(

&#x20;           train\_df\["comment"]

&#x20;       )

&#x20;   )



print(

&#x20;       "Fitting comment SVD on training data..."

&#x20;   )



train\_comment\_features\_array = (

&#x20;       self.comment\_svd.fit\_transform(

&#x20;           train\_comment\_tfidf

&#x20;       )

&#x20;   )



print(

&#x20;       "Transforming validation comments..."

&#x20;   )



val\_comment\_tfidf = (

&#x20;       self.comment\_tfidf.transform(

&#x20;           val\_df\["comment"]

&#x20;       )

&#x20;   )



val\_comment\_features\_array = (

&#x20;       self.comment\_svd.transform(

&#x20;           val\_comment\_tfidf

&#x20;       )

&#x20;   )



print(

&#x20;       "Transforming test comments..."

&#x20;   )



test\_comment\_tfidf = (

&#x20;       self.comment\_tfidf.transform(

&#x20;           test\_df\["comment"]

&#x20;       )

&#x20;   )



test\_comment\_features\_array = (

&#x20;       self.comment\_svd.transform(

&#x20;           test\_comment\_tfidf

&#x20;       )

&#x20;   )



comment\_columns = \[



&#x20;       f"comment\_topic\_{i}"



&#x20;       for i in range(

&#x20;           train\_comment\_features\_array.shape\[1]

&#x20;       )



&#x20;   ]



train\_comment\_features = pd.DataFrame(

&#x20;       train\_comment\_features\_array,

&#x20;       columns=comment\_columns,

&#x20;       index=train\_df.index

&#x20;   )



val\_comment\_features = pd.DataFrame(

&#x20;       val\_comment\_features\_array,

&#x20;       columns=comment\_columns,

&#x20;       index=val\_df.index

&#x20;   )



test\_comment\_features = pd.DataFrame(

&#x20;       test\_comment\_features\_array,

&#x20;       columns=comment\_columns,

&#x20;       index=test\_df.index

&#x20;   )



\# =========================================================

&#x20;   # ATTACH COMMENT FEATURES

&#x20;   # =========================================================



&#x20;   train\_df = pd.concat(

&#x20;       \[

&#x20;           train\_df,

&#x20;           train\_comment\_features

&#x20;       ],

&#x20;       axis=1

&#x20;   )



val\_df = pd.concat(

&#x20;       \[

&#x20;           val\_df,

&#x20;           val\_comment\_features

&#x20;       ],

&#x20;       axis=1

&#x20;   )



test\_df = pd.concat(

&#x20;       \[

&#x20;           test\_df,

&#x20;           test\_comment\_features

&#x20;       ],

&#x20;       axis=1

&#x20;   )



structured\_features\_with\_comments = (

&#x20;       structured\_features +

&#x20;       comment\_columns

&#x20;   )



\# =========================================================

&#x20;   # TARGETS

&#x20;   # =========================================================



&#x20;   y\_train = train\_df\[

&#x20;       "final\_rating"

&#x20;   ]



&#x20;   y\_val = val\_df\[

&#x20;       "final\_rating"

&#x20;   ]



&#x20;   y\_test = test\_df\[

&#x20;       "final\_rating"

&#x20;   ]



y\_status\_train = train\_df\[

&#x20;       "reservation\_status"

&#x20;   ]



&#x20;   y\_status\_val = val\_df\[

&#x20;       "reservation\_status"

&#x20;   ]



&#x20;   y\_status\_test = test\_df\[

&#x20;       "reservation\_status"

&#x20;   ]



\# =========================================================

&#x20;   # FEATURES

&#x20;   # =========================================================



&#x20;   X\_train = train\_df\[

&#x20;       \["comment"] +

&#x20;       structured\_features\_with\_comments

&#x20;   ]



&#x20;   X\_val = val\_df\[

&#x20;       \["comment"] +

&#x20;       structured\_features\_with\_comments

&#x20;   ]



&#x20;   X\_test = test\_df\[

&#x20;       \["comment"] +

&#x20;       structured\_features\_with\_comments

&#x20;   ]



\# =========================================================

&#x20;   # CLASS WEIGHTS

&#x20;   # =========================================================



&#x20;   classes = np.unique(

&#x20;       y\_train

&#x20;   )



class\_weights = compute\_class\_weight(

&#x20;       class\_weight="balanced",

&#x20;       classes=classes,

&#x20;       y=y\_train

&#x20;   )



class\_weight\_dict = dict(

&#x20;       zip(

&#x20;           classes,

&#x20;           class\_weights

&#x20;       )

&#x20;   )



print()

&#x20;   print("==============================")

&#x20;   print("DATA SPLIT")

&#x20;   print("==============================")



&#x20;   print(

&#x20;       "Training rows   :",

&#x20;       len(X\_train)

&#x20;   )



&#x20;   print(

&#x20;       "Validation rows:",

&#x20;       len(X\_val)

&#x20;   )



&#x20;   print(

&#x20;       "Test rows       :",

&#x20;       len(X\_test)

&#x20;   )



print()

&#x20;   print("Reservation status split:")



&#x20;   print(

&#x20;       "Training rows   :",

&#x20;       len(y\_status\_train)

&#x20;   )



&#x20;   print(

&#x20;       "Validation rows:",

&#x20;       len(y\_status\_val)

&#x20;   )



&#x20;   print(

&#x20;       "Test rows       :",

&#x20;       len(y\_status\_test)

&#x20;   )



\# =========================================================

&#x20;   # TEXT PIPELINE

&#x20;   # =========================================================



&#x20;   text\_pipeline = Pipeline(\[



&#x20;       (

&#x20;           "hash",

&#x20;           HashingVectorizer(

&#x20;               n\_features=2\*\*16,

&#x20;               alternate\_sign=False,

&#x20;               ngram\_range=(1, 2)

&#x20;           )

&#x20;       ),



&#x20;       (

&#x20;           "tfidf",

&#x20;           TfidfTransformer()

&#x20;       )



&#x20;   ])



\# =========================================================

&#x20;   # PREPROCESSOR

&#x20;   # =========================================================



&#x20;   preprocess = ColumnTransformer(\[



&#x20;       (

&#x20;           "text",

&#x20;           text\_pipeline,

&#x20;           "comment"

&#x20;       ),



&#x20;       (

&#x20;           "cat",

&#x20;           OneHotEncoder(

&#x20;               handle\_unknown="ignore"

&#x20;           ),

&#x20;           structured\_features\_with\_comments

&#x20;       )



&#x20;   ])



\# =========================================================

&#x20;   # MODELS

&#x20;   # =========================================================



&#x20;   models = {



&#x20;       "Logistic Regression": Pipeline(\[



&#x20;           (

&#x20;               "prep",

&#x20;               preprocess

&#x20;           ),



&#x20;           (

&#x20;               "clf",

&#x20;               LogisticRegression(

&#x20;                   solver="saga",

&#x20;                   max\_iter=300,

&#x20;                   tol=1e-2,

&#x20;                   class\_weight=class\_weight\_dict,

&#x20;                   n\_jobs=-1

&#x20;               )

&#x20;           )



&#x20;       ]),



"Linear SVC": Pipeline(\[



&#x20;           (

&#x20;               "prep",

&#x20;               preprocess

&#x20;           ),



&#x20;           (

&#x20;               "clf",

&#x20;               LinearSVC(

&#x20;                   class\_weight=class\_weight\_dict,

&#x20;                   max\_iter=1000,

&#x20;                   tol=1e-2,

&#x20;                   dual=False

&#x20;               )

&#x20;           )



&#x20;       ]),



"LightGBM": Pipeline(\[



&#x20;           (

&#x20;               "prep",

&#x20;               preprocess

&#x20;           ),



&#x20;           (

&#x20;               "clf",

&#x20;               LGBMClassifier(

&#x20;                   n\_estimators=300,

&#x20;                   learning\_rate=0.05,

&#x20;                   num\_leaves=31,

&#x20;                   class\_weight=class\_weight\_dict,

&#x20;                   random\_state=42,

&#x20;                   verbosity=-1

&#x20;               )

&#x20;           )



&#x20;       ])



&#x20;   }



self.models = models



\# =========================================================

&#x20;   # EVALUATION HELPER

&#x20;   # =========================================================



&#x20;   def evaluate(

&#x20;       model,

&#x20;       X\_eval,

&#x20;       y\_true,

&#x20;       name,

&#x20;       show\_report=True

&#x20;   ):



&#x20;       preds = model.predict(

&#x20;           X\_eval

&#x20;       )



f1 = f1\_score(

&#x20;           y\_true,

&#x20;           preds,

&#x20;           average="weighted"

&#x20;       )



try:



&#x20;           clf = model.named\_steps\[

&#x20;               "clf"

&#x20;           ]



if hasattr(

&#x20;               clf,

&#x20;               "predict\_proba"

&#x20;           ):



&#x20;               probs = model.predict\_proba(

&#x20;                   X\_eval

&#x20;               )



&#x20;           else:



&#x20;               scores = model.decision\_function(

&#x20;                   X\_eval

&#x20;               )



&#x20;               scores = np.asarray(

&#x20;                   scores

&#x20;               )



if scores.ndim == 1:



&#x20;                   scores = np.column\_stack(

&#x20;                       \[

&#x20;                           -scores,

&#x20;                           scores

&#x20;                       ]

&#x20;                   )



exp = np.exp(

&#x20;                   scores -

&#x20;                   np.max(

&#x20;                       scores,

&#x20;                       axis=1,

&#x20;                       keepdims=True

&#x20;                   )

&#x20;               )



probs = (

&#x20;                   exp /

&#x20;                   exp.sum(

&#x20;                       axis=1,

&#x20;                       keepdims=True

&#x20;                   )

&#x20;               )



roc = roc\_auc\_score(

&#x20;               y\_true,

&#x20;               probs,

&#x20;               multi\_class="ovr",

&#x20;               average="weighted"

&#x20;           )



except Exception as e:



&#x20;           print(

&#x20;               f"\[WARNING] ROC-AUC failed "

&#x20;               f"for {name}: {e}"

&#x20;           )



&#x20;           roc = 0.0



if show\_report:



&#x20;           print()

&#x20;           print("==============================")

&#x20;           print(name)

&#x20;           print("==============================")



print(

&#x20;               classification\_report(

&#x20;                   y\_true,

&#x20;                   preds

&#x20;               )

&#x20;           )



print(

&#x20;               "F1 Score :",

&#x20;               round(

&#x20;                   f1,

&#x20;                   4

&#x20;               )

&#x20;           )



print(

&#x20;               "ROC-AUC  :",

&#x20;               round(

&#x20;                   roc,

&#x20;                   4

&#x20;               )

&#x20;           )



return {



&#x20;           "model": name,

&#x20;           "f1": f1,

&#x20;           "roc": roc



&#x20;       }



\# =========================================================

&#x20;   # TRAIN MODELS

&#x20;   # =========================================================



&#x20;   print()

&#x20;   print("==============================")

&#x20;   print("TRAINING MODELS")

&#x20;   print("==============================")



for name, model in models.items():



&#x20;       print(

&#x20;           f"Training {name}..."

&#x20;       )



model.fit(

&#x20;           X\_train,

&#x20;           y\_train

&#x20;       )



print(

&#x20;           f"{name} completed."

&#x20;       )



\# =========================================================

&#x20;   # RESERVATION STATUS MODEL

&#x20;   # =========================================================



&#x20;   print()

&#x20;   print("==============================")

&#x20;   print("RESERVATION STATUS TRAINING")

&#x20;   print("==============================")



status\_preprocess = ColumnTransformer(\[



&#x20;       (

&#x20;           "text",

&#x20;           text\_pipeline,

&#x20;           "comment"

&#x20;       ),



&#x20;       (

&#x20;           "cat",

&#x20;           OneHotEncoder(

&#x20;               handle\_unknown="ignore"

&#x20;           ),

&#x20;           structured\_features\_with\_comments

&#x20;       )



&#x20;   ])



print(

&#x20;       "Fitting reservation status preprocessing..."

&#x20;   )



X\_train\_status = (

&#x20;       status\_preprocess.fit\_transform(

&#x20;           X\_train

&#x20;       )

&#x20;   )



X\_val\_status = (

&#x20;       status\_preprocess.transform(

&#x20;           X\_val

&#x20;       )

&#x20;   )



X\_test\_status = (

&#x20;       status\_preprocess.transform(

&#x20;           X\_test

&#x20;       )

&#x20;   )



self.status\_model = LogisticRegression(

&#x20;       solver="saga",

&#x20;       max\_iter=100,

&#x20;       tol=1e-2,

&#x20;       class\_weight="balanced",

&#x20;       n\_jobs=-1

&#x20;   )



print(

&#x20;       "Training Reservation Status Model..."

&#x20;   )



self.status\_model.fit(

&#x20;       X\_train\_status,

&#x20;       y\_status\_train

&#x20;   )



print(

&#x20;       "Reservation Status Model completed."

&#x20;   )



self.status\_preprocess = (

&#x20;       status\_preprocess

&#x20;   )



\# =========================================================

&#x20;   # RESERVATION STATUS EVALUATION

&#x20;   # =========================================================



&#x20;   print()

&#x20;   print("==============================")

&#x20;   print("RESERVATION STATUS EVALUATION")

&#x20;   print("==============================")



status\_preds = (

&#x20;       self.status\_model.predict(

&#x20;           X\_test\_status

&#x20;       )

&#x20;   )



print(

&#x20;       classification\_report(

&#x20;           y\_status\_test,

&#x20;           status\_preds

&#x20;       )

&#x20;   )



\# =========================================================

&#x20;   # VALIDATION

&#x20;   # =========================================================



&#x20;   print()

&#x20;   print("==============================")

&#x20;   print("VALIDATION")

&#x20;   print("==============================")



validation\_results = \[]



for name, model in models.items():



&#x20;       result = evaluate(

&#x20;           model,

&#x20;           X\_val,

&#x20;           y\_val,

&#x20;           name,

&#x20;           show\_report=True

&#x20;       )



validation\_results.append(

&#x20;           result

&#x20;       )



\# =========================================================

&#x20;   # SELECT BEST MODEL

&#x20;   # =========================================================



&#x20;   validation\_df = pd.DataFrame(

&#x20;       validation\_results

&#x20;   )



validation\_df\["final\_score"] = (



&#x20;       0.6 \*

&#x20;       validation\_df\["f1"]



&#x20;       +



&#x20;       0.4 \*

&#x20;       validation\_df\["roc"]



&#x20;   )



validation\_df = validation\_df.sort\_values(

&#x20;       "final\_score",

&#x20;       ascending=False

&#x20;   )



print()

&#x20;   print("==============================")

&#x20;   print("VALIDATION MODEL RANKING")

&#x20;   print("==============================")



print(

&#x20;       validation\_df\[

&#x20;           \[

&#x20;               "model",

&#x20;               "f1",

&#x20;               "roc",

&#x20;               "final\_score"

&#x20;           ]

&#x20;       ].to\_string(

&#x20;           index=False

&#x20;       )

&#x20;   )



\# =========================================================

&#x20;   # BEST MODEL

&#x20;   # =========================================================



&#x20;   self.best\_model\_name = (

&#x20;       validation\_df.iloc\[0]\["model"]

&#x20;   )



self.best\_model = (

&#x20;       self.models\[

&#x20;           self.best\_model\_name

&#x20;       ]

&#x20;   )



print(

&#x20;       "\\nBEST MODEL SELECTED:",

&#x20;       self.best\_model\_name

&#x20;   )



\# =========================================================

&#x20;   # FINAL TEST EVALUATION

&#x20;   # =========================================================



&#x20;   print()

&#x20;   print("==============================")

&#x20;   print("FINAL TEST EVALUATION")

&#x20;   print("==============================")



test\_result = evaluate(

&#x20;       self.best\_model,

&#x20;       X\_test,

&#x20;       y\_test,

&#x20;       self.best\_model\_name,

&#x20;       show\_report=True

&#x20;   )



self.results\_df = pd.DataFrame(\[



&#x20;       {



&#x20;           "model":

&#x20;               self.best\_model\_name,



&#x20;           "f1":

&#x20;               test\_result\["f1"],



&#x20;           "roc":

&#x20;               test\_result\["roc"],



&#x20;           "final\_score":

&#x20;               (

&#x20;                   0.6 \*

&#x20;                   test\_result\["f1"]



&#x20;                   +



&#x20;                   0.4 \*

&#x20;                   test\_result\["roc"]

&#x20;               )



&#x20;       }



&#x20;   ])



\# =========================================================

&#x20;   # REFERENCE DATA

&#x20;   # =========================================================



&#x20;   self.df\_reference = pd.concat(

&#x20;       \[

&#x20;           train\_df,

&#x20;           val\_df,

&#x20;           test\_df

&#x20;       ],

&#x20;       axis=0

&#x20;   )



\# =========================================================

&#x20;   # COMMENT DATA

&#x20;   # =========================================================



&#x20;   reference\_df = self.df\_reference.copy()



reference\_df\["comment"] = (

&#x20;       reference\_df\["comment"]

&#x20;       .fillna("")

&#x20;       .astype(str)

&#x20;   )



self.comment\_df = reference\_df\[\[



&#x20;       "comment",

&#x20;       "hotel",

&#x20;       "meal",

&#x20;       "market\_segment",

&#x20;       "distribution\_channel",

&#x20;       "deposit\_type",

&#x20;       "customer\_type",

&#x20;       "season\_group",

&#x20;       "country\_group",

&#x20;       "adr\_group",

&#x20;       "previous\_cancellations\_group",

&#x20;       "days\_in\_waiting\_list\_group",

&#x20;       "guest\_group",

&#x20;       "final\_rating"



&#x20;   ]].copy()



\# =========================================================

&#x20;   # COMMENT INDEX

&#x20;   # =========================================================



&#x20;   self.comment\_index = {}



fields = \[



&#x20;       "hotel",

&#x20;       "meal",

&#x20;       "market\_segment",

&#x20;       "distribution\_channel",

&#x20;       "deposit\_type",

&#x20;       "customer\_type",

&#x20;       "season\_group",

&#x20;       "country\_group",

&#x20;       "adr\_group",

&#x20;       "previous\_cancellations\_group",

&#x20;       "days\_in\_waiting\_list\_group",

&#x20;       "guest\_group"



&#x20;   ]



for rating, df\_r in reference\_df.groupby(

&#x20;       "final\_rating"

&#x20;   ):



&#x20;       rating\_key = str(

&#x20;           rating

&#x20;       )



self.comment\_index\[

&#x20;           rating\_key

&#x20;       ] = {



&#x20;           "ALL":

&#x20;               df\_r\[

&#x20;                   "comment"

&#x20;               ].tolist(),



&#x20;           "FIELDS":

&#x20;               {}



&#x20;       }



for field in fields:



&#x20;           if field not in df\_r.columns:

&#x20;               continue



self.comment\_index\[

&#x20;               rating\_key

&#x20;           ]\[

&#x20;               "FIELDS"

&#x20;           ]\[field] = (



&#x20;               df\_r

&#x20;               .groupby(field)\["comment"]

&#x20;               .apply(list)

&#x20;               .to\_dict()



&#x20;           )



print(

&#x20;       "FAST COMMENT INDEX READY "

&#x20;       "(RATING-FIRST + UI FILTER)"

&#x20;   )



\# =========================================================

&#x20;   # SAVE ARTIFACTS

&#x20;   # =========================================================



&#x20;   self.\_save\_artifacts(

&#x20;       reference\_df

&#x20;   )



return reference\_df



\# =========================================================

\# SAVE MODEL + TRAIN DATA

\# =========================================================



def \_save\_artifacts(

&#x20;   self,

&#x20;   df

):



&#x20;   trained\_dir = self.config.get(

&#x20;       "trained\_dir",

&#x20;       "trained"

&#x20;   )



os.makedirs(

&#x20;       trained\_dir,

&#x20;       exist\_ok=True

&#x20;   )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;   # SAVE PROCESSED TRAIN DATA

&#x20;   # =====================================================



&#x20;   train\_path = self.config.get(

&#x20;       "train\_data",

&#x20;       os.path.join(

&#x20;           trained\_dir,

&#x20;           "train.parquet"

&#x20;       )

&#x20;   )



df.to\_parquet(

&#x20;       train\_path,

&#x20;       index=False

&#x20;   )



print(

&#x20;       f"\[INFO] Training data saved: "

&#x20;       f"{train\_path}"

&#x20;   )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;   # SAVE SERVICE MODEL

&#x20;   # =====================================================



&#x20;   model\_path = self.config.get(

&#x20;       "service\_model",

&#x20;       os.path.join(

&#x20;           trained\_dir,

&#x20;           "service\_model.pkl"

&#x20;       )

&#x20;   )



joblib.dump(

&#x20;       self,

&#x20;       model\_path

&#x20;   )



print(

&#x20;       f"\[INFO] Service model saved: "

&#x20;       f"{model\_path}"

&#x20;   )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;               )

&#x20;           )



return {



&#x20;           "model": name,

&#x20;           "f1": f1,

&#x20;           "roc": roc



&#x20;       }

for name, model in models.items():

model.fit(

status\_preprocess = ColumnTransformer(\[

print(

&#x20;   )



X\_train\_status = (

X\_val\_status = (

self.status\_model = LogisticRegression(

print(

&#x20;   )



self.status\_model.fit(

print(

self.status\_preprocess = (

&#x20;   )

for name, model in models.items():

\# =========================================================

self.best\_model = (

self.results\_df = pd.DataFrame(\[

\# =========================================================

\# =========================================================

fields = \[

for rating, df\_r in reference\_df.groupby(

with open(

\# SWITCH MODEL
