def set\_model(

&#x20;   self,

&#x20;   name: str

):



&#x20;   if name in self.models:



&#x20;       self.best\_model\_name = name



&#x20;       self.best\_model = (

&#x20;           self.models\[name]

&#x20;       )



\# =========================================================

\# PREDICT

\# =========================================================



def predict(

&#x20;   self,

&#x20;   x: dict

):



&#x20;   # =====================================================

&#x20;   # STRUCTURED FEATURES

&#x20;   # =====================================================



&#x20;   structured\_features = \[



&#x20;       "comment",

&#x20;       "hotel",

&#x20;       "meal",

&#x20;       "market\_segment",

&#x20;       "distribution\_channel",

&#x20;       "deposit\_type",

&#x20;       "customer\_type",

&#x20;       "season\_group",

&#x20;       "country\_group",

&#x20;       "adr\_group",

&#x20;       "previous\_cancellations\_group",

&#x20;       "days\_in\_waiting\_list\_group",

&#x20;       "guest\_group",

&#x20;       "client\_segment",

&#x20;       "is\_top\_bad\_client",

&#x20;       "client\_bad\_rate"



&#x20;   ]



\# =====================================================

&#x20;   # CREATE INPUT DATAFRAME

&#x20;   # =====================================================



&#x20;   input\_df = pd.DataFrame(

&#x20;       \[x]

&#x20;   )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;   # ENSURE STRUCTURED FEATURES EXIST

&#x20;   # =====================================================



&#x20;   for col in structured\_features:



&#x20;       if col not in input\_df.columns:



&#x20;           input\_df\[col] = "unknown"



\# =====================================================

&#x20;   # COMMENT

&#x20;   # =====================================================



&#x20;   input\_df\["comment"] = (

&#x20;       input\_df\["comment"]

&#x20;       .fillna("")

&#x20;       .astype(str)

&#x20;   )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;   # COMMENT TOPIC FEATURES

&#x20;   #

&#x20;   # IMPORTANT:

&#x20;   #

&#x20;   # These MUST use the TF-IDF and SVD models that were

&#x20;   # fitted during training.

&#x20;   #

&#x20;   # DO NOT fit them again here.

&#x20;   # =====================================================



&#x20;   if (

&#x20;       self.comment\_tfidf is None

&#x20;       or self.comment\_svd is None

&#x20;   ):



&#x20;       raise RuntimeError(

&#x20;           "Comment TF-IDF/SVD models are not available. "

&#x20;           "Please retrain the ServiceModel."

&#x20;       )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;   # TRANSFORM COMMENT USING TRAINED TF-IDF

&#x20;   # =====================================================



&#x20;   comment\_tfidf = (

&#x20;       self.comment\_tfidf.transform(

&#x20;           input\_df\["comment"]

&#x20;       )

&#x20;   )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;   # TRANSFORM COMMENT USING TRAINED SVD

&#x20;   # =====================================================



&#x20;   comment\_features\_array = (

&#x20;       self.comment\_svd.transform(

&#x20;           comment\_tfidf

&#x20;       )

&#x20;   )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;   # CREATE COMMENT TOPIC COLUMNS

&#x20;   # =====================================================



&#x20;   comment\_columns = \[



&#x20;       f"comment\_topic\_{i}"



&#x20;       for i in range(

&#x20;           comment\_features\_array.shape\[1]

&#x20;       )



&#x20;   ]



comment\_features = pd.DataFrame(



&#x20;       comment\_features\_array,



&#x20;       columns=comment\_columns,



&#x20;       index=input\_df.index



&#x20;   )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;   # ATTACH COMMENT TOPIC FEATURES

&#x20;   # =====================================================



&#x20;   input\_df = pd.concat(

&#x20;       \[

&#x20;           input\_df,

&#x20;           comment\_features

&#x20;       ],

&#x20;       axis=1

&#x20;   )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;   # FINAL FEATURE LIST

&#x20;   #

&#x20;   # MUST MATCH TRAINING

&#x20;   # =====================================================



&#x20;   structured\_features\_with\_comments = (



&#x20;       \[

&#x20;           "hotel",

&#x20;           "meal",

&#x20;           "market\_segment",

&#x20;           "distribution\_channel",

&#x20;           "deposit\_type",

&#x20;           "customer\_type",

&#x20;           "season\_group",

&#x20;           "country\_group",

&#x20;           "adr\_group",

&#x20;           "previous\_cancellations\_group",

&#x20;           "days\_in\_waiting\_list\_group",

&#x20;           "guest\_group",

&#x20;           "client\_segment",

&#x20;           "is\_top\_bad\_client",

&#x20;           "client\_bad\_rate"

&#x20;       ]



&#x20;       +



&#x20;       comment\_columns



&#x20;   )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;   # FEATURES

&#x20;   # =====================================================



&#x20;   X\_input = input\_df\[

&#x20;       \["comment"] +

&#x20;       structured\_features\_with\_comments

&#x20;   ]



\# =====================================================

&#x20;   # RATING PREDICTION

&#x20;   # =====================================================



&#x20;   pred\_rating = int(

&#x20;       self.best\_model.predict(

&#x20;           X\_input

&#x20;       )\[0]

&#x20;   )



clf = (

&#x20;       self.best\_model

&#x20;       .named\_steps\["clf"]

&#x20;   )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;   # RESERVATION STATUS

&#x20;   # =====================================================



&#x20;   X\_status = (

&#x20;       self.status\_preprocess.transform(

&#x20;           X\_input

&#x20;       )

&#x20;   )



status\_probs = (

&#x20;       self.status\_model.predict\_proba(

&#x20;           X\_status

&#x20;       )\[0]

&#x20;   )



status\_class\_order = (

&#x20;       self.status\_model.classes\_

&#x20;   )



prob\_canceled = 0.0

&#x20;   prob\_check\_out = 0.0

&#x20;   prob\_no\_show = 0.0



for i, cls in enumerate(

&#x20;       status\_class\_order

&#x20;   ):



&#x20;       probability = (

&#x20;           status\_probs\[i] \*

&#x20;           100

&#x20;       )



if cls == "canceled":



&#x20;           prob\_canceled = round(

&#x20;               probability,

&#x20;               1

&#x20;           )



elif cls == "check-out":



&#x20;           prob\_check\_out = round(

&#x20;               probability,

&#x20;               1

&#x20;           )



elif cls == "no-show":



&#x20;           prob\_no\_show = round(

&#x20;               probability,

&#x20;               1

&#x20;           )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;   # RATING PROBABILITY

&#x20;   # =====================================================



&#x20;   if hasattr(

&#x20;       clf,

&#x20;       "predict\_proba"

&#x20;   ):



&#x20;       probs = (

&#x20;           self.best\_model

&#x20;           .predict\_proba(

&#x20;               X\_input

&#x20;           )\[0]

&#x20;       )



&#x20;   else:



&#x20;       scores = (

&#x20;           self.best\_model

&#x20;           .decision\_function(

&#x20;               X\_input

&#x20;           )

&#x20;       )



scores = np.asarray(

&#x20;           scores

&#x20;       )



if scores.ndim == 2:



&#x20;           scores = scores\[0]



exp = np.exp(

&#x20;           scores -

&#x20;           np.max(scores)

&#x20;       )



probs = (

&#x20;           exp /

&#x20;           np.sum(exp)

&#x20;       )



class\_order = list(

&#x20;       clf.classes\_

&#x20;   )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;   # SLA RISK

&#x20;   # =====================================================



&#x20;   risk\_weights = {



&#x20;       0: 1.0,

&#x20;       1: 0.90,

&#x20;       2: 0.75,

&#x20;       3: 0.60,

&#x20;       4: 0.40,

&#x20;       5: 0.20,

&#x20;       6: 0.00,



&#x20;   }



sla\_risk = 0.0



for i, cls in enumerate(

&#x20;       class\_order

&#x20;   ):



&#x20;       if i >= len(probs):

&#x20;           continue



sla\_risk += (



&#x20;           probs\[i] \*

&#x20;           risk\_weights.get(

&#x20;               cls,

&#x20;               0

&#x20;           )



&#x20;       )



sla\_risk\_score = round(

&#x20;       sla\_risk \* 100,

&#x20;       1

&#x20;   )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;   # BASE RISK

&#x20;   # =====================================================



&#x20;   rating\_map = {



&#x20;       0: 100,

&#x20;       1: 90,

&#x20;       2: 75,

&#x20;       3: 60,

&#x20;       4: 40,

&#x20;       5: 20,

&#x20;       6: 10



&#x20;   }



base\_risk = rating\_map.get(

&#x20;       pred\_rating,

&#x20;       50

&#x20;   )



risk\_score = round(



&#x20;       0.6 \*

&#x20;       base\_risk



&#x20;       +



&#x20;       0.4 \*

&#x20;       sla\_risk\_score,



&#x20;       1



&#x20;   )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;   # COMMENT

&#x20;   # =====================================================



&#x20;   generated\_comment = (

&#x20;       self.\_generate\_comment(

&#x20;           pred\_rating,

&#x20;           sla\_risk\_score,

&#x20;           risk\_score,

&#x20;           x

&#x20;       )

&#x20;   )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;   # RETURN

&#x20;   # =====================================================



&#x20;   return (



&#x20;       pred\_rating,



&#x20;       prob\_canceled,



&#x20;       prob\_check\_out,



&#x20;       prob\_no\_show,



&#x20;       sla\_risk\_score,



&#x20;       risk\_score,



&#x20;       generated\_comment



&#x20;   )



\# =====================================================

\# COMMENT GENERATION

\# =====================================================



def \_generate\_comment(

&#x20;   self,

&#x20;   rating,

&#x20;   sla\_risk,

&#x20;   risk,

&#x20;   x

):



&#x20;   msg = \[]



if rating == 5:



&#x20;       msg.append(

&#x20;           "Excellent service."

&#x20;       )



&#x20;   elif rating == 4:



&#x20;       msg.append(

&#x20;           "Positive service."

&#x20;       )



&#x20;   elif rating == 3:



&#x20;       msg.append(

&#x20;           "Average service."

&#x20;       )



&#x20;   elif rating == 2:



&#x20;       msg.append(

&#x20;           "Service quality issue."

&#x20;       )



&#x20;   else:



&#x20;       msg.append(

&#x20;           "High dissatisfaction."

&#x20;       )



context\_comments = (

&#x20;       self.\_get\_top\_comments\_dynamic(

&#x20;           rating,

&#x20;           x,

&#x20;           top\_k=20

&#x20;       )

&#x20;   )



if context\_comments:



&#x20;       ai\_summary = (

&#x20;           self.\_generate\_ai\_summary(

&#x20;               context\_comments,

&#x20;               rating

&#x20;           )

&#x20;       )



if ai\_summary:



&#x20;           msg.append(

&#x20;               ai\_summary

&#x20;           )



example\_block = \[

&#x20;           "Examples of similar feedback:"

&#x20;       ]



example\_block.extend(



&#x20;           \[

&#x20;               f"{i}. {c}"



&#x20;               for i, c in enumerate(

&#x20;                   context\_comments\[:5],

&#x20;                   1

&#x20;               )

&#x20;           ]

&#x20;           ),



&#x20;           (

&#x20;               "clf",

&#x20;               LogisticRegression(

&#x20;                   solver="saga",

&#x20;                   max\_iter=300,

&#x20;                   tol=1e-2,

&#x20;                   class\_weight=class\_weight\_dict,

&#x20;                   n\_jobs=-1

&#x20;               )

&#x20;           )



&#x20;       ]),



"Linear SVC": Pipeline(\[



&#x20;           (

&#x20;               "prep",

&#x20;               preprocess

&#x20;           ),



&#x20;           (

&#x20;               "clf",

&#x20;               LinearSVC(

&#x20;                   class\_weight=class\_weight\_dict,

&#x20;                   max\_iter=1000,

&#x20;                   tol=1e-2,

&#x20;                   dual=False

&#x20;               )

&#x20;           )



&#x20;       ]),



"LightGBM": Pipeline(\[



&#x20;           (

&#x20;               "prep",

&#x20;               preprocess

&#x20;           ),



&#x20;           (

&#x20;               "clf",

&#x20;               LGBMClassifier(

&#x20;                   n\_estimators=300,

&#x20;                   learning\_rate=0.05,

&#x20;                   num\_leaves=31,

&#x20;                   class\_weight=class\_weight\_dict,

&#x20;                   random\_state=42,

&#x20;                   verbosity=-1

&#x20;               )

&#x20;           )



&#x20;       ])



&#x20;   }



self.models = models



\# =========================================================

&#x20;   # EVALUATION HELPER

&#x20;   # =========================================================



&#x20;   def evaluate(

&#x20;       model,

&#x20;       X\_eval,

&#x20;       y\_true,

&#x20;       name,

&#x20;       show\_report=True

&#x20;   ):



&#x20;       preds = model.predict(

&#x20;           X\_eval

&#x20;       )



f1 = f1\_score(

&#x20;           y\_true,

&#x20;           preds,

&#x20;           average="weighted"

&#x20;       )



try:



&#x20;           clf = model.named\_steps\[

&#x20;               "clf"

&#x20;           ]



if hasattr(

&#x20;               clf,

&#x20;               "predict\_proba"

&#x20;           ):



&#x20;               probs = model.predict\_proba(

&#x20;                   X\_eval

&#x20;               )



&#x20;           else:



&#x20;               scores = model.decision\_function(

&#x20;                   X\_eval

&#x20;               )



&#x20;               scores = np.asarray(

&#x20;                   scores

&#x20;               )



if scores.ndim == 1:



&#x20;                   scores = np.column\_stack(

&#x20;                       \[

&#x20;                           -scores,

&#x20;                           scores

&#x20;                       ]

&#x20;                   )



exp = np.exp(

&#x20;                   scores -

&#x20;                   np.max(

&#x20;                       scores,

&#x20;                       axis=1,

&#x20;                       keepdims=True

&#x20;                   )

&#x20;               )



probs = (

&#x20;                   exp /

&#x20;                   exp.sum(

&#x20;                       axis=1,

&#x20;                       keepdims=True

&#x20;                   )

&#x20;               )



roc = roc\_auc\_score(

&#x20;               y\_true,

&#x20;               probs,

&#x20;               multi\_class="ovr",

&#x20;               average="weighted"

&#x20;           )



except Exception as e:



&#x20;           print(

&#x20;               f"\[WARNING] ROC-AUC failed "

&#x20;               f"for {name}: {e}"

&#x20;           )



&#x20;           roc = 0.0



if show\_report:



&#x20;           print()

&#x20;           print("==============================")

&#x20;           print(name)

&#x20;           print("==============================")



print(

&#x20;               classification\_report(

&#x20;                   y\_true,

&#x20;                   preds

&#x20;               )

&#x20;           )



print(

&#x20;               "F1 Score :",

&#x20;               round(

&#x20;                   f1,

&#x20;                   4

&#x20;               )

&#x20;           )



print(

&#x20;               "ROC-AUC  :",

&#x20;               round(

&#x20;                   roc,

&#x20;                   4

&#x20;               )

&#x20;           )



return {



&#x20;           "model": name,

&#x20;           "f1": f1,

&#x20;           "roc": roc



&#x20;       }



\# =========================================================

&#x20;   # TRAIN MODELS

&#x20;   # =========================================================



&#x20;   print()

&#x20;   print("==============================")

&#x20;   print("TRAINING MODELS")

&#x20;   print("==============================")



for name, model in models.items():



&#x20;       print(

&#x20;           f"Training {name}..."

&#x20;       )



model.fit(

&#x20;           X\_train,

&#x20;           y\_train

&#x20;       )



print(

&#x20;           f"{name} completed."

&#x20;       )



\# =========================================================

&#x20;   # RESERVATION STATUS MODEL

&#x20;   # =========================================================



&#x20;   print()

&#x20;   print("==============================")

&#x20;   print("RESERVATION STATUS TRAINING")

&#x20;   print("==============================")



status\_preprocess = ColumnTransformer(\[



&#x20;       (

&#x20;           "text",

&#x20;           text\_pipeline,

&#x20;           "comment"

&#x20;       ),



&#x20;       (

&#x20;           "cat",

&#x20;           OneHotEncoder(

&#x20;               handle\_unknown="ignore"

&#x20;           ),

&#x20;           structured\_features\_with\_comments

&#x20;       )



&#x20;   ])



print(

&#x20;       "Fitting reservation status preprocessing..."

&#x20;   )



X\_train\_status = (

&#x20;       status\_preprocess.fit\_transform(

&#x20;           X\_train

&#x20;       )

&#x20;   )



X\_val\_status = (

&#x20;       status\_preprocess.transform(

&#x20;           X\_val

&#x20;       )

&#x20;   )



X\_test\_status = (

&#x20;       status\_preprocess.transform(

&#x20;           X\_test

&#x20;       )

&#x20;   )



self.status\_model = LogisticRegression(

&#x20;       solver="saga",

&#x20;       max\_iter=100,

&#x20;       tol=1e-2,

&#x20;       class\_weight="balanced",

&#x20;       n\_jobs=-1

&#x20;   )



print(

&#x20;       "Training Reservation Status Model..."

&#x20;   )



self.status\_model.fit(

&#x20;       X\_train\_status,

&#x20;       y\_status\_train

&#x20;   )



print(

&#x20;       "Reservation Status Model completed."

&#x20;   )



self.status\_preprocess = (

&#x20;       status\_preprocess

&#x20;   )



\# =========================================================

&#x20;   # RESERVATION STATUS EVALUATION

&#x20;   # =========================================================



&#x20;   print()

&#x20;   print("==============================")

&#x20;   print("RESERVATION STATUS EVALUATION")

&#x20;   print("==============================")



status\_preds = (

&#x20;       self.status\_model.predict(

&#x20;           X\_test\_status

&#x20;       )

&#x20;   )



print(

&#x20;       classification\_report(

&#x20;           y\_status\_test,

&#x20;           status\_preds

&#x20;       )

&#x20;   )



\# =========================================================

&#x20;   # VALIDATION

&#x20;   # =========================================================



&#x20;   print()

&#x20;   print("==============================")

&#x20;   print("VALIDATION")

&#x20;   print("==============================")



validation\_results = \[]



for name, model in models.items():



&#x20;       result = evaluate(

&#x20;           model,

&#x20;           X\_val,

&#x20;           y\_val,

&#x20;           name,

&#x20;           show\_report=True

&#x20;       )



validation\_results.append(

&#x20;           result

&#x20;       )



\# =========================================================

&#x20;   # SELECT BEST MODEL

&#x20;   # =========================================================



&#x20;   validation\_df = pd.DataFrame(

&#x20;       validation\_results

&#x20;   )



validation\_df\["final\_score"] = (



&#x20;       0.6 \*

&#x20;       validation\_df\["f1"]



&#x20;       +



&#x20;       0.4 \*

&#x20;       validation\_df\["roc"]



&#x20;   )



validation\_df = validation\_df.sort\_values(

&#x20;       "final\_score",

&#x20;       ascending=False

&#x20;   )



print()

&#x20;   print("==============================")

&#x20;   print("VALIDATION MODEL RANKING")

&#x20;   print("==============================")



print(

&#x20;       validation\_df\[

&#x20;           \[

&#x20;               "model",

&#x20;               "f1",

&#x20;               "roc",

&#x20;               "final\_score"

&#x20;           ]

&#x20;       ].to\_string(

&#x20;           index=False

&#x20;       )

&#x20;   )



\# =========================================================

&#x20;   # BEST MODEL

&#x20;   # =========================================================



&#x20;   self.best\_model\_name = (

&#x20;       validation\_df.iloc\[0]\["model"]

&#x20;   )



self.best\_model = (

&#x20;       self.models\[

&#x20;           self.best\_model\_name

&#x20;       ]

&#x20;   )



print(

&#x20;       "\\nBEST MODEL SELECTED:",

&#x20;       self.best\_model\_name

&#x20;   )



\# =========================================================

&#x20;   # FINAL TEST EVALUATION

&#x20;   # =========================================================



&#x20;   print()

&#x20;   print("==============================")

&#x20;   print("FINAL TEST EVALUATION")

&#x20;   print("==============================")



test\_result = evaluate(

&#x20;       self.best\_model,

&#x20;       X\_test,

&#x20;       y\_test,

&#x20;       self.best\_model\_name,

&#x20;       show\_report=True

&#x20;   )



self.results\_df = pd.DataFrame(\[



&#x20;       {



&#x20;           "model":

&#x20;               self.best\_model\_name,



&#x20;           "f1":

&#x20;               test\_result\["f1"],



&#x20;           "roc":

&#x20;               test\_result\["roc"],



&#x20;           "final\_score":

&#x20;               (

&#x20;                   0.6 \*

&#x20;                   test\_result\["f1"]



&#x20;                   +



&#x20;                   0.4 \*

&#x20;                   test\_result\["roc"]

&#x20;               )



&#x20;       }



&#x20;   ])



\# =========================================================

&#x20;   # REFERENCE DATA

&#x20;   # =========================================================



&#x20;   self.df\_reference = pd.concat(

&#x20;       \[

&#x20;           train\_df,

&#x20;           val\_df,

&#x20;           test\_df

&#x20;       ],

&#x20;       axis=0

&#x20;   )



\# =========================================================

&#x20;   # COMMENT DATA

&#x20;   # =========================================================



&#x20;   reference\_df = self.df\_reference.copy()



reference\_df\["comment"] = (

&#x20;       reference\_df\["comment"]

&#x20;       .fillna("")

&#x20;       .astype(str)

&#x20;   )



self.comment\_df = reference\_df\[\[



&#x20;       "comment",

&#x20;       "hotel",

&#x20;       "meal",

&#x20;       "market\_segment",

&#x20;       "distribution\_channel",

&#x20;       "deposit\_type",

&#x20;       "customer\_type",

&#x20;       "season\_group",

&#x20;       "country\_group",

&#x20;       "adr\_group",

&#x20;       "previous\_cancellations\_group",

&#x20;       "days\_in\_waiting\_list\_group",

&#x20;       "guest\_group",

&#x20;       "final\_rating"



&#x20;   ]].copy()



\# =========================================================

&#x20;   # COMMENT INDEX

&#x20;   # =========================================================



&#x20;   self.comment\_index = {}



fields = \[



&#x20;       "hotel",

&#x20;       "meal",

&#x20;       "market\_segment",

&#x20;       "distribution\_channel",

&#x20;       "deposit\_type",

&#x20;       "customer\_type",

&#x20;       "season\_group",

&#x20;       "country\_group",

&#x20;       "adr\_group",

&#x20;       "previous\_cancellations\_group",

&#x20;       "days\_in\_waiting\_list\_group",

&#x20;       "guest\_group"



&#x20;   ]



for rating, df\_r in reference\_df.groupby(

&#x20;       "final\_rating"

&#x20;   ):



&#x20;       rating\_key = str(

&#x20;           rating

&#x20;       )



self.comment\_index\[

&#x20;       ] = {



&#x20;           "ALL":

&#x20;               df\_r\[

&#x20;               ].tolist(),



&#x20;           "FIELDS":

&#x20;               {}



&#x20;       }



for field in fields:



&#x20;           if field not in df\_r.columns:

&#x20;               continue



self.comment\_index\[

&#x20;               rating\_key

&#x20;           ]\[

&#x20;               "FIELDS"

&#x20;           ]\[field] = (



&#x20;               df\_r

&#x20;               .groupby(field)\["comment"]

&#x20;               .apply(list)

&#x20;               .to\_dict()

print(

\# =========================================================

&#x20;   # SAVE ARTIFACTS

&#x20;   self.\_save\_artifacts(

return reference\_df



\# =========================================================

\# SAVE MODEL + TRAIN DATA

\# =========================================================



def \_save\_artifacts(

&#x20;   self,

&#x20;   df

):



&#x20;   trained\_dir = self.config.get(

&#x20;       "trained\_dir",

&#x20;       "trained"

&#x20;   )



os.makedirs(

&#x20;       trained\_dir,

&#x20;       exist\_ok=True

&#x20;   )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;   # SAVE PROCESSED TRAIN DATA

&#x20;   # =====================================================



&#x20;   train\_path = self.config.get(

&#x20;       "train\_data",

&#x20;       os.path.join(

&#x20;           trained\_dir,

&#x20;           "train.parquet"

&#x20;       )

&#x20;   )



df.to\_parquet(

&#x20;       train\_path,

&#x20;       index=False

&#x20;   )



print(

&#x20;       f"\[INFO] Training data saved: "

&#x20;       f"{train\_path}"

&#x20;   )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;   # SAVE SERVICE MODEL

&#x20;   # =====================================================



&#x20;   model\_path = self.config.get(

&#x20;       "service\_model",

&#x20;       os.path.join(

&#x20;           trained\_dir,

&#x20;           "service\_model.pkl"

&#x20;       )

&#x20;   )



joblib.dump(

&#x20;       self,

&#x20;       model\_path

&#x20;   )



print(

&#x20;       f"\[INFO] Service model saved: "

&#x20;       f"{model\_path}"

&#x20;   )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;   # SAVE METADATA

&#x20;   # =====================================================



&#x20;   metadata\_path = self.config.get(

&#x20;       "training\_metadata",

&#x20;       os.path.join(

&#x20;           trained\_dir,

&#x20;           "training\_metadata.json"

&#x20;       )

&#x20;   )



import json



metadata = {}



if os.path.exists(

&#x20;       metadata\_path

&#x20;   ):



&#x20;       with open(

&#x20;           metadata\_path,

&#x20;           "r"

&#x20;       ) as f:



&#x20;           metadata = json.load(

&#x20;               f

&#x20;           )



metadata.update({



&#x20;       "model":

&#x20;           self.best\_model\_name,



&#x20;       "trained\_time":

&#x20;           datetime.now().isoformat(),



&#x20;       "rows":

&#x20;           len(df),



&#x20;       "columns":

&#x20;           list(df.columns)



&#x20;   })



with open(

&#x20;       metadata\_path,

&#x20;       "w"

&#x20;   ) as f:



&#x20;       json.dump(

&#x20;           metadata,

&#x20;           f,

&#x20;           indent=4

&#x20;       )



print(

&#x20;       f"\[INFO] Metadata updated: "

&#x20;       f"{metadata\_path}"

&#x20;   )



\# =====================================================

\# SWITCH MODEL

\# =====================================================



def set\_model(

&#x20;   self,

&#x20;   name: str

):



&#x20;   if name in self.models:



&#x20;       self.best\_model\_name = name



&#x20;       self.best\_model = (

&#x20;           self.models\[name]

&#x20;       )



\# =========================================================

\# PREDICT

\# =========================================================



def predict(

&#x20;   self,

&#x20;   x: dict

):



&#x20;   # =====================================================

&#x20;   # STRUCTURED FEATURES

&#x20;   # =====================================================



&#x20;   structured\_features = \[



&#x20;       "comment",

&#x20;       "hotel",

&#x20;       "meal",

&#x20;       "market\_segment",

&#x20;       "distribution\_channel",

&#x20;       "deposit\_type",

&#x20;       "customer\_type",

&#x20;       "season\_group",

&#x20;       "country\_group",

&#x20;       "adr\_group",

&#x20;       "previous\_cancellations\_group",

&#x20;       "days\_in\_waiting\_list\_group",

&#x20;       "guest\_group",

&#x20;       "client\_segment",

&#x20;       "is\_top\_bad\_client",

&#x20;       "client\_bad\_rate"



&#x20;   ]



\# =====================================================

&#x20;   # CREATE INPUT DATAFRAME

&#x20;   # =====================================================



&#x20;   input\_df = pd.DataFrame(

&#x20;       \[x]

&#x20;   )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;   # ENSURE STRUCTURED FEATURES EXIST

&#x20;   # =====================================================



&#x20;   for col in structured\_features:



&#x20;       if col not in input\_df.columns:



&#x20;           input\_df\[col] = "unknown"



\# =====================================================

&#x20;   # COMMENT

&#x20;   # =====================================================



&#x20;   input\_df\["comment"] = (

&#x20;       input\_df\["comment"]

&#x20;       .fillna("")

&#x20;       .astype(str)

&#x20;   )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;   # COMMENT TOPIC FEATURES

&#x20;   #

&#x20;   # IMPORTANT:

&#x20;   #

&#x20;   # These MUST use the TF-IDF and SVD models that were

&#x20;   # fitted during training.

&#x20;   #

&#x20;   # DO NOT fit them again here.

&#x20;   # =====================================================



&#x20;   if (

&#x20;       self.comment\_tfidf is None

&#x20;       or self.comment\_svd is None

&#x20;   ):



&#x20;       raise RuntimeError(

&#x20;           "Comment TF-IDF/SVD models are not available. "

&#x20;           "Please retrain the ServiceModel."

&#x20;       )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;   # TRANSFORM COMMENT USING TRAINED TF-IDF

&#x20;   # =====================================================



&#x20;   comment\_tfidf = (

&#x20;       self.comment\_tfidf.transform(

&#x20;           input\_df\["comment"]

&#x20;       )

&#x20;   )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;   # TRANSFORM COMMENT USING TRAINED SVD

&#x20;   # =====================================================



&#x20;   comment\_features\_array = (

&#x20;       self.comment\_svd.transform(

&#x20;           comment\_tfidf

&#x20;       )

&#x20;   )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;   # CREATE COMMENT TOPIC COLUMNS

&#x20;   # =====================================================



&#x20;   comment\_columns = \[



&#x20;       f"comment\_topic\_{i}"



&#x20;       for i in range(

&#x20;           comment\_features\_array.shape\[1]

&#x20;       )



&#x20;   ]



comment\_features = pd.DataFrame(



&#x20;       comment\_features\_array,



&#x20;       columns=comment\_columns,



&#x20;       index=input\_df.index



&#x20;   )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;   # ATTACH COMMENT TOPIC FEATURES

&#x20;   # =====================================================



&#x20;   input\_df = pd.concat(

&#x20;       \[

&#x20;           input\_df,

&#x20;           comment\_features

&#x20;       ],

&#x20;       axis=1

&#x20;   )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;   # FINAL FEATURE LIST

&#x20;   #

&#x20;   # MUST MATCH TRAINING

&#x20;   # =====================================================



&#x20;   structured\_features\_with\_comments = (



&#x20;       \[

&#x20;           "hotel",

&#x20;           "meal",

&#x20;           "market\_segment",

&#x20;           "distribution\_channel",

&#x20;           "deposit\_type",

&#x20;           "customer\_type",

&#x20;           "season\_group",

&#x20;           "country\_group",

&#x20;           "adr\_group",

&#x20;           "previous\_cancellations\_group",

&#x20;           "days\_in\_waiting\_list\_group",

&#x20;           "guest\_group",

&#x20;           "client\_segment",

&#x20;           "is\_top\_bad\_client",

&#x20;           "client\_bad\_rate",

&#x20;           "reservation\_status",

&#x20;           "is\_canceled"

&#x20;       ]



&#x20;       +



&#x20;       comment\_columns



&#x20;   )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;   # FEATURES

&#x20;   # =====================================================



&#x20;   X\_input = input\_df\[

&#x20;       \["comment"] +

&#x20;       structured\_features\_with\_comments

&#x20;   ]



\# =====================================================

&#x20;   # RATING PREDICTION

&#x20;   # =====================================================



&#x20;   pred\_rating = int(

&#x20;       self.best\_model.predict(

&#x20;           X\_input

&#x20;       )\[0]

&#x20;   )



clf = (

&#x20;       self.best\_model

&#x20;       .named\_steps\["clf"]

&#x20;   )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;   # RESERVATION STATUS

&#x20;   # =====================================================



&#x20;   X\_status = (

&#x20;       self.status\_preprocess.transform(

&#x20;           X\_input

&#x20;       )

&#x20;   )



status\_probs = (

&#x20;       self.status\_model.predict\_proba(

&#x20;           X\_status

&#x20;       )\[0]

&#x20;   )



status\_class\_order = (

&#x20;       self.status\_model.classes\_

&#x20;   )



prob\_canceled = 0.0

&#x20;   prob\_check\_out = 0.0

&#x20;   prob\_no\_show = 0.0



for i, cls in enumerate(

&#x20;       status\_class\_order

&#x20;   ):



&#x20;       probability = (

&#x20;           status\_probs\[i] \*

&#x20;           100

&#x20;       )



if cls == "canceled":



&#x20;           prob\_canceled = round(

&#x20;               probability,

&#x20;               1

&#x20;           )



elif cls == "check-out":



&#x20;           prob\_check\_out = round(

&#x20;               probability,

&#x20;               1

&#x20;           )



elif cls == "no-show":



&#x20;           prob\_no\_show = round(

&#x20;               probability,

&#x20;               1

&#x20;           )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;   # RATING PROBABILITY

&#x20;   # =====================================================



&#x20;   if hasattr(

&#x20;       clf,

&#x20;       "predict\_proba"

&#x20;   ):



&#x20;       probs = (

&#x20;           self.best\_model

&#x20;           .predict\_proba(

&#x20;               X\_input

&#x20;           )\[0]

&#x20;       )



&#x20;   else:



&#x20;       scores = (

&#x20;           self.best\_model

&#x20;           .decision\_function(

&#x20;               X\_input

&#x20;           )

&#x20;       )



scores = np.asarray(

&#x20;           scores

&#x20;       )



if scores.ndim == 2:



&#x20;           scores = scores\[0]



exp = np.exp(

&#x20;           scores -

&#x20;           np.max(scores)

&#x20;       )



probs = (

&#x20;           exp /

Reservation Status → Canceled



sends:

Selecting:



Reservation Status → No-Show



sends:



"reservation\_status": 1

Reservation Status → Check-Out



sends:



"reservation\_status": 2



And:



Is Reservation Cancel → Canceled



sends:



"is\_canceled": 1



while:



Is Reservation Cancel → Not Canceled



sends:



"is\_canceled": 0



One caution: your model.py training code uses reservation\_status as the target for status\_model, while also putting reservation\_status into the rating model's features. That means these two fields are being used as predictive features for the rating model, which is fine if that is intentionally what you want, but it can introduce target leakage if reservation\_status is only known after the booking/stay outcome.

Since your FeatureEngineering output is integer-based, the cleanest approach is to make predict\_page.py explicitly normalize every UI value before it reaches ml.predict().

def safe\_text(value):



&#x20;   """

&#x20;   Convert any UI value safely to text.



&#x20;   IMPORTANT:

&#x20;   be strings, integers, None, or other object types.

&#x20;   """



&#x20;   if value is None:

&#x20;       return "unknown"



&#x20;   try:



&#x20;       text = str(value).strip()



&#x20;   except Exception:



&#x20;       return "unknown"



&#x20;   if text.lower() in \[

&#x20;       "",

&#x20;       "nan",

&#x20;       "none",

&#x20;       "null",

&#x20;       "missing",

&#x20;       "unknown"

&#x20;   ]:



&#x20;       return "unknown"



&#x20;   return text

):



&#x20;   """

&#x20;   Handles:

&#x20;       None

&#x20;       strings

&#x20;       floats

&#x20;       numpy floats

&#x20;       'missing'

&#x20;   if value is None:

&#x20;       return default



&#x20;   # ---------------------------------------------

&#x20;   # Already integer

&#x20;       value,

&#x20;       (int, np.integer)

\# ---------------------------------------------

&#x20;           pass

\# ---------------------------------------------

One critical correction to your current model



Your model.py currently creates the status target:



y\_status\_train = train\_df\["reservation\_status"]



while also using reservation\_status as an input feature:



structured\_features = \[

&#x20;   ...

&#x20;   "reservation\_status",

&#x20;   "is\_canceled"

]



This creates target leakage for the reservation-status model.



The status model is effectively being trained with the answer (reservation\_status) included in its input. That can make the status probabilities look extremely strong during training but does not represent a real prediction scenario.



If your intention is that the user supplies reservation status and is\_canceled in the UI to improve the Customer Rating F1/ROC, that's fine for the rating model.



But the separate:



self.status\_model



should ideally not use reservation\_status itself as an input feature if it is supposed to predict reservation status.



Also, the current model.py uses:



OneHotEncoder(

&#x20;   handle\_unknown="ignore"

)



so integers are perfectly acceptable as categorical features. The important thing is that training and prediction must use the same representation.



The ufunc 'isnan' error should be eliminated by the above safe\_int() / feature\_value() approach because no np.isnan() is applied to arbitrary UI strings.

def build\_options(mapping):

&#x20;   """

&#x20;   Build Dash dropdown options.



&#x20;   IMPORTANT:

&#x20;   value = INTEGER used by FeatureEngineering

&#x20;   for integer\_value, label in mapping.items():



&#x20;       if label in \[

&#x20;           None,

&#x20;           "",

&#x20;           "missing",

&#x20;           "nan"

&#x20;       ]:



&#x20;           display\_label = "Missing"



&#x20;       else:



&#x20;           display\_label = str(

&#x20;               label

&#x20;           ).title()



&#x20;       options.append({



&#x20;           "label":

&#x20;               display\_label,



&#x20;           "value":

&#x20;               int(integer\_value)



&#x20;       })



&#x20;   return options



\# =========================================================

\# SAFE INTEGER CONVERSION

\# =========================================================



def safe\_int(value, default=0):

&#x20;   """

&#x20;   Convert UI value to integer.



&#x20;   This prevents:

&#x20;       ufunc 'isnan' not supported...



&#x20;   because the model receives numeric values instead

&#x20;   of strings / objects.

&#x20;   """



&#x20;   if value is None:

&#x20;       return int(default)



&#x20;   if isinstance(value, bool):

&#x20;       return int(value)



&#x20;   try:



&#x20;       if pd.isna(value):

&#x20;           return int(default)



&#x20;   except Exception:



&#x20;       pass



&#x20;   try:



&#x20;       return int(value)



&#x20;   except Exception:



&#x20;       return int(default)



\# =========================================================

\# NUMERIC FEATURE VALUES

\# =========================================================



def numeric\_feature\_value(

&#x20;   value,

&#x20;   df,

&#x20;   column,

&#x20;   default=0

):

&#x20;   """

&#x20;   Convert a FeatureEngineering-generated feature

&#x20;   to an integer.



&#x20;   Dropdown values are expected to already be integer

&#x20;   values where mappings are available.



&#x20;   For dynamically generated columns, values are converted

&#x20;   to integers where possible.

&#x20;   """



&#x20;   if value is None:

&#x20;       return int(default)



&#x20;   try:



&#x20;       if pd.isna(value):

&#x20;           return int(default)



&#x20;   except Exception:



&#x20;       pass



&#x20;   try:



&#x20;       return int(value)



&#x20;   except Exception:



&#x20;       pass



&#x20;   # -----------------------------------------------------

&#x20;   # Try matching against dataframe values

&#x20;   # -----------------------------------------------------



&#x20;   if column in df.columns:



&#x20;       try:



&#x20;           unique\_values = (

&#x20;               df\[column]

&#x20;               .dropna()

&#x20;               .unique()

&#x20;           )



&#x20;           # Direct string match

&#x20;           for item in unique\_values:



&#x20;               if str(item) == str(value):



&#x20;                   try:

&#x20;                       return int(item)

&#x20;                   except Exception:

&#x20;                       break



&#x20;       except Exception:



&#x20;           pass



&#x20;   return int(default)



\# =========================================================

\# CLEAN DATAFRAME VALUES

\# =========================================================



def clean\_values(series):



&#x20;   values = \[]



&#x20;   for value in series.dropna().unique():



&#x20;       try:



&#x20;           if pd.isna(value):

&#x20;               continue



&#x20;       except Exception:



&#x20;           pass



&#x20;       value\_str = str(value).strip()



&#x20;       if value\_str.lower() in \[

&#x20;           "missing",

&#x20;           "unknown",

&#x20;           "nan",

&#x20;           "none",

&#x20;           ""

&#x20;       ]:

&#x20;           continue



&#x20;       values.append(value)



&#x20;   return sorted(

&#x20;       values,

&#x20;       key=lambda x: str(x)

&#x20;   )



\# =========================================================

\# DYNAMIC OPTIONS

\# =========================================================



def build\_dynamic\_options(

&#x20;   df,

&#x20;   column

):

&#x20;   """

&#x20;   Build options for FeatureEngineering integer columns.



&#x20;   If the dataframe contains integers such as:



&#x20;       0

&#x20;       1

&#x20;       2



&#x20;   those integers are preserved as the actual UI values.

&#x20;   """



&#x20;   if column not in df.columns:



&#x20;       return \[]



&#x20;   values = clean\_values(

&#x20;       df\[column]

&#x20;   )



&#x20;   options = \[]



&#x20;   for value in values:



&#x20;       try:



&#x20;           integer\_value = int(value)



&#x20;           options.append({



&#x20;               "label":

&#x20;                   str(value),

The fix should be in predict\_page.py: do not convert the FeatureEngineering integer features back to strings. The UI can still display human-readable labels, but the value sent into ml.predict() must be the integer used by FeatureEngineering.



Also, reservation\_status and is\_canceled remain UI fields and are included in the prediction input.



Below is the revised predict\_page.py. It keeps your existing structure but separates:



UI display value → human-readable label



ML value → integer



reservation\_status → 0, 1, 2



is\_canceled → 0, 1



Other engineered categorical/group fields → integer



No "missing" strings sent to the trained encoder



All prediction outputs remain:

Customer Rating



Customer Risk Score



Cancellation Probability



Check Out Probability



No Show Probability



Service Level Risk



\*\*document: \*\*

\# =========================================================

\# HELPER:

\# SAFE INTEGER

\#

\# This prevents "missing", "", "nan", etc.

\# from reaching OneHotEncoder.

\# =========================================================



def safe\_integer(

&#x20;   value,

&#x20;   default=0

):



&#x20;   if value is None:

&#x20;       return int(default)



&#x20;   if isinstance(

&#x20;       value,

&#x20;       (int, np.integer)

&#x20;   ):



&#x20;       return int(value)



&#x20;   if isinstance(

&#x20;       value,

&#x20;       (float, np.floating)

&#x20;   ):



&#x20;       if np.isnan(value):

&#x20;           return int(default)



&#x20;       return int(value)



&#x20;   try:



&#x20;       value\_str = str(value).strip()



&#x20;       if value\_str.lower() in \[



&#x20;           "",

&#x20;           "missing",

&#x20;           "unknown",

&#x20;           "nan",

&#x20;           "none",

&#x20;           "null"



&#x20;       ]:



&#x20;           return int(default)



&#x20;       return int(float(value\_str))



&#x20;   except Exception:



&#x20;       return int(default)



\# =========================================================

\# HELPER:

\# SAFE FLOAT

\# =========================================================



def safe\_float(

&#x20;   value,

&#x20;   default=0.0

):



&#x20;   if value is None:



&#x20;       return float(default)



&#x20;   try:



&#x20;       number = float(value)



&#x20;       if np.isnan(number):



&#x20;           return float(default)



&#x20;       return number



&#x20;   except Exception:



&#x20;       return float(default)



\# =========================================================

\# HELPER:

\# CLEAN DATAFRAME VALUES

\#

\# Used only to generate UI options for engineered

\# integer columns.

\# =========================================================



def clean\_integer\_values(

&#x20;   series

):



&#x20;   values = \[]



&#x20;   for value in series.dropna().unique():



&#x20;       try:



&#x20;           values.append(

&#x20;               int(float(value))

&#x20;           )



&#x20;       except Exception:



&#x20;           continue



&#x20;   return sorted(

&#x20;       list(

&#x20;           set(values)

&#x20;       )

&#x20;   )

\# HELPER:

\# GENERATE OPTIONS FROM INTEGER FEATURE

\# =========================================================



def build\_integer\_feature\_options(

&#x20;   df,

&#x20;   column

):



&#x20;   if column not in df.columns:



&#x20;       return \[]



&#x20;   values = clean\_integer\_values(

&#x20;       df\[column]

&#x20;   )



&#x20;   return \[



&#x20;       {

&#x20;           "label": str(value),

&#x20;           "value": int(value)

&#x20;       }



&#x20;       for value in values



&#x20;   ]

&#x20;           "value": int(value)

city hotel → 0

local      → 0

low value  → 0



That means the model is receiving mostly zeros even though you selected different UI values.



The correct approach is:



UI label → FeatureEngineering's actual integer mapping → model



For example, if your FeatureEngineering produces:



city hotel → 0

airport hotel → 1



then selecting City Hotel should send integer 0.

def build\_options(mapping):

&#x20;   """

&#x20;   Display human-readable values while returning the

&#x20;   original STRING value to the prediction callback.



Example:



&#x20;   label = City Hotel

&#x20;   value = city hotel



NOT:



&#x20;   label = City Hotel

&#x20;   value = 0

"""



options = \[]



for value in mapping.values():



&#x20;   if value is None:

&#x20;       continue



&#x20;   value = str(value)



&#x20;   options.append({

&#x20;       "label": value.title(),

&#x20;       "value": value

&#x20;   })



return options



def safe(v):

&#x20;   """

&#x20;   Safely clean Dash dropdown values.



IMPORTANT:

Do not use np.isnan() or pd.isna() here because

prediction inputs can contain strings.

"""



if v is None:

&#x20;   return "missing"



if isinstance(v, str):



&#x20;   value = v.strip()



&#x20;   if value == "":

&#x20;       return "missing"



&#x20;   if value.lower() in \[

&#x20;       "nan",

&#x20;       "none",

&#x20;       "null",

&#x20;       "missing"

&#x20;   ]:

&#x20;       return "missing"



&#x20;   return value



return v



def clean\_values(series):

&#x20;   """

&#x20;   Clean categorical values for dropdowns.

&#x20;   """



if series is None:

&#x20;   return \[]



values = \[]



for value in series:



&#x20;   if value is None:

&#x20;       continue



&#x20;   if isinstance(value, float) and np.isnan(value):

&#x20;       continue



&#x20;   value = str(value).strip()



&#x20;   if value.lower() in \[

&#x20;       "missing",

&#x20;       "unknown",

&#x20;       "nan",

&#x20;       "none",

&#x20;       "null",

&#x20;       ""

&#x20;   ]:

&#x20;       continue



&#x20;   values.append(value)



return sorted(

&#x20;   list(set(values))

)

\# =========================================================

\# HELPER FUNCTIONS

\# =========================================================



def build\_options(mapping):

&#x20;   """

&#x20;   Build Dash dropdown options.



&#x20;   IMPORTANT:

&#x20;   Dropdown value remains INTEGER.



&#x20;   Example:



&#x20;       label = "City Hotel"

&#x20;       value = 0



&#x20;   The value is converted back to the original

&#x20;   FeatureEngineering category before prediction.

&#x20;   """



&#x20;   options = \[]



&#x20;   for integer\_value, original\_value in mapping.items():



&#x20;       if pd.isna(original\_value):



&#x20;           options.append({

&#x20;               "label": "Missing",

&#x20;               "value": integer\_value

&#x20;           })



&#x20;       else:



&#x20;           options.append({

&#x20;               "label": str(original\_value).title(),

&#x20;               "value": integer\_value

&#x20;           })



&#x20;   return options



def safe(v):

&#x20;   """

&#x20;   Safely handle empty Dash values.

&#x20;   """



&#x20;   if v is None:

&#x20;       return None



&#x20;   if isinstance(v, str):



&#x20;       if v.strip().lower() in \[

&#x20;           "",

&#x20;           "nan",

&#x20;           "none",

&#x20;           "missing"

&#x20;       ]:



&#x20;           return None



&#x20;   return v



def decode\_feature(

&#x20;   feature\_name,

&#x20;   value

):

&#x20;   """

&#x20;   Convert integer dropdown value back to the

&#x20;   exact categorical value used by FeatureEngineer.



&#x20;   Example:



&#x20;       decode\_feature("hotel", 0)



&#x20;       returns:



&#x20;       "city hotel"

&#x20;   """



&#x20;   value = safe(value)



&#x20;   if value is None:



&#x20;       return None



&#x20;   mapping = MAPPINGS.get(

&#x20;       feature\_name

&#x20;   )



&#x20;   if mapping is None:



&#x20;       return value



&#x20;   try:



&#x20;       integer\_value = int(value)



&#x20;   except (

&#x20;       ValueError,

&#x20;       TypeError

&#x20;   ):



&#x20;       return value



&#x20;   decoded\_value = mapping.get(

&#x20;       integer\_value

&#x20;   )



&#x20;   # -----------------------------------------------------

&#x20;   # IMPORTANT:

&#x20;   #

&#x20;   # Never pass np.nan into the model when possible.

&#x20;   #

&#x20;   # Missing categorical values should be represented

&#x20;   # consistently.

&#x20;   # -----------------------------------------------------



&#x20;   if decoded\_value is None:



&#x20;       return None



&#x20;   if pd.isna(decoded\_value):



&#x20;       return None



&#x20;   return decoded\_value



def decode\_numeric\_binary(

&#x20;   feature\_name,

&#x20;   value

):

&#x20;   """

&#x20;   Decode binary numeric values.



&#x20;   Used for fields such as is\_canceled.

&#x20;   """



&#x20;   value = safe(value)



&#x20;   if value is None:



&#x20;       return None



&#x20;   try:



&#x20;       return int(value)



&#x20;   except (

&#x20;       ValueError,

&#x20;       TypeError

&#x20;   ):



&#x20;       return value



def clean\_values(series):



&#x20;   return sorted(\[



&#x20;       v



&#x20;       for v in series.dropna()

&#x20;       .astype(str)

&#x20;       .unique()



&#x20;       if v.lower()

&#x20;       not in \[

&#x20;           "missing",

&#x20;           "unknown",

&#x20;           "nan",

&#x20;           "none",

&#x20;           ""

&#x20;       ]



&#x20;   ])

\# =========================================================

\# REGISTER CALLBACKS

def register\_callbacks(

&#x20;   app,

&#x20;   df

):



&#x20;   # =====================================================

&#x20;   # TOP BAD CLIENTS

&#x20;   # =====================================================



&#x20;   TOP\_CLIENTS = df.attrs.get(

&#x20;       "top\_10\_bad\_clients",

&#x20;       \[]

&#x20;   )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;   # PREDICTION CALLBACK

&#x20;   # =====================================================



&#x20;   @app.callback(



&#x20;       Output(

&#x20;           "output",

&#x20;           "children"

&#x20;       ),



&#x20;       Input(

&#x20;           "predict\_btn",

&#x20;           "n\_clicks"

&#x20;       ),



&#x20;       State(

&#x20;           "model\_choice",

&#x20;           "value"

&#x20;       ),



&#x20;       State(

&#x20;           "top\_bad\_client",

&#x20;           "value"

&#x20;       ),



&#x20;       State(

&#x20;           "hotel",

&#x20;           "value"

&#x20;       ),



&#x20;       State(

&#x20;           "country\_group",

&#x20;           "value"

&#x20;       ),



&#x20;       State(

&#x20;           "adr\_group",

&#x20;           "value"

&#x20;       ),



&#x20;       State(

&#x20;           "previous\_cancellations\_group",

&#x20;           "value"

&#x20;       ),



&#x20;       State(

&#x20;           "days\_in\_waiting\_list\_group",

&#x20;           "value"

&#x20;       ),



&#x20;       State(

&#x20;           "deposit\_type",

&#x20;           "value"

&#x20;       ),



&#x20;       State(

&#x20;           "customer\_type",

&#x20;           "value"

&#x20;       ),



&#x20;       State(

&#x20;           "guest\_group",

&#x20;           "value"

&#x20;       ),



&#x20;       State(

&#x20;           "season\_group",

&#x20;           "value"

&#x20;       ),



&#x20;       State(

&#x20;           "meal",

&#x20;           "value"

&#x20;       ),



&#x20;       State(

&#x20;           "market\_segment",

&#x20;           "value"

&#x20;       ),



&#x20;       State(

&#x20;           "distribution\_channel",

&#x20;           "value"

&#x20;       ),



&#x20;       State(

&#x20;           "reservation\_status",

&#x20;           "value"

&#x20;       ),



&#x20;       State(

&#x20;           "is\_canceled",

&#x20;           "value"

&#x20;       )



&#x20;   )



&#x20;   def predict(



&#x20;       n,



&#x20;       model\_choice,



&#x20;       top\_bad\_client,



&#x20;       hotel,



&#x20;       country\_group,



&#x20;       adr\_group,



&#x20;       previous\_cancellations\_group,



&#x20;       days\_in\_waiting\_list\_group,



&#x20;       deposit\_type,



&#x20;       customer\_type,



&#x20;       guest\_group,



&#x20;       season\_group,



&#x20;       meal,



&#x20;       market\_segment,



&#x20;       distribution\_channel,



&#x20;       reservation\_status,



&#x20;       is\_canceled



&#x20;   ):



&#x20;       # =================================================

&#x20;       # NO CLICK

&#x20;       # =================================================



&#x20;       if not n:



&#x20;           return ""



try:



&#x20;           # =================================================

&#x20;           # SWITCH MODEL

&#x20;           # =================================================



&#x20;           if model\_choice:



&#x20;               ml.set\_model(

&#x20;                   model\_choice

&#x20;               )



\# =================================================

&#x20;           # DECODE DASH INTEGER VALUES

&#x20;           #

&#x20;           # IMPORTANT:

&#x20;           #

&#x20;           # The dropdown sends:

&#x20;           #

&#x20;           # hotel = 0

&#x20;           # country\_group = 0

&#x20;           # adr\_group = 0

&#x20;           #

&#x20;           # But the FeatureEngineer/model expects:

&#x20;           #

&#x20;           # hotel = "city hotel"

&#x20;           # country\_group = "local"

&#x20;           # adr\_group = "Low value (≤100)"

&#x20;           # =================================================



&#x20;           decoded\_hotel = decode\_feature(

&#x20;               "hotel",

&#x20;               hotel

&#x20;           )



&#x20;           decoded\_country\_group = decode\_feature(

&#x20;               "country\_group",

&#x20;               country\_group

&#x20;           )



&#x20;           decoded\_adr\_group = decode\_feature(

&#x20;               "adr\_group",

&#x20;               adr\_group

&#x20;           )



&#x20;           decoded\_previous\_cancellations\_group = decode\_feature(

&#x20;               "previous\_cancellations\_group",

&#x20;               previous\_cancellations\_group

&#x20;           )



&#x20;           decoded\_days\_in\_waiting\_list\_group = decode\_feature(

&#x20;               "days\_in\_waiting\_list\_group",

&#x20;               days\_in\_waiting\_list\_group

&#x20;           )



&#x20;           decoded\_deposit\_type = decode\_feature(

&#x20;               "deposit\_type",

&#x20;               deposit\_type

&#x20;           )



&#x20;           decoded\_customer\_type = decode\_feature(

&#x20;               "customer\_type",

&#x20;               customer\_type

&#x20;           )



&#x20;           decoded\_guest\_group = decode\_feature(

&#x20;               "guest\_group",

&#x20;               guest\_group

&#x20;           )



&#x20;           decoded\_season\_group = decode\_feature(

&#x20;               "season\_group",

&#x20;               season\_group

&#x20;           )



&#x20;           decoded\_meal = decode\_feature(

&#x20;               "meal",

&#x20;               meal

&#x20;           )



&#x20;           decoded\_market\_segment = decode\_feature(

&#x20;               "market\_segment",

&#x20;               market\_segment

&#x20;           )



&#x20;           decoded\_distribution\_channel = decode\_feature(

&#x20;               "distribution\_channel",

&#x20;               distribution\_channel

&#x20;           )



&#x20;           decoded\_reservation\_status = decode\_feature(

&#x20;               "reservation\_status",

&#x20;               reservation\_status

&#x20;           )



&#x20;           decoded\_is\_canceled = decode\_numeric\_binary(

&#x20;               "is\_canceled",

&#x20;               is\_canceled

&#x20;           )



\# =================================================

&#x20;           # BUILD INPUT

&#x20;           #

&#x20;           # These are now the SAME TYPES used during

&#x20;           # FeatureEngineering/model training.

&#x20;           # =================================================



&#x20;           x = {



&#x20;               "comment": "",



&#x20;               "client\_email":

&#x20;                   safe(

&#x20;                       top\_bad\_client

&#x20;                   ),



&#x20;               "hotel":

&#x20;                   decoded\_hotel,



&#x20;               "country\_group":

&#x20;                   decoded\_country\_group,



&#x20;               "adr\_group":

&#x20;                   decoded\_adr\_group,



&#x20;               "previous\_cancellations\_group":

&#x20;                   decoded\_previous\_cancellations\_group,



&#x20;               "days\_in\_waiting\_list\_group":

&#x20;                   decoded\_days\_in\_waiting\_list\_group,



&#x20;               "deposit\_type":

&#x20;                   decoded\_deposit\_type,



&#x20;               "customer\_type":

&#x20;                   decoded\_customer\_type,



&#x20;               "guest\_group":

&#x20;                   decoded\_guest\_group,



&#x20;               "season\_group":

&#x20;                   decoded\_season\_group,



&#x20;               "meal":

&#x20;                   decoded\_meal,



&#x20;               "market\_segment":

&#x20;                   decoded\_market\_segment,



&#x20;               "distribution\_channel":

&#x20;                   decoded\_distribution\_channel,



&#x20;               "reservation\_status":

&#x20;                   decoded\_reservation\_status,



&#x20;               "is\_canceled":

&#x20;                   decoded\_is\_canceled

&#x20;           }



\# =================================================

&#x20;           # DEBUG PREDICTION INPUT

&#x20;           # =================================================



&#x20;           print()

&#x20;           print("==============================")

&#x20;           print("PREDICTION INPUT")

&#x20;           print("==============================")



&#x20;           print(

&#x20;               pd.DataFrame(\[x]).to\_string(

&#x20;                   index=False

&#x20;               )

&#x20;           )



print()

&#x20;           print("==============================")

&#x20;           print("DECODED VALUES")

&#x20;           print("==============================")



&#x20;           print(

&#x20;               f"hotel: "

&#x20;               f"{hotel} -> "

&#x20;               f"{decoded\_hotel}"

&#x20;           )



&#x20;           print(

&#x20;               f"country\_group: "

&#x20;               f"{country\_group} -> "

&#x20;               f"{decoded\_country\_group}"

&#x20;           )



&#x20;           print(

&#x20;               f"adr\_group: "

&#x20;               f"{adr\_group} -> "

&#x20;               f"{decoded\_adr\_group}"

&#x20;           )



&#x20;           print(

&#x20;               f"guest\_group: "

&#x20;               f"{guest\_group} -> "

&#x20;               f"{decoded\_guest\_group}"

&#x20;           )



&#x20;           print(

&#x20;               f"season\_group: "

&#x20;               f"{season\_group} -> "

&#x20;               f"{decoded\_season\_group}"

&#x20;           )



&#x20;           print(

&#x20;               f"deposit\_type: "

&#x20;               f"{deposit\_type} -> "

&#x20;               f"{decoded\_deposit\_type}"

&#x20;           )

So your log should no longer look like:

Instead, the prediction input should show approximately:



hotel                         city hotel

One important point



Your statement that "FeatureEngineering produces integers" doesn't match the feature\_engineering.py you just supplied.



For example, this code:



df\["country\_group"] = np.select(

&#x20;   \[...],

&#x20;   \[

&#x20;       "local",

&#x20;       "southeast\_asia",

&#x20;       "north\_asia",

&#x20;       "oceania",

&#x20;       "America",

&#x20;       "Europe"

&#x20;   ],

&#x20;   default="others"

)



produces strings, not integers.



Likewise:



df\["guest\_group"] = np.select(

&#x20;   \[...],

&#x20;   \[

&#x20;       "Single",

&#x20;       "Couple",

&#x20;       "Family",

&#x20;       "Group"

&#x20;   ],

&#x20;   default="Unknown"

)



produces strings.



So the revised predict\_page.py intentionally uses integer values only for the UI, then translates them back to the exact training categories before ml.predict().



That is the critical change for the ufunc 'isnan' error you showed.

\# Model:

\#     receives the ORIGINAL STRING values created by

\#     FeatureEngineer.

\#

\# Example:

\#

\#     City Hotel

\#         ↓

\#     dropdown value = 0

\#         ↓

\#     decode\_feature()

\#         ↓

\#     "city hotel"

\#         ↓

\#     ml.predict()

\#

\# =========================================================

\# HELPER FUNCTIONS

\# =========================================================



def build\_options(mapping):

&#x20;   """

&#x20;   Build dropdown options.



&#x20;   The VALUE is the integer key.



&#x20;   Example:



&#x20;       {

&#x20;           "label": "City Hotel",

&#x20;           "value": 0

&#x20;       }



&#x20;   """



&#x20;   options = \[]



&#x20;   for integer\_value, original\_value in mapping.items():



&#x20;       if original\_value is None:

&#x20;           continue



&#x20;       if isinstance(

&#x20;           original\_value,

&#x20;           float

&#x20;       ) and np.isnan(

&#x20;           original\_value

&#x20;       ):

&#x20;           continue



&#x20;       options.append({



&#x20;           "label":

&#x20;               str(

&#x20;                   original\_value

&#x20;               ).title(),



&#x20;           "value":

&#x20;               integer\_value



&#x20;       })



&#x20;   return options



def safe(value):

&#x20;   """

&#x20;   Handle empty values safely.



&#x20;   Do NOT convert missing values to the string

&#x20;   "missing" because that string may not exist

&#x20;   in the trained OneHotEncoder categories.



&#x20;   None is safer for categorical preprocessing.

&#x20;   """



&#x20;   if value is None:

&#x20;       return None



&#x20;   if isinstance(

&#x20;       value,

&#x20;       str

&#x20;   ):



&#x20;       value = value.strip()



&#x20;       if value == "":

&#x20;           return None



&#x20;       if value.lower() in \[

&#x20;           "nan",

&#x20;           "none",

&#x20;           "null",

&#x20;           "missing"

&#x20;       ]:

&#x20;           return None



&#x20;   return value



def decode\_feature(

&#x20;   feature\_name,

&#x20;   value

):

&#x20;   """

&#x20;   Convert integer dropdown value back to the

&#x20;   exact FeatureEngineering category.



&#x20;   Example:



&#x20;       decode\_feature(

&#x20;           "hotel",

&#x20;           0

&#x20;       )



&#x20;       returns:



&#x20;       "city hotel"

&#x20;   """



&#x20;   value = safe(value)



&#x20;   if value is None:

&#x20;       return None



&#x20;   mapping = MAPPINGS.get(

&#x20;       feature\_name

&#x20;   )



&#x20;   if mapping is None:

&#x20;       return value



&#x20;   try:



&#x20;       integer\_value = int(

&#x20;           value

&#x20;       )



&#x20;   except (

&#x20;       ValueError,

&#x20;       TypeError

&#x20;   ):



&#x20;       return value



&#x20;   decoded = mapping.get(

&#x20;       integer\_value

&#x20;   )



&#x20;   if decoded is None:

&#x20;       return None



&#x20;   if (

&#x20;       isinstance(

&#x20;           decoded,

&#x20;           float

&#x20;       )

&#x20;       and

&#x20;       np.isnan(decoded)

&#x20;   ):

&#x20;       return None



&#x20;   return decoded



def clean\_values(series):

&#x20;   """

&#x20;   Clean values for dynamically generated

&#x20;   dropdown fields.

&#x20;   """



&#x20;   if series is None:

&#x20;       return \[]



&#x20;   values = \[]



&#x20;   for value in series:



&#x20;       if value is None:

&#x20;           continue



&#x20;       if (

&#x20;           isinstance(

&#x20;               value,

&#x20;               float

&#x20;           )

&#x20;           and

&#x20;           np.isnan(value)

&#x20;       ):

&#x20;           continue



&#x20;       value = str(

&#x20;           value

&#x20;       ).strip()



&#x20;       if value.lower() in \[

&#x20;           "missing",

&#x20;           "unknown",

&#x20;           "nan",

&#x20;           "none",

&#x20;           "null",

&#x20;           ""

&#x20;       ]:

&#x20;           continue



&#x20;       values.append(

&#x20;           value

&#x20;       )



&#x20;   return sorted(

&#x20;       list(

&#x20;           set(values)

&#x20;       )

&#x20;   )

def register\_callbacks(

&#x20;   app,

&#x20;   df

):



&#x20;   # =====================================================

&#x20;   # PREDICTION CALLBACK

&#x20;   # =====================================================



&#x20;   @app.callback(



&#x20;       Output(

&#x20;           "output",

&#x20;           "children"

&#x20;       ),



&#x20;       Input(

&#x20;           "predict\_btn",

&#x20;           "n\_clicks"

&#x20;       ),



&#x20;       State(

&#x20;           "model\_choice",

&#x20;           "value"

&#x20;       ),



&#x20;       State(

&#x20;           "top\_bad\_client",

&#x20;           "value"

&#x20;       ),



&#x20;       State(

&#x20;           "hotel",

&#x20;           "value"

&#x20;       ),



&#x20;       State(

&#x20;           "country\_group",

&#x20;           "value"

&#x20;       ),



&#x20;       State(

&#x20;           "adr\_group",

&#x20;           "value"

&#x20;       ),



&#x20;       State(

&#x20;           "previous\_cancellations\_group",

&#x20;           "value"

&#x20;       ),



&#x20;       State(

&#x20;           "days\_in\_waiting\_list\_group",

&#x20;           "value"

&#x20;       ),



&#x20;       State(

&#x20;           "deposit\_type",

&#x20;           "value"

&#x20;       ),



&#x20;       State(

&#x20;           "customer\_type",

&#x20;           "value"

&#x20;       ),



&#x20;       State(

&#x20;           "guest\_group",

&#x20;           "value"

&#x20;       ),



&#x20;       State(

&#x20;           "season\_group",

&#x20;           "value"

&#x20;       ),



&#x20;       State(

&#x20;           "meal",

&#x20;           "value"

&#x20;       ),



&#x20;       State(

&#x20;           "market\_segment",

&#x20;           "value"

&#x20;       ),



&#x20;       State(

&#x20;           "distribution\_channel",

&#x20;           "value"

&#x20;       ),



&#x20;       State(

&#x20;           "reservation\_status",

&#x20;           "value"

&#x20;       ),



&#x20;       State(

&#x20;           "is\_canceled",

&#x20;           "value"

&#x20;       )



&#x20;   )



&#x20;   def predict(



&#x20;       n,



&#x20;       model\_choice,



&#x20;       top\_bad\_client,



&#x20;       hotel,



&#x20;       country\_group,



&#x20;       adr\_group,



&#x20;       previous\_cancellations\_group,



&#x20;       days\_in\_waiting\_list\_group,



&#x20;       deposit\_type,



&#x20;       customer\_type,



&#x20;       guest\_group,



&#x20;       season\_group,



&#x20;       meal,



&#x20;       market\_segment,



&#x20;       distribution\_channel,



&#x20;       reservation\_status,



&#x20;       is\_canceled



&#x20;   ):



&#x20;       # =================================================

&#x20;       # NO CLICK

&#x20;       # =================================================



&#x20;       if not n:

&#x20;           return ""



try:



&#x20;           # =================================================

&#x20;           # SWITCH MODEL

&#x20;           # =================================================



&#x20;           if model\_choice:



&#x20;               ml.set\_model(

&#x20;                   model\_choice

&#x20;               )



\# =================================================

&#x20;           # DECODE INTEGER VALUES

&#x20;           #

&#x20;           # Example:

&#x20;           #

&#x20;           # hotel:

&#x20;           #     0

&#x20;           #

&#x20;           # becomes:

&#x20;           #     "city hotel"

&#x20;           #

&#x20;           # =================================================



&#x20;           decoded\_hotel = decode\_feature(

&#x20;               "hotel",

&#x20;               hotel

&#x20;           )



&#x20;           decoded\_country\_group = decode\_feature(

&#x20;               "country\_group",

&#x20;               country\_group

&#x20;           )



&#x20;           decoded\_adr\_group = decode\_feature(

&#x20;               "adr\_group",

&#x20;               adr\_group

&#x20;           )



&#x20;           decoded\_previous\_cancellations\_group = decode\_feature(

&#x20;               "previous\_cancellations\_group",

&#x20;               previous\_cancellations\_group

&#x20;           )



&#x20;           decoded\_days\_in\_waiting\_list\_group = decode\_feature(

&#x20;               "days\_in\_waiting\_list\_group",

&#x20;               days\_in\_waiting\_list\_group

&#x20;           )



&#x20;           decoded\_deposit\_type = decode\_feature(

&#x20;               "deposit\_type",

&#x20;               deposit\_type

&#x20;           )



&#x20;           decoded\_customer\_type = decode\_feature(

&#x20;               "customer\_type",

&#x20;               customer\_type

&#x20;           )



&#x20;           decoded\_guest\_group = decode\_feature(

&#x20;               "guest\_group",

&#x20;               guest\_group

&#x20;           )



&#x20;           decoded\_season\_group = decode\_feature(

&#x20;               "season\_group",

&#x20;               season\_group

&#x20;           )



&#x20;           decoded\_meal = decode\_feature(

&#x20;               "meal",

&#x20;               meal

&#x20;           )



&#x20;           decoded\_market\_segment = decode\_feature(

&#x20;               "market\_segment",

&#x20;               market\_segment

&#x20;           )



&#x20;           decoded\_distribution\_channel = decode\_feature(

&#x20;               "distribution\_channel",

&#x20;               distribution\_channel

&#x20;           )



&#x20;           decoded\_reservation\_status = decode\_feature(

&#x20;               "reservation\_status",

&#x20;               reservation\_status

&#x20;           )



&#x20;           decoded\_is\_canceled = decode\_feature(

&#x20;               "is\_canceled",

&#x20;               is\_canceled

&#x20;           )



\# =================================================

&#x20;           # BUILD MODEL INPUT

&#x20;           # =================================================



&#x20;           x = {



&#x20;               "comment":

&#x20;                   "",



&#x20;               "client\_email":

&#x20;                   safe(

&#x20;                       top\_bad\_client

&#x20;                   ),



&#x20;               "hotel":

&#x20;                   decoded\_hotel,



&#x20;               "country\_group":

&#x20;                   decoded\_country\_group,



&#x20;               "adr\_group":

&#x20;                   decoded\_adr\_group,



&#x20;               "previous\_cancellations\_group":

&#x20;                   decoded\_previous\_cancellations\_group,



&#x20;               "days\_in\_waiting\_list\_group":

&#x20;                   decoded\_days\_in\_waiting\_list\_group,



&#x20;               "deposit\_type":

&#x20;                   decoded\_deposit\_type,



&#x20;               "customer\_type":

&#x20;                   decoded\_customer\_type,



&#x20;               "guest\_group":

&#x20;                   decoded\_guest\_group,



&#x20;               "season\_group":

&#x20;                   decoded\_season\_group,



&#x20;               "meal":

&#x20;                   decoded\_meal,



&#x20;               "market\_segment":

&#x20;                   decoded\_market\_segment,



&#x20;               "distribution\_channel":

&#x20;                   decoded\_distribution\_channel,



&#x20;               "reservation\_status":

&#x20;                   decoded\_reservation\_status,



&#x20;               "is\_canceled":

&#x20;                   decoded\_is\_canceled



&#x20;           }



\# =================================================

&#x20;           # DEBUG

&#x20;           # =================================================



&#x20;           print()

&#x20;           print(

&#x20;               "========================================"

&#x20;           )

&#x20;           print(

&#x20;               "PREDICTION INPUT"

&#x20;           )

&#x20;           print(

&#x20;               "========================================"

&#x20;           )



&#x20;           for key, value in x.items():



&#x20;               print(

&#x20;                   f"{key:<35} "

&#x20;                   f"{value!r:<35} "

&#x20;                   f"type={type(value).\_\_name\_\_}"

&#x20;               )



\# =================================================

&#x20;           # IMPORTANT DEBUG

&#x20;           #

&#x20;           # This proves the integer UI values are being

&#x20;           # converted back to the FeatureEngineering

&#x20;           # strings.

&#x20;           # =================================================



&#x20;           print()

&#x20;           print(

&#x20;               "========================================"

&#x20;           )

&#x20;           print(

&#x20;               "INTEGER -> FEATURE ENGINEERING VALUE"

&#x20;           )

&#x20;           print(

&#x20;               "========================================"

&#x20;           )



&#x20;           print(

&#x20;               f"hotel: "

&#x20;               f"{hotel!r} -> "

&#x20;               f"{decoded\_hotel!r}"

&#x20;           )



&#x20;           print(

&#x20;               f"country\_group: "

&#x20;               f"{country\_group!r} -> "

&#x20;               f"{decoded\_country\_group!r}"

&#x20;           )



&#x20;           print(

&#x20;               f"adr\_group: "

&#x20;               f"{adr\_group!r} -> "

&#x20;               f"{decoded\_adr\_group!r}"

&#x20;           )



&#x20;           print(

&#x20;               f"{previous\_cancellations\_group!r} -> "

Yes. The current error is because your FeatureEngineer output is integer/binary for ML, but predict\_page.py is still sending the original string categories such as "city hotel", "local", and "Low value (≤100)" directly into ml.predict().



Your training pipeline and prediction pipeline therefore do not have the same input representation.



The important point is:



hotel = "city hotel" → must become the same integer representation used during FeatureEngineering.



country\_group = "local" → must become its trained integer representation.



adr\_group = "Low value (≤100)" → must become its trained integer representation.



And the other categorical/group fields must follow the same encoding learned during training.



Also, simply converting strings to 0 is not correct. The integer must correspond to the training encoding.



Below is a revised predict\_page.py that:
