\# =========================================================

\# SAFE STRING VALUE

\# =========================================================



def safe(value):



&#x20;   if value is None:

&#x20;       return "missing"



&#x20;   if isinstance(value, float):



&#x20;       if np.isnan(value):

&#x20;           return "missing"



&#x20;   if isinstance(value, str):



&#x20;       value = value.strip()



&#x20;       if value == "":

&#x20;           return "missing"



&#x20;       if value.lower() in \[

&#x20;           "nan",

&#x20;           "none",

&#x20;           "null",

&#x20;           "missing"

&#x20;       ]:



&#x20;           return "missing"



&#x20;       return value



&#x20;   return value



\# =========================================================

\# CONVERT DROPDOWN VALUE TO INTEGER

\#

\# IMPORTANT

\#

\# This is the critical part.

\#

\# Example:

\#

\# "city hotel"

\#       ↓

\# 0

\#

\# "local"

\#       ↓

\# 0

\#

\# "Low value (≤100)"

\#       ↓

\# 0

\#

\# =========================================================



def encode\_feature(

&#x20;   feature\_name,

&#x20;   value

):



&#x20;   value = safe(value)



&#x20;   # -----------------------------------------------------

&#x20;   # Missing

&#x20;   # -----------------------------------------------------



&#x20;   if value == "missing":



&#x20;       # Numeric fallback

&#x20;       return 0



\# -----------------------------------------------------

&#x20;   # Already numeric

&#x20;   # -----------------------------------------------------



&#x20;   if isinstance(

&#x20;       value,

&#x20;       (int, np.integer)

&#x20;   ):



&#x20;       return int(value)



if isinstance(

&#x20;       value,

&#x20;       (float, np.floating)

&#x20;   ):



&#x20;       if np.isnan(value):

&#x20;           return 0



&#x20;       return int(value)



\# -----------------------------------------------------

&#x20;   # Convert string

&#x20;   # -----------------------------------------------------



&#x20;   value = str(value).strip()



\# -----------------------------------------------------

&#x20;   # Mapping

&#x20;   # -----------------------------------------------------



&#x20;   mapping = MAPPINGS.get(

&#x20;       feature\_name,

&#x20;       {}

&#x20;   )



if value in mapping:



&#x20;       return int(

&#x20;           mapping\[value]

&#x20;       )



\# -----------------------------------------------------

&#x20;   # Try numeric string

&#x20;   # -----------------------------------------------------



&#x20;   try:



&#x20;       return int(

&#x20;           float(value)

&#x20;       )



&#x20;   except (ValueError, TypeError):



&#x20;       pass



\# -----------------------------------------------------

&#x20;   # Unknown category

&#x20;   # -----------------------------------------------------



&#x20;   print(

&#x20;       f"\[WARNING] Unknown category "

&#x20;       f"for {feature\_name}: {value!r}"

&#x20;   )



&#x20;   return 0



\# =========================================================

\# =========================================================



def make\_numeric\_input(x):



&#x20;   result = {}



&#x20;   for key, value in x.items():



&#x20;       if key == "comment":



&#x20;           result\[key] = ""



&#x20;           continue



if key == "client\_email":



&#x20;           result\[key] = str(

&#x20;               value

&#x20;               if value is not None

&#x20;               else "missing"

&#x20;           )



&#x20;           continue



if key in MAPPINGS:



&#x20;           result\[key] = encode\_feature(

&#x20;               key,

&#x20;               value

&#x20;           )



&#x20;           continue



result\[key] = value



return result

&#x20;                   max\_iter=300,

&#x20;                   tol=1e-2,

&#x20;                   class\_weight=class\_weight\_dict,

&#x20;                   n\_jobs=-1

&#x20;               )

&#x20;           )



&#x20;       ]),



"Linear SVC": Pipeline(\[



&#x20;           (

&#x20;               "prep",

&#x20;               preprocess

&#x20;           ),



&#x20;           (

&#x20;               "clf",

&#x20;               LinearSVC(

&#x20;                   class\_weight=class\_weight\_dict,

&#x20;                   max\_iter=1000,

&#x20;                   tol=1e-2,

&#x20;                   dual=False

&#x20;               )

&#x20;           )



&#x20;       ]),



"LightGBM": Pipeline(\[



&#x20;           (

&#x20;               "prep",

&#x20;               preprocess

&#x20;           ),



&#x20;           (

&#x20;               "clf",

&#x20;               LGBMClassifier(

&#x20;                   n\_estimators=300,

&#x20;                   learning\_rate=0.05,

&#x20;                   num\_leaves=31,

&#x20;                   class\_weight=class\_weight\_dict,

&#x20;                   random\_state=42,

&#x20;                   verbosity=-1

&#x20;               )

&#x20;           )



&#x20;       ])



&#x20;   }



self.models = models



\# =========================================================

&#x20;   # EVALUATION HELPER

&#x20;   # =========================================================



&#x20;   def evaluate(

&#x20;       model,

&#x20;       X\_eval,

&#x20;       y\_true,

&#x20;       name,

&#x20;       show\_report=True

&#x20;   ):



&#x20;       preds = model.predict(

&#x20;           X\_eval

&#x20;       )



f1 = f1\_score(

&#x20;           y\_true,

&#x20;           preds,

&#x20;           average="weighted"

&#x20;       )



try:



&#x20;           clf = model.named\_steps\[

&#x20;               "clf"

&#x20;           ]



if hasattr(

&#x20;               clf,

&#x20;               "predict\_proba"

&#x20;           ):



&#x20;               probs = model.predict\_proba(

&#x20;                   X\_eval

&#x20;               )



&#x20;           else:



&#x20;               scores = model.decision\_function(

&#x20;                   X\_eval

&#x20;               )



&#x20;               scores = np.asarray(

&#x20;                   scores

&#x20;               )



if scores.ndim == 1:



&#x20;                   scores = np.column\_stack(

&#x20;                       \[

&#x20;                           -scores,

&#x20;                           scores

&#x20;                       ]

&#x20;                   )



exp = np.exp(

&#x20;                   scores -

&#x20;                   np.max(

&#x20;                       scores,

&#x20;                       axis=1,

&#x20;                       keepdims=True

&#x20;                   )

&#x20;               )



probs = (

&#x20;                   exp /

&#x20;                   exp.sum(

&#x20;                       axis=1,

&#x20;                       keepdims=True

&#x20;                   )

&#x20;               )



roc = roc\_auc\_score(

&#x20;               y\_true,

&#x20;               probs,

&#x20;               multi\_class="ovr",

&#x20;               average="weighted"

&#x20;           )



except Exception as e:



&#x20;           print(

&#x20;               f"\[WARNING] ROC-AUC failed "

&#x20;               f"for {name}: {e}"

&#x20;           )



&#x20;           roc = 0.0



if show\_report:



&#x20;           print()

&#x20;           print("==============================")

&#x20;           print(name)

&#x20;           print("==============================")



print(

&#x20;               classification\_report(

&#x20;                   y\_true,

&#x20;                   preds

&#x20;               )

&#x20;           )



print(

&#x20;               "F1 Score :",

&#x20;               round(

&#x20;                   f1,

&#x20;                   4

&#x20;               )

&#x20;           )



print(

&#x20;               "ROC-AUC  :",

&#x20;               round(

&#x20;                   roc,

&#x20;                   4

&#x20;               )

&#x20;           )



return {



&#x20;           "model": name,

&#x20;           "f1": f1,

&#x20;           "roc": roc



&#x20;       }



\# =========================================================

&#x20;   # TRAIN MODELS

&#x20;   # =========================================================



&#x20;   print()

&#x20;   print("==============================")

&#x20;   print("TRAINING MODELS")

&#x20;   print("==============================")



for name, model in models.items():



&#x20;       print(

&#x20;           f"Training {name}..."

&#x20;       )



model.fit(

&#x20;           X\_train,

&#x20;           y\_train

&#x20;       )



print(

&#x20;           f"{name} completed."

&#x20;       )



\# =========================================================

&#x20;   # RESERVATION STATUS MODEL

&#x20;   print()

&#x20;   print("RESERVATION STATUS TRAINING")

status\_preprocess = ColumnTransformer(\[



&#x20;       (

&#x20;           text\_pipeline,

&#x20;       ),



&#x20;       (

&#x20;           "cat",

&#x20;           OneHotEncoder(

&#x20;               handle\_unknown="ignore"

&#x20;           ),

&#x20;           structured\_features\_with\_comments

&#x20;       )



&#x20;   ])



print(

&#x20;       "Fitting reservation status preprocessing..."

&#x20;   )



status\_features = \[



&#x20;       "hotel",

&#x20;       "meal",

&#x20;       "market\_segment",

&#x20;       "distribution\_channel",

&#x20;       "deposit\_type",

&#x20;       "customer\_type",

&#x20;       "season\_group",

&#x20;       "country\_group",

&#x20;       "adr\_group",

&#x20;       "previous\_cancellations\_group",

&#x20;       "is\_canceled"



&#x20;   ]



status\_numeric\_features = \[

&#x20;       if col in \[

&#x20;           "client\_bad\_rate"

&#x20;       ]

status\_categorical\_features = \[



&#x20;       col

&#x20;       for col in status\_features

&#x20;       if col not in status\_numeric\_features



&#x20;   ]



status\_preprocess = ColumnTransformer(\[



&#x20;       (

&#x20;           "text",

&#x20;           text\_pipeline,

&#x20;           "comment"

&#x20;       ),



&#x20;       (

&#x20;           "cat",

&#x20;           OneHotEncoder(

&#x20;           ),

&#x20;           status\_categorical\_features

&#x20;       ),



&#x20;       (

&#x20;           "num",

&#x20;           "passthrough",

&#x20;           status\_numeric\_features

&#x20;       )



&#x20;   ])



X\_train\_status\_input = train\_df\[

&#x20;       \["comment"] +

&#x20;       status\_features

&#x20;   ]



&#x20;   X\_val\_status\_input = val\_df\[

&#x20;       \["comment"] +

&#x20;       status\_features

&#x20;   ]



&#x20;   X\_test\_status\_input = test\_df\[

&#x20;       \["comment"] +

&#x20;       status\_features

&#x20;   ]



X\_train\_status = (

&#x20;       status\_preprocess.fit\_transform(

&#x20;           X\_train\_status\_input

&#x20;       )

&#x20;   )



X\_val\_status = (

&#x20;       status\_preprocess.transform(

&#x20;           X\_val\_status\_input

&#x20;       )

&#x20;   )



X\_test\_status = (

&#x20;       status\_preprocess.transform(

&#x20;           X\_test\_status\_input

&#x20;       )

&#x20;   )



self.status\_model = LogisticRegression(

&#x20;       solver="saga",

&#x20;       max\_iter=100,

&#x20;       tol=1e-2,

&#x20;       class\_weight="balanced",

&#x20;       n\_jobs=-1

&#x20;   )



print(

&#x20;       "Training Reservation Status Model..."

&#x20;   )



self.status\_model.fit(

&#x20;       X\_train\_status,

&#x20;       y\_status\_train

&#x20;   )



print(

&#x20;       "Reservation Status Model completed."

&#x20;   )



self.status\_preprocess = (

&#x20;       status\_preprocess

&#x20;   )



\# =========================================================

&#x20;   # RESERVATION STATUS EVALUATION

&#x20;   # =========================================================



&#x20;   print()

&#x20;   print("==============================")

&#x20;   print("RESERVATION STATUS EVALUATION")

&#x20;   print("==============================")



status\_preds = (

&#x20;       self.status\_model.predict(

&#x20;           X\_test\_status

&#x20;       )

&#x20;   )



print(

&#x20;       classification\_report(

&#x20;           y\_status\_test,

&#x20;           status\_preds

&#x20;       )

&#x20;   )



\# =========================================================

&#x20;   # VALIDATION

&#x20;   # =========================================================



&#x20;   print()

&#x20;   print("==============================")

&#x20;   print("VALIDATION")

&#x20;   print("==============================")



validation\_results = \[]



for name, model in models.items():



&#x20;       result = evaluate(

&#x20;           model,

&#x20;           X\_val,

&#x20;           y\_val,

&#x20;           name,

&#x20;           show\_report=True

&#x20;       )



validation\_results.append(

&#x20;           result

&#x20;       )



\# =========================================================

&#x20;   # SELECT BEST MODEL

&#x20;   # =========================================================



&#x20;   validation\_df = pd.DataFrame(

&#x20;       validation\_results

&#x20;   )



validation\_df\["final\_score"] = (



&#x20;       0.6 \*

&#x20;       validation\_df\["f1"]



&#x20;       +



&#x20;       0.4 \*

&#x20;       validation\_df\["roc"]



&#x20;   )



validation\_df = validation\_df.sort\_values(

&#x20;       "final\_score",

&#x20;       ascending=False

&#x20;   )



print()

&#x20;   print("==============================")

&#x20;   print("VALIDATION MODEL RANKING")

&#x20;   print("==============================")



print(

&#x20;       validation\_df\[

&#x20;           \[

&#x20;               "model",

&#x20;               "f1",

&#x20;               "roc",

&#x20;               "final\_score"

&#x20;           ]

&#x20;       ].to\_string(

&#x20;           index=False

&#x20;       )

&#x20;   )



\# =========================================================

&#x20;   # BEST MODEL

&#x20;   # =========================================================



&#x20;   self.best\_model\_name = (

&#x20;       validation\_df.iloc\[0]\["model"]

&#x20;   )



self.best\_model = (

&#x20;       self.models\[

&#x20;           self.best\_model\_name

&#x20;       ]

&#x20;   )



print(

&#x20;       "\\nBEST MODEL SELECTED:",

&#x20;       self.best\_model\_name

&#x20;   )



\# =========================================================

&#x20;   # FINAL TEST EVALUATION

&#x20;   # =========================================================



&#x20;   print()

&#x20;   print("==============================")

&#x20;   print("FINAL TEST EVALUATION")

&#x20;   print("==============================")



test\_result = evaluate(

&#x20;       self.best\_model,

&#x20;       show\_report=True

&#x20;   )



self.results\_df = pd.DataFrame(\[



&#x20;       {



&#x20;           "model":

&#x20;               self.best\_model\_name,



&#x20;           "f1":

&#x20;               test\_result\["f1"],



&#x20;           "roc":

&#x20;                   0.4 \*

&#x20;                   test\_result\["roc"]

&#x20;               )



&#x20;       }



&#x20;   ])



\# =========================================================

&#x20;   # REFERENCE DATA

&#x20;   # =========================================================



&#x20;   self.df\_reference = pd.concat(

&#x20;       \[

&#x20;           train\_df,

&#x20;           val\_df,

&#x20;           test\_df

&#x20;       ],

&#x20;       axis=0

&#x20;   )



\# =========================================================

&#x20;   # COMMENT DATA

&#x20;   reference\_df = self.df\_reference.copy()



reference\_df\["comment"] = (

&#x20;       reference\_df\["comment"]

&#x20;       .fillna("")

&#x20;       .astype(str)

&#x20;   )



self.comment\_df = reference\_df\[\[



&#x20;       "comment",

&#x20;       "hotel",

&#x20;       "meal",

&#x20;       "market\_segment",

&#x20;       "distribution\_channel",

&#x20;       "deposit\_type",

&#x20;       "customer\_type",

&#x20;       "country\_group",

&#x20;       "previous\_cancellations\_group",

&#x20;       "days\_in\_waiting\_list\_group",

&#x20;       "guest\_group",

&#x20;       "final\_rating"



&#x20;   ]].copy()



\# =========================================================

&#x20;   # COMMENT INDEX

&#x20;   # =========================================================



&#x20;   self.comment\_index = {}



fields = \[



&#x20;       "hotel",

&#x20;       "meal",

&#x20;       "market\_segment",

&#x20;       "distribution\_channel",

&#x20;       "deposit\_type",

&#x20;       "customer\_type",

&#x20;       "season\_group",

&#x20;       "country\_group",

&#x20;       "adr\_group",

&#x20;       "previous\_cancellations\_group",

&#x20;       "days\_in\_waiting\_list\_group",

&#x20;       "guest\_group"



&#x20;   ]



for rating, df\_r in reference\_df.groupby(

&#x20;       "final\_rating"

&#x20;   ):



&#x20;       rating\_key = str(

&#x20;           rating

&#x20;       )



self.comment\_index\[

&#x20;           rating\_key

&#x20;       ] = {



&#x20;           "ALL":

&#x20;               df\_r\[

&#x20;                   "comment"

&#x20;               ].tolist(),



&#x20;           "FIELDS":

&#x20;               {}



&#x20;       }



for field in fields:



&#x20;           if field not in df\_r.columns:

&#x20;               continue



self.comment\_index\[

&#x20;               rating\_key

&#x20;           ]\[

&#x20;               "FIELDS"

&#x20;           ]\[field] = (



&#x20;               df\_r

&#x20;               .groupby(field)\["comment"]

&#x20;               .apply(list)

&#x20;               .to\_dict()



&#x20;           )



print(

&#x20;       "FAST COMMENT INDEX READY "

&#x20;       "(RATING-FIRST + UI FILTER)"

&#x20;   )

&#x20;   # SAVE ARTIFACTS

&#x20;   self.\_save\_artifacts(

&#x20;   )



return reference\_df

\# SAVE MODEL + TRAIN DATA

def \_save\_artifacts(

&#x20;   self,

&#x20;   df

):



&#x20;   trained\_dir = self.config.get(

&#x20;       "trained\_dir",

&#x20;       "trained"

&#x20;   )



os.makedirs(

&#x20;       trained\_dir,

&#x20;       exist\_ok=True

&#x20;   )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;   # SAVE PROCESSED TRAIN DATA

&#x20;   # =====================================================



&#x20;   train\_path = self.config.get(

&#x20;       "train\_data",

&#x20;       os.path.join(

&#x20;           trained\_dir,

&#x20;           "train.parquet"

&#x20;       )

&#x20;   )



df.to\_parquet(

&#x20;       train\_path,

&#x20;       index=False

&#x20;   )



print(

&#x20;       f"\[INFO] Training data saved: "

&#x20;       f"{train\_path}"

&#x20;   )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;   # SAVE SERVICE MODEL

&#x20;   # =====================================================



&#x20;   model\_path = self.config.get(

&#x20;       "service\_model",

&#x20;       os.path.join(

&#x20;           trained\_dir,

&#x20;           "service\_model.pkl"

&#x20;       )

&#x20;   )



joblib.dump(

&#x20;       self,

&#x20;       model\_path

&#x20;   )



print(

&#x20;       f"\[INFO] Service model saved: "

&#x20;       f"{model\_path}"

&#x20;   )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;   # SAVE METADATA

&#x20;   # =====================================================



&#x20;   metadata\_path = self.config.get(

&#x20;       "training\_metadata",

&#x20;       os.path.join(

&#x20;           trained\_dir,

&#x20;           "training\_metadata.json"

&#x20;       )

&#x20;   )



import json



metadata = {}



if os.path.exists(

&#x20;       metadata\_path

&#x20;   ):



&#x20;       with open(

&#x20;           metadata\_path,

&#x20;           "r"

&#x20;       ) as f:



&#x20;           metadata = json.load(

&#x20;               f

&#x20;           )



metadata.update({



&#x20;       "model":

&#x20;           self.best\_model\_name,



&#x20;       "trained\_time":

&#x20;           datetime.now().isoformat(),



&#x20;       "rows":

&#x20;           len(df),



&#x20;       "columns":

&#x20;           list(df.columns)



&#x20;   })



with open(

&#x20;       metadata\_path,

&#x20;       "w"

&#x20;   ) as f:



&#x20;       json.dump(

&#x20;           metadata,

&#x20;           f,

&#x20;           indent=4

&#x20;       )



print(

&#x20;       f"\[INFO] Metadata updated: "

&#x20;       f"{metadata\_path}"

&#x20;   )



\# =====================================================

\# SWITCH MODEL

\# =====================================================



def set\_model(

&#x20;   self,

&#x20;   name: str

):



&#x20;   if name in self.models:



&#x20;       self.best\_model\_name = name



&#x20;       self.best\_model = (

&#x20;           self.models\[name]

&#x20;       )



\# =========================================================

\# PREDICT

\# =========================================================



def predict(

&#x20;   self,

&#x20;   x: dict

):



&#x20;   # =====================================================

&#x20;   # STRUCTURED FEATURES

&#x20;   # =====================================================



&#x20;   structured\_features = \[



&#x20;       "comment",

&#x20;       "hotel",

&#x20;       "meal",

&#x20;       "market\_segment",

&#x20;       "distribution\_channel",

&#x20;       "deposit\_type",

&#x20;       "customer\_type",

&#x20;       "season\_group",

&#x20;       "country\_group",

&#x20;       "adr\_group",

&#x20;       "previous\_cancellations\_group",

&#x20;       "days\_in\_waiting\_list\_group",

&#x20;       "guest\_group",

&#x20;       "client\_segment",

&#x20;       "is\_top\_bad\_client",

&#x20;       "client\_bad\_rate",

&#x20;       "reservation\_status",

&#x20;       "is\_canceled"



&#x20;   ]



\# =====================================================

&#x20;   # CREATE INPUT DATAFRAME

&#x20;   # =====================================================



&#x20;   input\_df = pd.DataFrame(

&#x20;       \[x]

&#x20;   )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;   # ENSURE STRUCTURED FEATURES EXIST

&#x20;   # =====================================================



&#x20;   for col in structured\_features:



&#x20;       if col not in input\_df.columns:



&#x20;           input\_df\[col] = "unknown"



\# =====================================================

&#x20;   # COMMENT

&#x20;   # =====================================================



&#x20;   input\_df\["comment"] = (

&#x20;       input\_df\["comment"]

&#x20;       .fillna("")

&#x20;       .astype(str)

&#x20;   )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;   # COMMENT TOPIC FEATURES

&#x20;   #

&#x20;   # IMPORTANT:

&#x20;   #

&#x20;   # These MUST use the TF-IDF and SVD models that were

&#x20;   # fitted during training.

&#x20;   #

&#x20;   # DO NOT fit them again here.

&#x20;   # =====================================================



&#x20;   if (

&#x20;       self.comment\_tfidf is None

&#x20;       or self.comment\_svd is None

&#x20;   ):



&#x20;       raise RuntimeError(

&#x20;           "Comment TF-IDF/SVD models are not available. "

&#x20;           "Please retrain the ServiceModel."

&#x20;       )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;   # TRANSFORM COMMENT USING TRAINED TF-IDF

&#x20;   # =====================================================



&#x20;   comment\_tfidf = (

&#x20;       self.comment\_tfidf.transform(

&#x20;           input\_df\["comment"]

&#x20;       )

&#x20;   )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;   # TRANSFORM COMMENT USING TRAINED SVD

&#x20;   # =====================================================



&#x20;   comment\_features\_array = (

&#x20;       self.comment\_svd.transform(

&#x20;           comment\_tfidf

&#x20;       )

&#x20;   )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;   # CREATE COMMENT TOPIC COLUMNS

&#x20;   # =====================================================



&#x20;   comment\_columns = \[



&#x20;       f"comment\_topic\_{i}"



&#x20;       for i in range(

&#x20;           comment\_features\_array.shape\[1]

&#x20;       )



&#x20;   ]



comment\_features = pd.DataFrame(



&#x20;       comment\_features\_array,



&#x20;       columns=comment\_columns,



&#x20;       index=input\_df.index



&#x20;   )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;   # ATTACH COMMENT TOPIC FEATURES

&#x20;   # =====================================================



&#x20;   input\_df = pd.concat(

&#x20;       \[

&#x20;           input\_df,

&#x20;           comment\_features

&#x20;       ],

&#x20;       axis=1

&#x20;   )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;   # FINAL FEATURE LIST

&#x20;   #

&#x20;   # MUST MATCH TRAINING

&#x20;   # =====================================================



&#x20;   structured\_features\_with\_comments = (



&#x20;       \[

&#x20;           "hotel",

&#x20;           "meal",

&#x20;           "market\_segment",

&#x20;           "distribution\_channel",

&#x20;           "deposit\_type",

&#x20;           "customer\_type",

&#x20;           "season\_group",

&#x20;           "country\_group",

&#x20;           "adr\_group",

&#x20;           "previous\_cancellations\_group",

&#x20;           "days\_in\_waiting\_list\_group",

&#x20;           "guest\_group",

&#x20;           "client\_segment",

&#x20;           "is\_top\_bad\_client",

&#x20;           "client\_bad\_rate",

&#x20;           "reservation\_status",

&#x20;           "is\_canceled"

&#x20;       ]



&#x20;       +



&#x20;       comment\_columns



&#x20;   )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;   # FEATURES

&#x20;   # =====================================================



&#x20;   X\_input = input\_df\[

&#x20;       \["comment"] +

&#x20;       structured\_features\_with\_comments

&#x20;   ]



\# =====================================================

&#x20;   # RATING PREDICTION

&#x20;   # =====================================================



&#x20;   pred\_rating = int(

&#x20;       self.best\_model.predict(

&#x20;           X\_input

&#x20;       )\[0]

&#x20;   )



clf = (

&#x20;       self.best\_model

&#x20;       .named\_steps\["clf"]

&#x20;   )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;   # RESERVATION STATUS PREDICTION

&#x20;   # =====================================================



&#x20;   status\_input = input\_df\[

&#x20;       \[

def safe(v):

&#x20;       values.append(value)



&#x20;   return sorted(

&#x20;       list(set(values))

&#x20;   )



\# =========================================================

\# FIND CLIENT COLUMN

\#

\# Your model uses client\_email.

\#

\# This helper allows the prediction page to work even if

\# the dataframe uses a slightly different client column.

\# =========================================================



def get\_client\_column(df):



&#x20;   possible\_columns = \[



&#x20;       "client\_email",

&#x20;       "email",

&#x20;       "customer\_email",

&#x20;       "client"



&#x20;   ]



&#x20;   for col in possible\_columns:



&#x20;       if col in df.columns:

&#x20;           return col



&#x20;   return None



\# =========================================================

\# CALCULATE CLIENT BAD RATE

\#

\# IMPORTANT:

\#

\# This is calculated from historical data.

\#

\# Bad rating = rating 0, 1 or 2

\#

\# client\_bad\_rate =

\#

\# number of bad ratings

\# --------------------

\# total ratings

\#

\# Example:

\#

\# 8 bad bookings / 20 total bookings

\# = 0.40

\# =========================================================



def calculate\_client\_bad\_rate(

&#x20;   df,

&#x20;   client\_value

):



&#x20;   if df is None:

&#x20;       return 0.0



&#x20;   if client\_value is None:

&#x20;       return 0.0



&#x20;   client\_value = str(

&#x20;       client\_value

&#x20;   ).strip()



&#x20;   if client\_value == "":

&#x20;       return 0.0



&#x20;   client\_column = get\_client\_column(

&#x20;       df

&#x20;   )



&#x20;   if client\_column is None:



&#x20;       print(

&#x20;           "\[WARNING] Client column not found. "

&#x20;           "client\_bad\_rate = 0.0"

&#x20;       )



&#x20;       return 0.0



&#x20;   if "final\_rating" not in df.columns:



&#x20;       print(

&#x20;           "\[WARNING] final\_rating column not found. "

&#x20;           "client\_bad\_rate = 0.0"

&#x20;       )



&#x20;       return 0.0



\# =====================================================

&#x20;   # COPY DATA

&#x20;   # =====================================================



&#x20;   work\_df = df.copy()



\# =====================================================

&#x20;   # NORMALISE CLIENT COLUMN

&#x20;   # =====================================================



&#x20;   work\_df\["\_client\_key"] = (



&#x20;       work\_df\[client\_column]

&#x20;       .fillna("")

&#x20;       .astype(str)

&#x20;       .str.strip()

&#x20;       .str.lower()



&#x20;   )



selected\_key = (

&#x20;       client\_value

&#x20;       .lower()

&#x20;       .strip()

&#x20;   )



client\_df = work\_df\[

&#x20;       work\_df\["\_client\_key"] == selected\_key

&#x20;   ].copy()



if len(client\_df) == 0:



&#x20;       print(

&#x20;           f"\[INFO] No historical records found "

&#x20;           f"for client: {client\_value}"

&#x20;       )



&#x20;       return 0.0



\# =====================================================

&#x20;   # CONVERT RATING TO NUMERIC

&#x20;   # =====================================================



&#x20;   client\_df\["\_rating\_numeric"] = pd.to\_numeric(



&#x20;       client\_df\[

&#x20;           "final\_rating"

&#x20;       ],



&#x20;       errors="coerce"



&#x20;   )



client\_df = client\_df\[

&#x20;       client\_df\[

&#x20;           "\_rating\_numeric"

&#x20;       ].notna()

&#x20;   ]



if len(client\_df) == 0:



&#x20;       return 0.0



\# =====================================================

&#x20;   # BAD RATINGS

&#x20;   #

&#x20;   # 0, 1, 2 = BAD

&#x20;   # =====================================================



&#x20;   bad\_count = (

&#x20;       client\_df\[

&#x20;           "\_rating\_numeric"

&#x20;       ]

&#x20;       .isin(

&#x20;           \[

&#x20;               0,

&#x20;               1,

&#x20;               2

&#x20;           ]

&#x20;       )

&#x20;       .sum()

&#x20;   )



total\_count = len(

&#x20;       client\_df

&#x20;   )



if total\_count == 0:



&#x20;       return 0.0



bad\_rate = (

&#x20;       bad\_count /

&#x20;       total\_count

&#x20;   )



bad\_rate = float(

&#x20;       np.clip(

&#x20;           bad\_rate,

&#x20;           0.0,

&#x20;           1.0

&#x20;       )

&#x20;   )



print()

&#x20;   print(

&#x20;       "CLIENT BAD RATE"

&#x20;   )

&#x20;   print(

&#x20;       "------------------------------"

&#x20;   )

&#x20;   print(

&#x20;       f"Client        : {client\_value}"

&#x20;   )

&#x20;   print(

&#x20;       f"Total records : {total\_count}"

&#x20;   )

&#x20;   print(

&#x20;       f"Bad records   : {bad\_count}"

&#x20;   )

&#x20;   print(

&#x20;       f"Bad rate      : {bad\_rate:.4f}"

&#x20;   )



return bad\_rate



\# =========================================================

\# CALCULATE CLIENT SEGMENT

\# =========================================================



def calculate\_client\_segment(

&#x20;   bad\_rate

):



&#x20;   bad\_rate = safe\_numeric(

&#x20;       bad\_rate,

&#x20;       0.0

&#x20;   )



if bad\_rate >= 0.70:



&#x20;       return "high-risk"



elif bad\_rate >= 0.40:



&#x20;       return "bad"



elif bad\_rate >= 0.20:



&#x20;       return "moderate"



else:



&#x20;       return "low-risk"

def register\_callbacks(app, df):



&#x20;   # =====================================================

&#x20;   # PREDICTION CALLBACK

&#x20;   # =====================================================



&#x20;   @app.callback(



&#x20;       Output(

&#x20;           "output",

&#x20;           "children"

&#x20;       ),



&#x20;       Input(

&#x20;           "predict\_btn",

&#x20;           "n\_clicks"

&#x20;       ),



&#x20;       State(

&#x20;           "model\_choice",

&#x20;           "value"

&#x20;       ),



&#x20;       State(

&#x20;           "top\_bad\_client",

&#x20;           "value"

&#x20;       ),



&#x20;       State(

&#x20;           "hotel",

&#x20;           "value"

&#x20;       ),



&#x20;       State(

&#x20;           "country\_group",

&#x20;           "value"

&#x20;       ),



&#x20;       State(

&#x20;           "adr\_group",

&#x20;           "value"

&#x20;       ),



&#x20;       State(

&#x20;           "previous\_cancellations\_group",

&#x20;           "value"

&#x20;       ),



&#x20;       State(

&#x20;           "days\_in\_waiting\_list\_group",

&#x20;           "value"

&#x20;       ),



&#x20;       State(

&#x20;           "deposit\_type",

&#x20;           "value"

&#x20;       ),



&#x20;       State(

&#x20;           "customer\_type",

&#x20;           "value"

&#x20;       ),



&#x20;       State(

&#x20;           "guest\_group",

&#x20;           "value"

&#x20;       ),



&#x20;       State(

&#x20;           "season\_group",

&#x20;           "value"

&#x20;       ),



&#x20;       State(

&#x20;           "meal",

&#x20;           "value"

&#x20;       ),



&#x20;       State(

&#x20;           "market\_segment",

&#x20;           "value"

&#x20;       ),



&#x20;       State(

&#x20;           "distribution\_channel",

&#x20;           "value"

&#x20;       ),



&#x20;       State(

&#x20;           "reservation\_status",

&#x20;           "value"

&#x20;       ),



&#x20;       State(

&#x20;           "is\_canceled",

&#x20;           "value"

&#x20;       )



&#x20;   )



&#x20;   def predict(



&#x20;       n,



&#x20;       model\_choice,



&#x20;       top\_bad\_client,



&#x20;       hotel,



&#x20;       country\_group,



&#x20;       adr\_group,



&#x20;       previous\_cancellations\_group,



&#x20;       days\_in\_waiting\_list\_group,



&#x20;       deposit\_type,



&#x20;       customer\_type,



&#x20;       guest\_group,



&#x20;       season\_group,



&#x20;       meal,



&#x20;       market\_segment,



&#x20;       distribution\_channel,



&#x20;       reservation\_status,



&#x20;       is\_canceled



&#x20;   ):



&#x20;       # =================================================

&#x20;       # NO CLICK

&#x20;       # =================================================



&#x20;       if not n:

&#x20;           return ""



try:



&#x20;           # =================================================

&#x20;           # SWITCH MODEL

&#x20;           #

&#x20;           # The actual rating prediction continues to be

&#x20;           # performed by ServiceModel.predict().

&#x20;           # =================================================



&#x20;           if model\_choice:



&#x20;               ml.set\_model(

&#x20;                   model\_choice

&#x20;               )



\# =================================================

&#x20;           # CLIENT BAD RATE

&#x20;           #

&#x20;           # CALCULATED FROM HISTORICAL DATA.

&#x20;           # =================================================



&#x20;           client\_bad\_rate = (

&#x20;               calculate\_client\_bad\_rate(

&#x20;                   df,

&#x20;                   top\_bad\_client

&#x20;               )

&#x20;           )



\# =================================================

&#x20;           # CLIENT SEGMENT

&#x20;           # =================================================



&#x20;           client\_segment = (

&#x20;               calculate\_client\_segment(

&#x20;                   client\_bad\_rate

&#x20;               )

&#x20;           )



\# =================================================

&#x20;           # IS TOP BAD CLIENT

&#x20;           #

&#x20;           # Based on the selected client being present

&#x20;           # in the top bad client list.

&#x20;           # =================================================



&#x20;           TOP\_CLIENTS = df.attrs.get(

&#x20;               "top\_10\_bad\_clients",

&#x20;               \[]

&#x20;           )



top\_client\_strings = {



&#x20;               str(v).strip().lower()



&#x20;               for v in TOP\_CLIENTS



&#x20;               if v is not None



&#x20;           }



selected\_client\_key = (



&#x20;               str(

&#x20;                   top\_bad\_client

&#x20;               ).strip().lower()



&#x20;               if top\_bad\_client is not None



&#x20;               else ""



&#x20;           )



if selected\_client\_key in top\_client\_strings:



&#x20;               is\_top\_bad\_client = 1.0



&#x20;           else:



&#x20;               is\_top\_bad\_client = 0.0



\# =================================================

&#x20;           # BUILD INPUT

&#x20;           # =================================================



&#x20;           x = {



&#x20;               # -----------------------------------------

&#x20;               # TEXT

&#x20;               # -----------------------------------------



&#x20;               "comment":

&#x20;                   "",



\# -----------------------------------------

&#x20;               # CLIENT

&#x20;               # -----------------------------------------



&#x20;               "client\_email":

&#x20;                   safe(

&#x20;                       top\_bad\_client

&#x20;                   ),



&#x20;               "client\_segment":

&#x20;                   client\_segment,



&#x20;               "is\_top\_bad\_client":

&#x20;                   is\_top\_bad\_client,



&#x20;               "client\_bad\_rate":

&#x20;                   client\_bad\_rate,



\# -----------------------------------------

&#x20;               # HOTEL

&#x20;               # -----------------------------------------



&#x20;               "hotel":

&#x20;                   safe(

&#x20;                       hotel

&#x20;                   ),



\# -----------------------------------------

&#x20;               # COUNTRY

&#x20;               # -----------------------------------------



&#x20;               "country\_group":

&#x20;                   safe(

&#x20;                       country\_group

&#x20;                   ),



\# -----------------------------------------

&#x20;               # ADR

&#x20;               # -----------------------------------------



&#x20;               "adr\_group":

&#x20;                   safe(

&#x20;                       adr\_group

&#x20;                   ),



\# -----------------------------------------

&#x20;               # CANCELLATIONS

&#x20;               # -----------------------------------------



&#x20;               "previous\_cancellations\_group":

&#x20;                   safe(

&#x20;                       previous\_cancellations\_group

&#x20;                   ),



\# -----------------------------------------

&#x20;               # WAITING LIST

&#x20;               # -----------------------------------------



&#x20;               "days\_in\_waiting\_list\_group":

&#x20;                   safe(

&#x20;                       days\_in\_waiting\_list\_group

&#x20;                   ),



\# -----------------------------------------

&#x20;               # DEPOSIT

&#x20;               # -----------------------------------------



&#x20;               "deposit\_type":

&#x20;                   safe(

&#x20;                       deposit\_type

&#x20;                   ),



\# -----------------------------------------

&#x20;               # CUSTOMER TYPE

&#x20;               # -----------------------------------------



&#x20;               "customer\_type":

&#x20;                   safe(

&#x20;                       customer\_type

&#x20;                   ),



\# -----------------------------------------

&#x20;               # GUEST GROUP

&#x20;               # -----------------------------------------



&#x20;               "guest\_group":

&#x20;                   safe(

&#x20;                       guest\_group

&#x20;                   ),



\# -----------------------------------------

&#x20;               # SEASON

&#x20;               # -----------------------------------------



&#x20;               "season\_group":

&#x20;                   safe(

&#x20;                       season\_group

&#x20;                   ),



\# -----------------------------------------

&#x20;               # MEAL

&#x20;               # -----------------------------------------



&#x20;               "meal":

&#x20;                   safe(

&#x20;                       meal

&#x20;                   ),



\# -----------------------------------------

&#x20;               # MARKET SEGMENT

&#x20;               # -----------------------------------------



&#x20;               "market\_segment":

&#x20;                   safe(

&#x20;                       market\_segment

&#x20;                   ),



\# -----------------------------------------

&#x20;               # DISTRIBUTION CHANNEL

&#x20;               # -----------------------------------------



&#x20;               "distribution\_channel":

&#x20;                   safe(

&#x20;                       distribution\_channel

&#x20;                   ),



\# -----------------------------------------

&#x20;               # RESERVATION STATUS

&#x20;               # -----------------------------------------



&#x20;               "reservation\_status":

&#x20;                   safe(

&#x20;                       reservation\_status

&#x20;                   ),



\# -----------------------------------------

&#x20;               # CANCELED

&#x20;               # -----------------------------------------



&#x20;               "is\_canceled":

&#x20;                   safe(

&#x20;                       is\_canceled

&#x20;                   )



&#x20;           }



\# =================================================

&#x20;           # FORCE CORRECT NUMERIC TYPES

&#x20;           #

&#x20;           # These MUST match model.py.

&#x20;           # =================================================



&#x20;           x\["is\_top\_bad\_client"] = (

&#x20;               safe\_numeric(

&#x20;                   x\["is\_top\_bad\_client"],

&#x20;                   0.0

&#x20;               )

&#x20;           )



x\["client\_bad\_rate"] = (

&#x20;               safe\_numeric(

&#x20;                   x\["client\_bad\_rate"],

&#x20;                   0.0

&#x20;               )

&#x20;           )



\# =================================================

&#x20;           # DEBUG INPUT

&#x20;           # =================================================



&#x20;           print()



&#x20;           print(

&#x20;               "=============================="

&#x20;           )



&#x20;           print(

&#x20;               "PREDICTION INPUT"

&#x20;           )



&#x20;           print(

&#x20;               "=============================="

&#x20;           )



for key, value in x.items():



&#x20;               print(

&#x20;                   f"{key}: {value!r} "

&#x20;                   f"(type={type(value).\_\_name\_\_})"

&#x20;               )



\# =================================================

&#x20;           # PREDICT

&#x20;           #

&#x20;           # IMPORTANT:

&#x20;           #

&#x20;           # Rating is generated ONLY by model.py.

&#x20;           #

&#x20;           # predict\_page.py does NOT calculate the rating.

&#x20;           # =================================================



&#x20;           (



&#x20;               pred,



&#x20;               prob\_canceled,



&#x20;               prob\_check\_out,



&#x20;               prob\_no\_show,



&#x20;               sla\_risk,



&#x20;               risk,



&#x20;               comment



&#x20;           ) = ml.predict(

&#x20;               x

&#x20;           )



\# =================================================

&#x20;           # VALIDATE RATING

&#x20;           #

&#x20;           # model.py supports 0-6.

&#x20;           # =================================================



&#x20;           pred = int(

&#x20;               pred

&#x20;           )



if pred not in \[

&#x20;               0,

&#x20;               1,

&#x20;               2,

&#x20;               3,

&#x20;               4,

&#x20;               5,

&#x20;               6

&#x20;           ]:



&#x20;               raise ValueError(

&#x20;                   f"Invalid rating returned by model: "

&#x20;                   f"{pred}. Expected 0-6."

&#x20;               )



rating\_label = (

&#x20;               RATING\_LABELS.get(

&#x20;                   pred,

&#x20;                   "Unknown"

&#x20;               )

&#x20;           )



\# =================================================

&#x20;           # MODEL RISK

&#x20;           #

&#x20;           # IMPORTANT:

&#x20;           #

&#x20;           # This is the risk returned by model.py.

&#x20;           #

&#x20;           # DO NOT recalculate it here.

&#x20;           # =================================================



&#x20;           risk = float(

&#x20;               risk

&#x20;           )



&#x20;           sla\_risk = float(

&#x20;               sla\_risk

&#x20;           )



\# =================================================

&#x20;           # PREDICTION RESULT

&#x20;           # =================================================



&#x20;           print()



&#x20;           print(

&#x20;               "=============================="

&#x20;           )



&#x20;           print(

&#x20;               "PREDICTION RESULT"

&#x20;           )



&#x20;           print(

&#x20;               "=============================="

&#x20;           )



print(

&#x20;               f"Rating: {pred}"

&#x20;           )



&#x20;           print(

&#x20;               f"Rating Label: {rating\_label}"

&#x20;           )



&#x20;           print(

&#x20;               f"Risk: {risk}"

&#x20;           )



&#x20;           print(

&#x20;               f"Client Bad Rate: "

&#x20;               f"{client\_bad\_rate:.4f}"

&#x20;           )



&#x20;           print(

&#x20;               f"Is Top Bad Client: "

&#x20;               f"{is\_top\_bad\_client}"

&#x20;           )



&#x20;           print(

&#x20;               f"Cancellation Probability: "

&#x20;               f"{prob\_canceled}"

&#x20;           )



&#x20;           print(

&#x20;               f"Check Out Probability: "

&#x20;               f"{prob\_check\_out}"

&#x20;           )



&#x20;           print(

&#x20;               f"No Show Probability: "

&#x20;               f"{prob\_no\_show}"

&#x20;           )



&#x20;           print(

&#x20;               f"Service Level Risk: "

&#x20;               f"{sla\_risk}"

&#x20;           )



\# =================================================

&#x20;           # OUTPUT

&#x20;           # =================================================



&#x20;           return html.Div(\[



&#x20;               html.H4(

&#x20;                   f"Customer Rating: "

&#x20;                   f"{pred} / 6"

&#x20;               ),



&#x20;               html.H4(

&#x20;                   f"Rating Level: "

&#x20;                   f"{rating\_label}"

&#x20;               ),



&#x20;               html.H4(

&#x20;                   f"Customer Risk Score: "

&#x20;                   f"{risk}"

&#x20;               ),



&#x20;               html.H4(

&#x20;                   f"Client Bad Rate: "

&#x20;                   f"{client\_bad\_rate \* 100:.1f}%"

Important correction to the logic



There is one thing I deliberately did not do in this version:



risk = RATING\_RISK\[pred]



That would duplicate the logic from model.py.



Your model.py already calculates:



rating

&#x20;  ↓

rating probability

&#x20;  ↓

SLA risk

&#x20;  ↓

base risk

&#x20;  ↓

final risk



Specifically, model.py does:



base risk = rating\_map\[pred\_rating]



final risk =

&#x20;   0.6 × base risk

&#x20;   +

&#x20;   0.4 × SLA risk



So predict\_page.py now simply receives:



pred

sla\_risk

risk



from:



ml.predict(x)



and displays them.



client\_bad\_rate now works differently



If the selected client has historical data like:



Rating 0 → 2 bookings

Rating 1 → 3 bookings

Rating 2 → 1 booking

Rating 3 → 4 bookings

Rating 4 → 5 bookings

Rating 5 → 3 bookings

Rating 6 → 2 bookings



then:



Total bookings = 20

Bad bookings   = 2 + 3 + 1 = 6



client\_bad\_rate = 6 / 20

&#x20;                = 0.30

&#x20;                = 30%



That 0.30 is passed into model.py as the numeric feature.



One important caveat: this assumes df contains the client's historical records and has a client\_email (or email/customer\_email/client) column plus final\_rating. If your actual feature-engineering code calculates client\_bad\_rate using a different definition of "bad" or a different client identifier, we should make the prediction-page calculation match that exact feature-engineering formula rather than independently defining bad as ratings 0–2.

\# =========================================================

\# CLIENT BAD RATE

\# =========================================================



def calculate\_client\_bad\_rate(df, client\_email):



&#x20;   """

&#x20;   Calculate historical bad-review percentage for a client.



&#x20;   Bad review:

&#x20;       final\_rating <= 2



&#x20;   Result:

&#x20;       0.0 - 100.0

&#x20;   """



&#x20;   if df is None:

&#x20;       return 0.0



&#x20;   if client\_email is None:

&#x20;       return 0.0



&#x20;   client\_email = str(

&#x20;       client\_email

&#x20;   ).strip()



&#x20;   if client\_email == "":

&#x20;       return 0.0



&#x20;   if client\_email.lower() in \[

&#x20;       "missing",

&#x20;       "unknown",

&#x20;       "none",

&#x20;       "nan",

&#x20;       "null"

&#x20;   ]:

&#x20;       return 0.0



\# =====================================================

&#x20;   # USE EXISTING FEATURE ENGINEERING VALUE IF AVAILABLE

&#x20;   # =====================================================



&#x20;   if (

&#x20;       "client\_email" in df.columns

&#x20;       and

&#x20;       "client\_bad\_rate" in df.columns

&#x20;   ):



&#x20;       client\_rows = df\[

&#x20;           df\["client\_email"]

&#x20;           .astype(str)

&#x20;           .str.strip()

&#x20;           .str.lower()

&#x20;           ==

&#x20;           client\_email.lower()

&#x20;       ]



&#x20;       if len(client\_rows) > 0:



&#x20;           values = pd.to\_numeric(

&#x20;               client\_rows\["client\_bad\_rate"],

&#x20;               errors="coerce"

&#x20;           ).dropna()



&#x20;           if len(values) > 0:



&#x20;               rate = float(

&#x20;                   values.iloc\[0]

&#x20;               )



&#x20;               # Handle either 0-1 or 0-100 format

&#x20;               if rate <= 1.0:

&#x20;                   rate \*= 100.0



&#x20;               return round(

&#x20;                   rate,

&#x20;                   1

&#x20;               )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;   # CALCULATE FROM FINAL RATING

&#x20;   # =====================================================



&#x20;   if (

&#x20;       "client\_email" not in df.columns

&#x20;       or

&#x20;       "final\_rating" not in df.columns

&#x20;   ):



&#x20;       return 0.0



client\_rows = df\[

&#x20;       df\["client\_email"]

&#x20;       .astype(str)

&#x20;       .str.strip()

&#x20;       .str.lower()

&#x20;       ==

&#x20;       client\_email.lower()

&#x20;   ].copy()



if len(client\_rows) == 0:

&#x20;       return 0.0



ratings = pd.to\_numeric(

&#x20;       client\_rows\["final\_rating"],

&#x20;       errors="coerce"

&#x20;   ).dropna()



if len(ratings) == 0:

&#x20;       return 0.0



bad\_count = (

&#x20;       ratings <= 2

&#x20;   ).sum()



total\_count = len(

&#x20;       ratings

&#x20;   )



if total\_count == 0:

&#x20;       return 0.0



rate = (

&#x20;       bad\_count /

&#x20;       total\_count

&#x20;   ) \* 100.0



return round(

&#x20;       rate,

&#x20;       1

&#x20;   )



\# =========================================================

\# CLIENT SEGMENT

\# =========================================================



def get\_client\_segment(df, client\_email):



&#x20;   """

&#x20;   Retrieve the FeatureEngineering client\_segment.



&#x20;   If it is unavailable, derive a sensible segment from

&#x20;   historical bad-review rate.

&#x20;   """



&#x20;   if (

&#x20;       df is not None

&#x20;       and

&#x20;       client\_email is not None

&#x20;       and

&#x20;       "client\_email" in df.columns

&#x20;   ):



&#x20;       client\_email = str(

&#x20;           client\_email

&#x20;       ).strip()



client\_rows = df\[

&#x20;           df\["client\_email"]

&#x20;           .astype(str)

&#x20;           .str.strip()

&#x20;           .str.lower()

&#x20;           ==

&#x20;           client\_email.lower()

&#x20;       ]



if len(client\_rows) > 0:



&#x20;           if "client\_segment" in client\_rows.columns:



&#x20;               values = (

&#x20;                   client\_rows\["client\_segment"]

&#x20;                   .dropna()

&#x20;                   .astype(str)

&#x20;                   .str.strip()

&#x20;               )



&#x20;               values = values\[

&#x20;                   \~values.str.lower().isin(\[

&#x20;                       "",

&#x20;                       "nan",

&#x20;                       "none",

&#x20;                       "null",

&#x20;                       "unknown",

&#x20;                       "missing"

&#x20;                   ])

&#x20;               ]



if len(values) > 0:



&#x20;                   return str(

&#x20;                       values.mode().iloc\[0]

&#x20;                   )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;   # FALLBACK SEGMENT

&#x20;   # =====================================================



&#x20;   bad\_rate = calculate\_client\_bad\_rate(

&#x20;       df,

&#x20;       client\_email

&#x20;   )



if bad\_rate >= 50:

&#x20;       return "high risk"



&#x20;   elif bad\_rate >= 25:

&#x20;       return "medium risk"



&#x20;   elif bad\_rate > 0:

&#x20;       return "low risk"



&#x20;   return "new / no bad history"



\# =========================================================

\# TOP BAD CLIENTS

\# =========================================================



def get\_top\_bad\_clients(df):



&#x20;   if df is None:

&#x20;       return \[]



&#x20;   if "client\_email" not in df.columns:

&#x20;       return \[]



\# Use existing FeatureEngineering ranking if available



&#x20;   if "is\_top\_bad\_client" in df.columns:



&#x20;       top = df\[

&#x20;           df\["is\_top\_bad\_client"]

&#x20;           .astype(str)

&#x20;           .str.lower()

&#x20;           .isin(\[

&#x20;               "1",

&#x20;               "true",

&#x20;               "yes"

&#x20;           ])

&#x20;       ]



&#x20;       if len(top) > 0:



&#x20;           return (

&#x20;               top\["client\_email"]

&#x20;               .dropna()

&#x20;               .astype(str)

&#x20;               .drop\_duplicates()

&#x20;               .tolist()

&#x20;           )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;   # FALLBACK: CALCULATE TOP 10 CLIENTS

&#x20;   # =====================================================



&#x20;   if "final\_rating" not in df.columns:

&#x20;       return \[]



work = df.copy()



work\["rating\_numeric"] = pd.to\_numeric(

&#x20;       work\["final\_rating"],

&#x20;       errors="coerce"

&#x20;   )



work = work.dropna(

&#x20;       subset=\[

&#x20;           "rating\_numeric"

&#x20;       ]

&#x20;   )



if len(work) == 0:

&#x20;       return \[]



grouped = (

&#x20;       work

&#x20;       .groupby("client\_email")

&#x20;       .agg(

&#x20;           total\_reviews=(

&#x20;               "rating\_numeric",

&#x20;               "count"

&#x20;           ),

&#x20;           bad\_reviews=(

&#x20;               "rating\_numeric",

&#x20;               lambda x: (

&#x20;                   x <= 2

&#x20;               ).sum()

&#x20;           )

&#x20;       )

&#x20;   )



grouped\["bad\_rate"] = (

&#x20;       grouped\["bad\_reviews"]

&#x20;       /

&#x20;       grouped\["total\_reviews"]

&#x20;       \*

&#x20;       100

&#x20;   )



grouped = grouped.sort\_values(

&#x20;       \[

&#x20;           "bad\_rate",

&#x20;           "bad\_reviews"

&#x20;       ],

&#x20;       ascending=False

&#x20;   )



return (

&#x20;       grouped

&#x20;       .head(10)

&#x20;       .index

&#x20;       .astype(str)

&#x20;       .tolist()

&#x20;   )

def normalize\_status(value):



&#x20;   """

&#x20;   one of:



&#x20;       canceled

&#x20;       no-show

&#x20;       check-out

&#x20;   if value is None:

\# =====================================================

&#x20;   try:



&#x20;       numeric\_value = float(

&#x20;           value

&#x20;       )

&#x20;           numeric\_value = int(

&#x20;               numeric\_value

&#x20;           )



numeric\_mapping = {

&#x20;               1: "no-show",



&#x20;               2: "check-out"



&#x20;           }

&#x20;               return numeric\_mapping\[

&#x20;               ]

\# =====================================================

&#x20;       value

&#x20;       "-"

&#x20;   )



if value in \[

&#x20;       "cancelled",

&#x20;       "cancel",

&#x20;       "0"

&#x20;   ]:



&#x20;       return "canceled"



if value in \[

&#x20;       "noshow",

&#x20;       "no show",

&#x20;       "1"

&#x20;   ]:



&#x20;       return "no-show"



if value in \[

&#x20;       "check-out",

&#x20;       "checkout",

&#x20;       "check out",

&#x20;       "2"

&#x20;   ]:



&#x20;       return "check-out"



return value
