&#x20;           train\_df\["comment"]

&#x20;       )

&#x20;   )



print(

&#x20;       "Fitting comment SVD on training data..."

&#x20;   )



train\_comment\_features\_array = (

&#x20;       self.comment\_svd.fit\_transform(

&#x20;           train\_comment\_tfidf

&#x20;       )

&#x20;   )



print(

&#x20;       "Transforming validation comments..."

&#x20;   )



val\_comment\_tfidf = (

&#x20;       self.comment\_tfidf.transform(

&#x20;           val\_df\["comment"]

&#x20;       )

&#x20;   )



val\_comment\_features\_array = (

&#x20;       self.comment\_svd.transform(

&#x20;           val\_comment\_tfidf

&#x20;       )

&#x20;   )



print(

&#x20;       "Transforming test comments..."

&#x20;   )



test\_comment\_tfidf = (

&#x20;       self.comment\_tfidf.transform(

&#x20;           test\_df\["comment"]

&#x20;       )

&#x20;   )



test\_comment\_features\_array = (

&#x20;       self.comment\_svd.transform(

&#x20;           test\_comment\_tfidf

&#x20;       )

&#x20;   )



comment\_columns = \[



&#x20;       f"comment\_topic\_{i}"



&#x20;       for i in range(

&#x20;           train\_comment\_features\_array.shape\[1]

&#x20;       )



&#x20;   ]



train\_comment\_features = pd.DataFrame(

&#x20;       train\_comment\_features\_array,

&#x20;       columns=comment\_columns,

&#x20;       index=train\_df.index

&#x20;   )



val\_comment\_features = pd.DataFrame(

&#x20;       val\_comment\_features\_array,

&#x20;       columns=comment\_columns,

&#x20;       index=val\_df.index

&#x20;   )



test\_comment\_features = pd.DataFrame(

&#x20;       test\_comment\_features\_array,

&#x20;       columns=comment\_columns,

&#x20;       index=test\_df.index

&#x20;   )



\# =========================================================

&#x20;   # ATTACH COMMENT FEATURES

&#x20;   # =========================================================



&#x20;   train\_df = pd.concat(

&#x20;       \[

&#x20;           train\_df,

&#x20;           train\_comment\_features

&#x20;       ],

&#x20;       axis=1

&#x20;   )



val\_df = pd.concat(

&#x20;       \[

&#x20;           val\_df,

&#x20;           val\_comment\_features

&#x20;       ],

&#x20;       axis=1

&#x20;   )



test\_df = pd.concat(

&#x20;       \[

&#x20;           test\_df,

&#x20;           test\_comment\_features

&#x20;       ],

&#x20;       axis=1

&#x20;   )



structured\_features\_with\_comments = (

&#x20;       structured\_features +

&#x20;       comment\_columns

&#x20;   )



\# =========================================================

&#x20;   # TARGETS

&#x20;   # =========================================================



&#x20;   y\_train = train\_df\[

&#x20;       "final\_rating"

&#x20;   ]



&#x20;   y\_val = val\_df\[

&#x20;       "final\_rating"

&#x20;   ]



&#x20;   y\_test = test\_df\[

&#x20;       "final\_rating"

&#x20;   ]



y\_status\_train = train\_df\[

&#x20;       "reservation\_status"

&#x20;   ]



&#x20;   y\_status\_val = val\_df\[

&#x20;       "reservation\_status"

&#x20;   ]



&#x20;   y\_status\_test = test\_df\[

&#x20;       "reservation\_status"

&#x20;   ]



\# =========================================================

&#x20;   # FEATURES

&#x20;   # =========================================================



&#x20;   X\_train = train\_df\[

&#x20;       \["comment"] +

&#x20;       structured\_features\_with\_comments

&#x20;   ]



&#x20;   X\_val = val\_df\[

&#x20;       \["comment"] +

&#x20;       structured\_features\_with\_comments

&#x20;   ]



&#x20;   X\_test = test\_df\[

&#x20;       \["comment"] +

&#x20;       structured\_features\_with\_comments

&#x20;   ]



\# =========================================================

&#x20;   # CLASS WEIGHTS

&#x20;   # =========================================================



&#x20;   classes = np.unique(

&#x20;       y\_train

&#x20;   )



class\_weights = compute\_class\_weight(

&#x20;       class\_weight="balanced",

&#x20;       classes=classes,

&#x20;       y=y\_train

&#x20;   )



class\_weight\_dict = dict(

&#x20;       zip(

&#x20;           classes,

&#x20;           class\_weights

&#x20;       )

&#x20;   )



print()

&#x20;   print("==============================")

&#x20;   print("DATA SPLIT")

&#x20;   print("==============================")



&#x20;   print(

&#x20;       "Training rows   :",

&#x20;       len(X\_train)

&#x20;   )



&#x20;   print(

&#x20;       "Validation rows:",

&#x20;       len(X\_val)

&#x20;   )



&#x20;   print(

&#x20;       "Test rows       :",

&#x20;       len(X\_test)

&#x20;   )



print()

&#x20;   print("Reservation status split:")



&#x20;   print(

&#x20;       "Training rows   :",

&#x20;       len(y\_status\_train)

&#x20;   )



&#x20;   print(

&#x20;       "Validation rows:",

&#x20;       len(y\_status\_val)

&#x20;   )



&#x20;   print(

&#x20;       "Test rows       :",

&#x20;       len(y\_status\_test)

&#x20;   )



\# =========================================================

&#x20;   # TEXT PIPELINE

&#x20;   # =========================================================



&#x20;   text\_pipeline = Pipeline(\[



&#x20;       (

&#x20;           "hash",

&#x20;           HashingVectorizer(

&#x20;               n\_features=2\*\*16,

&#x20;               alternate\_sign=False,

&#x20;               ngram\_range=(1, 2)

&#x20;           )

&#x20;       ),



&#x20;       (

&#x20;           "tfidf",

&#x20;           TfidfTransformer()

&#x20;       )



&#x20;   ])



\# =========================================================

&#x20;   # PREPROCESSOR

&#x20;   # =========================================================



&#x20;   preprocess = ColumnTransformer(\[



&#x20;       (

&#x20;           "text",

&#x20;           text\_pipeline,

&#x20;           "comment"

&#x20;       ),



&#x20;       (

&#x20;           "cat",

&#x20;           OneHotEncoder(

&#x20;               handle\_unknown="ignore"

&#x20;           ),

&#x20;           structured\_features\_with\_comments

&#x20;       )



&#x20;   ])



\# =========================================================

&#x20;   # MODELS

&#x20;   # =========================================================



&#x20;   models = {



&#x20;       "Logistic Regression": Pipeline(\[



&#x20;           (

&#x20;               "prep",

&#x20;               preprocess

&#x20;           ),



&#x20;           (

&#x20;               "clf",

&#x20;               LogisticRegression(

&#x20;                   solver="saga",

&#x20;                   max\_iter=300,

&#x20;                   tol=1e-2,

&#x20;                   class\_weight=class\_weight\_dict,

&#x20;                   n\_jobs=-1

&#x20;               )

&#x20;           )



&#x20;       ]),



"Linear SVC": Pipeline(\[



&#x20;           (

&#x20;               "prep",

&#x20;               preprocess

&#x20;           ),



&#x20;           (

&#x20;               "clf",

&#x20;               LinearSVC(

&#x20;                   class\_weight=class\_weight\_dict,

&#x20;                   max\_iter=1000,

&#x20;                   tol=1e-2,

&#x20;                   dual=False

&#x20;               )

&#x20;           )



&#x20;       ]),



"LightGBM": Pipeline(\[



&#x20;           (

&#x20;               "prep",

&#x20;               preprocess

&#x20;           ),



&#x20;           (

&#x20;               "clf",

&#x20;               LGBMClassifier(

&#x20;                   n\_estimators=300,

&#x20;                   learning\_rate=0.05,

&#x20;                   num\_leaves=31,

&#x20;                   class\_weight=class\_weight\_dict,

&#x20;                   random\_state=42,

&#x20;                   verbosity=-1

&#x20;               )

&#x20;           )



&#x20;       ])



&#x20;   }



self.models = models



\# =========================================================

&#x20;   # EVALUATION HELPER

&#x20;   # =========================================================



&#x20;   def evaluate(

&#x20;       model,

&#x20;       X\_eval,

&#x20;       y\_true,

&#x20;       name,

&#x20;       show\_report=True

&#x20;   ):



&#x20;       preds = model.predict(

&#x20;           X\_eval

&#x20;       )



f1 = f1\_score(

&#x20;           y\_true,

&#x20;           preds,

&#x20;           average="weighted"

&#x20;       )



try:



&#x20;           clf = model.named\_steps\[

&#x20;               "clf"

&#x20;           ]



if hasattr(

&#x20;               clf,

&#x20;               "predict\_proba"

&#x20;           ):



&#x20;               probs = model.predict\_proba(

&#x20;                   X\_eval

&#x20;               )



&#x20;           else:



&#x20;               scores = model.decision\_function(

&#x20;                   X\_eval

&#x20;               )



&#x20;               scores = np.asarray(

&#x20;                   scores

&#x20;               )



if scores.ndim == 1:



&#x20;                   scores = np.column\_stack(

&#x20;                       \[

&#x20;                           -scores,

&#x20;                           scores

&#x20;                       ]

&#x20;                   )



exp = np.exp(

&#x20;                   scores -

&#x20;                   np.max(

&#x20;                       scores,

&#x20;                       axis=1,

&#x20;                       keepdims=True

&#x20;                   )

&#x20;               )



probs = (

&#x20;                   exp /

&#x20;                   exp.sum(

&#x20;                       axis=1,

&#x20;                       keepdims=True

&#x20;                   )

&#x20;               )



roc = roc\_auc\_score(

&#x20;               y\_true,

&#x20;               probs,

&#x20;               multi\_class="ovr",

&#x20;               average="weighted"

&#x20;           )



except Exception as e:



&#x20;           print(

&#x20;               f"\[WARNING] ROC-AUC failed "

&#x20;               f"for {name}: {e}"

&#x20;           )



&#x20;           roc = 0.0



if show\_report:



&#x20;           print()

&#x20;           print("==============================")

&#x20;           print(name)

&#x20;           print("==============================")



print(

&#x20;               classification\_report(

&#x20;                   y\_true,

&#x20;                   preds

&#x20;               )

&#x20;           )



print(

&#x20;               "F1 Score :",

&#x20;               round(

&#x20;                   f1,

&#x20;                   4

&#x20;               )

&#x20;           )



print(

&#x20;               "ROC-AUC  :",

&#x20;               round(

&#x20;                   roc,

&#x20;                   4

&#x20;               )

&#x20;           )



return {



&#x20;           "model": name,

&#x20;           "f1": f1,

&#x20;           "roc": roc



&#x20;       }



\# =========================================================

&#x20;   # TRAIN MODELS

&#x20;   # =========================================================



&#x20;   print()

&#x20;   print("==============================")

&#x20;   print("TRAINING MODELS")

&#x20;   print("==============================")



for name, model in models.items():



&#x20;       print(

&#x20;           f"Training {name}..."

&#x20;       )



model.fit(

&#x20;           X\_train,

&#x20;           y\_train

&#x20;       )



print(

&#x20;           f"{name} completed."

&#x20;       )



\# =========================================================

&#x20;   # RESERVATION STATUS MODEL

&#x20;   # =========================================================



&#x20;   print()

&#x20;   print("==============================")

&#x20;   print("RESERVATION STATUS TRAINING")

&#x20;   print("==============================")



status\_preprocess = ColumnTransformer(\[



&#x20;       (

&#x20;           "text",

&#x20;           text\_pipeline,

&#x20;           "comment"

&#x20;       ),



&#x20;       (

&#x20;           "cat",

&#x20;           OneHotEncoder(

&#x20;               handle\_unknown="ignore"

&#x20;           ),

&#x20;           structured\_features\_with\_comments

&#x20;       )



&#x20;   ])



print(

&#x20;       "Fitting reservation status preprocessing..."

&#x20;   )



status\_features = \[



&#x20;       "hotel",

&#x20;       "meal",

&#x20;       "market\_segment",

&#x20;       "distribution\_channel",

&#x20;       "deposit\_type",

&#x20;       "customer\_type",

&#x20;       "season\_group",

&#x20;       "country\_group",

&#x20;       "adr\_group",

&#x20;       "previous\_cancellations\_group",

&#x20;       "days\_in\_waiting\_list\_group",

&#x20;       "guest\_group",

&#x20;       "client\_segment",

&#x20;       "is\_top\_bad\_client",

&#x20;       "client\_bad\_rate",

&#x20;       "is\_canceled"



&#x20;   ]



status\_numeric\_features = \[



&#x20;       col

&#x20;       for col in status\_features

&#x20;       if col in \[

&#x20;           "is\_top\_bad\_client",

&#x20;           "client\_bad\_rate"

&#x20;       ]



&#x20;   ]



status\_categorical\_features = \[



&#x20;       col

&#x20;       for col in status\_features

&#x20;       if col not in status\_numeric\_features



&#x20;   ]



status\_preprocess = ColumnTransformer(\[



&#x20;       (

&#x20;           "text",

&#x20;           text\_pipeline,

&#x20;           "comment"

&#x20;       ),



&#x20;       (

&#x20;           "cat",

&#x20;           OneHotEncoder(

&#x20;               handle\_unknown="ignore"

&#x20;           ),

&#x20;           status\_categorical\_features

&#x20;       ),



&#x20;       (

&#x20;           "num",

&#x20;           "passthrough",

&#x20;           status\_numeric\_features

&#x20;       )



&#x20;   ])



X\_train\_status\_input = train\_df\[

&#x20;       \["comment"] +

&#x20;       status\_features

&#x20;   ]



&#x20;   X\_val\_status\_input = val\_df\[

&#x20;       \["comment"] +

&#x20;       status\_features

&#x20;   ]



&#x20;   X\_test\_status\_input = test\_df\[

&#x20;       \["comment"] +

&#x20;       status\_features

&#x20;   ]



X\_train\_status = (

&#x20;       status\_preprocess.fit\_transform(

&#x20;           X\_train\_status\_input

&#x20;       )

&#x20;   )



X\_val\_status = (

&#x20;       status\_preprocess.transform(

&#x20;           X\_val\_status\_input

&#x20;       )

&#x20;   )



X\_test\_status = (

&#x20;       status\_preprocess.transform(

&#x20;           X\_test\_status\_input

&#x20;       )

&#x20;   )



self.status\_model = LogisticRegression(

&#x20;       solver="saga",

&#x20;       max\_iter=100,

&#x20;       tol=1e-2,

&#x20;       class\_weight="balanced",

&#x20;       n\_jobs=-1

&#x20;   )



print(

&#x20;       "Training Reservation Status Model..."

&#x20;   )



self.status\_model.fit(

&#x20;       X\_train\_status,

&#x20;       y\_status\_train

&#x20;   )



print(

&#x20;       "Reservation Status Model completed."

&#x20;   )



self.status\_preprocess = (

&#x20;       status\_preprocess

&#x20;   )



\# =========================================================

&#x20;   # RESERVATION STATUS EVALUATION

&#x20;   # =========================================================



&#x20;   print()

&#x20;   print("==============================")

&#x20;   print("RESERVATION STATUS EVALUATION")

&#x20;   print("==============================")



status\_preds = (

&#x20;       self.status\_model.predict(

&#x20;           X\_test\_status

&#x20;       )

&#x20;   )



print(

&#x20;       classification\_report(

&#x20;           y\_status\_test,

&#x20;           status\_preds

&#x20;       )

&#x20;   )



\# =========================================================

&#x20;   # VALIDATION

&#x20;   # =========================================================



&#x20;   print()

&#x20;   print("==============================")

&#x20;   print("VALIDATION")

&#x20;   print("==============================")



validation\_results = \[]



for name, model in models.items():



&#x20;       result = evaluate(

&#x20;           model,

&#x20;           X\_val,

&#x20;           y\_val,

&#x20;           name,

&#x20;           show\_report=True

&#x20;       )



validation\_results.append(

&#x20;           result

&#x20;       )



\# =========================================================

&#x20;   # SELECT BEST MODEL

&#x20;   # =========================================================



&#x20;   validation\_df = pd.DataFrame(

&#x20;       validation\_results

&#x20;   )



validation\_df\["final\_score"] = (



&#x20;       0.6 \*

&#x20;       validation\_df\["f1"]



&#x20;       +



&#x20;       0.4 \*

&#x20;       validation\_df\["roc"]



&#x20;   )



validation\_df = validation\_df.sort\_values(

&#x20;       "final\_score",

&#x20;       ascending=False

&#x20;   )



print()

&#x20;   print("==============================")

&#x20;   print("VALIDATION MODEL RANKING")

&#x20;   print("==============================")



print(

&#x20;       validation\_df\[

&#x20;           \[

&#x20;               "model",

&#x20;               "f1",

&#x20;               "roc",

&#x20;               "final\_score"

&#x20;           ]

&#x20;       ].to\_string(

&#x20;           index=False

&#x20;       )

&#x20;   )



\# =========================================================

&#x20;   # BEST MODEL

&#x20;   # =========================================================



&#x20;   self.best\_model\_name = (

&#x20;       validation\_df.iloc\[0]\["model"]

&#x20;   )



self.best\_model = (

&#x20;       self.models\[

&#x20;           self.best\_model\_name

&#x20;       ]

&#x20;   )



print(

&#x20;       "\\nBEST MODEL SELECTED:",

&#x20;       self.best\_model\_name

&#x20;   )



\# =========================================================

&#x20;   # FINAL TEST EVALUATION

&#x20;   # =========================================================



&#x20;   print()

&#x20;   print("==============================")

&#x20;   print("FINAL TEST EVALUATION")

&#x20;   print("==============================")



test\_result = evaluate(

&#x20;       self.best\_model,

&#x20;       X\_test,

&#x20;       y\_test,

&#x20;       self.best\_model\_name,

&#x20;       show\_report=True

&#x20;   )



self.results\_df = pd.DataFrame(\[



&#x20;       {



&#x20;           "model":

&#x20;               self.best\_model\_name,



&#x20;           "f1":

&#x20;               test\_result\["f1"],



&#x20;           "roc":

&#x20;               test\_result\["roc"],



&#x20;           "final\_score":

&#x20;               (

&#x20;                   0.6 \*

&#x20;                   test\_result\["f1"]



&#x20;                   +



&#x20;                   0.4 \*

&#x20;                   test\_result\["roc"]

&#x20;               )



&#x20;       }



&#x20;   ])



\# =========================================================

&#x20;   # REFERENCE DATA

&#x20;   # =========================================================



&#x20;   self.df\_reference = pd.concat(

&#x20;       \[

&#x20;           train\_df,

&#x20;           val\_df,

&#x20;           test\_df

&#x20;       ],

&#x20;       axis=0

&#x20;   )



\# =========================================================

&#x20;   # COMMENT DATA

&#x20;   # =========================================================



&#x20;   reference\_df = self.df\_reference.copy()



reference\_df\["comment"] = (

&#x20;       reference\_df\["comment"]

&#x20;       .fillna("")

&#x20;       .astype(str)

&#x20;   )



self.comment\_df = reference\_df\[\[



&#x20;       "comment",

&#x20;       "hotel",

&#x20;       "meal",

&#x20;       "market\_segment",

&#x20;       "distribution\_channel",

&#x20;       "deposit\_type",

&#x20;       "customer\_type",

&#x20;       "season\_group",

&#x20;       "country\_group",

&#x20;       "adr\_group",

&#x20;       "previous\_cancellations\_group",

&#x20;       "days\_in\_waiting\_list\_group",

&#x20;       "guest\_group",

&#x20;       "final\_rating"



&#x20;   ]].copy()



\# =========================================================

&#x20;   # COMMENT INDEX

&#x20;   # =========================================================



&#x20;   self.comment\_index = {}



fields = \[



&#x20;       "hotel",

&#x20;       "meal",

&#x20;       "market\_segment",

&#x20;       "distribution\_channel",

&#x20;       "deposit\_type",

&#x20;       "customer\_type",

&#x20;       "season\_group",

&#x20;       "country\_group",

&#x20;       "adr\_group",

&#x20;       "previous\_cancellations\_group",

&#x20;       "days\_in\_waiting\_list\_group",

&#x20;       "guest\_group"



&#x20;   ]



for rating, df\_r in reference\_df.groupby(

&#x20;       "final\_rating"

&#x20;   ):



&#x20;       rating\_key = str(

&#x20;           rating

&#x20;       )



self.comment\_index\[

&#x20;           rating\_key

&#x20;       ] = {



&#x20;           "ALL":

&#x20;               df\_r\[

&#x20;                   "comment"

&#x20;               ].tolist(),



&#x20;           "FIELDS":

&#x20;               {}



&#x20;       }



for field in fields:



&#x20;           if field not in df\_r.columns:

&#x20;               continue



self.comment\_index\[

&#x20;               rating\_key

&#x20;           ]\[

&#x20;               "FIELDS"

&#x20;           ]\[field] = (



&#x20;               df\_r

&#x20;               .groupby(field)\["comment"]

&#x20;               .apply(list)

&#x20;               .to\_dict()



&#x20;           )



print(

&#x20;       "FAST COMMENT INDEX READY "

&#x20;       "(RATING-FIRST + UI FILTER)"

&#x20;   )



\# =========================================================

&#x20;   # SAVE ARTIFACTS

&#x20;   # =========================================================



&#x20;   self.\_save\_artifacts(

&#x20;       reference\_df

&#x20;   )



return reference\_df



\# =========================================================

\# SAVE MODEL + TRAIN DATA

\# =========================================================



def \_save\_artifacts(

&#x20;   self,

&#x20;   df

):



&#x20;   trained\_dir = self.config.get(

&#x20;       "trained\_dir",

&#x20;       "trained"

&#x20;   )



os.makedirs(

&#x20;       trained\_dir,

&#x20;       exist\_ok=True

&#x20;   )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;   # SAVE PROCESSED TRAIN DATA

&#x20;   # =====================================================



&#x20;   train\_path = self.config.get(

&#x20;       "train\_data",

&#x20;       os.path.join(

&#x20;           trained\_dir,

&#x20;           "train.parquet"

&#x20;       )

&#x20;   )



df.to\_parquet(

&#x20;       train\_path,

&#x20;       index=False

&#x20;   )



print(

&#x20;       f"\[INFO] Training data saved: "

&#x20;       f"{train\_path}"

&#x20;   )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;   # SAVE SERVICE MODEL

&#x20;   # =====================================================



&#x20;   model\_path = self.config.get(

&#x20;       "service\_model",

&#x20;       os.path.join(

&#x20;           trained\_dir,

&#x20;           "service\_model.pkl"

&#x20;       )

&#x20;   )



joblib.dump(

&#x20;       self,

&#x20;       model\_path

&#x20;   )



print(

&#x20;       f"\[INFO] Service model saved: "

&#x20;       f"{model\_path}"

&#x20;   )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;   # SAVE METADATA

&#x20;   # =====================================================



&#x20;   metadata\_path = self.config.get(

&#x20;       "training\_metadata",

&#x20;       os.path.join(

&#x20;           trained\_dir,

Yes. The error is coming from a mismatch between predict\_page.py and the features expected by your current model.py.



There are three important fixes:



client\_bad\_rate must be calculated from the selected client\_email, rather than defaulting to 0.0.



is\_top\_bad\_client and client\_bad\_rate must be passed in the correct form expected by model.py.



The rating display must follow the actual model.py rating classes 0–6, rather than treating the rating as a 1–5 scale.



Your current model.py returns 7 values, so predict\_page.py must unpack all 7.



The reservation-status probabilities come from status\_model.predict\_proba(). Selecting "canceled" in the UI does not force cancellation probability to 100%, because model.py deliberately does not use reservation\_status as an input to the status model—it is the target being predicted.

\# =========================================================

\# HELPER FUNCTIONS

\# =========================================================



def build\_options(mapping):



&#x20;   options = \[]



&#x20;   for value in mapping.values():



&#x20;       if value is None:

&#x20;           continue



&#x20;       value = str(value)



&#x20;       options.append({



&#x20;           "label":

&#x20;               value.title(),



&#x20;           "value":

&#x20;               value



&#x20;       })



&#x20;   return options



\# =========================================================

\# SAFE VALUE

\# =========================================================



def safe(v):



&#x20;   if v is None:

&#x20;       return "unknown"



&#x20;   if isinstance(v, str):



&#x20;       value = v.strip()



&#x20;       if value == "":

&#x20;           return "unknown"



&#x20;       if value.lower() in \[



&#x20;           "nan",

&#x20;           "none",

&#x20;           "null",

&#x20;           "missing"



&#x20;       ]:



&#x20;           return "unknown"



&#x20;       return value



&#x20;   return v



\# =========================================================

\# SAFE NUMERIC VALUE

\#

\# IMPORTANT:

\# client\_bad\_rate and is\_top\_bad\_client are NUMERIC

\# in the reservation status model.

\# =========================================================



def safe\_numeric(v, default=0.0):



&#x20;   if v is None:

&#x20;       return default



&#x20;   try:



&#x20;       value = float(v)



&#x20;       if np.isnan(value):

&#x20;           return default



&#x20;       return value



&#x20;   except Exception:



&#x20;       return default



\# =========================================================

\# CLEAN VALUES

\# =========================================================



def clean\_values(series):



&#x20;   if series is None:

&#x20;       return \[]



&#x20;   values = \[]



&#x20;   for value in series:



&#x20;       if value is None:

&#x20;           continue



&#x20;       if isinstance(value, float) and np.isnan(value):

&#x20;           continue



&#x20;       value = str(value).strip()



&#x20;       if value.lower() in \[



&#x20;           "missing",

&#x20;           "unknown",

&#x20;           "nan",

&#x20;           "none",

&#x20;           "null",

&#x20;           ""



&#x20;       ]:



&#x20;           continue



&#x20;       values.append(value)



&#x20;   return sorted(

&#x20;       list(set(values))

&#x20;   )



\# =========================================================

\# FIND CLIENT INFORMATION

\#

\# client\_bad\_rate must NOT always be 0.0

\# =========================================================



def get\_client\_information(

&#x20;   df,

&#x20;   client\_email

):



&#x20;   default\_result = {



&#x20;       "client\_bad\_rate":

&#x20;           0.0,



&#x20;       "is\_top\_bad\_client":

&#x20;           0.0



&#x20;   }



&#x20;   if df is None:

&#x20;       return default\_result



&#x20;   if client\_email in \[

&#x20;       None,

&#x20;       "",

&#x20;       "unknown",

&#x20;       "missing"

&#x20;   ]:



&#x20;       return default\_result



&#x20;   if "client\_email" not in df.columns:



&#x20;       print(

&#x20;           "\[WARNING] client\_email column "

&#x20;           "not found in dataframe."

&#x20;       )



&#x20;       return default\_result



&#x20;   client\_email = str(

&#x20;       client\_email

&#x20;   ).strip()



&#x20;   client\_rows = df\[

&#x20;       df\["client\_email"]

&#x20;       .astype(str)

&#x20;       .str.strip()

&#x20;       .str.lower()

&#x20;       ==

&#x20;       client\_email.lower()

&#x20;   ]



&#x20;   if len(client\_rows) == 0:



&#x20;       print(

&#x20;           f"\[INFO] Client not found: "

&#x20;           f"{client\_email}"

&#x20;       )



&#x20;       return default\_result



&#x20;   # =====================================================

&#x20;   # CLIENT BAD RATE

&#x20;   # =====================================================



&#x20;   client\_bad\_rate = 0.0



&#x20;   if "client\_bad\_rate" in client\_rows.columns:



&#x20;       values = pd.to\_numeric(

&#x20;           client\_rows\["client\_bad\_rate"],

&#x20;           errors="coerce"

&#x20;       ).dropna()



&#x20;       if len(values) > 0:



&#x20;           client\_bad\_rate = float(

&#x20;               values.iloc\[0]

&#x20;           )



&#x20;   # =====================================================

&#x20;   # IS TOP BAD CLIENT

&#x20;   # =====================================================



&#x20;   is\_top\_bad\_client = 0.0



&#x20;   if "is\_top\_bad\_client" in client\_rows.columns:



&#x20;       values = pd.to\_numeric(

&#x20;           client\_rows\["is\_top\_bad\_client"],

&#x20;           errors="coerce"

&#x20;       ).dropna()



&#x20;       if len(values) > 0:



&#x20;           is\_top\_bad\_client = float(

&#x20;               values.iloc\[0]

&#x20;           )



&#x20;   result = {



&#x20;       "client\_bad\_rate":

&#x20;           client\_bad\_rate,



&#x20;       "is\_top\_bad\_client":

&#x20;           is\_top\_bad\_client



&#x20;   }



&#x20;   print()

&#x20;   print(

&#x20;       "=============================="

&#x20;   )

&#x20;   print(

&#x20;       "CLIENT INFORMATION"

&#x20;   )

&#x20;   print(

&#x20;       "=============================="

&#x20;   )



&#x20;   print(

&#x20;       f"Client Email      : {client\_email}"

&#x20;   )



&#x20;   print(

&#x20;       f"Client Bad Rate   : "

&#x20;       f"{client\_bad\_rate:.2f}%"

&#x20;   )



&#x20;   print(

&#x20;       f"Top Bad Client    : "

&#x20;       f"{is\_top\_bad\_client}"

&#x20;   )



&#x20;   return result

\# =========================================================

\# REGISTER CALLBACKS

\# =========================================================



def register\_callbacks(

&#x20;   app,

&#x20;   df

):



&#x20;   # =====================================================

&#x20;   # PREDICTION CALLBACK

&#x20;   # =====================================================



&#x20;   @app.callback(



&#x20;       Output(

&#x20;           "output",

&#x20;           "children"

&#x20;       ),



&#x20;       Input(

&#x20;           "predict\_btn",

&#x20;           "n\_clicks"

&#x20;       ),



&#x20;       State(

&#x20;           "model\_choice",

&#x20;           "value"

&#x20;       ),



&#x20;       State(

&#x20;           "top\_bad\_client",

&#x20;           "value"

&#x20;       ),



&#x20;       State(

&#x20;           "hotel",

&#x20;           "value"

&#x20;       ),



&#x20;       State(

&#x20;           "country\_group",

&#x20;           "value"

&#x20;       ),



&#x20;       State(

&#x20;           "adr\_group",

&#x20;           "value"

&#x20;       ),



&#x20;       State(

&#x20;           "previous\_cancellations\_group",

&#x20;           "value"

&#x20;       ),



&#x20;       State(

&#x20;           "days\_in\_waiting\_list\_group",

&#x20;           "value"

&#x20;       ),



&#x20;       State(

&#x20;           "deposit\_type",

&#x20;           "value"

&#x20;       ),



&#x20;       State(

&#x20;           "customer\_type",

&#x20;           "value"

&#x20;       ),



&#x20;       State(

&#x20;           "guest\_group",

&#x20;           "value"

&#x20;       ),



&#x20;       State(

&#x20;           "season\_group",

&#x20;           "value"

&#x20;       ),



&#x20;       State(

&#x20;           "meal",

&#x20;           "value"

&#x20;       ),



&#x20;       State(

&#x20;           "market\_segment",

&#x20;           "value"

&#x20;       ),



&#x20;       State(

&#x20;           "distribution\_channel",

&#x20;           "value"

&#x20;       ),



&#x20;       State(

&#x20;           "reservation\_status",

&#x20;           "value"

&#x20;       ),



&#x20;       State(

&#x20;           "is\_canceled",

&#x20;           "value"

&#x20;       )



&#x20;   )



&#x20;   def predict(



&#x20;       n,



&#x20;       model\_choice,



&#x20;       top\_bad\_client,



&#x20;       hotel,



&#x20;       country\_group,



&#x20;       adr\_group,



&#x20;       previous\_cancellations\_group,



&#x20;       days\_in\_waiting\_list\_group,



&#x20;       deposit\_type,



&#x20;       customer\_type,



&#x20;       guest\_group,



&#x20;       season\_group,



&#x20;       meal,



&#x20;       market\_segment,



&#x20;       distribution\_channel,



&#x20;       reservation\_status,



&#x20;       is\_canceled



&#x20;   ):



&#x20;       # =================================================

&#x20;       # NO CLICK

&#x20;       # =================================================



&#x20;       if not n:



&#x20;           return ""



&#x20;       try:



&#x20;           # =================================================

&#x20;           # SWITCH MODEL

&#x20;           # =================================================



&#x20;           if model\_choice:



&#x20;               ml.set\_model(

&#x20;                   model\_choice

&#x20;               )



&#x20;           # =================================================

&#x20;           # CLIENT INFORMATION

&#x20;           #

&#x20;           # Get actual client\_bad\_rate

&#x20;           # =================================================



&#x20;           client\_info = (

&#x20;               get\_client\_information(

&#x20;                   df,

&#x20;                   top\_bad\_client

&#x20;               )

&#x20;           )



&#x20;           client\_bad\_rate = (

&#x20;               safe\_numeric(

&#x20;                   client\_info\[

&#x20;                       "client\_bad\_rate"

&#x20;                   ],

&#x20;                   0.0

&#x20;               )

&#x20;           )



&#x20;           is\_top\_bad\_client = (

&#x20;               safe\_numeric(

&#x20;                   client\_info\[

&#x20;                       "is\_top\_bad\_client"

&#x20;                   ],

&#x20;                   0.0

&#x20;               )

&#x20;           )



&#x20;           # =================================================

&#x20;           # BUILD INPUT

&#x20;           # =================================================



&#x20;           x = {



&#x20;               "comment":

&#x20;                   "",



&#x20;               "client\_email":

&#x20;                   safe(

&#x20;                       top\_bad\_client

&#x20;                   ),



&#x20;               "hotel":

&#x20;                   safe(

&#x20;                       hotel

&#x20;                   ),



&#x20;               "country\_group":

&#x20;                   safe(

&#x20;                       country\_group

&#x20;                   ),



&#x20;               "adr\_group":

&#x20;                   safe(

&#x20;                       adr\_group

&#x20;                   ),



&#x20;               "previous\_cancellations\_group":

&#x20;                   safe(

&#x20;                       previous\_cancellations\_group

&#x20;                   ),



&#x20;               "days\_in\_waiting\_list\_group":

&#x20;                   safe(

&#x20;                       days\_in\_waiting\_list\_group

&#x20;                   ),



&#x20;               "deposit\_type":

&#x20;                   safe(

&#x20;                       deposit\_type

&#x20;                   ),



&#x20;               "customer\_type":

&#x20;                   safe(

&#x20;                       customer\_type

&#x20;                   ),



&#x20;               "guest\_group":

&#x20;                   safe(

&#x20;                       guest\_group

&#x20;                   ),



&#x20;               "season\_group":

&#x20;                   safe(

&#x20;                       season\_group

&#x20;                   ),



&#x20;               "meal":

&#x20;                   safe(

&#x20;                       meal

&#x20;                   ),



&#x20;               "market\_segment":

&#x20;                   safe(

&#x20;                       market\_segment

&#x20;                   ),



&#x20;               "distribution\_channel":

&#x20;                   safe(

&#x20;                       distribution\_channel

&#x20;                   ),



&#x20;               "reservation\_status":

&#x20;                   safe(

&#x20;                       reservation\_status

&#x20;                   ),



&#x20;               "is\_canceled":

&#x20;                   safe(

&#x20;                       is\_canceled

&#x20;                   ),



&#x20;               # =============================================

&#x20;               # REQUIRED BY model.py

&#x20;               # =============================================



&#x20;               "client\_segment":

&#x20;                   "unknown",



&#x20;               "is\_top\_bad\_client":

&#x20;                   is\_top\_bad\_client,



&#x20;               "client\_bad\_rate":

&#x20;                   client\_bad\_rate



&#x20;           }



&#x20;           # =================================================

&#x20;           # DEBUG INPUT

&#x20;           # =================================================



&#x20;           print()

&#x20;           print(

&#x20;               "=============================="

&#x20;           )

&#x20;           print(

&#x20;               "PREDICTION INPUT"

&#x20;           )

&#x20;           print(

&#x20;               "=============================="

&#x20;           )



&#x20;           for key, value in x.items():



&#x20;               print(

&#x20;                   f"{key}: {value!r} "

&#x20;                   f"(type={type(value).\_\_name\_\_})"

&#x20;               )



&#x20;           # =================================================

&#x20;           # PREDICT

&#x20;           #

&#x20;           # model.py returns EXACTLY 7 values

&#x20;           # =================================================



&#x20;           (



&#x20;               pred,



&#x20;               prob\_canceled,



&#x20;               prob\_check\_out,



&#x20;               prob\_no\_show,



&#x20;               sla\_risk,



&#x20;               risk,



&#x20;               comment



&#x20;           ) = ml.predict(

&#x20;               x

&#x20;           )



&#x20;           # =================================================

&#x20;           # ENSURE RATING IS INTEGER

&#x20;           # =================================================



&#x20;           pred = int(

&#x20;               pred

&#x20;           )



&#x20;           # =================================================

&#x20;           # RATING LEVEL

&#x20;           #

&#x20;           # MODEL CLASSES = 0,1,2,3,4,5,6

&#x20;           # =================================================



&#x20;           rating\_level = RATING\_LEVELS.get(



&#x20;               pred,



&#x20;               "Unknown"



&#x20;           )



&#x20;           # =================================================

&#x20;           # CLIENT BAD RATE

&#x20;           # =================================================



&#x20;           client\_bad\_rate\_display = round(



&#x20;               client\_bad\_rate,



&#x20;               1



&#x20;           )



&#x20;           # =================================================

&#x20;           # DEBUG RESULT

&#x20;           # =================================================



&#x20;           print()

&#x20;           print(

&#x20;               "=============================="

&#x20;           )

&#x20;           print(

&#x20;               "PREDICTION RESULT"

&#x20;           )

&#x20;           print(

&#x20;               "=============================="

&#x20;           )



&#x20;           print(

&#x20;               f"Customer Rating : "

&#x20;               f"{pred} / 6"

&#x20;           )



&#x20;           print(

&#x20;               f"Rating Level    : "

&#x20;               f"{rating\_level}"

&#x20;           )



&#x20;           print(

&#x20;               f"Client Bad Rate : "

&#x20;               f"{client\_bad\_rate\_display}%"

&#x20;           )



&#x20;           print(

&#x20;               f"Cancellation Probability : "

&#x20;               f"{prob\_canceled}%"

&#x20;           )



&#x20;           print(

&#x20;               f"Check Out Probability : "

&#x20;               f"{prob\_check\_out}%"

&#x20;           )



&#x20;           print(

&#x20;               f"No Show Probability : "

&#x20;               f"{prob\_no\_show}%"

&#x20;           )



&#x20;           print(

&#x20;               f"Service Level Risk : "

&#x20;               f"{sla\_risk}%"

&#x20;           )



&#x20;           print(

&#x20;               f"Customer Risk Score : "

&#x20;               f"{risk}"

&#x20;           )



&#x20;           # =================================================

&#x20;           # OUTPUT

&#x20;           # =================================================



&#x20;           return html.Div(\[



&#x20;               # =============================================

&#x20;               # RATING

&#x20;               # =============================================



&#x20;               html.H3(

&#x20;                   f"Customer Rating: "

&#x20;                   f"{pred} / 6"

&#x20;               ),



&#x20;               html.H4(

&#x20;                   f"Rating Level: "

&#x20;                   f"{rating\_level}"

&#x20;               ),



&#x20;               # =============================================

&#x20;               # RISK

&#x20;               # =============================================



&#x20;               html.H4(

&#x20;                   f"Customer Risk Score: "

&#x20;                   f"{risk}"

&#x20;               ),



&#x20;               # =============================================

&#x20;               # CLIENT BAD RATE

&#x20;               # =============================================



&#x20;               html.H4(

&#x20;                   f"Client Bad Rate: "

&#x20;                   f"{client\_bad\_rate\_display}%"

&#x20;               ),



&#x20;               # =============================================

&#x20;               # RESERVATION STATUS PROBABILITIES

&#x20;               # =============================================



&#x20;               html.H4(

&#x20;                   f"Cancellation Probability: "

&#x20;                   f"{prob\_canceled}%"

&#x20;               ),



&#x20;               html.H4(

&#x20;                   f"Check Out Probability: "

&#x20;                   f"{prob\_check\_out}%"

&#x20;               ),



&#x20;               html.H4(

&#x20;                   f"No Show Probability: "

&#x20;                   f"{prob\_no\_show}%"

&#x20;               ),



&#x20;               # =============================================

&#x20;               # SLA RISK

&#x20;               # =============================================



&#x20;               html.H4(

&#x20;                   f"Service Level Risk: "
