&#x20;       # ---------------------------------------------

&#x20;       # FINAL RATING MODEL

&#x20;       # ---------------------------------------------



&#x20;       self.best\_model = None

&#x20;       self.best\_model\_name = None



&#x20;       self.models = {}

&#x20;       self.results\_df = None



&#x20;       # ---------------------------------------------

&#x20;       # REFERENCE DATA

&#x20;       # ---------------------------------------------



&#x20;       self.df\_reference = None



&#x20;       # ---------------------------------------------

&#x20;       # COMMENT MODEL

&#x20;       # ---------------------------------------------



&#x20;       self.comment\_df = None

&#x20;       self.comment\_index = {}



&#x20;       self.comment\_tfidf = None

&#x20;       self.comment\_svd = None



&#x20;       # ---------------------------------------------

&#x20;       # RESERVATION STATUS MODEL

&#x20;       # ---------------------------------------------



&#x20;       self.status\_model = None

&#x20;       self.status\_preprocess = None



&#x20;       self.status\_features = \[]

&#x20;       self.status\_numeric\_features = \[]

&#x20;       self.status\_categorical\_features = \[]



&#x20;       # ---------------------------------------------

&#x20;       # RATING FEATURES

&#x20;       # ---------------------------------------------



&#x20;       self.rating\_features = \[]



\# =========================================================

&#x20;   # TRAIN

&#x20;   # =========================================================



&#x20;   def train(

&#x20;       self,

&#x20;       train\_df,

&#x20;       val\_df,

&#x20;       test\_df

&#x20;   ):



&#x20;       train\_df = train\_df.copy()

&#x20;       val\_df = val\_df.copy()

&#x20;       test\_df = test\_df.copy()



\# =====================================================

&#x20;       # ENSURE COMMENT

&#x20;       # =====================================================



&#x20;       for data in \[

&#x20;           train\_df,

&#x20;           val\_df,

&#x20;           test\_df

&#x20;       ]:



&#x20;           if "comment" not in data.columns:



&#x20;               data\["comment"] = ""



&#x20;           data\["comment"] = (

&#x20;               data\["comment"]

&#x20;               .fillna("")

&#x20;               .astype(str)

&#x20;           )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;       # RATING FEATURES

&#x20;       #

&#x20;       # FINAL RATING MODEL

&#x20;       # TARGET = final\_rating

&#x20;       # =====================================================



&#x20;       rating\_features = \[



&#x20;           "hotel",

&#x20;           "meal",

&#x20;           "market\_segment",

&#x20;           "distribution\_channel",

&#x20;           "deposit\_type",

&#x20;           "customer\_type",

&#x20;           "season\_group",

&#x20;           "country\_group",

&#x20;           "adr\_group",

&#x20;           "previous\_cancellations\_group",

&#x20;           "days\_in\_waiting\_list\_group",

&#x20;           "guest\_group",

&#x20;           "client\_segment",

&#x20;           "is\_top\_bad\_client",

&#x20;           "client\_bad\_rate",

&#x20;           "reservation\_status",

&#x20;           "is\_canceled"



&#x20;       ]



&#x20;       self.rating\_features = rating\_features.copy()



\# =====================================================

&#x20;       # STATUS FEATURES

&#x20;       #

&#x20;       # RESERVATION STATUS MODEL

&#x20;       # TARGET = reservation\_status

&#x20;       #

&#x20;       # IMPORTANT:

&#x20;       # reservation\_status itself is NOT an input feature.

&#x20;       # Otherwise the model would be given its own answer.

&#x20;       # =====================================================



&#x20;       status\_features = \[



&#x20;           "hotel",

&#x20;           "meal",

&#x20;           "market\_segment",

&#x20;           "distribution\_channel",

&#x20;           "deposit\_type",

&#x20;           "customer\_type",

&#x20;           "season\_group",

&#x20;           "country\_group",

&#x20;           "adr\_group",

&#x20;           "previous\_cancellations\_group",

&#x20;           "days\_in\_waiting\_list\_group",

&#x20;           "guest\_group",

&#x20;           "client\_segment",

&#x20;           "is\_top\_bad\_client",

&#x20;           "client\_bad\_rate",

&#x20;           "is\_canceled"



&#x20;       ]



&#x20;       self.status\_features = status\_features.copy()



\# =====================================================

&#x20;       # ENSURE FEATURES EXIST

&#x20;       # =====================================================



&#x20;       for data in \[

&#x20;           train\_df,

&#x20;           val\_df,

&#x20;           test\_df

&#x20;       ]:



&#x20;           for col in rating\_features:



&#x20;               if col not in data.columns:



&#x20;                   if col in \[

&#x20;                       "is\_top\_bad\_client",

&#x20;                       "client\_bad\_rate",

&#x20;                       "is\_canceled"

&#x20;                   ]:



&#x20;                       data\[col] = 0



&#x20;                   else:



&#x20;                       data\[col] = "unknown"



for col in status\_features:



&#x20;               if col not in data.columns:



&#x20;                   if col in \[

&#x20;                       "is\_top\_bad\_client",

&#x20;                       "client\_bad\_rate",

&#x20;                       "is\_canceled"

&#x20;                   ]:



&#x20;                       data\[col] = 0



&#x20;                   else:



&#x20;                       data\[col] = "unknown"



\# =====================================================

&#x20;       # NORMALISE NUMERIC FEATURES

&#x20;       # =====================================================



&#x20;       numeric\_columns = \[



&#x20;           "is\_top\_bad\_client",

&#x20;           "client\_bad\_rate",

&#x20;           "is\_canceled"



&#x20;       ]



for data in \[

&#x20;           train\_df,

&#x20;           val\_df,

&#x20;           test\_df

&#x20;       ]:



&#x20;           for col in numeric\_columns:



&#x20;               data\[col] = pd.to\_numeric(

&#x20;                   data\[col],

&#x20;                   errors="coerce"

&#x20;               )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;       # CLIENT BAD RATE

&#x20;       #

&#x20;       # Do NOT blindly make every missing value 0.

&#x20;       #

&#x20;       # Use training median as fallback.

&#x20;       # =====================================================



&#x20;       client\_bad\_rate\_median = (

&#x20;           train\_df\["client\_bad\_rate"]

&#x20;           .median()

&#x20;       )



&#x20;       if pd.isna(client\_bad\_rate\_median):



&#x20;           client\_bad\_rate\_median = 0.0



for data in \[

&#x20;           train\_df,

&#x20;           val\_df,

&#x20;           test\_df

&#x20;       ]:



&#x20;           data\["client\_bad\_rate"] = (

&#x20;               data\["client\_bad\_rate"]

&#x20;               .fillna(

&#x20;                   client\_bad\_rate\_median

&#x20;               )

&#x20;           )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;       # NORMALISE IS CANCELED

&#x20;       # =====================================================



&#x20;       for data in \[

&#x20;           train\_df,

&#x20;           val\_df,

&#x20;           test\_df

&#x20;       ]:



&#x20;           data\["is\_canceled"] = (

&#x20;               data\["is\_canceled"]

&#x20;               .fillna(0)

&#x20;               .clip(0, 1)

&#x20;           )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;       # COMMENT TOPIC LEARNING

&#x20;       # =====================================================



&#x20;       print()

&#x20;       print("==============================")

&#x20;       print("COMMENT TOPIC LEARNING")

&#x20;       print("==============================")



self.comment\_tfidf = TfidfVectorizer(

&#x20;           max\_features=5000,

&#x20;           ngram\_range=(1, 2),

&#x20;           min\_df=3

&#x20;       )



self.comment\_svd = TruncatedSVD(

&#x20;           n\_components=30,

&#x20;           random\_state=42

&#x20;       )



print(

&#x20;           "Fitting comment TF-IDF on training data..."

&#x20;       )



train\_comment\_tfidf = (

&#x20;           self.comment\_tfidf.fit\_transform(

&#x20;               train\_df\["comment"]

&#x20;           )

&#x20;       )



print(

&#x20;           "Fitting comment SVD on training data..."

&#x20;       )



train\_comment\_features\_array = (

&#x20;           self.comment\_svd.fit\_transform(

&#x20;               train\_comment\_tfidf

&#x20;           )

&#x20;       )



val\_comment\_tfidf = (

&#x20;           self.comment\_tfidf.transform(

&#x20;               val\_df\["comment"]

&#x20;           )

&#x20;       )



val\_comment\_features\_array = (

&#x20;           self.comment\_svd.transform(

&#x20;               val\_comment\_tfidf

&#x20;           )

&#x20;       )



test\_comment\_tfidf = (

&#x20;           self.comment\_tfidf.transform(

&#x20;               test\_df\["comment"]

&#x20;           )

&#x20;       )



test\_comment\_features\_array = (

&#x20;           self.comment\_svd.transform(

&#x20;               test\_comment\_tfidf

&#x20;           )

&#x20;       )



comment\_columns = \[



&#x20;           f"comment\_topic\_{i}"



&#x20;           for i in range(

&#x20;               train\_comment\_features\_array.shape\[1]

&#x20;           )



&#x20;       ]



train\_comment\_features = pd.DataFrame(

&#x20;           train\_comment\_features\_array,

&#x20;           columns=comment\_columns,

&#x20;           index=train\_df.index

&#x20;       )



val\_comment\_features = pd.DataFrame(

&#x20;           val\_comment\_features\_array,

&#x20;           columns=comment\_columns,

&#x20;           index=val\_df.index

&#x20;       )



test\_comment\_features = pd.DataFrame(

&#x20;           test\_comment\_features\_array,

&#x20;           columns=comment\_columns,

&#x20;           index=test\_df.index

&#x20;       )



train\_df = pd.concat(

&#x20;           \[

&#x20;               train\_df,

&#x20;               train\_comment\_features

&#x20;           ],

&#x20;           axis=1

&#x20;       )



val\_df = pd.concat(

&#x20;           \[

&#x20;               val\_df,

&#x20;               val\_comment\_features

&#x20;           ],

&#x20;           axis=1

&#x20;       )



test\_df = pd.concat(

&#x20;           \[

&#x20;               test\_df,

&#x20;               test\_comment\_features

&#x20;           ],

&#x20;           axis=1

&#x20;       )



rating\_features\_with\_comments = (

&#x20;           rating\_features +

&#x20;           comment\_columns

&#x20;       )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;       # FINAL RATING TARGET

&#x20;       # =====================================================



&#x20;       y\_train = (

&#x20;           pd.to\_numeric(

&#x20;               train\_df\["final\_rating"],

&#x20;               errors="coerce"

&#x20;           )

&#x20;           .fillna(0)

&#x20;           .astype(int)

&#x20;       )



&#x20;       y\_val = (

&#x20;           pd.to\_numeric(

&#x20;               val\_df\["final\_rating"],

&#x20;               errors="coerce"

&#x20;           )

&#x20;           .fillna(0)

&#x20;           .astype(int)

&#x20;       )



&#x20;       y\_test = (

&#x20;           pd.to\_numeric(

&#x20;               test\_df\["final\_rating"],

&#x20;               errors="coerce"

&#x20;           )

&#x20;           .fillna(0)

&#x20;           .astype(int)

&#x20;       )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;       # RESERVATION STATUS TARGET

&#x20;       # =====================================================



&#x20;       y\_status\_train = (

&#x20;           train\_df\["reservation\_status"]

&#x20;           .fillna("unknown")

&#x20;           .astype(str)

&#x20;           .str.strip()

&#x20;       )



&#x20;       y\_status\_val = (

&#x20;           val\_df\["reservation\_status"]

&#x20;           .fillna("unknown")

&#x20;           .astype(str)

&#x20;           .str.strip()

&#x20;       )



&#x20;       y\_status\_test = (

&#x20;           test\_df\["reservation\_status"]

&#x20;           .fillna("unknown")

&#x20;           .astype(str)

&#x20;           .str.strip()

&#x20;       )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;       # RATING INPUT

&#x20;       # =====================================================



&#x20;       X\_train = train\_df\[

&#x20;           \["comment"] +

&#x20;           rating\_features\_with\_comments

&#x20;       ]



&#x20;       X\_val = val\_df\[

&#x20;           \["comment"] +

&#x20;           rating\_features\_with\_comments

&#x20;       ]



&#x20;       X\_test = test\_df\[

&#x20;           \["comment"] +

&#x20;           rating\_features\_with\_comments

&#x20;       ]



\# =====================================================

&#x20;       # CLASS WEIGHTS

&#x20;       # =====================================================



&#x20;       classes = np.unique(

&#x20;           y\_train

&#x20;       )



class\_weights = compute\_class\_weight(

&#x20;           class\_weight="balanced",

&#x20;           classes=classes,

&#x20;           y=y\_train

&#x20;       )



class\_weight\_dict = dict(

&#x20;           zip(

&#x20;               classes,

&#x20;               class\_weights

&#x20;           )

&#x20;       )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;       # TEXT PIPELINE

&#x20;       # =====================================================



&#x20;       text\_pipeline = Pipeline(\[



&#x20;           (

&#x20;               "hash",

&#x20;               HashingVectorizer(

&#x20;                   n\_features=2\*\*16,

&#x20;                   alternate\_sign=False,

&#x20;                   ngram\_range=(1, 2)

&#x20;               )

&#x20;           ),



&#x20;           (

&#x20;               "tfidf",

&#x20;               TfidfTransformer()

&#x20;           )



&#x20;       ])



\# =====================================================

&#x20;       # RATING PREPROCESSOR

&#x20;       # =====================================================



&#x20;       rating\_preprocess = ColumnTransformer(\[



&#x20;           (

&#x20;               "text",

&#x20;               text\_pipeline,

&#x20;               "comment"

&#x20;           ),



&#x20;           (

&#x20;               "cat",

&#x20;               OneHotEncoder(

&#x20;                   handle\_unknown="ignore"

&#x20;               ),

&#x20;               \[

&#x20;                   c

&#x20;                   for c in rating\_features\_with\_comments

&#x20;                   if c not in \[

&#x20;                       "is\_top\_bad\_client",

&#x20;                       "client\_bad\_rate",

&#x20;                       "is\_canceled"

&#x20;                   ]

&#x20;               ]

&#x20;           ),



&#x20;           (

&#x20;               "num",

&#x20;               "passthrough",

&#x20;               \[

&#x20;                   c

&#x20;                   for c in rating\_features\_with\_comments

&#x20;                   if c in \[

&#x20;                       "is\_top\_bad\_client",

&#x20;                       "client\_bad\_rate",

&#x20;                       "is\_canceled"

&#x20;                   ]

&#x20;               ]

&#x20;           )



&#x20;       ])



\# =====================================================

&#x20;       # FINAL RATING MODELS

&#x20;       # =====================================================



&#x20;       models = {



&#x20;           "Logistic Regression": Pipeline(\[



&#x20;               (

&#x20;                   "prep",

&#x20;                   rating\_preprocess

&#x20;               ),



&#x20;               (

&#x20;                   "clf",

&#x20;                   LogisticRegression(

&#x20;                       solver="saga",

&#x20;                       max\_iter=500,

&#x20;                       tol=1e-3,

&#x20;                       class\_weight=class\_weight\_dict,

&#x20;                       n\_jobs=-1,

&#x20;                       multi\_class="auto"

&#x20;                   )

&#x20;               )



&#x20;           ]),



"Linear SVC": Pipeline(\[



&#x20;               (

&#x20;                   "prep",

&#x20;                   rating\_preprocess

&#x20;               ),



&#x20;               (

&#x20;                   "clf",

&#x20;                   LinearSVC(

&#x20;                       class\_weight=class\_weight\_dict,

&#x20;                       max\_iter=2000,

&#x20;                       tol=1e-3,

&#x20;                       dual=False

&#x20;                   )

&#x20;               )



&#x20;           ]),



"LightGBM": Pipeline(\[



&#x20;               (

&#x20;                   "prep",

&#x20;                   rating\_preprocess

&#x20;               ),



&#x20;               (

&#x20;                   "clf",

&#x20;                   LGBMClassifier(

&#x20;                       n\_estimators=300,

&#x20;                       learning\_rate=0.05,

&#x20;                       num\_leaves=31,

&#x20;                       class\_weight=class\_weight\_dict,

&#x20;                       random\_state=42,

&#x20;                       verbosity=-1

&#x20;                   )

&#x20;               )



&#x20;           ])



&#x20;       }



self.models = models



\# =====================================================

&#x20;       # TRAIN RATING MODELS

&#x20;       # =====================================================



&#x20;       print()

&#x20;       print("==============================")

&#x20;       print("FINAL RATING MODEL TRAINING")

&#x20;       print("==============================")



for name, model in models.items():



&#x20;           print(

&#x20;               f"Training {name}..."

&#x20;           )



&#x20;           model.fit(

&#x20;               X\_train,

&#x20;               y\_train

&#x20;           )



&#x20;           print(

&#x20;               f"{name} completed."

&#x20;           )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;       # RESERVATION STATUS MODEL

&#x20;       #

&#x20;       # THIS IS A COMPLETELY SEPARATE MODEL.

&#x20;       # =====================================================



&#x20;       print()

&#x20;       print("==============================")

&#x20;       print("RESERVATION STATUS TRAINING")

&#x20;       print("==============================")



status\_numeric\_features = \[



&#x20;           "is\_top\_bad\_client",

&#x20;           "client\_bad\_rate",

&#x20;           "is\_canceled"



&#x20;       ]



status\_categorical\_features = \[



&#x20;           c

&#x20;           for c in status\_features

&#x20;           if c not in status\_numeric\_features



&#x20;       ]



self.status\_numeric\_features = (

&#x20;           status\_numeric\_features

&#x20;       )



&#x20;       self.status\_categorical\_features = (

&#x20;           status\_categorical\_features

&#x20;       )



status\_preprocess = ColumnTransformer(\[



&#x20;           (

&#x20;               "text",

&#x20;               text\_pipeline,

&#x20;               "comment"

&#x20;           ),



&#x20;           (

&#x20;               "cat",

&#x20;               OneHotEncoder(

&#x20;                   handle\_unknown="ignore"

&#x20;               ),

&#x20;               status\_categorical\_features

&#x20;           ),



&#x20;           (

&#x20;               "num",

&#x20;               "passthrough",

&#x20;               status\_numeric\_features

&#x20;           )



&#x20;       ])



X\_train\_status = train\_df\[

&#x20;           \["comment"] +

&#x20;           status\_features

&#x20;       ]



&#x20;       X\_val\_status = val\_df\[

&#x20;           \["comment"] +

&#x20;           status\_features

&#x20;       ]



&#x20;       X\_test\_status = test\_df\[

&#x20;           \["comment"] +

&#x20;           status\_features

&#x20;       ]



X\_train\_status\_processed = (

&#x20;           status\_preprocess.fit\_transform(

&#x20;               X\_train\_status

&#x20;           )

&#x20;       )



X\_val\_status\_processed = (

&#x20;           status\_preprocess.transform(

&#x20;               X\_val\_status

&#x20;           )

&#x20;       )



X\_test\_status\_processed = (

&#x20;           status\_preprocess.transform(

&#x20;               X\_test\_status

&#x20;           )

&#x20;       )



self.status\_model = LogisticRegression(



&#x20;           solver="saga",



&#x20;           max\_iter=500,



&#x20;           tol=1e-3,



&#x20;           class\_weight="balanced",



&#x20;           n\_jobs=-1



&#x20;       )



print(

&#x20;           "Training Reservation Status Model..."

&#x20;       )



self.status\_model.fit(

&#x20;           X\_train\_status\_processed,

&#x20;           y\_status\_train

&#x20;       )



self.status\_preprocess = (

&#x20;           status\_preprocess

&#x20;       )



print(

&#x20;           "Reservation Status Model completed."

&#x20;       )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;       # STATUS EVALUATION

&#x20;       # =====================================================



&#x20;       status\_preds = (

&#x20;           self.status\_model.predict(

&#x20;               X\_test\_status\_processed

&#x20;           )

&#x20;       )



print()

&#x20;       print("==============================")

&#x20;       print("RESERVATION STATUS EVALUATION")

&#x20;       print("==============================")



print(

&#x20;           classification\_report(

&#x20;               y\_status\_test,

&#x20;               status\_preds,

&#x20;               zero\_division=0

&#x20;           )

&#x20;       )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;       # VALIDATION

&#x20;       # =====================================================



&#x20;       print()

&#x20;       print("==============================")

&#x20;       print("FINAL RATING VALIDATION")

&#x20;       print("==============================")



validation\_results = \[]



for name, model in models.items():



&#x20;           preds = model.predict(

&#x20;               X\_val

&#x20;           )



f1 = f1\_score(

&#x20;               y\_val,

&#x20;               preds,

&#x20;               average="weighted"

&#x20;           )



try:



&#x20;               clf = model.named\_steps\["clf"]



if hasattr(

&#x20;                   clf,

&#x20;                   "predict\_proba"

&#x20;               ):



&#x20;                   probs = model.predict\_proba(

&#x20;                       X\_val

&#x20;                   )



&#x20;               else:



&#x20;                   scores = model.decision\_function(

&#x20;                       X\_val

&#x20;                   )



&#x20;                   scores = np.asarray(

&#x20;                       scores

&#x20;                   )



if scores.ndim == 1:



&#x20;                       scores = np.column\_stack(

&#x20;                           \[

&#x20;                               -scores,

&#x20;                               scores

&#x20;                           ]

&#x20;                       )



exp = np.exp(

&#x20;                       scores -

&#x20;                       np.max(

&#x20;                           scores,

&#x20;                           axis=1,

&#x20;                           keepdims=True

&#x20;                       )

&#x20;                   )



&#x20;                   probs = (

&#x20;                       exp /

&#x20;                       exp.sum(

&#x20;                           axis=1,

&#x20;                           keepdims=True

&#x20;                       )

&#x20;                   )



roc = roc\_auc\_score(

&#x20;                   y\_val,

&#x20;                   probs,

&#x20;                   multi\_class="ovr",

&#x20;                   average="weighted"

&#x20;               )



&#x20;           except Exception as e:



&#x20;               print(

&#x20;                   f"\[WARNING] ROC-AUC failed "

&#x20;                   f"for {name}: {e}"

&#x20;               )



&#x20;               roc = 0.0



validation\_results.append({



&#x20;               "model": name,



&#x20;               "f1": f1,



&#x20;               "roc": roc



&#x20;           })



validation\_df = pd.DataFrame(

&#x20;           validation\_results

&#x20;       )



validation\_df\["final\_score"] = (



&#x20;           0.6 \*

&#x20;           validation\_df\["f1"]



&#x20;           +



&#x20;           0.4 \*

&#x20;           validation\_df\["roc"]



&#x20;       )



validation\_df = validation\_df.sort\_values(

&#x20;           "final\_score",

&#x20;           ascending=False

&#x20;       )



print(

&#x20;           validation\_df\[

&#x20;               \[

&#x20;                   "model",

&#x20;                   "f1",

&#x20;                   "roc",

&#x20;                   "final\_score"

&#x20;               ]

&#x20;           ].to\_string(

&#x20;               index=False

&#x20;           )

&#x20;       )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;       # BEST RATING MODEL

&#x20;       # =====================================================



&#x20;       self.best\_model\_name = (

&#x20;           validation\_df.iloc\[0]\["model"]

&#x20;       )



self.best\_model = (

&#x20;           self.models\[

&#x20;               self.best\_model\_name

&#x20;           ]

&#x20;       )



print(

&#x20;           "\\nBEST RATING MODEL SELECTED:",

&#x20;           self.best\_model\_name

&#x20;       )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;       # REFERENCE DATA

&#x20;       # =====================================================



&#x20;       self.df\_reference = pd.concat(

&#x20;           \[

&#x20;               train\_df,

&#x20;               val\_df,

&#x20;               test\_df

&#x20;           ],

&#x20;           axis=0

&#x20;       )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;       # COMMENT DATA

&#x20;       # =====================================================



&#x20;       reference\_df = self.df\_reference.copy()



self.comment\_df = reference\_df\[\[



&#x20;           "comment",

&#x20;           "hotel",

&#x20;           "meal",

&#x20;           "market\_segment",

&#x20;           "distribution\_channel",

&#x20;           "deposit\_type",

&#x20;           "customer\_type",

&#x20;           "season\_group",

&#x20;           "country\_group",

&#x20;           "adr\_group",

&#x20;           "previous\_cancellations\_group",

&#x20;           "days\_in\_waiting\_list\_group",

&#x20;           "guest\_group",

&#x20;           "final\_rating"



&#x20;       ]].copy()



\# =====================================================

&#x20;       # COMMENT INDEX

&#x20;       # =====================================================



&#x20;       self.comment\_index = {}



fields = \[



&#x20;           "hotel",

&#x20;           "meal",

&#x20;           "market\_segment",

&#x20;           "distribution\_channel",

&#x20;           "deposit\_type",

&#x20;           "customer\_type",

&#x20;           "season\_group",

&#x20;           "country\_group",

&#x20;           "adr\_group",

&#x20;           "previous\_cancellations\_group",

&#x20;           "days\_in\_waiting\_list\_group",

&#x20;           "guest\_group"



&#x20;       ]



for rating, df\_r in reference\_df.groupby(

&#x20;           "final\_rating"

&#x20;       ):



&#x20;           rating\_key = str(

&#x20;               rating

&#x20;           )



self.comment\_index\[

&#x20;               rating\_key

&#x20;           ] = {



&#x20;               "ALL":

&#x20;                   df\_r\[

&#x20;                       "comment"

&#x20;                   ].tolist(),



&#x20;               "FIELDS":

&#x20;                   {}



&#x20;           }



for field in fields:



&#x20;               if field not in df\_r.columns:

&#x20;                   continue



self.comment\_index\[

&#x20;                   rating\_key

&#x20;               ]\[

&#x20;                   "FIELDS"

&#x20;               ]\[field] = (



&#x20;                   df\_r

&#x20;                   .groupby(field)\["comment"]

&#x20;                   .apply(list)

&#x20;                   .to\_dict()



&#x20;               )



print(

&#x20;           "FAST COMMENT INDEX READY"

&#x20;       )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;       # SAVE

&#x20;       # =====================================================



&#x20;       self.\_save\_artifacts(

&#x20;           reference\_df

&#x20;       )



return reference\_df



\# =========================================================

&#x20;   # SAVE ARTIFACTS

&#x20;   # =========================================================



&#x20;   def \_save\_artifacts(

&#x20;       self,

&#x20;       df

&#x20;   ):



&#x20;       trained\_dir = self.config.get(

&#x20;           "trained\_dir",

&#x20;           "trained"

&#x20;       )



os.makedirs(

&#x20;           trained\_dir,

&#x20;           exist\_ok=True

&#x20;       )



train\_path = self.config.get(

&#x20;           "train\_data",

&#x20;           os.path.join(

&#x20;               trained\_dir,

&#x20;               "train.parquet"

&#x20;           )

&#x20;       )



df.to\_parquet(

&#x20;           train\_path,

&#x20;           index=False

&#x20;       )



print(

&#x20;           f"\[INFO] Training data saved: "

&#x20;           f"{train\_path}"

&#x20;       )



model\_path = self.config.get(

&#x20;           "service\_model",

&#x20;           os.path.join(

&#x20;               trained\_dir,

&#x20;               "service\_model.pkl"

&#x20;           )

&#x20;       )



joblib.dump(

&#x20;           self,

&#x20;           model\_path

&#x20;       )



print(

&#x20;           f"\[INFO] Service model saved: "

&#x20;           f"{model\_path}"

&#x20;       )



metadata\_path = self.config.get(

&#x20;           "training\_metadata",

&#x20;           os.path.join(

&#x20;               trained\_dir,

&#x20;               "training\_metadata.json"

&#x20;           )

&#x20;       )



import json



metadata = {}



if os.path.exists(

&#x20;           metadata\_path

&#x20;       ):



&#x20;           with open(

&#x20;               metadata\_path,

&#x20;               "r"

&#x20;           ) as f:



&#x20;               metadata = json.load(

&#x20;                   f

&#x20;               )



metadata.update({



&#x20;           "model":

&#x20;               self.best\_model\_name,



&#x20;           "trained\_time":

&#x20;               datetime.now().isoformat(),



&#x20;           "rows":

&#x20;               len(df),



&#x20;           "columns":

&#x20;               list(df.columns)



&#x20;       })



with open(

&#x20;           metadata\_path,

&#x20;           "w"

&#x20;       ) as f:



&#x20;           json.dump(

&#x20;               metadata,

&#x20;               f,

&#x20;               indent=4

&#x20;           )



print(

&#x20;           f"\[INFO] Metadata updated: "

&#x20;           f"{metadata\_path}"

&#x20;       )



\# =========================================================

&#x20;   # SWITCH MODEL

&#x20;   # =========================================================



&#x20;   def set\_model(

&#x20;       self,

&#x20;       name: str

&#x20;   ):



&#x20;       if name in self.models:



&#x20;           self.best\_model\_name = name



&#x20;           self.best\_model = (

&#x20;               self.models\[name]

&#x20;           )



\# =========================================================

&#x20;   # NORMALISE INPUT

&#x20;   # =========================================================



&#x20;   def \_prepare\_input(

&#x20;       self,

&#x20;       x

&#x20;   ):



&#x20;       input\_df = pd.DataFrame(

&#x20;           \[x]

&#x20;       )



\# ---------------------------------------------

&#x20;       # Text

&#x20;       # ---------------------------------------------



&#x20;       if "comment" not in input\_df.columns:



&#x20;           input\_df\["comment"] = ""



input\_df\["comment"] = (

&#x20;           input\_df\["comment"]

&#x20;           .fillna("")

&#x20;           .astype(str)

&#x20;       )



\# ---------------------------------------------

&#x20;       # Categorical

&#x20;       # ---------------------------------------------



&#x20;       categorical\_features = \[



&#x20;           "hotel",

&#x20;           "meal",

&#x20;           "market\_segment",

&#x20;           "distribution\_channel",

&#x20;           "deposit\_type",

&#x20;           "customer\_type",

&#x20;           "season\_group",

&#x20;           "country\_group",

&#x20;           "adr\_group",

&#x20;           "previous\_cancellations\_group",

&#x20;           "days\_in\_waiting\_list\_group",

&#x20;           "guest\_group",

&#x20;           "client\_segment"



&#x20;       ]



for col in categorical\_features:



&#x20;           if col not in input\_df.columns:



&#x20;               input\_df\[col] = "unknown"



&#x20;           input\_df\[col] = (

&#x20;               input\_df\[col]

&#x20;               .fillna("unknown")

&#x20;               .astype(str)

&#x20;           )



\# ---------------------------------------------

&#x20;       # Numeric

&#x20;       # ---------------------------------------------



&#x20;       if "is\_top\_bad\_client" not in input\_df.columns:



&#x20;           input\_df\["is\_top\_bad\_client"] = 0



if "is\_canceled" not in input\_df.columns:



&#x20;           input\_df\["is\_canceled"] = 0



if "client\_bad\_rate" not in input\_df.columns:



&#x20;           input\_df\["client\_bad\_rate"] = np.nan



input\_df\["is\_top\_bad\_client"] = (

&#x20;           pd.to\_numeric(

&#x20;               input\_df\["is\_top\_bad\_client"],

&#x20;               errors="coerce"

&#x20;           )

&#x20;           .fillna(0)

&#x20;           .clip(0, 1)

&#x20;       )



input\_df\["is\_canceled"] = (

&#x20;           pd.to\_numeric(

&#x20;               input\_df\["is\_canceled"],

&#x20;               errors="coerce"

&#x20;           )

&#x20;           .fillna(0)

&#x20;           .clip(0, 1)

&#x20;       )



\# ---------------------------------------------

&#x20;       # Client bad rate

&#x20;       # ---------------------------------------------



&#x20;       client\_bad\_rate = pd.to\_numeric(

&#x20;           input\_df\["client\_bad\_rate"],

&#x20;           errors="coerce"

&#x20;       )



if client\_bad\_rate.isna().all():



&#x20;           if self.df\_reference is not None and \\

&#x20;              "client\_bad\_rate" in self.df\_reference.columns:



&#x20;               fallback = pd.to\_numeric(

&#x20;                   self.df\_reference\[

&#x20;                       "client\_bad\_rate"

&#x20;                   ],

&#x20;                   errors="coerce"

&#x20;               ).median()



&#x20;               if pd.isna(fallback):



&#x20;                   fallback = 0.0



&#x20;           else:



&#x20;               fallback = 0.0



&#x20;           client\_bad\_rate = client\_bad\_rate.fillna(

&#x20;               fallback

&#x20;           )



&#x20;       else:



&#x20;           fallback = client\_bad\_rate.median()



&#x20;           if pd.isna(fallback):



&#x20;               fallback = 0.0



&#x20;           client\_bad\_rate = client\_bad\_rate.fillna(

&#x20;               fallback

&#x20;           )



input\_df\["client\_bad\_rate"] = (

&#x20;           client\_bad\_rate

&#x20;       )



return input\_df



\# =========================================================

&#x20;   # PREDICT

&#x20;   # =========================================================



&#x20;   def predict(

&#x20;       self,

&#x20;       x: dict

&#x20;   ):



&#x20;       # =====================================================

&#x20;       # PREPARE UI INPUT

&#x20;       # =====================================================



&#x20;       input\_df = self.\_prepare\_input(

&#x20;           x

&#x20;       )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;       # COMMENT TOPIC FEATURES

&#x20;       # =====================================================



&#x20;       if (

&#x20;           self.comment\_tfidf is None

&#x20;           or self.comment\_svd is None

&#x20;       ):



&#x20;           raise RuntimeError(

&#x20;               "Comment TF-IDF/SVD models are not available. "

&#x20;               "Please retrain the ServiceModel."

&#x20;           )



comment\_tfidf = (

&#x20;           self.comment\_tfidf.transform(

&#x20;               input\_df\["comment"]

&#x20;           )

&#x20;       )



comment\_features\_array = (

&#x20;           self.comment\_svd.transform(

&#x20;               comment\_tfidf

&#x20;           )

&#x20;       )



comment\_columns = \[



&#x20;           f"comment\_topic\_{i}"



&#x20;           for i in range(

&#x20;               comment\_features\_array.shape\[1]

&#x20;           )



&#x20;       ]



comment\_features = pd.DataFrame(



&#x20;           comment\_features\_array,



&#x20;           columns=comment\_columns,



&#x20;           index=input\_df.index



&#x20;       )



input\_df = pd.concat(

&#x20;           \[

&#x20;               input\_df,

&#x20;               comment\_features

&#x20;           ],

&#x20;           axis=1

&#x20;       )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;       # =====================================================

&#x20;       # PART 1

&#x20;       # FINAL RATING PREDICTION

&#x20;       # =====================================================

&#x20;       # =====================================================



&#x20;       rating\_features\_with\_comments = (



&#x20;           self.rating\_features +



&#x20;           comment\_columns



&#x20;       )



X\_rating = input\_df\[

&#x20;           \["comment"] +

&#x20;           rating\_features\_with\_comments

&#x20;       ]



pred\_rating = int(

&#x20;           self.best\_model.predict(

&#x20;               X\_rating

&#x20;           )\[0]

&#x20;       )



\# Make absolutely sure rating stays 0-6.



&#x20;       pred\_rating = int(

&#x20;           np.clip(

&#x20;               pred\_rating,

&#x20;               0,

&#x20;               6

&#x20;           )

&#x20;       )



clf = (

&#x20;           self.best\_model

&#x20;           .named\_steps\["clf"]

&#x20;       )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;       # RATING PROBABILITIES

&#x20;       # =====================================================



&#x20;       if hasattr(

&#x20;           clf,

&#x20;           "predict\_proba"

&#x20;       ):



&#x20;           rating\_probs = (

&#x20;               self.best\_model

&#x20;               .predict\_proba(

&#x20;                   X\_rating

&#x20;               )\[0]

&#x20;           )



&#x20;       else:



&#x20;           scores = (

&#x20;               self.best\_model

&#x20;               .decision\_function(

&#x20;                   X\_rating

&#x20;               )

&#x20;           )



scores = np.asarray(

&#x20;               scores

&#x20;           )



if scores.ndim == 2:



&#x20;               scores = scores\[0]



exp = np.exp(

&#x20;               scores -

&#x20;               np.max(scores)

&#x20;           )



rating\_probs = (

&#x20;               exp /

&#x20;               np.sum(exp)

&#x20;           )



rating\_class\_order = list(

&#x20;           clf.classes\_

&#x20;       )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;       # SLA RISK

&#x20;       #

&#x20;       # 0 = highest risk

&#x20;       # 6 = lowest risk

&#x20;       # =====================================================



&#x20;       risk\_weights = {



&#x20;           0: 1.00,

&#x20;           1: 0.90,

&#x20;           2: 0.75,

&#x20;           3: 0.60,

&#x20;           4: 0.40,

&#x20;           5: 0.20,

&#x20;           6: 0.00



&#x20;       }



sla\_risk = 0.0



for i, cls in enumerate(

&#x20;           rating\_class\_order

&#x20;       ):



&#x20;           if i >= len(

&#x20;               rating\_probs

&#x20;           ):



&#x20;               continue



try:



&#x20;               rating\_class = int(

&#x20;                   cls

&#x20;               )



&#x20;           except Exception:



&#x20;               continue



sla\_risk += (



&#x20;               rating\_probs\[i] \*



&#x20;               risk\_weights.get(

&#x20;                   rating\_class,

&#x20;                   0.50

&#x20;               )



&#x20;           )



sla\_risk\_score = round(

&#x20;           sla\_risk \* 100,

&#x20;           1

&#x20;       )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;       # CUSTOMER RISK SCORE

&#x20;       # =====================================================



&#x20;       rating\_risk\_map = {



&#x20;           0: 100,

&#x20;           1: 90,

&#x20;           2: 75,

&#x20;           3: 60,

&#x20;           4: 40,

&#x20;           5: 20,

&#x20;           6: 10



&#x20;       }



base\_risk = rating\_risk\_map.get(

&#x20;           pred\_rating,

&#x20;           50

&#x20;       )



risk\_score = round(



&#x20;           (

&#x20;               0.6 \*

&#x20;               base\_risk

&#x20;           )



&#x20;           +



&#x20;           (

&#x20;               0.4 \*

&#x20;               sla\_risk\_score

&#x20;           ),



&#x20;           1



&#x20;       )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;       # =====================================================

&#x20;       # PART 2

&#x20;       # RESERVATION STATUS PREDICTION

&#x20;       # =====================================================

&#x20;       # =====================================================



&#x20;       status\_input = input\_df\[



&#x20;           \[

&#x20;               "comment",

&#x20;               "hotel",

&#x20;               "meal",

&#x20;               "market\_segment",

&#x20;               "distribution\_channel",

&#x20;               "deposit\_type",

&#x20;               "customer\_type",

&#x20;               "season\_group",

&#x20;               "country\_group",

&#x20;               "adr\_group",

&#x20;               "previous\_cancellations\_group",

&#x20;               "days\_in\_waiting\_list\_group",

&#x20;               "guest\_group",

&#x20;               "client\_segment",

&#x20;               "is\_top\_bad\_client",

&#x20;               "client\_bad\_rate",

&#x20;               "is\_canceled"



&#x20;           ]



&#x20;       ]



\# =====================================================

&#x20;       # TRANSFORM USING STATUS MODEL PREPROCESSOR

&#x20;       # =====================================================



&#x20;       X\_status = (

&#x20;           self.status\_preprocess.transform(

&#x20;               status\_input

&#x20;           )

&#x20;       )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;       # STATUS PROBABILITIES

&#x20;       # =====================================================



&#x20;       status\_probs = (

&#x20;           self.status\_model

&#x20;           .predict\_proba(

&#x20;               X\_status

&#x20;           )\[0]

&#x20;       )



status\_classes = (

&#x20;           self.status\_model.classes\_

&#x20;       )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;       # INITIALISE

&#x20;       # =====================================================



&#x20;       prob\_canceled = 0.0

&#x20;       prob\_check\_out = 0.0

&#x20;       prob\_no\_show = 0.0



\# =====================================================

&#x20;       # MAP BY ACTUAL TRAINED CLASS

&#x20;       #

&#x20;       # This is important.

&#x20;       #

&#x20;       # Do NOT assume:

&#x20;       #

&#x20;       # \[Canceled, Check-Out, No-Show]

&#x20;       #

&#x20;       # Instead use classes\_ returned by the trained model.

&#x20;       # =====================================================



&#x20;       for probability, cls in zip(

&#x20;           status\_probs,

&#x20;           status\_classes

&#x20;       ):



&#x20;           normalized\_cls = (

&#x20;               str(cls)

&#x20;               .strip()

&#x20;               .lower()

&#x20;               .replace("\_", "-")

&#x20;               .replace(" ", "-")

&#x20;           )



percentage = (

&#x20;               float(probability) \*

&#x20;               100.0

&#x20;           )



if normalized\_cls in \[

&#x20;               "canceled",

&#x20;               "cancelled"

&#x20;           ]:



&#x20;               prob\_canceled = percentage



elif normalized\_cls in \[

&#x20;               "check-out",

&#x20;               "check-out",

&#x20;               "checkout"

&#x20;           ]:



&#x20;               prob\_check\_out = percentage



elif normalized\_cls in \[

&#x20;               "no-show",

&#x20;               "noshow"

&#x20;           ]:



&#x20;               prob\_no\_show = percentage



\# =====================================================

&#x20;       # IMPORTANT STATUS SIGNAL

&#x20;       #

&#x20;       # is\_canceled = 1 is a strong operational signal.

&#x20;       #

&#x20;       # We do NOT simply force cancellation to 100%.

&#x20;       #

&#x20;       # Instead we make sure the probability reflects

&#x20;       # the cancellation signal when the model produces

&#x20;       # an extremely tiny cancellation probability.

&#x20;       # =====================================================



&#x20;       is\_canceled\_value = float(

&#x20;           input\_df\[

&#x20;               "is\_canceled"

&#x20;           ].iloc\[0]

&#x20;       )



if is\_canceled\_value >= 1:



&#x20;           # If training data contains canceled records

&#x20;           # with is\_canceled=1, the status model should

&#x20;           # normally produce a meaningful cancellation

&#x20;           # probability.

&#x20;           #

&#x20;           # This fallback prevents an abnormal near-zero

&#x20;           # prediction when the trained model has a very

&#x20;           # weak learned signal.



&#x20;           if prob\_canceled < 1.0:



&#x20;               prob\_canceled = 1.0



\# =====================================================

&#x20;       # NORMALISE STATUS PROBABILITIES

&#x20;       #

&#x20;       # Only normalise if the three known classes exist.

&#x20;       # =====================================================



&#x20;       status\_total = (



&#x20;           prob\_canceled +



&#x20;           prob\_check\_out +



&#x20;           prob\_no\_show



&#x20;       )



if status\_total > 0:



&#x20;           prob\_canceled = (

&#x20;               prob\_canceled /

&#x20;               status\_total \*

&#x20;               100

&#x20;           )



&#x20;           prob\_check\_out = (

&#x20;               prob\_check\_out /

&#x20;               status\_total \*

&#x20;               100

&#x20;           )



&#x20;           prob\_no\_show = (

&#x20;               prob\_no\_show /

&#x20;               status\_total \*

&#x20;               100

&#x20;           )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;       # ROUND AFTER NORMALISATION

&#x20;       # =====================================================



&#x20;       prob\_canceled = round(

&#x20;           prob\_canceled,

&#x20;           1

&#x20;       )



&#x20;       prob\_check\_out = round(

&#x20;           prob\_check\_out,

&#x20;           1

&#x20;       )



&#x20;       prob\_no\_show = round(

&#x20;           prob\_no\_show,

&#x20;           1

&#x20;       )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;       # COMMENT

&#x20;       # =====================================================



&#x20;       generated\_comment = (

&#x20;           self.\_generate\_comment(

&#x20;               pred\_rating,

&#x20;               sla\_risk\_score,

&#x20;               risk\_score,

&#x20;               x

&#x20;           )

&#x20;       )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;       # DEBUG INFORMATION

&#x20;       # =====================================================



&#x20;       print()

&#x20;       print("==============================")

&#x20;       print("FINAL PREDICTION")

&#x20;       print("==============================")



print(

&#x20;           "Predicted Rating:",

&#x20;           pred\_rating

&#x20;       )



print(

&#x20;           "Rating Risk:",

&#x20;           risk\_score

&#x20;       )



print(

&#x20;           "SLA Risk:",

&#x20;           sla\_risk\_score

&#x20;       )



print(

&#x20;           "Client Bad Rate:",

&#x20;           input\_df\[

&#x20;               "client\_bad\_rate"

&#x20;           ].iloc\[0]

&#x20;       )



print()

&#x20;       print("Reservation Status Probabilities:")



print(

&#x20;           "Cancellation:",

&#x20;           prob\_canceled,

&#x20;           "%"

&#x20;       )



print(

&#x20;           "Check-Out:",

&#x20;           prob\_check\_out,

&#x20;           "%"

&#x20;       )



print(

&#x20;           "No-Show:",

&#x20;           prob\_no\_show,

&#x20;           "%"

&#x20;       )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;       # RETURN

&#x20;       # =====================================================



&#x20;       return (



&#x20;           pred\_rating,



&#x20;           prob\_canceled,



&#x20;           prob\_check\_out,



&#x20;           prob\_no\_show,



&#x20;           sla\_risk\_score,



&#x20;           risk\_score,



&#x20;           generated\_comment



&#x20;       )



\# =========================================================

&#x20;   # COMMENT GENERATION

&#x20;   # =========================================================



&#x20;   def \_generate\_comment(

&#x20;       self,

&#x20;       rating,

&#x20;       sla\_risk,

&#x20;       risk,

&#x20;       x

&#x20;   ):



&#x20;       msg = \[]



\# =====================================================

&#x20;       # RATING 0-6

&#x20;       # =====================================================



&#x20;       if rating == 6:



&#x20;           msg.append(

&#x20;               "Excellent service."

&#x20;           )



&#x20;       elif rating == 5:



&#x20;           msg.append(

&#x20;               "Very good service."

&#x20;           )



&#x20;       elif rating == 4:



&#x20;           msg.append(

&#x20;               "Positive service."

&#x20;           )



&#x20;       elif rating == 3:



&#x20;           msg.append(

What this changes



The important conceptual separation is now:



UI INPUT

&#x20;                      │

&#x20;                      ▼

&#x20;               model.predict(x)

&#x20;                      │

&#x20;         ┌────────────┴────────────┐

&#x20;         │                         │

&#x20;         ▼                         ▼

&#x20;RESERVATION STATUS MODEL     FINAL RATING MODEL

&#x20;target: reservation\_status   target: final\_rating

&#x20;         │                         │

&#x20;         ├─ Cancellation %        ├─ Rating 0–6

&#x20;         ├─ Check-Out %           ├─ Risk Score

&#x20;         └─ No-Show %             └─ SLA Risk



So if the UI sends:



{

&#x20;   "is\_canceled": 1,

&#x20;   ...

}



the reservation status model receives is\_canceled=1.



It does not use reservation\_status itself as an input to the status model. That was conceptually wrong because reservation\_status is the thing that the model is supposed to predict.



Also, the final-rating model remains independent and predicts final\_rating.



One important point about your current 0.0% result



Your original code is actually capable of returning a genuine 0.0 after rounding if the trained status model gives something like:



Canceled     0.004%

Check-Out   99.995%

No-Show      0.001%



It would display:



Cancellation Probability: 0.0%



That doesn't necessarily mean the status model failed. It means the UI is displaying only one decimal place.



The revised code additionally handles is\_canceled=1 as an explicit operational signal so that a completely negligible cancellation probability is not shown when the input explicitly indicates cancellation.



Also fix predict\_page.py



Because this revised model.py returns 7 values, your predict\_page.py must use:



(

&#x20;   pred,

&#x20;   prob\_canceled,

&#x20;   prob\_check\_out,

&#x20;   prob\_no\_show,

&#x20;   sla\_risk,

&#x20;   risk,

&#x20;   comment

) = service\_model.predict(input\_data)



Do not use:



pred, sla\_risk, risk, comment = service\_model.predict(input\_data)



because that is exactly what causes:



ValueError: too many values to unpack

(expected 4, got 7)

rating\_level = {

&#x20;   3: "Average",

&#x20;   4: "Good",

&#x20;   5: "Very Good",

&#x20;   6: "Excellent"

}.get(pred, "Unknown")



This will also fix the inconsistency you showed where the UI says:



Customer Rating: 6 / 6

Rating Level: Excellent



but the generated comment says:



High dissatisfaction.



The revised \_generate\_comment() now correctly treats 6 as Excellent.

8/28/2026, 1:04:01 PM



Yes. The main issue is that predict\_page.py is currently treating the reservation-status probability and final-rating prediction as if they come from the same model output.



With your model.py, they are actually two separate prediction paths:



Reservation Status model → status\_model.predict\_proba() → Cancellation / Check-Out / No-Show probabilities.



Final Rating model → best\_model.predict() and best\_model.predict\_proba() / decision\_function() → Customer Rating, SLA Risk and Customer Risk Score.



client\_bad\_rate is a historical feature calculated from the selected client's records and passed into both models where applicable.



predict\_page.py should therefore only collect UI inputs, calculate the historical client feature, call ml.predict(x), and display the seven returned values.



Your existing predict\_page.py is already close, but I would make the alignment stricter and fix one important issue: reservation\_status must not be used as an input feature for the reservation-status prediction model, because model.py deliberately excludes it from status\_features. It is fine for the final-rating model.



Also, your current rating label says rating 6 = Excellent, but \_generate\_comment() in your model.py only explicitly handles 5 as "Excellent service." and sends 6 into "High dissatisfaction." That is inconsistent and explains your result:



Customer Rating: 6 / 6

Rating Level: Excellent

...

High dissatisfaction.



So both files need to agree.



Below is the revised predict\_page.py that aligns with the model.py you supplied.

values = \[]



for value in series:



&#x20;   if value is None:

&#x20;       continue



&#x20;   if isinstance(value, float) and np.isnan(value):

&#x20;       continue



&#x20;   value = str(value).strip()



&#x20;   if value.lower() in \[

&#x20;       "missing",

&#x20;       "unknown",

&#x20;       "nan",

&#x20;       "none",

&#x20;       "null",

&#x20;       ""

&#x20;   ]:

&#x20;       continue



&#x20;   values.append(value)



return sorted(

&#x20;   list(set(values))

)



=========================================================



FIND CLIENT COLUMN



=========================================================



def get\_client\_column(df):



possible\_columns = \[



&#x20;   "client\_email",

&#x20;   "email",

&#x20;   "customer\_email",

&#x20;   "client"



]



for col in possible\_columns:



&#x20;   if col in df.columns:

&#x20;       return col



return None



=========================================================



CALCULATE CLIENT BAD RATE



Historical feature:



bad rating = 0, 1 or 2



client\_bad\_rate =



bad historical bookings



\-----------------------



total historical bookings



Result is 0.0 - 1.0



=========================================================



def calculate\_client\_bad\_rate(

&#x20;   df,

&#x20;   client\_value

):



if df is None:

&#x20;   return 0.0



if client\_value is None:

&#x20;   return 0.0



client\_value = str(

&#x20;   client\_value

).strip()



if client\_value == "":

&#x20;   return 0.0



client\_column = get\_client\_column(

&#x20;   df

)



if client\_column is None:



&#x20;   print(

&#x20;       "\[WARNING] Client column not found. "

&#x20;       "client\_bad\_rate = 0.0"

&#x20;   )



&#x20;   return 0.0



if "final\_rating" not in df.columns:



&#x20;   print(

&#x20;       "\[WARNING] final\_rating column not found. "

&#x20;       "client\_bad\_rate = 0.0"

&#x20;   )



&#x20;   return 0.0



=====================================================



\# COPY

\# =====================================================



work\_df = df.copy()



=====================================================



\# NORMALISE CLIENT

\# =====================================================



work\_df\["\_client\_key"] = (



&#x20;   work\_df\[client\_column]

&#x20;   .fillna("")

&#x20;   .astype(str)

&#x20;   .str.strip()

&#x20;   .str.lower()



)



selected\_key = (

&#x20;       client\_value

&#x20;       .lower()

&#x20;       .strip()

&#x20;   )



=====================================================



\# FIND HISTORICAL RECORDS

\# =====================================================



client\_df = work\_df\[

&#x20;   work\_df\["\_client\_key"] == selected\_key

].copy()



if len(client\_df) == 0:



print(

&#x20;       f"\[INFO] No historical records found "

&#x20;       f"for client: {client\_value}"

&#x20;   )



&#x20;   return 0.0



=====================================================



\# CONVERT RATING

\# =====================================================



client\_df\["\_rating\_numeric"] = pd.to\_numeric(



&#x20;   client\_df\[

&#x20;       "final\_rating"

&#x20;   ],



&#x20;   errors="coerce"



)



client\_df = client\_df\[

&#x20;       client\_df\[

&#x20;           "\_rating\_numeric"

&#x20;       ].notna()

&#x20;   ]



if len(client\_df) == 0:



return 0.0



=====================================================



\# BAD RATINGS

\#

\# 0, 1, 2 = BAD

\# =====================================================



bad\_count = (



&#x20;   client\_df\[

&#x20;       "\_rating\_numeric"

&#x20;   ]

&#x20;   .isin(

&#x20;       \[

&#x20;           0,

&#x20;           1,

&#x20;           2

&#x20;       ]

&#x20;   )

&#x20;   .sum()



)



total\_count = len(

&#x20;       client\_df

&#x20;   )



if total\_count == 0:



return 0.0



=====================================================



\# BAD RATE

\# =====================================================



bad\_rate = (



&#x20;   bad\_count /

&#x20;   total\_count



)



bad\_rate = float(

&#x20;       np.clip(

&#x20;           bad\_rate,

&#x20;           0.0,

&#x20;           1.0

&#x20;       )

&#x20;   )



print()

&#x20;   print(

&#x20;       "=============================="

&#x20;   )

&#x20;   print(

&#x20;       "CLIENT BAD RATE"

&#x20;   )

&#x20;   print(

&#x20;       "=============================="

&#x20;   )

&#x20;   print(

&#x20;       f"Client        : {client\_value}"

&#x20;   )

&#x20;   print(

&#x20;       f"Total records : {total\_count}"

&#x20;   )

&#x20;   print(

&#x20;       f"Bad records   : {bad\_count}"

&#x20;   )

&#x20;   print(

&#x20;       f"Bad rate      : {bad\_rate:.4f}"

&#x20;   )

&#x20;   print(

&#x20;       f"Bad rate %    : {bad\_rate \* 100:.1f}%"

&#x20;   )



return bad\_rate



=========================================================



CALCULATE CLIENT SEGMENT



=========================================================



def calculate\_client\_segment(

&#x20;   bad\_rate

):



bad\_rate = safe\_numeric(

&#x20;   bad\_rate,

&#x20;   0.0

)



if bad\_rate >= 0.70:



return "high-risk"



elif bad\_rate >= 0.40:



return "bad"



elif bad\_rate >= 0.20:



return "moderate"



else:



return "low-risk"

n,



&#x20;   model\_choice,

&#x20;   is\_canceled



):



=================================================



\# NO CLICK

&#x20;   # =================================================



&#x20;   if not n:

&#x20;       return ""



try:

\# SELECT FINAL-RATING MODEL

&#x20;       #

&#x20;       # This only controls the final\_rating model.

&#x20;       # final\_rating records.

&#x20;       # =================================================



&#x20;       client\_bad\_rate = (

&#x20;           )



&#x20;       )

&#x20;           )

\# TOP BAD CLIENT

&#x20;           \[]

&#x20;       )



top\_client\_strings = {



str(v)

&#x20;           .strip()

&#x20;           .lower()



&#x20;           for v in TOP\_CLIENTS



&#x20;           if v is not None



&#x20;       }



selected\_client\_key = (



str(

&#x20;               top\_bad\_client

&#x20;           )

&#x20;           .strip()

&#x20;           .lower()



&#x20;           if top\_bad\_client is not None



&#x20;           else ""



&#x20;       )



if selected\_client\_key in top\_client\_strings:



is\_top\_bad\_client = 1.0



&#x20;       else:



&#x20;           is\_top\_bad\_client = 0.0



=================================================



\# BUILD MODEL INPUT

for key, value in x.items():

=================================================



\# MODEL PREDICTION

&#x20;       (

if pred not in \[

raise ValueError(

&#x20;       )



=================================================



\# MODEL RISK VALUES

&#x20;       #

&#x20;       # DO NOT RECALCULATE HERE.

&#x20;       # =================================================



&#x20;       risk = float(

&#x20;           risk

&#x20;       )



&#x20;       sla\_risk = float(

&#x20;           sla\_risk

prob\_canceled = float(

&#x20;       print()

&#x20;           "=============================="

&#x20;       )

&#x20;       print(

&#x20;       )

&#x20;       )



&#x20;       print(

&#x20;       )



=================================================



\# OUTPUT

&#x20;       # =================================================



&#x20;       return html.Div(\[



&#x20;           html.H4(

&#x20;           ),



&#x20;           html.H4(

&#x20;           ),



&#x20;           html.H4(

&#x20;               f"Customer Risk Score: "

&#x20;               f"{risk:.1f}"

&#x20;           ),



&#x20;           html.H4(

&#x20;               f"Client Bad Rate: "

&#x20;           ),



&#x20;           html.H4(

&#x20;           ),



&#x20;           html.H4(

&#x20;               f"{prob\_check\_out:.1f}%"

&#x20;           ),

&#x20;   "=============================="

)

print(

&#x20;   "CLIENT BAD RATE"

)

print(

&#x20;   "=============================="

)

print(

&#x20;   f"Client        : {client\_value}"

)

print(

&#x20;   f"Total records : {total\_count}"

)

print(

&#x20;   f"Bad records   : {bad\_count}"

)

print(

&#x20;   f"Bad rate      : {bad\_rate:.4f}"

)

print(

&#x20;   f"Bad rate %    : {bad\_rate \* 100:.1f}%"

)



return bad\_rate



=========================================================



CALCULATE CLIENT SEGMENT



=========================================================



def calculate\_client\_segment(

&#x20;   bad\_rate

):



bad\_rate = safe\_numeric(

&#x20;   bad\_rate,

&#x20;   0.0

)



if bad\_rate >= 0.70:



&#x20;   return "high-risk"



elif bad\_rate >= 0.40:



&#x20;   return "bad"



elif bad\_rate >= 0.20:



&#x20;   return "moderate"



else:



&#x20;   return "low-risk"
