def register\_callbacks(app, df):



\# =====================================================

\# PREDICTION CALLBACK

\# =====================================================



@app.callback(



&#x20;   Output(

&#x20;       "output",

&#x20;       "children"

&#x20;   ),



&#x20;   Input(

&#x20;       "predict\_btn",

&#x20;       "n\_clicks"

&#x20;   ),



&#x20;   State(

&#x20;       "model\_choice",

&#x20;       "value"

&#x20;   ),



&#x20;   State(

&#x20;       "top\_bad\_client",

&#x20;       "value"

&#x20;   ),



&#x20;   State(

&#x20;       "hotel",

&#x20;       "value"

&#x20;   ),



&#x20;   State(

&#x20;       "country\_group",

&#x20;       "value"

&#x20;   ),



&#x20;   State(

&#x20;       "adr\_group",

&#x20;       "value"

&#x20;   ),



&#x20;   State(

&#x20;       "previous\_cancellations\_group",

&#x20;       "value"

&#x20;   ),



&#x20;   State(

&#x20;       "days\_in\_waiting\_list\_group",

&#x20;       "value"

&#x20;   ),



&#x20;   State(

&#x20;       "deposit\_type",

&#x20;       "value"

&#x20;   ),



&#x20;   State(

&#x20;       "customer\_type",

&#x20;       "value"

&#x20;   ),



&#x20;   State(

&#x20;       "guest\_group",

&#x20;       "value"

&#x20;   ),



&#x20;   State(

&#x20;       "season\_group",

&#x20;       "value"

&#x20;   ),



&#x20;   State(

&#x20;       "meal",

&#x20;       "value"

&#x20;   ),



&#x20;   State(

&#x20;       "market\_segment",

&#x20;       "value"

&#x20;   ),



&#x20;   State(

&#x20;       "distribution\_channel",

&#x20;       "value"

&#x20;   ),



&#x20;   State(

&#x20;       "reservation\_status",

&#x20;       "value"

&#x20;   ),



&#x20;   State(

&#x20;       "is\_canceled",

&#x20;       "value"

&#x20;   )



)



def predict(



&#x20;   n,



&#x20;   model\_choice,



&#x20;   top\_bad\_client,



&#x20;   hotel,



&#x20;   country\_group,



&#x20;   adr\_group,



&#x20;   previous\_cancellations\_group,



&#x20;   days\_in\_waiting\_list\_group,



&#x20;   deposit\_type,



&#x20;   customer\_type,



&#x20;   guest\_group,



&#x20;   season\_group,



&#x20;   meal,



&#x20;   market\_segment,



&#x20;   distribution\_channel,



&#x20;   reservation\_status,



&#x20;   is\_canceled



):



&#x20;   # =================================================

&#x20;   # NO CLICK

&#x20;   # =================================================



&#x20;   if not n:

&#x20;       return ""



&#x20;   try:



&#x20;       # =================================================

&#x20;       # SELECT FINAL-RATING MODEL

&#x20;       #

&#x20;       # IMPORTANT:

&#x20;       #

&#x20;       # model\_choice controls ONLY the final-rating

&#x20;       # model.

&#x20;       #

&#x20;       # Reservation status prediction remains inside

&#x20;       # model.py.

&#x20;       # =================================================



&#x20;       if model\_choice:



&#x20;           ml.set\_model(

&#x20;               model\_choice

&#x20;           )



&#x20;       # =================================================

&#x20;       # CLIENT BAD RATE

&#x20;       # =================================================



&#x20;       client\_bad\_rate = (



&#x20;           calculate\_client\_bad\_rate(



&#x20;               df,



&#x20;               top\_bad\_client



&#x20;           )



&#x20;       )



&#x20;       # =================================================

&#x20;       # CLIENT SEGMENT

&#x20;       # =================================================



&#x20;       client\_segment = (



&#x20;           calculate\_client\_segment(



&#x20;               client\_bad\_rate



&#x20;           )



&#x20;       )



&#x20;       # =================================================

&#x20;       # TOP BAD CLIENT

&#x20;       # =================================================



&#x20;       TOP\_CLIENTS = df.attrs.get(

&#x20;           "top\_10\_bad\_clients",

&#x20;           \[]

&#x20;       )



&#x20;       top\_client\_strings = {



&#x20;           str(v)

&#x20;           .strip()

&#x20;           .lower()



&#x20;           for v in TOP\_CLIENTS



&#x20;           if v is not None



&#x20;       }



&#x20;       selected\_client\_key = (



&#x20;           str(

&#x20;               top\_bad\_client

&#x20;           )

&#x20;           .strip()

&#x20;           .lower()



&#x20;           if top\_bad\_client is not None



&#x20;           else ""



&#x20;       )



&#x20;       if selected\_client\_key in top\_client\_strings:



&#x20;           is\_top\_bad\_client = 1.0



&#x20;       else:



&#x20;           is\_top\_bad\_client = 0.0



&#x20;       # =================================================

&#x20;       # NORMALISE UI is\_canceled

&#x20;       #

&#x20;       # IMPORTANT:

&#x20;       #

&#x20;       # The UI value is converted to numeric 0/1 BEFORE

&#x20;       # being passed to model.py.

&#x20;       #

&#x20;       # model.py decides how this feature is used.

&#x20;       # =================================================



&#x20;       is\_canceled\_numeric = safe\_numeric(

&#x20;           is\_canceled,

&#x20;           0.0

&#x20;       )



&#x20;       # Explicitly force binary value.



&#x20;       if is\_canceled\_numeric >= 0.5:



&#x20;           is\_canceled\_numeric = 1.0



&#x20;       else:



&#x20;           is\_canceled\_numeric = 0.0



&#x20;       # =================================================

&#x20;       # BUILD MODEL INPUT

&#x20;       # =================================================



&#x20;       x = {



&#x20;           # -----------------------------------------

&#x20;           # COMMENT

&#x20;           # -----------------------------------------



&#x20;           "comment":

&#x20;               "",



&#x20;           # -----------------------------------------

&#x20;           # CLIENT

&#x20;           # -----------------------------------------



&#x20;           "client\_email":

&#x20;               safe(

&#x20;                   top\_bad\_client

&#x20;               ),



&#x20;           "client\_segment":

&#x20;               client\_segment,



&#x20;           "is\_top\_bad\_client":

&#x20;               is\_top\_bad\_client,



&#x20;           "client\_bad\_rate":

&#x20;               client\_bad\_rate,



&#x20;           # -----------------------------------------

&#x20;           # HOTEL

&#x20;           # -----------------------------------------



&#x20;           "hotel":

&#x20;               safe(

&#x20;                   hotel

&#x20;               ),



&#x20;           # -----------------------------------------

&#x20;           # COUNTRY

&#x20;           # -----------------------------------------



&#x20;           "country\_group":

&#x20;               safe(

&#x20;                   country\_group

&#x20;               ),



&#x20;           # -----------------------------------------

&#x20;           # ADR

&#x20;           # -----------------------------------------



&#x20;           "adr\_group":

&#x20;               safe(

&#x20;                   adr\_group

&#x20;               ),



&#x20;           # -----------------------------------------

&#x20;           # PREVIOUS CANCELLATIONS

&#x20;           # -----------------------------------------



&#x20;           "previous\_cancellations\_group":

&#x20;               safe(

&#x20;                   previous\_cancellations\_group

&#x20;               ),



&#x20;           # -----------------------------------------

&#x20;           # WAITING LIST

&#x20;           # -----------------------------------------



&#x20;           "days\_in\_waiting\_list\_group":

&#x20;               safe(

&#x20;                   days\_in\_waiting\_list\_group

&#x20;               ),



&#x20;           # -----------------------------------------

&#x20;           # DEPOSIT

&#x20;           # -----------------------------------------



&#x20;           "deposit\_type":

&#x20;               safe(

&#x20;                   deposit\_type

&#x20;               ),



&#x20;           # -----------------------------------------

&#x20;           # CUSTOMER TYPE

&#x20;           # -----------------------------------------



&#x20;           "customer\_type":

&#x20;               safe(

&#x20;                   customer\_type

&#x20;               ),



&#x20;           # -----------------------------------------

&#x20;           # GUEST GROUP

&#x20;           # -----------------------------------------



&#x20;           "guest\_group":

&#x20;               safe(

&#x20;                   guest\_group

&#x20;               ),



&#x20;           # -----------------------------------------

&#x20;           # SEASON

&#x20;           # -----------------------------------------



&#x20;           "season\_group":

&#x20;               safe(

&#x20;                   season\_group

&#x20;               ),



&#x20;           # -----------------------------------------

&#x20;           # MEAL

&#x20;           # -----------------------------------------



&#x20;           "meal":

&#x20;               safe(

&#x20;                   meal

&#x20;               ),



&#x20;           # -----------------------------------------

&#x20;           # MARKET SEGMENT

&#x20;           # -----------------------------------------



&#x20;           "market\_segment":

&#x20;               safe(

&#x20;                   market\_segment

&#x20;               ),



&#x20;           # -----------------------------------------

&#x20;           # DISTRIBUTION CHANNEL

&#x20;           # -----------------------------------------



&#x20;           "distribution\_channel":

&#x20;               safe(

&#x20;                   distribution\_channel

&#x20;               ),



&#x20;           # -----------------------------------------

&#x20;           # RESERVATION STATUS

&#x20;           #

&#x20;           # Used by final-rating model.

&#x20;           #

&#x20;           # model.py determines how the reservation

&#x20;           # status model uses this information.

&#x20;           # -----------------------------------------



&#x20;           "reservation\_status":

&#x20;               safe(

&#x20;                   reservation\_status

&#x20;               ),



&#x20;           # -----------------------------------------

&#x20;           # IS CANCELED

&#x20;           #

&#x20;           # Numeric 0 / 1.

&#x20;           # -----------------------------------------



&#x20;           "is\_canceled":

&#x20;               is\_canceled\_numeric



&#x20;       }



&#x20;       # =================================================

&#x20;       # FORCE NUMERIC FEATURES

&#x20;       # =================================================



&#x20;       x\["is\_top\_bad\_client"] = (



&#x20;           safe\_numeric(



&#x20;               x\[

&#x20;                   "is\_top\_bad\_client"

&#x20;               ],



&#x20;               0.0



&#x20;           )



&#x20;       )



&#x20;       x\["client\_bad\_rate"] = (



&#x20;           safe\_numeric(



&#x20;               x\[

&#x20;                   "client\_bad\_rate"

&#x20;               ],



&#x20;               0.0



&#x20;           )



&#x20;       )



&#x20;       # =================================================

&#x20;       # DEBUG INPUT

&#x20;       # =================================================



&#x20;       print()

&#x20;       print(

&#x20;           "=============================="

&#x20;       )

&#x20;       print(

&#x20;           "PREDICTION INPUT"

&#x20;       )

&#x20;       print(

&#x20;           "=============================="

&#x20;       )



&#x20;       for key, value in x.items():



&#x20;           print(



&#x20;               f"{key}: {value!r} "

&#x20;               f"(type={type(value).\_\_name\_\_})"



&#x20;           )



&#x20;       # =================================================

&#x20;       # MODEL PREDICTION

&#x20;       #

&#x20;       # model.py MUST return exactly 7 values:

&#x20;       #

&#x20;       # 1. final rating

&#x20;       # 2. cancellation probability

&#x20;       # 3. check-out probability

&#x20;       # 4. no-show probability

&#x20;       # 5. SLA risk

&#x20;       # 6. customer risk

&#x20;       # 7. generated comment

&#x20;       # =================================================



&#x20;       (



&#x20;           pred,



&#x20;           prob\_canceled,



&#x20;           prob\_check\_out,



&#x20;           prob\_no\_show,



&#x20;           sla\_risk,



&#x20;           risk,



&#x20;           comment



&#x20;       ) = ml.predict(

&#x20;           x

&#x20;       )



&#x20;       # =================================================

&#x20;       # VALIDATE FINAL RATING

&#x20;       # =================================================



&#x20;       pred = int(

&#x20;           pred

&#x20;       )



&#x20;       if pred not in \[

&#x20;           0,

&#x20;           1,

&#x20;           2,

&#x20;           3,

&#x20;           4,

&#x20;           5,

&#x20;           6

&#x20;       ]:



&#x20;           raise ValueError(



&#x20;               f"Invalid rating returned by model: "

&#x20;               f"{pred}. Expected 0-6."



&#x20;           )



&#x20;       rating\_label = (



&#x20;           RATING\_LABELS.get(



&#x20;               pred,



&#x20;               "Unknown"



&#x20;           )



&#x20;       )



&#x20;       # =================================================

&#x20;       # MODEL RISK VALUES

&#x20;       #

&#x20;       # DO NOT RECALCULATE HERE.

&#x20;       # =================================================



&#x20;       risk = float(

&#x20;           risk

&#x20;       )



&#x20;       sla\_risk = float(

&#x20;           sla\_risk

&#x20;       )



&#x20;       prob\_canceled = float(

&#x20;           prob\_canceled

&#x20;       )



&#x20;       prob\_check\_out = float(

&#x20;           prob\_check\_out

&#x20;       )



&#x20;       prob\_no\_show = float(

&#x20;           prob\_no\_show

&#x20;       )



&#x20;       # =================================================

&#x20;       # CLAMP PROBABILITIES

&#x20;       #

&#x20;       # Keeps UI values between 0 and 100.

&#x20;       # =================================================



&#x20;       prob\_canceled = float(

&#x20;           np.clip(

&#x20;               prob\_canceled,

&#x20;               0.0,

&#x20;               100.0

&#x20;           )

&#x20;       )



&#x20;       prob\_check\_out = float(

&#x20;           np.clip(

&#x20;               prob\_check\_out,

&#x20;               0.0,

&#x20;               100.0

&#x20;           )

&#x20;       )



&#x20;       prob\_no\_show = float(

&#x20;           np.clip(

&#x20;               prob\_no\_show,

&#x20;               0.0,

&#x20;               100.0

&#x20;           )

&#x20;       )



&#x20;       sla\_risk = float(

&#x20;           np.clip(

&#x20;               sla\_risk,

&#x20;               0.0,

&#x20;               100.0

&#x20;           )

&#x20;       )



&#x20;       # =================================================

&#x20;       # DEBUG RESULT

&#x20;       # =================================================



&#x20;       print()

&#x20;       print(

&#x20;           "=============================="

&#x20;       )

&#x20;       print(

&#x20;           "PREDICTION RESULT"

&#x20;       )

&#x20;       print(

&#x20;           "=============================="

&#x20;       )



&#x20;       print(

&#x20;           f"Customer Rating       : "

&#x20;           f"{pred} / 6"

&#x20;       )



&#x20;       print(

&#x20;           f"Rating Level          : "

&#x20;           f"{rating\_label}"

&#x20;       )



&#x20;       print(

&#x20;           f"Customer Risk Score   : "

&#x20;           f"{risk:.1f}"

&#x20;       )



&#x20;       print(

&#x20;           f"Client Bad Rate       : "

&#x20;           f"{client\_bad\_rate \* 100:.1f}%"

&#x20;       )



&#x20;       print(

&#x20;           f"Is Canceled           : "

&#x20;           f"{is\_canceled\_numeric:.0f}"

&#x20;       )



&#x20;       print(

&#x20;           f"Cancellation         : "

&#x20;           f"{prob\_canceled:.1f}%"

&#x20;       )



&#x20;       print(

&#x20;           f"Check Out             : "

&#x20;           f"{prob\_check\_out:.1f}%"

&#x20;       )



&#x20;       print(

&#x20;           f"No Show               : "

&#x20;           f"{prob\_no\_show:.1f}%"

&#x20;       )



&#x20;       print(

&#x20;           f"Service Level Risk    : "

&#x20;           f"{sla\_risk:.1f}%"

&#x20;       )



&#x20;       # =================================================

&#x20;       # OUTPUT

&#x20;       # =================================================



&#x20;       return html.Div(\[



&#x20;           html.H4(

&#x20;               f"Customer Rating: "

&#x20;               f"{pred} / 6"

&#x20;           ),



&#x20;           html.H4(

&#x20;               f"Rating Level: "

&#x20;               f"{rating\_label}"

&#x20;           ),



&#x20;           html.H4(

&#x20;               f"Customer Risk Score: "

&#x20;               f"{risk:.1f}"

&#x20;           ),



&#x20;           html.H4(

&#x20;               f"Client Bad Rate: "

&#x20;               f"{client\_bad\_rate \* 100:.1f}%"

&#x20;           ),



&#x20;           html.H4(

&#x20;               f"Cancellation Probability: "

&#x20;               f"{prob\_canceled:.1f}%"

&#x20;           ),



&#x20;           html.H4(

&#x20;               f"Check Out Probability: "

&#x20;               f"{prob\_check\_out:.1f}%"

&#x20;           ),



&#x20;           html.H4(

&#x20;               f"No Show Probability: "

&#x20;               f"{prob\_no\_show:.1f}%"

&#x20;           ),



&#x20;           html.H4(

&#x20;               f"Service Level Risk: "

&#x20;               f"{sla\_risk:.1f}%"

&#x20;           ),



&#x20;           html.P(

&#x20;               comment

&#x20;           )



&#x20;       ])



&#x20;   # =====================================================

&#x20;   # PREDICTION ERROR

&#x20;   # =====================================================



&#x20;   except Exception as e:



&#x20;       import traceback



&#x20;       print()

&#x20;       print(

&#x20;           "=============================="

&#x20;       )

&#x20;       print(

&#x20;           "PREDICTION ERROR"

&#x20;       )

&#x20;       print(

&#x20;           "=============================="

&#x20;       )



&#x20;       traceback.print\_exc()



&#x20;       return html.Div(\[



&#x20;           html.H4(



&#x20;               "Prediction Error",



&#x20;               style={

&#x20;                   "color": "red"

&#x20;               }



&#x20;           ),



&#x20;           html.P(



&#x20;               str(e),



&#x20;               style={

&#x20;                   "color": "red"

&#x20;               }



&#x20;           )



&#x20;       ])

def safe(v):



if v is None:

&#x20;   return "unknown"



if isinstance(v, str):



&#x20;   value = v.strip()



&#x20;   if value == "":

&#x20;       return "unknown"



&#x20;   if value.lower() in \[

&#x20;       "nan",

&#x20;       "none",

&#x20;       "null",

&#x20;       "missing"

&#x20;   ]:

&#x20;       return "unknown"



&#x20;   return value



return v

def safe\_numeric(v, default=0.0):

&#x20;   return default



if isinstance(v, str):



&#x20;   value = v.strip().lower()



&#x20;   if value in \[

&#x20;       "none",

&#x20;       "null",

&#x20;       "missing",

&#x20;       "unknown"

&#x20;   ]:

&#x20;       return default



try:



&#x20;   number = float(v)



&#x20;   if np.isnan(number):

&#x20;       return default



&#x20;   return number



except Exception:



&#x20;   return default

&#x20;                   )

&#x20;               )



roc = roc\_auc\_score(

&#x20;               y\_val,

&#x20;               probs,

&#x20;               multi\_class="ovr",

&#x20;               average="weighted"

&#x20;           )



&#x20;       except Exception as e:



&#x20;           print(

&#x20;               f"\[WARNING] ROC-AUC failed "

&#x20;               f"for {name}: {e}"

&#x20;           )



&#x20;           roc = 0.0



validation\_results.append({



&#x20;           "model": name,



&#x20;           "f1": f1,



&#x20;           "roc": roc



&#x20;       })



validation\_df = pd.DataFrame(

&#x20;       validation\_results

&#x20;   )



validation\_df\["final\_score"] = (



&#x20;       0.6 \*

&#x20;       validation\_df\["f1"]



&#x20;       +



&#x20;       0.4 \*

&#x20;       validation\_df\["roc"]



&#x20;   )



validation\_df = validation\_df.sort\_values(

&#x20;       "final\_score",

&#x20;       ascending=False

&#x20;   )



print(

&#x20;       validation\_df\[

&#x20;           \[

&#x20;               "model",

&#x20;               "f1",

&#x20;               "roc",

&#x20;               "final\_score"

&#x20;           ]

&#x20;       ].to\_string(

&#x20;           index=False

&#x20;       )

&#x20;   )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;   # BEST RATING MODEL

&#x20;   # =====================================================



&#x20;   self.best\_model\_name = (

&#x20;       validation\_df.iloc\[0]\["model"]

&#x20;   )



self.best\_model = (

&#x20;       self.models\[

&#x20;           self.best\_model\_name

&#x20;       ]

&#x20;   )



print(

&#x20;       "\\nBEST RATING MODEL SELECTED:",

&#x20;       self.best\_model\_name

&#x20;   )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;   # REFERENCE DATA

&#x20;   # =====================================================



&#x20;   self.df\_reference = pd.concat(

&#x20;       \[

&#x20;           train\_df,

&#x20;           val\_df,

&#x20;           test\_df

&#x20;       ],

&#x20;       axis=0

&#x20;   )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;   # COMMENT DATA

&#x20;   # =====================================================



&#x20;   reference\_df = self.df\_reference.copy()



self.comment\_df = reference\_df\[\[



&#x20;       "comment",

&#x20;       "hotel",

&#x20;       "meal",

&#x20;       "market\_segment",

&#x20;       "distribution\_channel",

&#x20;       "deposit\_type",

&#x20;       "customer\_type",

&#x20;       "season\_group",

&#x20;       "country\_group",

&#x20;       "adr\_group",

&#x20;       "previous\_cancellations\_group",

&#x20;       "days\_in\_waiting\_list\_group",

&#x20;       "guest\_group",

&#x20;       "final\_rating"



&#x20;   ]].copy()



\# =====================================================

&#x20;   # COMMENT INDEX

&#x20;   # =====================================================



&#x20;   self.comment\_index = {}



fields = \[



&#x20;       "hotel",

&#x20;       "meal",

&#x20;       "market\_segment",

&#x20;       "distribution\_channel",

&#x20;       "deposit\_type",

&#x20;       "customer\_type",

&#x20;       "season\_group",

&#x20;       "country\_group",

&#x20;       "adr\_group",

&#x20;       "previous\_cancellations\_group",

&#x20;       "days\_in\_waiting\_list\_group",

&#x20;       "guest\_group"



&#x20;   ]



for rating, df\_r in reference\_df.groupby(

&#x20;       "final\_rating"

&#x20;   ):



&#x20;       rating\_key = str(

&#x20;           rating

&#x20;       )



self.comment\_index\[

&#x20;           rating\_key

&#x20;       ] = {



&#x20;           "ALL":

&#x20;               df\_r\[

&#x20;                   "comment"

&#x20;               ].tolist(),



&#x20;           "FIELDS":

&#x20;               {}



&#x20;       }



for field in fields:



&#x20;           if field not in df\_r.columns:

&#x20;               continue



self.comment\_index\[

&#x20;               rating\_key

&#x20;           ]\[

&#x20;               "FIELDS"

&#x20;           ]\[field] = (



&#x20;               df\_r

&#x20;               .groupby(field)\["comment"]

&#x20;               .apply(list)

&#x20;               .to\_dict()



&#x20;           )



print(

&#x20;       "FAST COMMENT INDEX READY"

&#x20;   )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;   # SAVE

&#x20;   # =====================================================



&#x20;   self.\_save\_artifacts(

&#x20;       reference\_df

&#x20;   )



return reference\_df



\# =========================================================

\# SAVE ARTIFACTS

\# =========================================================



def \_save\_artifacts(

&#x20;   self,

&#x20;   df

):



&#x20;   trained\_dir = self.config.get(

&#x20;       "trained\_dir",

&#x20;       "trained"

&#x20;   )



os.makedirs(

&#x20;       trained\_dir,

&#x20;       exist\_ok=True

&#x20;   )



train\_path = self.config.get(

&#x20;       "train\_data",

&#x20;       os.path.join(

&#x20;           trained\_dir,

&#x20;           "train.parquet"

&#x20;       )

&#x20;   )



df.to\_parquet(

&#x20;       train\_path,

&#x20;       index=False

&#x20;   )



print(

&#x20;       f"\[INFO] Training data saved: "

&#x20;       f"{train\_path}"

&#x20;   )



model\_path = self.config.get(

&#x20;       "service\_model",

&#x20;       os.path.join(

&#x20;           trained\_dir,

&#x20;           "service\_model.pkl"

&#x20;       )

&#x20;   )



joblib.dump(

&#x20;       self,

&#x20;       model\_path

&#x20;   )



print(

&#x20;       f"\[INFO] Service model saved: "

&#x20;       f"{model\_path}"

&#x20;   )



metadata\_path = self.config.get(

&#x20;       "training\_metadata",

&#x20;       os.path.join(

&#x20;           trained\_dir,

&#x20;           "training\_metadata.json"

&#x20;       )

&#x20;   )



import json



metadata = {}



if os.path.exists(

&#x20;       metadata\_path

&#x20;   ):



&#x20;       with open(

&#x20;           metadata\_path,

&#x20;           "r"

&#x20;       ) as f:



&#x20;           metadata = json.load(

&#x20;               f

&#x20;           )



metadata.update({



&#x20;       "model":

&#x20;           self.best\_model\_name,



&#x20;       "trained\_time":

&#x20;           datetime.now().isoformat(),



&#x20;       "rows":

&#x20;           len(df),



&#x20;       "columns":

&#x20;           list(df.columns)



&#x20;   })



with open(

&#x20;       metadata\_path,

&#x20;       "w"

&#x20;   ) as f:



&#x20;       json.dump(

&#x20;           metadata,

&#x20;           f,

&#x20;           indent=4

&#x20;       )



print(

&#x20;       f"\[INFO] Metadata updated: "

&#x20;       f"{metadata\_path}"

&#x20;   )



\# =========================================================

\# SWITCH MODEL

\# =========================================================



def set\_model(

&#x20;   self,

&#x20;   name: str

):



&#x20;   if name in self.models:



&#x20;       self.best\_model\_name = name



&#x20;       self.best\_model = (

&#x20;           self.models\[name]

&#x20;       )



\# =========================================================

\# NORMALISE INPUT

\# =========================================================



def \_prepare\_input(

&#x20;   self,

&#x20;   x

):



&#x20;   input\_df = pd.DataFrame(

&#x20;       \[x]

&#x20;   )



\# ---------------------------------------------

&#x20;   # Text

&#x20;   # ---------------------------------------------



&#x20;   if "comment" not in input\_df.columns:



&#x20;       input\_df\["comment"] = ""



input\_df\["comment"] = (

&#x20;       input\_df\["comment"]

&#x20;       .fillna("")

&#x20;       .astype(str)

&#x20;   )



\# ---------------------------------------------

&#x20;   # Categorical

&#x20;   # ---------------------------------------------



&#x20;   categorical\_features = \[



&#x20;       "hotel",

&#x20;       "meal",

&#x20;       "market\_segment",

&#x20;       "distribution\_channel",

&#x20;       "deposit\_type",

&#x20;       "customer\_type",

&#x20;       "season\_group",

&#x20;       "country\_group",

&#x20;       "adr\_group",

&#x20;       "previous\_cancellations\_group",

&#x20;       "days\_in\_waiting\_list\_group",

&#x20;       "guest\_group",

&#x20;       "client\_segment"



&#x20;   ]



for col in categorical\_features:



&#x20;       if col not in input\_df.columns:



&#x20;           input\_df\[col] = "unknown"



&#x20;       input\_df\[col] = (

&#x20;           input\_df\[col]

&#x20;           .fillna("unknown")

&#x20;           .astype(str)

&#x20;       )



\# ---------------------------------------------

&#x20;   # Numeric

&#x20;   # ---------------------------------------------



&#x20;   if "is\_top\_bad\_client" not in input\_df.columns:



&#x20;       input\_df\["is\_top\_bad\_client"] = 0



if "is\_canceled" not in input\_df.columns:



&#x20;       input\_df\["is\_canceled"] = 0



if "client\_bad\_rate" not in input\_df.columns:



&#x20;       input\_df\["client\_bad\_rate"] = np.nan



input\_df\["is\_top\_bad\_client"] = (

&#x20;       pd.to\_numeric(

&#x20;           input\_df\["is\_top\_bad\_client"],

&#x20;           errors="coerce"

&#x20;       )

&#x20;       .fillna(0)

&#x20;       .clip(0, 1)

&#x20;   )



input\_df\["is\_canceled"] = (

&#x20;       pd.to\_numeric(

&#x20;           input\_df\["is\_canceled"],

&#x20;           errors="coerce"

&#x20;       )

&#x20;       .fillna(0)

&#x20;       .clip(0, 1)

&#x20;   )



\# ---------------------------------------------

&#x20;   # Client bad rate

&#x20;   # ---------------------------------------------



&#x20;   client\_bad\_rate = pd.to\_numeric(

&#x20;       input\_df\["client\_bad\_rate"],

&#x20;       errors="coerce"

&#x20;   )



if client\_bad\_rate.isna().all():



&#x20;       if self.df\_reference is not None and \\

&#x20;          "client\_bad\_rate" in self.df\_reference.columns:



&#x20;           fallback = pd.to\_numeric(

&#x20;               self.df\_reference\[

&#x20;                   "client\_bad\_rate"

&#x20;               ],

&#x20;               errors="coerce"

&#x20;           ).median()



&#x20;           if pd.isna(fallback):



&#x20;               fallback = 0.0



&#x20;       else:



&#x20;           fallback = 0.0



&#x20;       client\_bad\_rate = client\_bad\_rate.fillna(

&#x20;           fallback

&#x20;       )



&#x20;   else:



&#x20;       fallback = client\_bad\_rate.median()



&#x20;       if pd.isna(fallback):



&#x20;           fallback = 0.0



&#x20;       client\_bad\_rate = client\_bad\_rate.fillna(

&#x20;           fallback

&#x20;       )



input\_df\["client\_bad\_rate"] = (

&#x20;       client\_bad\_rate

&#x20;   )



return input\_df



\# =========================================================

\# PREDICT

\# =========================================================



def predict(

&#x20;   self,

&#x20;   x: dict

):



&#x20;   # =====================================================

&#x20;   # PREPARE UI INPUT

&#x20;   # =====================================================



&#x20;   input\_df = self.\_prepare\_input(

&#x20;       x

&#x20;   )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;   # COMMENT TOPIC FEATURES

&#x20;   # =====================================================



&#x20;   if (

&#x20;       self.comment\_tfidf is None

&#x20;       or self.comment\_svd is None

&#x20;   ):



&#x20;       raise RuntimeError(

&#x20;           "Comment TF-IDF/SVD models are not available. "

&#x20;           "Please retrain the ServiceModel."

&#x20;       )



comment\_tfidf = (

&#x20;       self.comment\_tfidf.transform(

&#x20;           input\_df\["comment"]

&#x20;       )

&#x20;   )



comment\_features\_array = (

&#x20;       self.comment\_svd.transform(

&#x20;           comment\_tfidf

&#x20;       )

&#x20;   )



comment\_columns = \[



&#x20;       f"comment\_topic\_{i}"



&#x20;       for i in range(

&#x20;           comment\_features\_array.shape\[1]

&#x20;       )



&#x20;   ]



comment\_features = pd.DataFrame(



&#x20;       comment\_features\_array,



&#x20;       columns=comment\_columns,



&#x20;       index=input\_df.index



&#x20;   )



input\_df = pd.concat(

&#x20;       \[

&#x20;           input\_df,

&#x20;           comment\_features

&#x20;       ],

&#x20;       axis=1

&#x20;   )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;   # =====================================================

&#x20;   # PART 1

&#x20;   # FINAL RATING PREDICTION

&#x20;   # =====================================================

&#x20;   # =====================================================



&#x20;   rating\_features\_with\_comments = (



&#x20;       self.rating\_features +



&#x20;       comment\_columns



&#x20;   )



X\_rating = input\_df\[

&#x20;       \["comment"] +

&#x20;       rating\_features\_with\_comments

&#x20;   ]



pred\_rating = int(

&#x20;       self.best\_model.predict(

&#x20;           X\_rating

&#x20;       )\[0]

&#x20;   )



\# Make absolutely sure rating stays 0-6.



&#x20;   pred\_rating = int(

&#x20;       np.clip(

&#x20;           pred\_rating,

&#x20;           0,

&#x20;           6

&#x20;       )

&#x20;   )



clf = (

&#x20;       self.best\_model

&#x20;       .named\_steps\["clf"]

&#x20;   )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;   # RATING PROBABILITIES

&#x20;   # =====================================================



&#x20;   if hasattr(

&#x20;       clf,

&#x20;       "predict\_proba"

&#x20;   ):



&#x20;       rating\_probs = (

&#x20;           self.best\_model

&#x20;           .predict\_proba(

&#x20;               X\_rating

&#x20;           )\[0]

&#x20;       )



&#x20;   else:



&#x20;       scores = (

&#x20;           self.best\_model

&#x20;           .decision\_function(

&#x20;               X\_rating

&#x20;           )

&#x20;       )



scores = np.asarray(

&#x20;           scores

&#x20;       )



if scores.ndim == 2:



&#x20;           scores = scores\[0]



exp = np.exp(

&#x20;           scores -

&#x20;           np.max(scores)

&#x20;       )



rating\_probs = (

&#x20;           exp /

&#x20;           np.sum(exp)

&#x20;       )



rating\_class\_order = list(

&#x20;       clf.classes\_

&#x20;   )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;   # SLA RISK

&#x20;   #

&#x20;   # 0 = highest risk

&#x20;   # 6 = lowest risk

&#x20;   # =====================================================



&#x20;   risk\_weights = {



&#x20;       0: 1.00,

&#x20;       1: 0.90,

&#x20;       2: 0.75,

&#x20;       3: 0.60,

&#x20;       4: 0.40,

&#x20;       5: 0.20,

&#x20;       6: 0.00



&#x20;   }



sla\_risk = 0.0



for i, cls in enumerate(

&#x20;       rating\_class\_order

&#x20;   ):



&#x20;       if i >= len(

&#x20;           rating\_probs

&#x20;       ):



&#x20;           continue



try:



&#x20;           rating\_class = int(

&#x20;               cls

&#x20;           )



&#x20;       except Exception:



&#x20;           continue



sla\_risk += (



&#x20;           rating\_probs\[i] \*



&#x20;           risk\_weights.get(

&#x20;               rating\_class,

&#x20;               0.50

&#x20;           )



&#x20;       )



sla\_risk\_score = round(

&#x20;       sla\_risk \* 100,

&#x20;       1

&#x20;   )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;   # CUSTOMER RISK SCORE

&#x20;   # =====================================================



&#x20;   rating\_risk\_map = {



&#x20;       0: 100,

&#x20;       1: 90,

&#x20;       2: 75,

&#x20;       3: 60,

&#x20;       4: 40,

&#x20;       5: 20,

&#x20;       6: 10



&#x20;   }



base\_risk = rating\_risk\_map.get(

&#x20;       pred\_rating,

&#x20;       50

&#x20;   )



risk\_score = round(



&#x20;       (

&#x20;           0.6 \*

&#x20;           base\_risk

&#x20;       )



&#x20;       +



&#x20;       (

&#x20;           0.4 \*

&#x20;           sla\_risk\_score

&#x20;       ),



&#x20;       1



&#x20;   )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;   # =====================================================

&#x20;   # PART 2

&#x20;   # RESERVATION STATUS PREDICTION

&#x20;   # =====================================================

&#x20;   # =====================================================



&#x20;   status\_input = input\_df\[



&#x20;       \[

&#x20;           "comment",

&#x20;           "hotel",

&#x20;           "meal",

&#x20;           "market\_segment",

&#x20;           "distribution\_channel",

&#x20;           "deposit\_type",

&#x20;           "customer\_type",

&#x20;           "season\_group",

&#x20;           "country\_group",

&#x20;           "adr\_group",

&#x20;           "previous\_cancellations\_group",

&#x20;           "days\_in\_waiting\_list\_group",

&#x20;           "guest\_group",

&#x20;           "client\_segment",

&#x20;           "is\_top\_bad\_client",

&#x20;           "client\_bad\_rate",

&#x20;           "is\_canceled"



&#x20;       ]



&#x20;   ]



\# =====================================================

&#x20;   # TRANSFORM USING STATUS MODEL PREPROCESSOR

&#x20;   # =====================================================



&#x20;   X\_status = (

&#x20;       self.status\_preprocess.transform(

&#x20;           status\_input

&#x20;       )

&#x20;   )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;   # STATUS PROBABILITIES

&#x20;   # =====================================================



&#x20;   status\_probs = (

&#x20;       self.status\_model

&#x20;       .predict\_proba(

&#x20;           X\_status

&#x20;       )\[0]

&#x20;   )



status\_classes = (

&#x20;       self.status\_model.classes\_

&#x20;   )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;   # INITIALISE

&#x20;   # =====================================================



&#x20;   prob\_canceled = 0.0

&#x20;   prob\_check\_out = 0.0

&#x20;   prob\_no\_show = 0.0



\# =====================================================

&#x20;   # MAP BY ACTUAL TRAINED CLASS

&#x20;   #

&#x20;   # This is important.

&#x20;   #

&#x20;   # Do NOT assume:

&#x20;   #

&#x20;   # \[Canceled, Check-Out, No-Show]

&#x20;   #

&#x20;   # Instead use classes\_ returned by the trained model.

&#x20;   # =====================================================



&#x20;   for probability, cls in zip(

&#x20;       status\_probs,

&#x20;       status\_classes

&#x20;   ):



&#x20;       normalized\_cls = (

&#x20;           str(cls)

&#x20;           .strip()

&#x20;           .lower()

&#x20;           .replace("\_", "-")

&#x20;           .replace(" ", "-")

&#x20;       )



percentage = (

&#x20;           float(probability) \*

&#x20;           100.0

&#x20;       )



if normalized\_cls in \[

&#x20;           "canceled",

&#x20;           "cancelled"

&#x20;       ]:



&#x20;           prob\_canceled = percentage



elif normalized\_cls in \[

&#x20;           "check-out",

&#x20;           "check-out",

&#x20;           "checkout"

&#x20;       ]:



&#x20;           prob\_check\_out = percentage



elif normalized\_cls in \[

&#x20;           "no-show",

&#x20;           "noshow"

&#x20;       ]:



&#x20;           prob\_no\_show = percentage



\# =====================================================

&#x20;   # IMPORTANT STATUS SIGNAL

&#x20;   #

&#x20;   # is\_canceled = 1 is a strong operational signal.

&#x20;   #

&#x20;   # We do NOT simply force cancellation to 100%.

&#x20;   #

&#x20;   # Instead we make sure the probability reflects

&#x20;   # the cancellation signal when the model produces

&#x20;   # an extremely tiny cancellation probability.

&#x20;   # =====================================================



&#x20;   is\_canceled\_value = float(

&#x20;       input\_df\[

&#x20;           "is\_canceled"

&#x20;       ].iloc\[0]

&#x20;   )



if is\_canceled\_value >= 1:



&#x20;       # If training data contains canceled records

&#x20;       # with is\_canceled=1, the status model should

&#x20;       # normally produce a meaningful cancellation

&#x20;       # probability.

&#x20;       #

&#x20;       # This fallback prevents an abnormal near-zero

&#x20;       # prediction when the trained model has a very

&#x20;       # weak learned signal.



&#x20;       if prob\_canceled < 1.0:



&#x20;           prob\_canceled = 1.0



\# =====================================================

&#x20;   # NORMALISE STATUS PROBABILITIES

&#x20;   #

&#x20;   # Only normalise if the three known classes exist.

&#x20;   # =====================================================



&#x20;   status\_total = (



&#x20;       prob\_canceled +



&#x20;       prob\_check\_out +



&#x20;       prob\_no\_show



&#x20;   )



if status\_total > 0:



&#x20;       prob\_canceled = (

&#x20;           prob\_canceled /

&#x20;           status\_total \*

&#x20;           100

&#x20;       )



&#x20;       prob\_check\_out = (

&#x20;           prob\_check\_out /

&#x20;           status\_total \*

&#x20;           100

&#x20;       )



&#x20;       prob\_no\_show = (

&#x20;           prob\_no\_show /

&#x20;           status\_total \*

&#x20;           100

&#x20;       )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;   # ROUND AFTER NORMALISATION

&#x20;   # =====================================================



&#x20;   prob\_canceled = round(

&#x20;       prob\_canceled,

&#x20;       1

&#x20;   )



&#x20;   prob\_check\_out = round(

&#x20;       prob\_check\_out,

&#x20;       1

&#x20;   )



&#x20;   prob\_no\_show = round(

&#x20;       prob\_no\_show,

&#x20;       1

&#x20;   )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;   # COMMENT

&#x20;   # =====================================================



&#x20;   generated\_comment = (

&#x20;       self.\_generate\_comment(

&#x20;           pred\_rating,

&#x20;           sla\_risk\_score,

&#x20;           risk\_score,

&#x20;           x

&#x20;       )

&#x20;   )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;   # DEBUG INFORMATION

&#x20;   # =====================================================



&#x20;   print()

&#x20;   print("==============================")

&#x20;   print("FINAL PREDICTION")

&#x20;   print("==============================")



print(

&#x20;       "Predicted Rating:",

&#x20;       pred\_rating

&#x20;   )



print(

&#x20;       "Rating Risk:",

&#x20;       risk\_score

&#x20;   )



print(

&#x20;       "SLA Risk:",

&#x20;       sla\_risk\_score

&#x20;   )



print(

&#x20;       "Client Bad Rate:",

&#x20;       input\_df\[

&#x20;           "client\_bad\_rate"

&#x20;       ].iloc\[0]

&#x20;   )



print()

&#x20;   print("Reservation Status Probabilities:")



print(

&#x20;       "Cancellation:",

&#x20;       prob\_canceled,

&#x20;       "%"
