&#x20;                   .astype(int)



&#x20;               )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;       # COMMENT TOPIC LEARNING

&#x20;       # =====================================================



&#x20;       print()

&#x20;       print("==============================")

&#x20;       print("COMMENT TOPIC LEARNING")

&#x20;       print("==============================")



self.comment\_tfidf = TfidfVectorizer(



&#x20;           max\_features=5000,



&#x20;           ngram\_range=(1, 2),



&#x20;           min\_df=3



&#x20;       )



print(

&#x20;           "Fitting comment TF-IDF on training data..."

&#x20;       )



train\_comment\_tfidf = (

&#x20;           self.comment\_tfidf.fit\_transform(

&#x20;               train\_df\["comment"]

&#x20;           )

&#x20;       )



\# -----------------------------------------------------

&#x20;       # Protect against datasets with too few TF-IDF

&#x20;       # dimensions for 30 SVD components.

&#x20;       # -----------------------------------------------------



&#x20;       max\_svd\_components = min(



&#x20;           30,



&#x20;           max(

&#x20;               1,

&#x20;               train\_comment\_tfidf.shape\[1] - 1

&#x20;           )



&#x20;       )



self.comment\_svd = TruncatedSVD(



&#x20;           n\_components=max\_svd\_components,



&#x20;           random\_state=42



&#x20;       )



print(

&#x20;           "Fitting comment SVD on training data..."

&#x20;       )



train\_comment\_features\_array = (

&#x20;           self.comment\_svd.fit\_transform(

&#x20;               train\_comment\_tfidf

&#x20;           )

&#x20;       )



val\_comment\_tfidf = (

&#x20;           self.comment\_tfidf.transform(

&#x20;               val\_df\["comment"]

&#x20;           )

&#x20;       )



val\_comment\_features\_array = (

&#x20;           self.comment\_svd.transform(

&#x20;               val\_comment\_tfidf

&#x20;           )

&#x20;       )



test\_comment\_tfidf = (

&#x20;           self.comment\_tfidf.transform(

&#x20;               test\_df\["comment"]

&#x20;           )

&#x20;       )



test\_comment\_features\_array = (

&#x20;           self.comment\_svd.transform(

&#x20;               test\_comment\_tfidf

&#x20;           )

&#x20;       )



comment\_columns = \[



&#x20;           f"comment\_topic\_{i}"



&#x20;           for i in range(

&#x20;               train\_comment\_features\_array.shape\[1]

&#x20;           )



&#x20;       ]



train\_comment\_features = pd.DataFrame(



&#x20;           train\_comment\_features\_array,



&#x20;           columns=comment\_columns,



&#x20;           index=train\_df.index



&#x20;       )



val\_comment\_features = pd.DataFrame(



&#x20;           val\_comment\_features\_array,



&#x20;           columns=comment\_columns,



&#x20;           index=val\_df.index



&#x20;       )



test\_comment\_features = pd.DataFrame(



&#x20;           test\_comment\_features\_array,



&#x20;           columns=comment\_columns,



&#x20;           index=test\_df.index



&#x20;       )



train\_df = pd.concat(

&#x20;           \[

&#x20;               train\_df,

&#x20;               train\_comment\_features

&#x20;           ],

&#x20;           axis=1

&#x20;       )



val\_df = pd.concat(

&#x20;           \[

&#x20;               val\_df,

&#x20;               val\_comment\_features

&#x20;           ],

&#x20;           axis=1

&#x20;       )



test\_df = pd.concat(

&#x20;           \[

&#x20;               test\_df,

&#x20;               test\_comment\_features

&#x20;           ],

&#x20;           axis=1

&#x20;       )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;       # RATING FEATURES WITH COMMENTS + MISSING INDICATORS

&#x20;       # =====================================================



&#x20;       rating\_features\_with\_comments = (



&#x20;           rating\_features +



&#x20;           self.rating\_missing\_features +



&#x20;           comment\_columns



&#x20;       )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;       # FINAL RATING TARGET

&#x20;       # =====================================================



&#x20;       y\_train = (

&#x20;           pd.to\_numeric(

&#x20;               train\_df\["final\_rating"],

&#x20;               errors="coerce"

&#x20;           )

&#x20;           .fillna(0)

&#x20;           .astype(int)

&#x20;           .clip(0, 6)

&#x20;       )



y\_val = (

&#x20;           pd.to\_numeric(

&#x20;               val\_df\["final\_rating"],

&#x20;               errors="coerce"

&#x20;           )

&#x20;           .fillna(0)

&#x20;           .astype(int)

&#x20;           .clip(0, 6)

&#x20;       )



y\_test = (

&#x20;           pd.to\_numeric(

&#x20;               test\_df\["final\_rating"],

&#x20;               errors="coerce"

&#x20;           )

&#x20;           .fillna(0)

&#x20;           .astype(int)

&#x20;           .clip(0, 6)

&#x20;       )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;       # RESERVATION STATUS TARGET

&#x20;       # =====================================================



&#x20;       y\_status\_train = (

&#x20;           train\_df\["reservation\_status"]

&#x20;           .fillna(UNKNOWN\_VALUE)

&#x20;           .astype(str)

&#x20;           .str.strip()

&#x20;       )



y\_status\_val = (

&#x20;           val\_df\["reservation\_status"]

&#x20;           .fillna(UNKNOWN\_VALUE)

&#x20;           .astype(str)

&#x20;           .str.strip()

&#x20;       )



y\_status\_test = (

&#x20;           test\_df\["reservation\_status"]

&#x20;           .fillna(UNKNOWN\_VALUE)

&#x20;           .astype(str)

&#x20;           .str.strip()

&#x20;       )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;       # RATING INPUT

&#x20;       # =====================================================



&#x20;       X\_train = train\_df\[

&#x20;           \["comment"] +

&#x20;           rating\_features\_with\_comments

&#x20;       ]



X\_val = val\_df\[

&#x20;           \["comment"] +

&#x20;           rating\_features\_with\_comments

&#x20;       ]



X\_test = test\_df\[

&#x20;           \["comment"] +

&#x20;           rating\_features\_with\_comments

&#x20;       ]



\# =====================================================

&#x20;       # CLASS WEIGHTS

&#x20;       # =====================================================



&#x20;       classes = np.unique(

&#x20;           y\_train

&#x20;       )



class\_weights = compute\_class\_weight(



&#x20;           class\_weight="balanced",



&#x20;           classes=classes,



&#x20;           y=y\_train



&#x20;       )



class\_weight\_dict = dict(



&#x20;           zip(

&#x20;               classes,

&#x20;               class\_weights

&#x20;           )



&#x20;       )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;       # TEXT PIPELINE

&#x20;       # =====================================================



&#x20;       text\_pipeline = Pipeline(\[



&#x20;           (

&#x20;               "hash",



&#x20;               HashingVectorizer(



&#x20;                   n\_features=2\*\*16,



&#x20;                   alternate\_sign=False,



&#x20;                   ngram\_range=(1, 2)



&#x20;               )



&#x20;           ),



&#x20;           (

&#x20;               "tfidf",



&#x20;               TfidfTransformer()



&#x20;           )



&#x20;       ])



\# =====================================================

&#x20;       # RATING CATEGORICAL FEATURES

&#x20;       # =====================================================



&#x20;       rating\_categorical\_features = \[



&#x20;           c



&#x20;           for c in rating\_features\_with\_comments



&#x20;           if c not in (



&#x20;               NUMERIC\_FEATURES +



&#x20;               self.rating\_missing\_features +



&#x20;               comment\_columns



&#x20;           )



&#x20;       ]



\# =====================================================

&#x20;       # RATING NUMERIC FEATURES

&#x20;       # =====================================================



&#x20;       rating\_numeric\_features = \[



&#x20;           c



&#x20;           for c in rating\_features\_with\_comments



&#x20;           if c in (



&#x20;               NUMERIC\_FEATURES +



&#x20;               self.rating\_missing\_features



&#x20;           )



&#x20;       ]



\# =====================================================

&#x20;       # RATING PREPROCESSOR

&#x20;       # =====================================================



&#x20;       rating\_preprocess = ColumnTransformer(\[



&#x20;           (

&#x20;               "text",



&#x20;               text\_pipeline,



&#x20;               "comment"



&#x20;           ),



&#x20;           (

&#x20;               "cat",



&#x20;               OneHotEncoder(



&#x20;                   handle\_unknown="ignore",



&#x20;                   # Explicitly recognise unknown as a

&#x20;                   # valid category.

&#x20;                   min\_frequency=1



&#x20;               ),



&#x20;               rating\_categorical\_features



&#x20;           ),



&#x20;           (

&#x20;               "num",



&#x20;               "passthrough",



&#x20;               rating\_numeric\_features



&#x20;           )



&#x20;       ])



\# =====================================================

&#x20;       # FINAL RATING MODELS

&#x20;       # =====================================================



&#x20;       models = {



&#x20;           "Logistic Regression": Pipeline(\[



&#x20;               (

&#x20;                   "prep",



&#x20;                   rating\_preprocess



&#x20;               ),



&#x20;               (

&#x20;                   "clf",



&#x20;                   LogisticRegression(



&#x20;                       solver="saga",



&#x20;                       max\_iter=300,



&#x20;                       tol=1e-2,



&#x20;                       class\_weight=class\_weight\_dict,



&#x20;                       n\_jobs=-1



&#x20;                   )



&#x20;               )



&#x20;           ]),



"Linear SVC": Pipeline(\[



&#x20;               (

&#x20;                   "prep",



&#x20;                   rating\_preprocess



&#x20;               ),



&#x20;               (

&#x20;                   "clf",



&#x20;                   LinearSVC(



&#x20;                       class\_weight=class\_weight\_dict,



&#x20;                       max\_iter=2000,



&#x20;                       tol=1e-2,



&#x20;                       dual=False



&#x20;                   )



&#x20;               )



&#x20;           ]),



"LightGBM": Pipeline(\[



&#x20;               (

&#x20;                   "prep",



&#x20;                   rating\_preprocess



&#x20;               ),



&#x20;               (

&#x20;                   "clf",



&#x20;                   LGBMClassifier(



&#x20;                       n\_estimators=300,



&#x20;                       learning\_rate=0.05,



&#x20;                       num\_leaves=31,



&#x20;                       class\_weight=class\_weight\_dict,



&#x20;                       random\_state=42,



&#x20;                       verbosity=-1



&#x20;                   )



&#x20;               )



&#x20;           ])



&#x20;       }



self.models = models



\# =====================================================

&#x20;       # TRAIN RATING MODELS

&#x20;       # =====================================================



&#x20;       print()

&#x20;       print("==============================")

&#x20;       print("FINAL RATING MODEL TRAINING")

&#x20;       print("==============================")



for name, model in models.items():



&#x20;           print(

&#x20;               f"Training {name}..."

&#x20;           )



&#x20;           model.fit(

&#x20;               X\_train,

&#x20;               y\_train

&#x20;           )



&#x20;           print(

&#x20;               f"{name} completed."

&#x20;           )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;       # RESERVATION STATUS MODEL

&#x20;       # =====================================================



&#x20;       print()

&#x20;       print("==============================")

&#x20;       print("RESERVATION STATUS TRAINING")

&#x20;       print("==============================")



status\_numeric\_features = \[



&#x20;           "is\_top\_bad\_client",

&#x20;           "client\_bad\_rate",

&#x20;           "is\_canceled"



&#x20;       ] + self.status\_missing\_features



status\_categorical\_features = \[



&#x20;           c



&#x20;           for c in status\_features



&#x20;           if c not in NUMERIC\_FEATURES



&#x20;       ]



self.status\_numeric\_features = (

&#x20;           status\_numeric\_features

&#x20;       )



self.status\_categorical\_features = (

&#x20;           status\_categorical\_features

&#x20;       )



status\_preprocess = ColumnTransformer(\[



&#x20;           (

&#x20;               "text",



&#x20;               text\_pipeline,



&#x20;               "comment"



&#x20;           ),



&#x20;           (

&#x20;               "cat",



&#x20;               OneHotEncoder(



&#x20;                   handle\_unknown="ignore",



&#x20;                   min\_frequency=1



&#x20;               ),



&#x20;               status\_categorical\_features



&#x20;           ),



&#x20;           (

&#x20;               "num",



&#x20;               "passthrough",



&#x20;               status\_numeric\_features



&#x20;           )



&#x20;       ])



X\_train\_status = train\_df\[

&#x20;           \["comment"] +

&#x20;           status\_features +

&#x20;           self.status\_missing\_features

&#x20;       ]



X\_val\_status = val\_df\[

&#x20;           \["comment"] +

&#x20;           status\_features +

&#x20;           self.status\_missing\_features

&#x20;       ]



X\_test\_status = test\_df\[

&#x20;           \["comment"] +

&#x20;           status\_features +

&#x20;           self.status\_missing\_features

&#x20;       ]



X\_train\_status\_processed = (

&#x20;           status\_preprocess.fit\_transform(

&#x20;               X\_train\_status

&#x20;           )

&#x20;       )



X\_val\_status\_processed = (

&#x20;           status\_preprocess.transform(

&#x20;               X\_val\_status

&#x20;           )

&#x20;       )



X\_test\_status\_processed = (

&#x20;           status\_preprocess.transform(

&#x20;               X\_test\_status

&#x20;           )

&#x20;       )



self.status\_model = LogisticRegression(



&#x20;           solver="saga",



&#x20;           max\_iter=100,



&#x20;           tol=1e-2,



&#x20;           class\_weight="balanced",



&#x20;           n\_jobs=-1



&#x20;       )



print(

&#x20;           "Training Reservation Status Model..."

&#x20;       )



self.status\_model.fit(



&#x20;           X\_train\_status\_processed,



&#x20;           y\_status\_train



&#x20;       )



self.status\_preprocess = (

&#x20;           status\_preprocess

&#x20;       )



print(

&#x20;           "Reservation Status Model completed."

&#x20;       )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;       # STATUS EVALUATION

&#x20;       # =====================================================



&#x20;       status\_preds = (

&#x20;           self.status\_model.predict(

&#x20;               X\_test\_status\_processed

&#x20;           )

&#x20;       )



print()

&#x20;       print("==============================")

&#x20;       print("RESERVATION STATUS EVALUATION")

&#x20;       print("==============================")



print(

&#x20;           classification\_report(

&#x20;               y\_status\_test,

&#x20;               status\_preds,

&#x20;               zero\_division=0

&#x20;           )

&#x20;       )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;       # VALIDATION

&#x20;       # =====================================================



&#x20;       print()

&#x20;       print("==============================")

&#x20;       print("FINAL RATING VALIDATION")

&#x20;       print("==============================")



validation\_results = \[]



for name, model in models.items():



&#x20;           preds = model.predict(

&#x20;               X\_val

&#x20;           )



f1 = f1\_score(



&#x20;               y\_val,



&#x20;               preds,



&#x20;               average="weighted"



&#x20;           )



try:



&#x20;               clf = model.named\_steps\["clf"]



if hasattr(

&#x20;                   clf,

&#x20;                   "predict\_proba"

&#x20;               ):



&#x20;                   probs = model.predict\_proba(

&#x20;                       X\_val

&#x20;                   )



else:



&#x20;                   scores = model.decision\_function(

&#x20;                       X\_val

&#x20;                   )



scores = np.asarray(

&#x20;                       scores

&#x20;                   )



if scores.ndim == 1:



&#x20;                       scores = np.column\_stack(

&#x20;                           \[

&#x20;                               -scores,

&#x20;                               scores

&#x20;                           ]

&#x20;                       )



exp = np.exp(



&#x20;                       scores -



&#x20;                       np.max(

&#x20;                           scores,

&#x20;                           axis=1,

&#x20;                           keepdims=True

&#x20;                       )



&#x20;                   )



probs = (



&#x20;                       exp /



&#x20;                       exp.sum(

&#x20;                           axis=1,

&#x20;                           keepdims=True

&#x20;                       )



&#x20;                   )



roc = roc\_auc\_score(



&#x20;                   y\_val,



&#x20;                   probs,



&#x20;                   multi\_class="ovr",



&#x20;                   average="weighted"



&#x20;               )



except Exception as e:



&#x20;               print(



&#x20;                   f"\[WARNING] ROC-AUC failed "

&#x20;                   f"for {name}: {e}"



&#x20;               )



&#x20;               roc = 0.0



validation\_results.append({



&#x20;               "model": name,



&#x20;               "f1": f1,



&#x20;               "roc": roc



&#x20;           })



validation\_df = pd.DataFrame(

&#x20;           validation\_results

&#x20;       )



validation\_df\["final\_score"] = (



&#x20;           0.6 \*

&#x20;           validation\_df\["f1"]



&#x20;           +



&#x20;           0.4 \*

&#x20;           validation\_df\["roc"]



&#x20;       )



validation\_df = validation\_df.sort\_values(



&#x20;           "final\_score",



&#x20;           ascending=False



&#x20;       )



print(



&#x20;           validation\_df\[



&#x20;               \[

&#x20;                   "model",

&#x20;                   "f1",

&#x20;                   "roc",

&#x20;                   "final\_score"

&#x20;               ]



&#x20;           ].to\_string(

&#x20;               index=False

&#x20;           )



&#x20;       )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;       # BEST RATING MODEL

&#x20;       # =====================================================



&#x20;       self.best\_model\_name = (

&#x20;           validation\_df.iloc\[0]\["model"]

&#x20;       )



self.best\_model = (

&#x20;           self.models\[

&#x20;               self.best\_model\_name

&#x20;           ]

&#x20;       )



print(

&#x20;           "\\nBEST RATING MODEL SELECTED:",

&#x20;           self.best\_model\_name

&#x20;       )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;       # REFERENCE DATA

&#x20;       # =====================================================



&#x20;       self.df\_reference = pd.concat(



&#x20;           \[

&#x20;               train\_df,

&#x20;               val\_df,

&#x20;               test\_df

&#x20;           ],



&#x20;           axis=0



&#x20;       )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;       # COMMENT DATA

&#x20;       # =====================================================



&#x20;       reference\_df = self.df\_reference.copy()



comment\_reference\_columns = \[



&#x20;           "comment",

&#x20;           "hotel",

&#x20;           "meal",

&#x20;           "market\_segment",

&#x20;           "distribution\_channel",

&#x20;           "deposit\_type",

&#x20;           "customer\_type",

&#x20;           "season\_group",

&#x20;           "country\_group",

&#x20;           "adr\_group",

&#x20;           "previous\_cancellations\_group",

&#x20;           "days\_in\_waiting\_list\_group",

&#x20;           "guest\_group",

&#x20;           "final\_rating"



&#x20;       ]



self.comment\_df = reference\_df\[

&#x20;           \[

&#x20;               c



&#x20;               for c in comment\_reference\_columns



&#x20;               if c in reference\_df.columns

&#x20;           ]



&#x20;       ].copy()



\# =====================================================

&#x20;       # COMMENT INDEX

&#x20;       # =====================================================



&#x20;       self.comment\_index = {}



fields = \[



&#x20;           "hotel",

&#x20;           "meal",

&#x20;           "market\_segment",

&#x20;           "distribution\_channel",

&#x20;           "deposit\_type",

&#x20;           "customer\_type",

&#x20;           "season\_group",

&#x20;           "country\_group",

&#x20;           "adr\_group",

&#x20;           "previous\_cancellations\_group",

&#x20;           "days\_in\_waiting\_list\_group",

&#x20;           "guest\_group"



&#x20;       ]



for rating, df\_r in reference\_df.groupby(

&#x20;           "final\_rating"

&#x20;       ):



&#x20;           rating\_key = str(

&#x20;               rating

&#x20;           )



self.comment\_index\[

&#x20;               rating\_key

&#x20;           ] = {



&#x20;               "ALL":

&#x20;                   df\_r\[

&#x20;                       "comment"

&#x20;                   ].tolist(),



&#x20;               "FIELDS":

&#x20;                   {}



&#x20;           }



for field in fields:



&#x20;               if field not in df\_r.columns:

&#x20;                   continue



self.comment\_index\[

&#x20;                   rating\_key

&#x20;               ]\[

&#x20;                   "FIELDS"

&#x20;               ]\[field] = (



&#x20;                   df\_r

&#x20;                   .groupby(field)\["comment"]

&#x20;                   .apply(list)

&#x20;                   .to\_dict()



&#x20;               )



print(

&#x20;           "FAST COMMENT INDEX READY"

&#x20;       )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;       # SAVE

&#x20;       # =====================================================



&#x20;       self.\_save\_artifacts(

&#x20;           reference\_df

&#x20;       )



return reference\_df



\# =========================================================

&#x20;   # SAVE ARTIFACTS

&#x20;   # =========================================================



&#x20;   def \_save\_artifacts(

&#x20;       self,

&#x20;       df

&#x20;   ):



&#x20;       trained\_dir = self.config.get(



&#x20;           "trained\_dir",



&#x20;           "trained"



&#x20;       )



os.makedirs(



&#x20;           trained\_dir,



&#x20;           exist\_ok=True



&#x20;       )



train\_path = self.config.get(



&#x20;           "train\_data",



&#x20;           os.path.join(



&#x20;               trained\_dir,



&#x20;               "train.parquet"



&#x20;           )



&#x20;       )



df.to\_parquet(



&#x20;           train\_path,



&#x20;           index=False



&#x20;       )



print(



&#x20;           f"\[INFO] Training data saved: "

&#x20;           f"{train\_path}"



&#x20;       )



model\_path = self.config.get(



&#x20;           "service\_model",



&#x20;           os.path.join(



&#x20;               trained\_dir,



&#x20;               "service\_model.pkl"



&#x20;           )



&#x20;       )



joblib.dump(



&#x20;           self,



&#x20;           model\_path



&#x20;       )



print(



&#x20;           f"\[INFO] Service model saved: "

&#x20;           f"{model\_path}"



&#x20;       )



metadata\_path = self.config.get(



&#x20;           "training\_metadata",



&#x20;           os.path.join(



&#x20;               trained\_dir,



&#x20;               "training\_metadata.json"



&#x20;           )



&#x20;       )



metadata = {}



if os.path.exists(

&#x20;           metadata\_path

&#x20;       ):



&#x20;           with open(

&#x20;               metadata\_path,

&#x20;               "r"

&#x20;           ) as f:



&#x20;               metadata = json.load(

&#x20;                   f

&#x20;               )



metadata.update({



&#x20;           "model":

&#x20;               self.best\_model\_name,



&#x20;           "trained\_time":

&#x20;               datetime.now().isoformat(),



&#x20;           "rows":

&#x20;               len(df),



&#x20;           "columns":

&#x20;               list(df.columns),



&#x20;           "rating\_features":

&#x20;               self.rating\_features,



&#x20;           "status\_features":

&#x20;               self.status\_features,



&#x20;           "unknown\_value":

&#x20;               UNKNOWN\_VALUE



&#x20;       })



with open(

&#x20;           metadata\_path,

&#x20;           "w"

&#x20;       ) as f:



&#x20;           json.dump(



&#x20;               metadata,



&#x20;               f,



&#x20;               indent=4



&#x20;           )



print(



&#x20;           f"\[INFO] Metadata updated: "

&#x20;           f"{metadata\_path}"



&#x20;       )



\# =========================================================

&#x20;   # SWITCH MODEL

&#x20;   # =========================================================



&#x20;   def set\_model(

&#x20;       self,

&#x20;       name: str

&#x20;   ):



&#x20;       if name in self.models:



&#x20;           self.best\_model\_name = name



&#x20;           self.best\_model = (

&#x20;               self.models\[name]

&#x20;           )



\# =========================================================

&#x20;   # NORMALISE INPUT

&#x20;   # =========================================================



&#x20;   def \_prepare\_input(

&#x20;       self,

&#x20;       x

&#x20;   ):



&#x20;       input\_df = pd.DataFrame(

&#x20;           \[x]

&#x20;       )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;       # TEXT

&#x20;       # =====================================================



&#x20;       if "comment" not in input\_df.columns:



&#x20;           input\_df\["comment"] = ""



input\_df\["comment"] = (



&#x20;           input\_df\["comment"]



&#x20;           .fillna("")



&#x20;           .astype(str)



&#x20;       )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;       # CATEGORICAL

&#x20;       #

&#x20;       # Missing user selections become "unknown".

&#x20;       # =====================================================



&#x20;       for col in CATEGORICAL\_FEATURES:



&#x20;           if col not in input\_df.columns:



&#x20;               input\_df\[col] = UNKNOWN\_VALUE



input\_df\[col] = (

&#x20;               normalise\_categorical\_column(

&#x20;                   input\_df\[col]

&#x20;               )

&#x20;           )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;       # NUMERIC

&#x20;       # =====================================================



&#x20;       if "is\_top\_bad\_client" not in input\_df.columns:



&#x20;           input\_df\["is\_top\_bad\_client"] = 0



if "is\_canceled" not in input\_df.columns:



&#x20;           input\_df\["is\_canceled"] = 0



if "client\_bad\_rate" not in input\_df.columns:



&#x20;           input\_df\["client\_bad\_rate"] = np.nan



input\_df\["is\_top\_bad\_client"] = (



&#x20;           pd.to\_numeric(



&#x20;               input\_df\[

&#x20;                   "is\_top\_bad\_client"

&#x20;               ],



&#x20;               errors="coerce"



&#x20;           )



&#x20;           .fillna(0)



&#x20;           .clip(0, 1)



&#x20;       )



input\_df\["is\_canceled"] = (



&#x20;           pd.to\_numeric(



&#x20;               input\_df\[

&#x20;                   "is\_canceled"

&#x20;               ],



&#x20;               errors="coerce"



&#x20;           )



&#x20;           .fillna(0)



&#x20;           .clip(0, 1)



&#x20;       )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;       # CLIENT BAD RATE

&#x20;       # =====================================================



&#x20;       client\_bad\_rate = pd.to\_numeric(



&#x20;           input\_df\[

&#x20;               "client\_bad\_rate"

&#x20;           ],



&#x20;           errors="coerce"



&#x20;       )



if client\_bad\_rate.isna().all():



&#x20;           if (



&#x20;               self.df\_reference is not None



&#x20;               and



&#x20;               "client\_bad\_rate"

&#x20;               in self.df\_reference.columns



&#x20;           ):



&#x20;               fallback = pd.to\_numeric(



&#x20;                   self.df\_reference\[

&#x20;                       "client\_bad\_rate"

&#x20;                   ],



&#x20;                   errors="coerce"



&#x20;               ).median()



if pd.isna(fallback):



&#x20;                   fallback = 0.0



&#x20;           else:



&#x20;               fallback = 0.0



client\_bad\_rate = (

&#x20;               client\_bad\_rate.fillna(

&#x20;                   fallback

&#x20;               )

&#x20;           )



&#x20;       else:



&#x20;           fallback = (

&#x20;               client\_bad\_rate.median()

&#x20;           )



if pd.isna(fallback):



&#x20;               fallback = 0.0



client\_bad\_rate = (

&#x20;               client\_bad\_rate.fillna(

&#x20;                   fallback

&#x20;               )

&#x20;           )



input\_df\["client\_bad\_rate"] = (

&#x20;           client\_bad\_rate.clip(0, 1)

&#x20;       )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;       # MISSING INFORMATION FLAGS

&#x20;       # =====================================================



&#x20;       for col in \[



&#x20;           "hotel",

&#x20;           "meal",

&#x20;           "market\_segment",

&#x20;           "distribution\_channel",

&#x20;           "deposit\_type",

&#x20;           "customer\_type",

&#x20;           "season\_group",

&#x20;           "country\_group",

&#x20;           "adr\_group",

&#x20;           "previous\_cancellations\_group",

&#x20;           "days\_in\_waiting\_list\_group",

&#x20;           "guest\_group",

&#x20;           "client\_segment"



&#x20;       ]:



&#x20;           missing\_col = (

&#x20;               f"{col}\_missing"

&#x20;           )



input\_df\[missing\_col] = (



&#x20;               input\_df\[col]



&#x20;               .astype(str)



&#x20;               .str.lower()



&#x20;               .eq(UNKNOWN\_VALUE)



&#x20;               .astype(int)



&#x20;           )



return input\_df



\# =========================================================

&#x20;   # PREDICT

&#x20;   # =========================================================



&#x20;   def predict(

&#x20;       self,

&#x20;       x: dict

&#x20;   ):



&#x20;       # =====================================================

&#x20;       # PREPARE UI INPUT

&#x20;       # =====================================================



&#x20;       input\_df = self.\_prepare\_input(

&#x20;           x

&#x20;       )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;       # COMMENT TOPIC FEATURES

&#x20;       # =====================================================



&#x20;       if (



&#x20;           self.comment\_tfidf is None



&#x20;           or



&#x20;           self.comment\_svd is None



&#x20;       ):



&#x20;           raise RuntimeError(



&#x20;               "Comment TF-IDF/SVD models are not "

&#x20;               "available. Please retrain the "

&#x20;               "ServiceModel."



&#x20;           )



comment\_tfidf = (

&#x20;           self.comment\_tfidf.transform(

&#x20;               input\_df\["comment"]

&#x20;           )

&#x20;       )



comment\_features\_array = (

&#x20;           self.comment\_svd.transform(

&#x20;               comment\_tfidf

&#x20;           )

&#x20;       )



comment\_columns = \[



&#x20;           f"comment\_topic\_{i}"



&#x20;           for i in range(



&#x20;               comment\_features\_array.shape\[1]



&#x20;           )



&#x20;       ]



comment\_features = pd.DataFrame(



&#x20;           comment\_features\_array,



&#x20;           columns=comment\_columns,



&#x20;           index=input\_df.index



&#x20;       )



input\_df = pd.concat(



&#x20;           \[

&#x20;               input\_df,

&#x20;               comment\_features

&#x20;           ],



&#x20;           axis=1



&#x20;       )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;       # FINAL RATING PREDICTION

&#x20;       #

&#x20;       # IMPORTANT:

&#x20;       #

&#x20;       # No manual client-risk adjustment is performed.

&#x20;       #

&#x20;       # The trained ML model uses:

&#x20;       #

&#x20;       # client\_segment

&#x20;       # is\_top\_bad\_client

&#x20;       # client\_bad\_rate

&#x20;       #

&#x20;       # together with whatever booking information was

&#x20;       # actually supplied by predict\_page.py.

&#x20;       # =====================================================



&#x20;       rating\_features\_with\_comments = (



&#x20;           self.rating\_features +



&#x20;           self.rating\_missing\_features +



&#x20;           comment\_columns



&#x20;       )



X\_rating = input\_df\[



&#x20;           \["comment"] +



&#x20;           rating\_features\_with\_comments



&#x20;       ]



\# =====================================================

&#x20;       # RATING PROBABILITIES

&#x20;       # =====================================================



&#x20;       clf = (

&#x20;           self.best\_model

&#x20;           .named\_steps\["clf"]

&#x20;       )



if hasattr(



&#x20;           clf,



&#x20;           "predict\_proba"



&#x20;       ):



&#x20;           rating\_probs = (



&#x20;               self.best\_model



&#x20;               .predict\_proba(



&#x20;                   X\_rating



&#x20;               )\[0]



&#x20;           )



&#x20;       else:



&#x20;           scores = (



&#x20;               self.best\_model



&#x20;               .decision\_function(



&#x20;                   X\_rating



&#x20;               )



&#x20;           )



scores = np.asarray(

&#x20;               scores

&#x20;           )



if scores.ndim == 2:



&#x20;               scores = scores\[0]



exp = np.exp(



&#x20;               scores -



&#x20;               np.max(scores)



&#x20;           )



rating\_probs = (



&#x20;               exp /



&#x20;               np.sum(exp)



&#x20;           )



rating\_probs = np.asarray(



&#x20;           rating\_probs,



&#x20;           dtype=float



&#x20;       )



rating\_class\_order = list(



&#x20;           clf.classes\_



&#x20;       )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;       # FINAL RATING

&#x20;       #

&#x20;       # Select the class with the highest probability.

&#x20;       #

&#x20;       # This means the final rating comes directly from the

&#x20;       # trained model rather than a hard-coded client rule.

&#x20;       # =====================================================



&#x20;       best\_probability\_index = int(



&#x20;           np.argmax(

&#x20;               rating\_probs

&#x20;           )



&#x20;       )



pred\_rating = int(



&#x20;           rating\_class\_order\[

&#x20;               best\_probability\_index

&#x20;           ]



&#x20;       )



pred\_rating = int(



&#x20;           np.clip(



&#x20;               pred\_rating,



&#x20;               0,



&#x20;               6



&#x20;           )



&#x20;       )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;       # SLA RISK

&#x20;       #

&#x20;       # 0 = highest risk

&#x20;       # 6 = lowest risk

&#x20;       # =====================================================



&#x20;       risk\_weights = {



&#x20;           0: 1.00,

&#x20;           1: 0.90,

&#x20;           2: 0.75,

&#x20;           3: 0.60,

&#x20;           4: 0.40,

&#x20;           5: 0.20,

&#x20;           6: 0.00



&#x20;       }



sla\_risk = 0.0



for i, cls in enumerate(



&#x20;           rating\_class\_order



&#x20;       ):



&#x20;           if i >= len(

&#x20;               rating\_probs

&#x20;           ):



&#x20;               continue



try:



&#x20;               rating\_class = int(

&#x20;                   cls

&#x20;               )



&#x20;           except Exception:



&#x20;               continue



sla\_risk += (



&#x20;               rating\_probs\[i] \*



&#x20;               risk\_weights.get(



&#x20;                   rating\_class,



&#x20;                   0.50



&#x20;               )



&#x20;           )



sla\_risk\_score = round(



&#x20;           sla\_risk \* 100,



&#x20;           1



&#x20;       )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;       # CUSTOMER RISK SCORE

&#x20;       # =====================================================



&#x20;       rating\_risk\_map = {



&#x20;           0: 100,

&#x20;           1: 90,

&#x20;           2: 75,

&#x20;           3: 60,

&#x20;           4: 40,

&#x20;           5: 20,

&#x20;           6: 10



&#x20;       }



base\_risk = rating\_risk\_map.get(



&#x20;           pred\_rating,



&#x20;           50



&#x20;       )



risk\_score = round(



&#x20;           (



&#x20;               0.6 \*



&#x20;               base\_risk



&#x20;           )



&#x20;           +



&#x20;           (



&#x20;               0.4 \*



&#x20;               sla\_risk\_score



&#x20;           ),



&#x20;           1



&#x20;       )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;       # RESERVATION STATUS PREDICTION

&#x20;       # =====================================================



&#x20;       status\_input = input\_df\[



&#x20;           \[



&#x20;               "comment",



&#x20;               "hotel",



&#x20;               "meal",



&#x20;               "market\_segment",



&#x20;               "distribution\_channel",



&#x20;               "deposit\_type",



&#x20;               "customer\_type",



&#x20;               "season\_group",



&#x20;               "country\_group",



&#x20;               "adr\_group",



&#x20;               "previous\_cancellations\_group",



&#x20;               "days\_in\_waiting\_list\_group",



&#x20;               "guest\_group",



&#x20;               "client\_segment",



&#x20;               "is\_top\_bad\_client",



&#x20;               "client\_bad\_rate",



&#x20;               "is\_canceled"



&#x20;           ]



&#x20;           +



&#x20;           self.status\_missing\_features



&#x20;       ]



\# =====================================================

&#x20;       # STATUS TRANSFORM

&#x20;       # =====================================================



&#x20;       X\_status = (



&#x20;           self.status\_preprocess.transform(



&#x20;               status\_input



&#x20;           )



&#x20;       )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;       # STATUS PROBABILITIES

&#x20;       # =====================================================



&#x20;       status\_probs = (



&#x20;           self.status\_model



&#x20;           .predict\_proba(



&#x20;               X\_status



&#x20;           )\[0]



&#x20;       )



status\_classes = (



&#x20;           self.status\_model.classes\_



&#x20;       )



print()



&#x20;       print(

&#x20;           "STATUS MODEL CLASSES:",

&#x20;           list(status\_classes)

&#x20;       )



&#x20;       print(

&#x20;           "STATUS MODEL RAW PROBABILITIES:",

&#x20;           status\_probs

&#x20;       )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;       # INITIALISE

&#x20;       # =====================================================



&#x20;       prob\_canceled = 0.0

&#x20;       prob\_check\_out = 0.0

&#x20;       prob\_no\_show = 0.0



\# =====================================================

&#x20;       # NORMALISE STATUS CLASS NAME

&#x20;       # =====================================================



&#x20;       def normalise\_status\_class(

&#x20;           value

&#x20;       ):



&#x20;           value = str(

&#x20;               value

&#x20;           ).strip().lower()



value = (

&#x20;               value

&#x20;               .replace("\_", "-")

&#x20;               .replace(" ", "-")

&#x20;           )



value = (

&#x20;               value

&#x20;               .replace("–", "-")

&#x20;               .replace("—", "-")

&#x20;           )



while "--" in value:



&#x20;               value = value.replace(

&#x20;                   "--",

&#x20;                   "-"

&#x20;               )



return value



\# =====================================================

&#x20;       # MAP STATUS PROBABILITIES

&#x20;       # =====================================================



&#x20;       for probability, cls in zip(



&#x20;           status\_probs,



&#x20;           status\_classes



&#x20;       ):



&#x20;           normalized\_cls = (

&#x20;               normalise\_status\_class(

&#x20;                   cls

&#x20;               )

&#x20;           )



percentage = (



&#x20;               float(probability) \*



&#x20;               100.0



&#x20;           )



if normalized\_cls in \[



&#x20;               "canceled",

&#x20;               "cancelled",

&#x20;               "cancellation"



&#x20;           ]:



&#x20;               prob\_canceled = percentage



elif normalized\_cls in \[



&#x20;               "check-out",

&#x20;               "checkout",

&#x20;               "check\_out",

&#x20;               "check-out-status"



&#x20;           ]:



&#x20;               prob\_check\_out = percentage



elif normalized\_cls in \[



&#x20;               "no-show",

&#x20;               "noshow",

&#x20;               "no\_show"



&#x20;           ]:



&#x20;               prob\_no\_show = percentage



\# =====================================================

&#x20;       # DEBUG STATUS MAPPING

&#x20;       # =====================================================



&#x20;       print()



&#x20;       print(

&#x20;           "STATUS MAPPED PROBABILITIES:"

&#x20;       )



&#x20;       print(

&#x20;           "Cancellation:",

&#x20;           prob\_canceled

&#x20;       )



&#x20;       print(

&#x20;           "Check-Out:",

&#x20;           prob\_check\_out

&#x20;       )



&#x20;       print(

&#x20;           "No-Show:",

&#x20;           prob\_no\_show

&#x20;       )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;       # IS CANCELED SIGNAL

&#x20;       #

&#x20;       # This is NOT used to force cancellation.

&#x20;       #

&#x20;       # The status model remains responsible for the

&#x20;       # probability.

&#x20;       # =====================================================



&#x20;       is\_canceled\_value = float(



&#x20;           input\_df\[

&#x20;               "is\_canceled"

&#x20;           ].iloc\[0]



&#x20;       )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;       # NORMALISE STATUS PROBABILITIES

&#x20;       #

&#x20;       # Only the three recognised operational classes are

&#x20;       # displayed.

&#x20;       # =====================================================



&#x20;       status\_total = (



&#x20;           prob\_canceled +



&#x20;           prob\_check\_out +



&#x20;           prob\_no\_show



&#x20;       )



if status\_total > 0:



&#x20;           prob\_canceled = (



&#x20;               prob\_canceled /



&#x20;               status\_total \*



&#x20;               100



&#x20;           )



prob\_check\_out = (



&#x20;               prob\_check\_out /



&#x20;               status\_total \*



&#x20;               100



&#x20;           )



prob\_no\_show = (



&#x20;               prob\_no\_show /



&#x20;               status\_total \*



&#x20;               100



&#x20;           )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;       # ROUND

&#x20;       # =====================================================



&#x20;       prob\_canceled = round(



&#x20;           prob\_canceled,



&#x20;           1



&#x20;       )



prob\_check\_out = round(



&#x20;           prob\_check\_out,



&#x20;           1



&#x20;       )



prob\_no\_show = round(



&#x20;           prob\_no\_show,



&#x20;           1



&#x20;       )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;       # COMMENT

&#x20;       # =====================================================



&#x20;       generated\_comment = (



&#x20;           self.\_generate\_comment(



&#x20;               pred\_rating,



&#x20;               sla\_risk\_score,



&#x20;               risk\_score,



&#x20;               x



&#x20;           )



&#x20;       )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;       # DEBUG INFORMATION

&#x20;       # =====================================================



&#x20;       print()



&#x20;       print("==============================")

&#x20;       print("FINAL PREDICTION")

&#x20;       print("==============================")



print(



&#x20;           "Predicted Rating:",



&#x20;           pred\_rating



&#x20;       )



print(



&#x20;           "Rating Risk:",



&#x20;           risk\_score



&#x20;       )



print(



&#x20;           "SLA Risk:",



&#x20;           sla\_risk\_score



&#x20;       )



print(



&#x20;           "Client Bad Rate:",



&#x20;           input\_df\[

&#x20;               "client\_bad\_rate"

&#x20;           ].iloc\[0]



&#x20;       )



print()



&#x20;       print(

&#x20;           "Reservation Status Probabilities:"

&#x20;       )



print(



&#x20;           "Cancellation:",



&#x20;           prob\_canceled,



&#x20;           "%"



&#x20;       )



print(



&#x20;           "Check-Out:",



&#x20;           prob\_check\_out,



&#x20;           "%"



&#x20;       )



print(



&#x20;           "No-Show:",



&#x20;           prob\_no\_show,



&#x20;           "%"



&#x20;       )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;       # RETURN

&#x20;       #

&#x20;       # IMPORTANT:

&#x20;       #

&#x20;       # Exactly 7 values.

&#x20;       #

&#x20;       # predict\_page.py must unpack exactly 7 values.

&#x20;       # =====================================================



&#x20;       return (



&#x20;           pred\_rating,



&#x20;           prob\_canceled,



&#x20;           prob\_check\_out,



&#x20;           prob\_no\_show,



&#x20;           sla\_risk\_score,



&#x20;           risk\_score,



&#x20;           generated\_comment



&#x20;       )



\# =========================================================

&#x20;   # COMMENT GENERATION

&#x20;   # =========================================================



&#x20;   def \_generate\_comment(



&#x20;       self,



&#x20;       rating,



&#x20;       sla\_risk,



&#x20;       risk,



&#x20;       x



&#x20;   ):



&#x20;       msg = \[]



\# =====================================================

&#x20;       # RATING 0-6

&#x20;       # =====================================================



&#x20;       if rating == 6:



&#x20;           msg.append(

&#x20;               "Excellent service."

&#x20;           )



&#x20;       elif rating == 5:



&#x20;           msg.append(

&#x20;               "Very good service."

&#x20;           )



&#x20;       elif rating == 4:



&#x20;           msg.append(

&#x20;               "Positive service."

&#x20;           )



&#x20;       elif rating == 3:



&#x20;           msg.append(

&#x20;               "Average service."

&#x20;           )



&#x20;       elif rating == 2:



&#x20;           msg.append(

&#x20;               "Service quality issue."

&#x20;           )



&#x20;       elif rating == 1:



&#x20;           msg.append(

&#x20;               "Poor service experience."

&#x20;           )



&#x20;       else:



&#x20;           msg.append(

&#x20;               "Severe dissatisfaction."

&#x20;           )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;       # HISTORICAL COMMENTS

&#x20;       # =====================================================



&#x20;       context\_comments = (



&#x20;           self.\_get\_top\_comments\_dynamic(



&#x20;               rating,



&#x20;               x,



&#x20;               top\_k=20



&#x20;           )



&#x20;       )



if context\_comments:



&#x20;           ai\_summary = (



&#x20;               self.\_generate\_ai\_summary(



&#x20;                   context\_comments,



&#x20;                   rating



&#x20;               )



&#x20;           )



if ai\_summary:



&#x20;               msg.append(

&#x20;                   ai\_summary

&#x20;               )



example\_block = \[



&#x20;               "Examples of similar feedback:"



&#x20;           ]



example\_block.extend(



&#x20;               \[



&#x20;                   f"{i}. {c}"



&#x20;                   for i, c in enumerate(



&#x20;                       context\_comments\[:5],



&#x20;                       1



&#x20;                   )



&#x20;               ]



&#x20;           )



msg.append(



&#x20;               "\\n".join(

&#x20;                   example\_block

&#x20;               )



&#x20;           )



else:



&#x20;           msg.append(



&#x20;               "No historical patterns found; "



&#x20;               "using operational signals."



&#x20;           )



return "\\n\\n".join(

&#x20;           msg

&#x20;       )



\# =========================================================

&#x20;   # TOP COMMENTS

&#x20;   # =========================================================



&#x20;   def \_get\_top\_comments\_dynamic(



&#x20;       self,



&#x20;       rating,



&#x20;       x,



&#x20;       top\_k=5



&#x20;   ):



&#x20;       df = self.comment\_df.copy()



df\["final\_rating"] = (



&#x20;           pd.to\_numeric(



&#x20;               df\["final\_rating"],



&#x20;               errors="coerce"



&#x20;           )



&#x20;       )



df = df\[



&#x20;           df\["final\_rating"] == rating



&#x20;       ]



if len(df) == 0:



&#x20;           return \[]



priority\_fields = \[



&#x20;           "hotel",

&#x20;           "meal",

&#x20;           "market\_segment",

&#x20;           "distribution\_channel",

&#x20;           "deposit\_type",

&#x20;           "customer\_type",

&#x20;           "season\_group",

&#x20;           "country\_group",

&#x20;           "adr\_group",

&#x20;           "previous\_cancellations\_group",

&#x20;           "days\_in\_waiting\_list\_group",

&#x20;           "guest\_group"

One important point about this revision



There is a distinction between supporting "unknown" and learning that "unknown" means something.



This revised model does both as far as the available training data allows:



predict\_page.py

&#x20;      │

&#x20;      ▼

client\_email

&#x20;      │

&#x20;      ├── client\_segment

&#x20;      ├── is\_top\_bad\_client

&#x20;      └── client\_bad\_rate

&#x20;      

optional booking inputs

&#x20;      │

&#x20;      ├── hotel

&#x20;      ├── meal

&#x20;      ├── country

&#x20;      └── etc.

&#x20;      

unselected fields

&#x20;      │

&#x20;      ▼

&#x20;   "unknown"

&#x20;      │

&#x20;      ▼

missing indicators

&#x20;      │

&#x20;      ▼

&#x20;     ML model

&#x20;      │

&#x20;      ▼

learned prediction



So if the user selects only:

and predict\_page.py supplies:

is\_top\_bad\_client    = 1

client\_bad\_rate      = 1.0



hotel                = unknown

meal                 = unknown

country\_group        = unknown

...



the rating model does not replace those values with invented booking information.



It uses exactly what predict\_page.py supplied.



Very important: retrain



Because this changes the rating feature set by removing:



"reservation\_status"



and adding the missing-information features, you must retrain the model and regenerate:



data/trained/service\_model.pkl



Do not test this using the old service\_model.pkl.



Also, your existing predict\_page.py must continue unpacking 7 values, because this revised predict() returns exactly:



(

&#x20;   pred\_rating,

&#x20;   prob\_canceled,

&#x20;   prob\_check\_out,

&#x20;   prob\_no\_show,

&#x20;   sla\_risk\_score,

&#x20;   risk\_score,

&#x20;   generated\_comment

)



One further thing I deliberately did not do is force a bad client to receive a low rating. If the trained data genuinely says that a high-risk/100% bad-rate client historically can still receive rating 6, the model is allowed to predict 6. The objective is for the training data to determine that relationship, rather than inserting a manual rule into predict().

Yes. The logs show three separate problems in the current model.py:



Client bad rate is reaching the model, but the final rating prediction is still dominated by the booking/unknown feature pattern and predicts 6.



Reservation status is encoded as 0.0 / 1.0 / 2.0, but your prediction code expects text such as "Canceled", "Check-Out", "No-Show", so every probability is being discarded and displayed as 0.0%.



Comment generation depends almost entirely on the predicted rating, so once the rating incorrectly becomes 6, it retrieves excellent comments.



The important change is that client information must become an independent prediction signal, not merely another optional feature.



For example:



client\_bad\_rate = 1.00



is\_top\_bad\_client = 1



client\_segment = high-risk



should strongly push the prediction toward a poor rating even when hotel/meal/market segment/etc. are "unknown".



Below is the revised model.py. The key design is:



Keep the ML rating model.



Add a client-risk rating adjustment based on the three client signals.



Blend the ML rating probabilities with the client-risk prior.



Make 100% bad rate + high-risk client impossible to end up as 6 / Excellent unless the ML model is overwhelmingly contradictory.



Correctly map status classes 0.0, 1.0, 2.0.



Generate comments based on the final adjusted rating, not the raw ML rating.



Handle "unknown" booking information safely.



Keep the existing predict() return structure of 7 values.



Replace src/model.py with this version
