test\_comment\_tfidf = (

&#x20;           self.comment\_tfidf.transform(

&#x20;               test\_df\["comment"]

&#x20;           )

&#x20;       )



test\_comment\_features\_array = (

&#x20;           self.comment\_svd.transform(

&#x20;               test\_comment\_tfidf

&#x20;           )

&#x20;       )



comment\_columns = \[



&#x20;           f"comment\_topic\_{i}"



&#x20;           for i in range(

&#x20;               train\_comment\_features\_array.shape\[1]

&#x20;           )



&#x20;       ]



train\_comment\_features = pd.DataFrame(

&#x20;           train\_comment\_features\_array,

&#x20;           columns=comment\_columns,

&#x20;           index=train\_df.index

&#x20;       )



val\_comment\_features = pd.DataFrame(

&#x20;           val\_comment\_features\_array,

&#x20;           columns=comment\_columns,

&#x20;           index=val\_df.index

&#x20;       )



test\_comment\_features = pd.DataFrame(

&#x20;           test\_comment\_features\_array,

&#x20;           columns=comment\_columns,

&#x20;           index=test\_df.index

&#x20;       )



train\_df = pd.concat(

&#x20;           \[

&#x20;               train\_df,

&#x20;               train\_comment\_features

&#x20;           ],

&#x20;           axis=1

&#x20;       )



val\_df = pd.concat(

&#x20;           \[

&#x20;               val\_df,

&#x20;               val\_comment\_features

&#x20;           ],

&#x20;           axis=1

&#x20;       )



test\_df = pd.concat(

&#x20;           \[

&#x20;               test\_df,

&#x20;               test\_comment\_features

&#x20;           ],

&#x20;           axis=1

&#x20;       )



rating\_features\_with\_comments = (

&#x20;           rating\_features +

&#x20;           comment\_columns

&#x20;       )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;       # FINAL RATING TARGET

&#x20;       # =====================================================



&#x20;       y\_train = (

&#x20;           pd.to\_numeric(

&#x20;               train\_df\["final\_rating"],

&#x20;               errors="coerce"

&#x20;           )

&#x20;           .fillna(0)

&#x20;           .clip(0, 6)

&#x20;           .astype(int)

&#x20;       )



y\_val = (

&#x20;           pd.to\_numeric(

&#x20;               val\_df\["final\_rating"],

&#x20;               errors="coerce"

&#x20;           )

&#x20;           .fillna(0)

&#x20;           .clip(0, 6)

&#x20;           .astype(int)

&#x20;       )



y\_test = (

&#x20;           pd.to\_numeric(

&#x20;               test\_df\["final\_rating"],

&#x20;               errors="coerce"

&#x20;           )

&#x20;           .fillna(0)

&#x20;           .clip(0, 6)

&#x20;           .astype(int)

&#x20;       )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;       # RESERVATION STATUS TARGET

&#x20;       # =====================================================



&#x20;       y\_status\_train = (

&#x20;           train\_df\["reservation\_status"]

&#x20;           .fillna("unknown")

&#x20;           .astype(str)

&#x20;           .str.strip()

&#x20;           .str.lower()

&#x20;       )



y\_status\_val = (

&#x20;           val\_df\["reservation\_status"]

&#x20;           .fillna("unknown")

&#x20;           .astype(str)

&#x20;           .str.strip()

&#x20;           .str.lower()

&#x20;       )



y\_status\_test = (

&#x20;           test\_df\["reservation\_status"]

&#x20;           .fillna("unknown")

&#x20;           .astype(str)

&#x20;           .str.strip()

&#x20;           .str.lower()

&#x20;       )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;       # RATING INPUT

&#x20;       # =====================================================



&#x20;       X\_train = train\_df\[

&#x20;           \["comment"] +

&#x20;           rating\_features\_with\_comments

&#x20;       ]



X\_val = val\_df\[

&#x20;           \["comment"] +

&#x20;           rating\_features\_with\_comments

&#x20;       ]



X\_test = test\_df\[

&#x20;           \["comment"] +

&#x20;           rating\_features\_with\_comments

&#x20;       ]



\# =====================================================

&#x20;       # CLASS WEIGHTS

&#x20;       # =====================================================



&#x20;       classes = np.unique(

&#x20;           y\_train

&#x20;       )



class\_weights = compute\_class\_weight(

&#x20;           class\_weight="balanced",

&#x20;           classes=classes,

&#x20;           y=y\_train

&#x20;       )



class\_weight\_dict = dict(

&#x20;           zip(

&#x20;               classes,

&#x20;               class\_weights

&#x20;           )

&#x20;       )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;       # TEXT PIPELINE

&#x20;       # =====================================================



&#x20;       text\_pipeline = Pipeline(\[



&#x20;           (

&#x20;               "hash",

&#x20;               HashingVectorizer(

&#x20;                   n\_features=2\*\*16,

&#x20;                   alternate\_sign=False,

&#x20;                   ngram\_range=(1, 2)

&#x20;               )

&#x20;           ),



&#x20;           (

&#x20;               "tfidf",

&#x20;               TfidfTransformer()

&#x20;           )



&#x20;       ])



\# =====================================================

&#x20;       # RATING PREPROCESSOR

&#x20;       # =====================================================



&#x20;       rating\_preprocess = ColumnTransformer(\[



&#x20;           (

&#x20;               "text",

&#x20;               text\_pipeline,

&#x20;               "comment"

&#x20;           ),



&#x20;           (

&#x20;               "cat",

&#x20;               OneHotEncoder(

&#x20;                   handle\_unknown="ignore"

&#x20;               ),

&#x20;               \[

&#x20;                   c

&#x20;                   for c in rating\_features\_with\_comments

&#x20;                   if c not in \[

&#x20;                       "is\_top\_bad\_client",

&#x20;                       "client\_bad\_rate",

&#x20;                       "is\_canceled"

&#x20;                   ]

&#x20;               ]

&#x20;           ),



&#x20;           (

&#x20;               "num",

&#x20;               "passthrough",

&#x20;               \[

&#x20;                   c

&#x20;                   for c in rating\_features\_with\_comments

&#x20;                   if c in \[

&#x20;                       "is\_top\_bad\_client",

&#x20;                       "client\_bad\_rate",

&#x20;                       "is\_canceled"

&#x20;                   ]

&#x20;               ]

&#x20;           )



&#x20;       ])



\# =====================================================

&#x20;       # FINAL RATING MODELS

&#x20;       # =====================================================



&#x20;       models = {



&#x20;           "Logistic Regression": Pipeline(\[



&#x20;               (

&#x20;                   "prep",

&#x20;                   rating\_preprocess

&#x20;               ),



&#x20;               (

&#x20;                   "clf",

&#x20;                   LogisticRegression(

&#x20;                       solver="saga",

&#x20;                       max\_iter=500,

&#x20;                       tol=1e-2,

&#x20;                       class\_weight=class\_weight\_dict,

&#x20;                       n\_jobs=-1

&#x20;                   )

&#x20;               )



&#x20;           ]),



"Linear SVC": Pipeline(\[



&#x20;               (

&#x20;                   "prep",

&#x20;                   rating\_preprocess

&#x20;               ),



&#x20;               (

&#x20;                   "clf",

&#x20;                   LinearSVC(

&#x20;                       class\_weight=class\_weight\_dict,

&#x20;                       max\_iter=3000,

&#x20;                       tol=1e-2,

&#x20;                       dual=False

&#x20;                   )

&#x20;               )



&#x20;           ]),



"LightGBM": Pipeline(\[



&#x20;               (

&#x20;                   "prep",

&#x20;                   rating\_preprocess

&#x20;               ),



&#x20;               (

&#x20;                   "clf",

&#x20;                   LGBMClassifier(

&#x20;                       n\_estimators=300,

&#x20;                       learning\_rate=0.05,

&#x20;                       num\_leaves=31,

&#x20;                       class\_weight=class\_weight\_dict,

&#x20;                       random\_state=42,

&#x20;                       verbosity=-1

&#x20;                   )

&#x20;               )



&#x20;           ])



&#x20;       }



self.models = models



\# =====================================================

&#x20;       # TRAIN RATING MODELS

&#x20;       # =====================================================



&#x20;       print()

&#x20;       print("==============================")

&#x20;       print("FINAL RATING MODEL TRAINING")

&#x20;       print("==============================")



for name, model in models.items():



&#x20;           print(

&#x20;               f"Training {name}..."

&#x20;           )



model.fit(

&#x20;               X\_train,

&#x20;               y\_train

&#x20;           )



print(

&#x20;               f"{name} completed."

&#x20;           )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;       # RESERVATION STATUS MODEL

&#x20;       # =====================================================



&#x20;       print()

&#x20;       print("==============================")

&#x20;       print("RESERVATION STATUS TRAINING")

&#x20;       print("==============================")



status\_numeric\_features = \[



&#x20;           "is\_top\_bad\_client",

&#x20;           "client\_bad\_rate",

&#x20;           "is\_canceled"



&#x20;       ]



status\_categorical\_features = \[



&#x20;           c

&#x20;           for c in status\_features

&#x20;           if c not in status\_numeric\_features



&#x20;       ]



self.status\_numeric\_features = (

&#x20;           status\_numeric\_features

&#x20;       )



self.status\_categorical\_features = (

&#x20;           status\_categorical\_features

&#x20;       )



status\_preprocess = ColumnTransformer(\[



&#x20;           (

&#x20;               "text",

&#x20;               text\_pipeline,

&#x20;               "comment"

&#x20;           ),



&#x20;           (

&#x20;               "cat",

&#x20;               OneHotEncoder(

&#x20;                   handle\_unknown="ignore"

&#x20;               ),

&#x20;               status\_categorical\_features

&#x20;           ),



&#x20;           (

&#x20;               "num",

&#x20;               "passthrough",

&#x20;               status\_numeric\_features

&#x20;           )



&#x20;       ])



X\_train\_status = train\_df\[

&#x20;           \["comment"] +

&#x20;           status\_features

&#x20;       ]



X\_val\_status = val\_df\[

&#x20;           \["comment"] +

&#x20;           status\_features

&#x20;       ]



X\_test\_status = test\_df\[

&#x20;           \["comment"] +

&#x20;           status\_features

&#x20;       ]



X\_train\_status\_processed = (

&#x20;           status\_preprocess.fit\_transform(

&#x20;               X\_train\_status

&#x20;           )

&#x20;       )



X\_val\_status\_processed = (

&#x20;           status\_preprocess.transform(

&#x20;               X\_val\_status

&#x20;           )

&#x20;       )



X\_test\_status\_processed = (

&#x20;           status\_preprocess.transform(

&#x20;               X\_test\_status

&#x20;           )

&#x20;       )



self.status\_model = LogisticRegression(



&#x20;           solver="saga",



&#x20;           max\_iter=500,



&#x20;           tol=1e-2,



&#x20;           class\_weight="balanced",



&#x20;           n\_jobs=-1



&#x20;       )



print(

&#x20;           "Training Reservation Status Model..."

&#x20;       )



self.status\_model.fit(

&#x20;           X\_train\_status\_processed,

&#x20;           y\_status\_train

&#x20;       )



self.status\_preprocess = (

&#x20;           status\_preprocess

&#x20;       )



print(

&#x20;           "Reservation Status Model completed."

&#x20;       )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;       # STATUS EVALUATION

&#x20;       # =====================================================



&#x20;       status\_preds = (

&#x20;           self.status\_model.predict(

&#x20;               X\_test\_status\_processed

&#x20;           )

&#x20;       )



print()

&#x20;       print("==============================")

&#x20;       print("RESERVATION STATUS EVALUATION")

&#x20;       print("==============================")



print(

&#x20;           classification\_report(

&#x20;               y\_status\_test,

&#x20;               status\_preds,

&#x20;               zero\_division=0

&#x20;           )

&#x20;       )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;       # VALIDATION

&#x20;       # =====================================================



&#x20;       print()

&#x20;       print("==============================")

&#x20;       print("FINAL RATING VALIDATION")

&#x20;       print("==============================")



validation\_results = \[]



for name, model in models.items():



&#x20;           preds = model.predict(

&#x20;               X\_val

&#x20;           )



f1 = f1\_score(

&#x20;               y\_val,

&#x20;               preds,

&#x20;               average="weighted"

&#x20;           )



try:



&#x20;               clf = model.named\_steps\["clf"]



if hasattr(

&#x20;                   clf,

&#x20;                   "predict\_proba"

&#x20;               ):



&#x20;                   probs = (

&#x20;                       model

&#x20;                       .predict\_proba(

&#x20;                           X\_val

&#x20;                       )

&#x20;                   )



&#x20;               else:



&#x20;                   scores = (

&#x20;                       model

&#x20;                       .decision\_function(

&#x20;                           X\_val

&#x20;                       )

&#x20;                   )



scores = np.asarray(

&#x20;                       scores

&#x20;                   )



if scores.ndim == 1:



&#x20;                       scores = np.column\_stack(

&#x20;                           \[

&#x20;                               -scores,

&#x20;                               scores

&#x20;                           ]

&#x20;                       )



exp = np.exp(

&#x20;                       scores -

&#x20;                       np.max(

&#x20;                           scores,

&#x20;                           axis=1,

&#x20;                           keepdims=True

&#x20;                       )

&#x20;                   )



probs = (

&#x20;                       exp /

&#x20;                       exp.sum(

&#x20;                           axis=1,

&#x20;                           keepdims=True

&#x20;                       )

&#x20;                   )



roc = roc\_auc\_score(

&#x20;                   y\_val,

&#x20;                   probs,

&#x20;                   multi\_class="ovr",

&#x20;                   average="weighted"

&#x20;               )



except Exception as e:



&#x20;               print(

&#x20;                   f"\[WARNING] ROC-AUC failed "

&#x20;                   f"for {name}: {e}"

&#x20;               )



roc = 0.0



validation\_results.append({



&#x20;               "model": name,



&#x20;               "f1": f1,



&#x20;               "roc": roc



&#x20;           })



validation\_df = pd.DataFrame(

&#x20;           validation\_results

&#x20;       )



validation\_df\["final\_score"] = (



&#x20;           0.6 \*

&#x20;           validation\_df\["f1"]



&#x20;           +



&#x20;           0.4 \*

&#x20;           validation\_df\["roc"]



&#x20;       )



validation\_df = (

&#x20;           validation\_df

&#x20;           .sort\_values(

&#x20;               "final\_score",

&#x20;               ascending=False

&#x20;           )

&#x20;       )



print(

&#x20;           validation\_df\[

&#x20;               \[

&#x20;                   "model",

&#x20;                   "f1",

&#x20;                   "roc",

&#x20;                   "final\_score"

&#x20;               ]

&#x20;           ].to\_string(

&#x20;               index=False

&#x20;           )

&#x20;       )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;       # BEST RATING MODEL

&#x20;       # =====================================================



&#x20;       self.best\_model\_name = (

&#x20;           validation\_df.iloc\[0]\["model"]

&#x20;       )



self.best\_model = (

&#x20;           self.models\[

&#x20;               self.best\_model\_name

&#x20;           ]

&#x20;       )



print(

&#x20;           "\\nBEST RATING MODEL SELECTED:",

&#x20;           self.best\_model\_name

&#x20;       )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;       # REFERENCE DATA

&#x20;       # =====================================================



&#x20;       self.df\_reference = pd.concat(

&#x20;           \[

&#x20;               train\_df,

&#x20;               val\_df,

&#x20;               test\_df

&#x20;           ],

&#x20;           axis=0

&#x20;       )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;       # COMMENT DATA

&#x20;       # =====================================================



&#x20;       reference\_df = self.df\_reference.copy()



self.comment\_df = reference\_df\[\[



&#x20;           "comment",

&#x20;           "hotel",

&#x20;           "meal",

&#x20;           "market\_segment",

&#x20;           "distribution\_channel",

&#x20;           "deposit\_type",

&#x20;           "customer\_type",

&#x20;           "season\_group",

&#x20;           "country\_group",

&#x20;           "adr\_group",

&#x20;           "previous\_cancellations\_group",

&#x20;           "days\_in\_waiting\_list\_group",

&#x20;           "guest\_group",

&#x20;           "final\_rating"



&#x20;       ]].copy()



\# =====================================================

&#x20;       # COMMENT INDEX

&#x20;       # =====================================================



&#x20;       self.comment\_index = {}



fields = \[



&#x20;           "hotel",

&#x20;           "meal",

&#x20;           "market\_segment",

&#x20;           "distribution\_channel",

&#x20;           "deposit\_type",

&#x20;           "customer\_type",

&#x20;           "season\_group",

&#x20;           "country\_group",

&#x20;           "adr\_group",

&#x20;           "previous\_cancellations\_group",

&#x20;           "days\_in\_waiting\_list\_group",

&#x20;           "guest\_group"



&#x20;       ]



for rating, df\_r in reference\_df.groupby(

&#x20;           "final\_rating"

&#x20;       ):



&#x20;           rating\_key = str(

&#x20;               rating

&#x20;           )



self.comment\_index\[

&#x20;               rating\_key

&#x20;           ] = {



&#x20;               "ALL":

&#x20;                   df\_r\[

&#x20;                       "comment"

&#x20;                   ].tolist(),



&#x20;               "FIELDS":

&#x20;                   {}



&#x20;           }



for field in fields:



&#x20;               if field not in df\_r.columns:

&#x20;                   continue



self.comment\_index\[

&#x20;                   rating\_key

&#x20;               ]\[

&#x20;                   "FIELDS"

&#x20;               ]\[field] = (



&#x20;                   df\_r

&#x20;                   .groupby(field)\["comment"]

&#x20;                   .apply(list)

&#x20;                   .to\_dict()



&#x20;               )



print(

&#x20;           "FAST COMMENT INDEX READY"

&#x20;       )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;       # SAVE

&#x20;       # =====================================================



&#x20;       self.\_save\_artifacts(

&#x20;           reference\_df

&#x20;       )



return reference\_df



\# =========================================================

&#x20;   # SAVE ARTIFACTS

&#x20;   # =========================================================



&#x20;   def \_save\_artifacts(

&#x20;       self,

&#x20;       df

&#x20;   ):



&#x20;       trained\_dir = self.config.get(

&#x20;           "trained\_dir",

&#x20;           "trained"

&#x20;       )



os.makedirs(

&#x20;           trained\_dir,

&#x20;           exist\_ok=True

&#x20;       )



train\_path = self.config.get(

&#x20;           "train\_data",

&#x20;           os.path.join(

&#x20;               trained\_dir,

&#x20;               "train.parquet"

&#x20;           )

&#x20;       )



df.to\_parquet(

&#x20;           train\_path,

&#x20;           index=False

&#x20;       )



print(

&#x20;           f"\[INFO] Training data saved: "

&#x20;           f"{train\_path}"

&#x20;       )



model\_path = self.config.get(

&#x20;           "service\_model",

&#x20;           os.path.join(

&#x20;               trained\_dir,

&#x20;               "service\_model.pkl"

&#x20;           )

&#x20;       )



joblib.dump(

&#x20;           self,

&#x20;           model\_path

&#x20;       )



print(

&#x20;           f"\[INFO] Service model saved: "

&#x20;           f"{model\_path}"

&#x20;       )



metadata\_path = self.config.get(

&#x20;           "training\_metadata",

&#x20;           os.path.join(

&#x20;               trained\_dir,

&#x20;               "training\_metadata.json"

&#x20;           )

&#x20;       )



import json



metadata = {}



if os.path.exists(

&#x20;           metadata\_path

&#x20;       ):



&#x20;           with open(

&#x20;               metadata\_path,

&#x20;               "r"

&#x20;           ) as f:



&#x20;               metadata = json.load(

&#x20;                   f

&#x20;               )



metadata.update({



&#x20;           "model":

&#x20;               self.best\_model\_name,



&#x20;           "trained\_time":

&#x20;               datetime.now().isoformat(),



&#x20;           "rows":

&#x20;               len(df),



&#x20;           "columns":

&#x20;               list(df.columns)



&#x20;       })



with open(

&#x20;           metadata\_path,

&#x20;           "w"

&#x20;       ) as f:



&#x20;           json.dump(

&#x20;               metadata,

&#x20;               f,

&#x20;               indent=4

&#x20;           )



print(

&#x20;           f"\[INFO] Metadata updated: "

&#x20;           f"{metadata\_path}"

&#x20;       )



\# =========================================================

&#x20;   # SWITCH MODEL

&#x20;   # =========================================================



&#x20;   def set\_model(

&#x20;       self,

&#x20;       name: str

&#x20;   ):



&#x20;       if name in self.models:



&#x20;           self.best\_model\_name = name



&#x20;           self.best\_model = (

&#x20;               self.models\[name]

&#x20;           )



\# =========================================================

&#x20;   # NORMALISE INPUT

&#x20;   # =========================================================



&#x20;   def \_prepare\_input(

&#x20;       self,

&#x20;       x

&#x20;   ):



&#x20;       input\_df = pd.DataFrame(

&#x20;           \[x]

&#x20;       )



\# ---------------------------------------------

&#x20;       # Text

&#x20;       # ---------------------------------------------



&#x20;       if "comment" not in input\_df.columns:



&#x20;           input\_df\["comment"] = ""



input\_df\["comment"] = (

&#x20;           input\_df\["comment"]

&#x20;           .fillna("")

&#x20;           .astype(str)

&#x20;       )



\# ---------------------------------------------

&#x20;       # Categorical

&#x20;       # ---------------------------------------------



&#x20;       categorical\_features = \[



&#x20;           "hotel",

&#x20;           "meal",

&#x20;           "market\_segment",

&#x20;           "distribution\_channel",

&#x20;           "deposit\_type",

&#x20;           "customer\_type",

&#x20;           "season\_group",

&#x20;           "country\_group",

&#x20;           "adr\_group",

&#x20;           "previous\_cancellations\_group",

&#x20;           "days\_in\_waiting\_list\_group",

&#x20;           "guest\_group",

&#x20;           "client\_segment"



&#x20;       ]



for col in categorical\_features:



&#x20;           if col not in input\_df.columns:



&#x20;               input\_df\[col] = "unknown"



input\_df\[col] = (

&#x20;               input\_df\[col]

&#x20;               .fillna("unknown")

&#x20;               .astype(str)

&#x20;               .str.strip()

&#x20;               .str.lower()

&#x20;           )



\# ---------------------------------------------

&#x20;       # Numeric

&#x20;       # ---------------------------------------------



&#x20;       if "is\_top\_bad\_client" not in input\_df.columns:



&#x20;           input\_df\["is\_top\_bad\_client"] = 0



if "is\_canceled" not in input\_df.columns:



&#x20;           input\_df\["is\_canceled"] = 0



if "client\_bad\_rate" not in input\_df.columns:



&#x20;           input\_df\["client\_bad\_rate"] = np.nan



input\_df\["is\_top\_bad\_client"] = (

&#x20;           pd.to\_numeric(

&#x20;               input\_df\["is\_top\_bad\_client"],

&#x20;               errors="coerce"

&#x20;           )

&#x20;           .fillna(0)

&#x20;           .clip(0, 1)

&#x20;       )



input\_df\["is\_canceled"] = (

&#x20;           pd.to\_numeric(

&#x20;               input\_df\["is\_canceled"],

&#x20;               errors="coerce"

&#x20;           )

&#x20;           .fillna(0)

&#x20;           .clip(0, 1)

&#x20;       )



\# ---------------------------------------------

&#x20;       # Client bad rate

&#x20;       # ---------------------------------------------



&#x20;       client\_bad\_rate = pd.to\_numeric(

&#x20;           input\_df\["client\_bad\_rate"],

&#x20;           errors="coerce"

&#x20;       )



if client\_bad\_rate.isna().all():



&#x20;           if (

&#x20;               self.df\_reference is not None

&#x20;               and

&#x20;               "client\_bad\_rate" in self.df\_reference.columns

&#x20;           ):



&#x20;               fallback = pd.to\_numeric(

&#x20;                   self.df\_reference\[

&#x20;                       "client\_bad\_rate"

&#x20;                   ],

&#x20;                   errors="coerce"

&#x20;               ).median()



if pd.isna(fallback):



&#x20;                   fallback = 0.0



&#x20;           else:



&#x20;               fallback = 0.0



client\_bad\_rate = (

&#x20;               client\_bad\_rate

&#x20;               .fillna(fallback)

&#x20;           )



&#x20;       else:



&#x20;           fallback = client\_bad\_rate.median()



if pd.isna(fallback):



&#x20;               fallback = 0.0



client\_bad\_rate = (

&#x20;               client\_bad\_rate

&#x20;               .fillna(fallback)

&#x20;           )



input\_df\["client\_bad\_rate"] = (

&#x20;           client\_bad\_rate

&#x20;           .clip(0, 1)

&#x20;       )



\# ---------------------------------------------

&#x20;       # Reservation status

&#x20;       # ---------------------------------------------



&#x20;       if "reservation\_status" not in input\_df.columns:



&#x20;           input\_df\["reservation\_status"] = "unknown"



input\_df\["reservation\_status"] = (

&#x20;           input\_df\["reservation\_status"]

&#x20;           .fillna("unknown")

&#x20;           .astype(str)

&#x20;           .str.strip()

&#x20;           .str.lower()

&#x20;       )



return input\_df



\# =========================================================

&#x20;   # CLIENT RISK SCORE

&#x20;   # =========================================================



&#x20;   def \_calculate\_client\_risk(

&#x20;       self,

&#x20;       input\_df

&#x20;   ):



&#x20;       bad\_rate = float(

&#x20;           input\_df\[

&#x20;               "client\_bad\_rate"

&#x20;           ].iloc\[0]

&#x20;       )



top\_bad = float(

&#x20;           input\_df\[

&#x20;               "is\_top\_bad\_client"

&#x20;           ].iloc\[0]

&#x20;       )



segment = str(

&#x20;           input\_df\[

&#x20;               "client\_segment"

&#x20;           ].iloc\[0]

&#x20;       ).strip().lower()



\# ---------------------------------------------

&#x20;       # Client bad rate

&#x20;       # ---------------------------------------------



&#x20;       bad\_rate\_score = (

&#x20;           np.clip(

&#x20;               bad\_rate,

&#x20;               0,

&#x20;               1

&#x20;           )

&#x20;       )



\# ---------------------------------------------

&#x20;       # Top bad client

&#x20;       # ---------------------------------------------



&#x20;       top\_bad\_score = (

&#x20;           np.clip(

&#x20;               top\_bad,

&#x20;               0,

&#x20;               1

&#x20;           )

&#x20;       )



\# ---------------------------------------------

&#x20;       # Client segment

&#x20;       # ---------------------------------------------



&#x20;       if segment in \[

&#x20;           "high-risk",

&#x20;           "high risk",

&#x20;           "bad",

&#x20;           "poor",

&#x20;           "very-high-risk",

&#x20;           "very high risk"

&#x20;       ]:



&#x20;           segment\_score = 1.0



&#x20;       elif segment in \[

&#x20;           "medium-risk",

&#x20;           "medium risk",

&#x20;           "moderate-risk",

&#x20;           "moderate risk"

&#x20;       ]:



&#x20;           segment\_score = 0.5



&#x20;       elif segment in \[

&#x20;           "low-risk",

&#x20;           "low risk",

&#x20;           "good",

&#x20;           "normal"

&#x20;       ]:



&#x20;           segment\_score = 0.0



&#x20;       else:



&#x20;           segment\_score = 0.0



\# ---------------------------------------------

&#x20;       # Combined client risk

&#x20;       # ---------------------------------------------



&#x20;       client\_risk = (



&#x20;           0.60 \*

&#x20;           bad\_rate\_score



&#x20;           +



&#x20;           0.25 \*

&#x20;           top\_bad\_score



&#x20;           +



&#x20;           0.15 \*

&#x20;           segment\_score



&#x20;       )



return float(

&#x20;           np.clip(

&#x20;               client\_risk,

&#x20;               0,

&#x20;               1

&#x20;           )

&#x20;       )



\# =========================================================

&#x20;   # CLIENT RISK RATING PRIOR

&#x20;   # =========================================================



&#x20;   def \_client\_rating\_prior(

&#x20;       self,

&#x20;       client\_risk

&#x20;   ):



&#x20;       """

&#x20;       Convert client risk into a rating probability.



&#x20;       0.00 risk:

&#x20;           mostly positive



&#x20;       1.00 risk:

&#x20;           mostly ratings 0-2



&#x20;       This is intentionally independent from booking

&#x20;       characteristics.

&#x20;       """



&#x20;       client\_risk = float(

&#x20;           np.clip(

&#x20;               client\_risk,

&#x20;               0,

&#x20;               1

&#x20;           )

&#x20;       )



\# Rating order: 0,1,2,3,4,5,6



&#x20;       low\_risk\_prior = np.array(\[



&#x20;           0.01,

&#x20;           0.01,

&#x20;           0.02,

&#x20;           0.06,

&#x20;           0.15,

&#x20;           0.30,

&#x20;           0.45



&#x20;       ])



high\_risk\_prior = np.array(\[



&#x20;           0.25,

&#x20;           0.25,

&#x20;           0.22,

&#x20;           0.15,

&#x20;           0.08,

&#x20;           0.04,

&#x20;           0.01



&#x20;       ])



prior = (



&#x20;           (

&#x20;               1.0 -

&#x20;               client\_risk

&#x20;           )

&#x20;           \*

&#x20;           low\_risk\_prior



&#x20;           +



&#x20;           client\_risk

&#x20;           \*

&#x20;           high\_risk\_prior



&#x20;       )



prior = (

&#x20;           prior /

&#x20;           prior.sum()

&#x20;       )



return prior



\# =========================================================

&#x20;   # RATING PROBABILITIES

&#x20;   # =========================================================



&#x20;   def \_get\_rating\_probabilities(

&#x20;       self,

&#x20;       X\_rating

&#x20;   ):



&#x20;       clf = (

&#x20;           self.best\_model

&#x20;           .named\_steps\["clf"]

&#x20;       )



if hasattr(

&#x20;           clf,

&#x20;           "predict\_proba"

&#x20;       ):



&#x20;           probabilities = (

&#x20;               self.best\_model

&#x20;               .predict\_proba(

&#x20;                   X\_rating

&#x20;               )\[0]

&#x20;           )



&#x20;       else:



&#x20;           scores = (

&#x20;               self.best\_model

&#x20;               .decision\_function(

&#x20;                   X\_rating

&#x20;               )

&#x20;           )



scores = np.asarray(

&#x20;               scores

&#x20;           )



if scores.ndim == 2:



&#x20;               scores = scores\[0]



exp = np.exp(

&#x20;               scores -

&#x20;               np.max(scores)

&#x20;           )



probabilities = (

&#x20;               exp /

&#x20;               exp.sum()

&#x20;           )



classes = list(

&#x20;           clf.classes\_

&#x20;       )



rating\_probabilities = np.zeros(

&#x20;           7,

&#x20;           dtype=float

&#x20;       )



for probability, cls in zip(

&#x20;           probabilities,

&#x20;           classes

&#x20;       ):



&#x20;           try:



&#x20;               rating\_class = int(

&#x20;                   float(cls)

&#x20;               )



&#x20;           except Exception:



&#x20;               continue



if 0 <= rating\_class <= 6:



&#x20;               rating\_probabilities\[

&#x20;                   rating\_class

&#x20;               ] = float(

&#x20;                   probability

&#x20;               )



total = rating\_probabilities.sum()



if total <= 0:



&#x20;           rating\_probabilities = (

&#x20;               np.ones(7) / 7

&#x20;           )



&#x20;       else:



&#x20;           rating\_probabilities = (

&#x20;               rating\_probabilities /

&#x20;               total

&#x20;           )



return rating\_probabilities



\# =========================================================

&#x20;   # APPLY CLIENT RISK TO RATING

&#x20;   # =========================================================



&#x20;   def \_apply\_client\_risk\_to\_rating(

&#x20;       self,

&#x20;       ml\_probabilities,

&#x20;       client\_risk

&#x20;   ):



&#x20;       client\_prior = (

&#x20;           self.\_client\_rating\_prior(

&#x20;               client\_risk

&#x20;           )

&#x20;       )



weight = float(

&#x20;           np.clip(

&#x20;               self.client\_risk\_weight,

&#x20;               0,

&#x20;               1

&#x20;           )

&#x20;       )



final\_probabilities = (



&#x20;           (

&#x20;               1.0 -

&#x20;               weight

&#x20;           )

&#x20;           \*

&#x20;           ml\_probabilities



&#x20;           +



&#x20;           weight

&#x20;           \*

&#x20;           client\_prior



&#x20;       )



final\_probabilities = (

&#x20;           final\_probabilities /

&#x20;           final\_probabilities.sum()

&#x20;       )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;       # HARD CLIENT-RISK PROTECTION

&#x20;       # =====================================================

&#x20;       #

&#x20;       # This prevents the exact problem in the logs:

&#x20;       #

&#x20;       # client\_bad\_rate = 1.0

&#x20;       # is\_top\_bad\_client = 1

&#x20;       # client\_segment = high-risk

&#x20;       #

&#x20;       # -> rating 6 / Excellent

&#x20;       #

&#x20;       # A client with 100% historical bad rate should not

&#x20;       # receive an Excellent prediction simply because the

&#x20;       # other booking fields are unknown.

&#x20;       # =====================================================



&#x20;       if self.client\_rating\_cap:



&#x20;           if client\_risk >= 0.90:



&#x20;               # Rating 5 and 6 cannot dominate.

&#x20;               final\_probabilities\[5] \*= 0.10

&#x20;               final\_probabilities\[6] \*= 0.02



elif client\_risk >= 0.70:



&#x20;               final\_probabilities\[6] \*= 0.05



elif client\_risk >= 0.50:



&#x20;               final\_probabilities\[6] \*= 0.20



final\_probabilities = (

&#x20;               final\_probabilities /

&#x20;               final\_probabilities.sum()

&#x20;           )



return final\_probabilities



\# =========================================================

&#x20;   # PREDICT

&#x20;   # =========================================================



&#x20;   def predict(

&#x20;       self,

&#x20;       x: dict

&#x20;   ):



&#x20;       # =====================================================

&#x20;       # PREPARE UI INPUT

&#x20;       # =====================================================



&#x20;       input\_df = self.\_prepare\_input(

&#x20;           x

&#x20;       )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;       # CLIENT RISK

&#x20;       # =====================================================



&#x20;       client\_risk = (

&#x20;           self.\_calculate\_client\_risk(

&#x20;               input\_df

&#x20;           )

&#x20;       )



print()

&#x20;       print("==============================")

&#x20;       print("CLIENT RISK SIGNAL")

&#x20;       print("==============================")



print(

&#x20;           "Client Segment:",

&#x20;           input\_df\[

&#x20;               "client\_segment"

&#x20;           ].iloc\[0]

&#x20;       )



print(

&#x20;           "Client Bad Rate:",

&#x20;           input\_df\[

&#x20;               "client\_bad\_rate"

&#x20;           ].iloc\[0]

&#x20;       )



print(

&#x20;           "Top Bad Client:",

&#x20;           input\_df\[

&#x20;               "is\_top\_bad\_client"

&#x20;           ].iloc\[0]

&#x20;       )



print(

&#x20;           "Calculated Client Risk:",

&#x20;           round(

&#x20;               client\_risk,

&#x20;               4

&#x20;           )

&#x20;       )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;       # COMMENT TOPIC FEATURES

&#x20;       # =====================================================



&#x20;       if (

&#x20;           self.comment\_tfidf is None

&#x20;           or self.comment\_svd is None

&#x20;       ):



&#x20;           raise RuntimeError(

&#x20;               "Comment TF-IDF/SVD models are not available. "

&#x20;               "Please retrain the ServiceModel."

&#x20;           )



comment\_tfidf = (

&#x20;           self.comment\_tfidf.transform(

&#x20;               input\_df\["comment"]

&#x20;           )

&#x20;       )



comment\_features\_array = (

&#x20;           self.comment\_svd.transform(

&#x20;               comment\_tfidf

&#x20;           )

&#x20;       )



comment\_columns = \[



&#x20;           f"comment\_topic\_{i}"



&#x20;           for i in range(

&#x20;               comment\_features\_array.shape\[1]

&#x20;           )



&#x20;       ]



comment\_features = pd.DataFrame(



&#x20;           comment\_features\_array,



&#x20;           columns=comment\_columns,



&#x20;           index=input\_df.index



&#x20;       )



input\_df = pd.concat(

&#x20;           \[

&#x20;               input\_df,

&#x20;               comment\_features

&#x20;           ],

&#x20;           axis=1

&#x20;       )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;       # FINAL RATING

&#x20;       # =====================================================



&#x20;       rating\_features\_with\_comments = (



&#x20;           self.rating\_features +



&#x20;           comment\_columns



&#x20;       )



X\_rating = input\_df\[

&#x20;           \["comment"] +

&#x20;           rating\_features\_with\_comments

&#x20;       ]



\# =====================================================

&#x20;       # RAW ML RATING PROBABILITIES

&#x20;       # =====================================================



&#x20;       ml\_rating\_probabilities = (

&#x20;           self.\_get\_rating\_probabilities(

&#x20;               X\_rating

&#x20;           )

&#x20;       )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;       # CLIENT-ADJUSTED RATING PROBABILITIES

&#x20;       # =====================================================



&#x20;       rating\_probabilities = (

&#x20;           self.\_apply\_client\_risk\_to\_rating(

&#x20;               ml\_rating\_probabilities,

&#x20;               client\_risk

&#x20;           )

&#x20;       )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;       # FINAL PREDICTED RATING

&#x20;       # =====================================================



&#x20;       pred\_rating = int(

&#x20;           np.argmax(

&#x20;               rating\_probabilities

&#x20;           )

&#x20;       )



pred\_rating = int(

&#x20;           np.clip(

&#x20;               pred\_rating,

&#x20;               0,

&#x20;               6

&#x20;           )

&#x20;       )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;       # RATING RISK

&#x20;       # =====================================================



&#x20;       rating\_risk\_map = {



&#x20;           0: 100,

&#x20;           1: 90,

&#x20;           2: 75,

&#x20;           3: 60,

&#x20;           4: 40,

&#x20;           5: 20,

&#x20;           6: 10



&#x20;       }



risk\_weights = {



&#x20;           0: 1.00,

&#x20;           1: 0.90,

&#x20;           2: 0.75,

&#x20;           3: 0.60,

&#x20;           4: 0.40,

&#x20;           5: 0.20,

&#x20;           6: 0.00



&#x20;       }



sla\_risk = 0.0



for rating\_class in range(7):



&#x20;           sla\_risk += (



&#x20;               rating\_probabilities\[

&#x20;                   rating\_class

&#x20;               ]



&#x20;               \*



&#x20;               risk\_weights\[

&#x20;                   rating\_class

&#x20;               ]



&#x20;           )



sla\_risk\_score = round(

&#x20;           sla\_risk \* 100,

&#x20;           1

&#x20;       )



base\_risk = rating\_risk\_map.get(

&#x20;           pred\_rating,

&#x20;           50

&#x20;       )



risk\_score = round(



&#x20;           (

&#x20;               0.6 \*

&#x20;               base\_risk

&#x20;           )



&#x20;           +



&#x20;           (

&#x20;               0.4 \*

&#x20;               sla\_risk\_score

&#x20;           ),



&#x20;           1



&#x20;       )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;       # RESERVATION STATUS

&#x20;       # =====================================================



&#x20;       status\_input = input\_df\[



&#x20;           \[

&#x20;               "comment",

&#x20;               "hotel",

&#x20;               "meal",

&#x20;               "market\_segment",

&#x20;               "distribution\_channel",

&#x20;               "deposit\_type",

&#x20;               "customer\_type",

&#x20;               "season\_group",

&#x20;               "country\_group",

&#x20;               "adr\_group",

&#x20;               "previous\_cancellations\_group",

&#x20;               "days\_in\_waiting\_list\_group",

&#x20;               "guest\_group",

&#x20;               "client\_segment",

&#x20;               "is\_top\_bad\_client",

&#x20;               "client\_bad\_rate",

&#x20;               "is\_canceled"



&#x20;           ]



&#x20;       ]



X\_status = (

&#x20;           self.status\_preprocess.transform(

&#x20;               status\_input

&#x20;           )

&#x20;       )



status\_probs = (

&#x20;           self.status\_model

&#x20;           .predict\_proba(

&#x20;               X\_status

&#x20;           )\[0]

&#x20;       )



status\_classes = (

&#x20;           self.status\_model.classes\_

&#x20;       )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;       # DEBUG STATUS MODEL

&#x20;       # =====================================================



&#x20;       print()

&#x20;       print(

&#x20;           "STATUS MODEL CLASSES:",

&#x20;           list(status\_classes)

&#x20;       )



print(

&#x20;           "STATUS MODEL RAW PROBABILITIES:",

&#x20;           status\_probs

&#x20;       )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;       # INITIALISE

&#x20;       # =====================================================



&#x20;       prob\_canceled = 0.0

&#x20;       prob\_check\_out = 0.0

&#x20;       prob\_no\_show = 0.0



\# =====================================================

&#x20;       # STATUS CLASS NORMALISATION

&#x20;       # =====================================================



&#x20;       for probability, cls in zip(

&#x20;           status\_probs,

&#x20;           status\_classes

&#x20;       ):



&#x20;           normalized\_cls = (

&#x20;               str(cls)

&#x20;               .strip()

&#x20;               .lower()

&#x20;               .replace("\_", "-")

&#x20;               .replace(" ", "-")

&#x20;           )



percentage = (

&#x20;               float(probability) \*

&#x20;               100.0

&#x20;           )



\# -------------------------------------------------

&#x20;           # Text classes

&#x20;           # -------------------------------------------------



&#x20;           if normalized\_cls in \[

&#x20;               "canceled",

&#x20;               "cancelled"

&#x20;           ]:



&#x20;               prob\_canceled = percentage



elif normalized\_cls in \[

&#x20;               "check-out",

&#x20;               "checkout",

&#x20;               "check\_out"

&#x20;           ]:



&#x20;               prob\_check\_out = percentage



elif normalized\_cls in \[

&#x20;               "no-show",

&#x20;               "noshow",

&#x20;               "no\_show"

&#x20;           ]:



&#x20;               prob\_no\_show = percentage



\# -------------------------------------------------

&#x20;           # Numeric encoded classes

&#x20;           #

&#x20;           # Expected mapping:

&#x20;           #

&#x20;           # 0 = Canceled

&#x20;           # 1 = Check-Out

&#x20;           # 2 = No-Show

&#x20;           # -------------------------------------------------



&#x20;           else:



&#x20;               try:



&#x20;                   numeric\_cls = float(

&#x20;                       cls

&#x20;                   )



if numeric\_cls == 0:



&#x20;                       prob\_canceled = percentage



elif numeric\_cls == 1:



&#x20;                       prob\_check\_out = percentage



elif numeric\_cls == 2:



&#x20;                       prob\_no\_show = percentage



except Exception:



&#x20;                   pass



\# =====================================================

&#x20;       # STATUS DEBUG

&#x20;       # =====================================================



&#x20;       print()

&#x20;       print(

&#x20;           "STATUS MAPPED PROBABILITIES:"

&#x20;       )



print(

&#x20;           "Cancellation:",

&#x20;           prob\_canceled

&#x20;       )



print(

&#x20;           "Check-Out:",

&#x20;           prob\_check\_out

&#x20;       )



print(

&#x20;           "No-Show:",

&#x20;           prob\_no\_show

&#x20;       )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;       # IS CANCELED SIGNAL

&#x20;       # =====================================================



&#x20;       is\_canceled\_value = float(

&#x20;           input\_df\[

&#x20;               "is\_canceled"

&#x20;           ].iloc\[0]

&#x20;       )



if is\_canceled\_value >= 1:



&#x20;           if prob\_canceled < 1.0:



&#x20;               prob\_canceled = 1.0



\# =====================================================

&#x20;       # NORMALISE STATUS PROBABILITIES

&#x20;       # =====================================================



&#x20;       status\_total = (



&#x20;           prob\_canceled +



&#x20;           prob\_check\_out +



&#x20;           prob\_no\_show



&#x20;       )



if status\_total > 0:



&#x20;           prob\_canceled = (



&#x20;               prob\_canceled /

&#x20;               status\_total \*

&#x20;               100



&#x20;           )



prob\_check\_out = (



&#x20;               prob\_check\_out /

&#x20;               status\_total \*

&#x20;               100



&#x20;           )



prob\_no\_show = (



&#x20;               prob\_no\_show /

&#x20;               status\_total \*

&#x20;               100



&#x20;           )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;       # ROUND

&#x20;       # =====================================================



&#x20;       prob\_canceled = round(

&#x20;           prob\_canceled,

&#x20;           1

&#x20;       )



prob\_check\_out = round(

&#x20;           prob\_check\_out,

&#x20;           1

&#x20;       )



prob\_no\_show = round(

&#x20;           prob\_no\_show,

&#x20;           1

&#x20;       )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;       # COMMENT

&#x20;       # =====================================================



&#x20;       generated\_comment = (

&#x20;           self.\_generate\_comment(

&#x20;               pred\_rating,

&#x20;               sla\_risk\_score,

&#x20;               risk\_score,

&#x20;               x,

&#x20;               client\_risk=client\_risk

&#x20;           )

&#x20;       )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;       # DEBUG INFORMATION

&#x20;       # =====================================================



&#x20;       print()

&#x20;       print("==============================")

&#x20;       print("FINAL PREDICTION")

&#x20;       print("==============================")



print(

&#x20;           "ML Predicted Rating:",

&#x20;           int(

&#x20;               np.argmax(

&#x20;                   ml\_rating\_probabilities

&#x20;               )

&#x20;           )

&#x20;       )



print(

&#x20;           "Client Adjusted Rating:",

&#x20;           pred\_rating

&#x20;       )



print(

&#x20;           "Client Risk:",

&#x20;           round(

&#x20;               client\_risk,

&#x20;               4

&#x20;           )

&#x20;       )



print(

&#x20;           "Rating Risk:",

&#x20;           risk\_score

&#x20;       )



print(

&#x20;           "SLA Risk:",

&#x20;           sla\_risk\_score

&#x20;       )



print(

&#x20;           "Client Bad Rate:",

&#x20;           input\_df\[

\# =========================================================

&#x20;   # COMMENT GENERATION

&#x20;   def \_generate\_comment(

&#x20;       self,

&#x20;       rating,

&#x20;       sla\_risk,

&#x20;       risk,

&#x20;       x,

&#x20;       client\_risk=0.0

&#x20;   ):



&#x20;       msg = \[]



\# =====================================================

&#x20;       # CLIENT RISK OVERRIDE

&#x20;       # =====================================================

&#x20;       #

&#x20;       # The comment must reflect client risk.

&#x20;       #

&#x20;       # This prevents:

&#x20;       #

&#x20;       # 100% bad client

&#x20;       # ->

&#x20;       # "Excellent service."

&#x20;       #

&#x20;       # even if the raw ML model originally selected 6.

&#x20;       # =====================================================



&#x20;       if client\_risk >= 0.90:



&#x20;           msg.append(

&#x20;               "High-risk customer with a strong "

&#x20;               "history of poor outcomes."

&#x20;           )



elif client\_risk >= 0.70:



&#x20;           msg.append(

&#x20;               "Customer shows a high level of "

&#x20;               "historical service risk."

&#x20;           )



elif client\_risk >= 0.50:



&#x20;           msg.append(

&#x20;               "Customer shows moderate service risk."

&#x20;           )



else:



&#x20;           # =================================================

&#x20;           # RATING 0-6

&#x20;           # =================================================



&#x20;           if rating == 6:



&#x20;               msg.append(

&#x20;                   "Excellent service."

&#x20;               )



&#x20;           elif rating == 5:



&#x20;               msg.append(

&#x20;                   "Very good service."

&#x20;               )



&#x20;           elif rating == 4:



&#x20;               msg.append(

&#x20;                   "Positive service."

&#x20;               )



&#x20;           elif rating == 3:



&#x20;               msg.append(

&#x20;                   "Average service."

&#x20;               )



&#x20;           elif rating == 2:



&#x20;               msg.append(

&#x20;                   "Service quality issue."

&#x20;               )



&#x20;           elif rating == 1:



&#x20;               msg.append(

&#x20;                   "Poor service experience."

&#x20;               )



&#x20;           else:



&#x20;               msg.append(

&#x20;                   "Severe dissatisfaction."

&#x20;               )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;       # HISTORICAL COMMENTS

&#x20;       # =====================================================



&#x20;       context\_comments = (

&#x20;           self.\_get\_top\_comments\_dynamic(

&#x20;               rating,

&#x20;               x,

&#x20;               top\_k=20

&#x20;           )

&#x20;       )



if context\_comments:



&#x20;           ai\_summary = (

&#x20;               self.\_generate\_ai\_summary(

&#x20;                   context\_comments,

&#x20;                   rating

&#x20;               )

&#x20;           )



if ai\_summary:



&#x20;               msg.append(

&#x20;                   ai\_summary

&#x20;               )



example\_block = \[

&#x20;               "Examples of similar feedback:"

&#x20;           ]



example\_block.extend(



&#x20;               \[

&#x20;                   f"{i}. {c}"



&#x20;                   for i, c in enumerate(

&#x20;                       context\_comments\[:5],

&#x20;                       1

&#x20;                   )



&#x20;               ]



&#x20;           )



msg.append(

&#x20;               "\\n".join(

&#x20;                   example\_block

&#x20;               )

&#x20;           )



else:



&#x20;           msg.append(

&#x20;               "No historical patterns found; "

&#x20;               "using client risk and operational signals."

&#x20;           )



return "\\n\\n".join(

&#x20;           msg

&#x20;       )



\# =========================================================

&#x20;   # TOP COMMENTS

&#x20;   # =========================================================



&#x20;   def \_get\_top\_comments\_dynamic(

&#x20;       self,

&#x20;       rating,

&#x20;       x,

&#x20;       top\_k=5

&#x20;   ):



&#x20;       if self.comment\_df is None:



&#x20;           return \[]



df = self.comment\_df.copy()



df\["final\_rating"] = (

&#x20;           pd.to\_numeric(

&#x20;               df\["final\_rating"],

&#x20;               errors="coerce"

&#x20;           )

&#x20;       )



df = df\[

&#x20;           df\["final\_rating"] == rating

&#x20;       ]



if len(df) == 0:



&#x20;           return \[]



priority\_fields = \[



&#x20;           "hotel",

&#x20;           "meal",

&#x20;           "market\_segment",

&#x20;           "distribution\_channel",

&#x20;           "deposit\_type",

&#x20;           "customer\_type",

&#x20;           "season\_group",

&#x20;           "country\_group",

&#x20;           "adr\_group",

&#x20;           "previous\_cancellations\_group",

&#x20;           "days\_in\_waiting\_list\_group",

&#x20;           "guest\_group"



&#x20;       ]



filtered = df



for field in priority\_fields:



&#x20;           if field not in filtered.columns:



&#x20;               continue



value = x.get(

&#x20;               field

&#x20;           )



if value in \[

&#x20;               None,

&#x20;               "",

&#x20;               "unknown"

&#x20;           ]:



&#x20;               continue



tmp = filtered\[

&#x20;               filtered\[field].astype(str)

&#x20;               ==

&#x20;               str(value)

&#x20;           ]



if len(tmp) > 0:



&#x20;               filtered = tmp



comments = (

&#x20;           filtered\["comment"]

&#x20;           .dropna()

&#x20;           .astype(str)

&#x20;       )



comments = comments\[

&#x20;           comments.apply(

&#x20;               is\_valid\_comment

&#x20;           )

&#x20;       ]



comments = (

&#x20;           comments

&#x20;           .value\_counts()

&#x20;           .index

&#x20;           .tolist()

&#x20;       )



if len(comments) == 0:



&#x20;           comments = (

&#x20;               df\["comment"]

&#x20;               .dropna()

&#x20;               .astype(str)

&#x20;           )



comments = comments\[

&#x20;               comments.apply(

&#x20;                   is\_valid\_comment

&#x20;               )

&#x20;           ]



comments = (

&#x20;               comments

&#x20;               .value\_counts()

&#x20;               .index

&#x20;               .tolist()

&#x20;           )



return comments\[:top\_k]



\# =========================================================

&#x20;   # AI SUMMARY

&#x20;   # =========================================================



&#x20;   def \_generate\_ai\_summary(

&#x20;       self,

&#x20;       comments,

&#x20;       rating

&#x20;   ):



&#x20;       if not comments:



&#x20;           return None



try:



&#x20;           corpus = \[



&#x20;               str(x).lower()



&#x20;               for x in comments\[:30]



&#x20;           ]



vectorizer = CountVectorizer(



&#x20;               stop\_words="english",



&#x20;               ngram\_range=(2, 3),



&#x20;               max\_features=50,



&#x20;               min\_df=2



&#x20;           )



X = vectorizer.fit\_transform(

&#x20;               corpus

&#x20;           )



phrases = (

&#x20;               vectorizer

&#x20;               .get\_feature\_names\_out()

&#x20;           )



freq = np.asarray(

&#x20;               X.sum(

&#x20;                   axis=0

&#x20;               )

&#x20;           ).ravel()



df\_kw = pd.DataFrame({



&#x20;               "phrase": phrases,



&#x20;               "freq": freq



&#x20;           })



def is\_valid\_phrase(p):



&#x20;               words = p.split()



if len(set(words)) == 1:



&#x20;                   return False



if len(words) == 1:



&#x20;                   return False



if any(



&#x20;                   w in \[

&#x20;                       "service",

&#x20;                       "customer"

&#x20;                   ]



&#x20;                   for w in words



&#x20;               ):



&#x20;                   return False



return True



df\_kw = df\_kw\[

&#x20;               df\_kw\["phrase"].apply(

&#x20;                   is\_valid\_phrase

&#x20;               )

&#x20;           ]



df\_kw = df\_kw.sort\_values(

&#x20;               "freq",

&#x20;               ascending=False

&#x20;           )



top\_phrases = (

&#x20;               df\_kw\[

&#x20;                   "phrase"

&#x20;               ]

&#x20;               .head(5)

&#x20;               .tolist()

&#x20;           )



if not top\_phrases:



&#x20;               return None



keyword\_text = (

&#x20;               "; ".join(

&#x20;                   top\_phrases

&#x20;               )

&#x20;           )

&#x20;           if rating == 0:

elif rating == 1:

What this fixes



For your current example:



client\_segment: high-risk

is\_top\_bad\_client: 1.0

client\_bad\_rate: 1.0

hotel: city hotel

country\_group: local

adr\_group: Low value (≤100)

everything else: unknown



the model calculates the client risk approximately as:



bad rate       = 100%

top bad client = 100%

high-risk      = 100%



client risk ≈ 100%



That signal is then independently blended into the rating prediction.



So you should not get:



Customer Rating: 6 / 6

Rating Level: Excellent



for this client merely because the other booking fields are unknown.



You should instead see the debug section something like:



==============================

CLIENT RISK SIGNAL

==============================

Client Segment: high-risk

Client Bad Rate: 1.0

Top Bad Client: 1.0

Calculated Client Risk: 0.75



or higher depending on the exact calculation.



And:



==============================

FINAL PREDICTION

==============================

ML Predicted Rating: 6

Client Adjusted Rating: 0/1/2/3

Client Risk: ...



The Client Adjusted Rating is the rating that the UI receives.



The reservation-status problem is also fixed



Your log currently says:



STATUS MODEL CLASSES: \['0.0', '1.0', '2.0']



STATUS MODEL RAW PROBABILITIES:

\[8.35715457e-11 1.35631309e-02 9.86436869e-01]



but then:



STATUS MAPPED PROBABILITIES:

Cancellation: 0.0

Check-Out: 0.0

No-Show: 0.0



That is definitely wrong.



The new code explicitly handles:



0.0 → Cancellation

1.0 → Check-Out

2.0 → No-Show



Therefore the same raw probabilities will become approximately:



Cancellation: 0.0%

Check-Out: 1.4%

No-Show: 98.6%



instead of all three becoming zero.



One important step after changing model.py



You must retrain the model.



Do not simply restart app.py and use the existing:



service\_model.pkl



because that file contains the old ServiceModel.



Delete/recreate the trained artifacts according to your existing training flow, or force initialize\_training() to retrain.



In particular, the new model.py needs to generate a new:



service\_model.pkl



Then test the two cases separately.



Test 1 — bad client



client\_bad\_rate = 1.0

is\_top\_bad\_client = 1

client\_segment = high-risk



with most booking fields:



unknown



Expected direction:



Rating → poor/low range

Comment → poor/high-risk range

Customer Risk → high



Test 2 — normal client



client\_bad\_rate = 0.0

is\_top\_bad\_client = 0

client\_segment = low-risk



with the same booking fields unknown.



Expected direction:



Rating → can be positive

Comment → can be positive

Customer Risk → lower



This is the important distinction: unknown booking information no longer means "excellent". Unknown means the booking fields provide little/no additional information, while the client information supplied by predict\_page.py remains an independent signal.
