&#x20;       self.df\_reference = None



&#x20;       # ---------------------------------------------

&#x20;       # COMMENT MODEL

&#x20;       # ---------------------------------------------



&#x20;       self.comment\_df = None

&#x20;       self.comment\_index = {}



&#x20;       self.comment\_tfidf = None

&#x20;       self.comment\_svd = None



&#x20;       # ---------------------------------------------

&#x20;       # RESERVATION STATUS MODEL

&#x20;       # ---------------------------------------------



&#x20;       self.status\_model = None

&#x20;       self.status\_preprocess = None



&#x20;       self.status\_features = \[]

&#x20;       self.status\_numeric\_features = \[]

&#x20;       self.status\_categorical\_features = \[]



&#x20;       # IMPORTANT:

&#x20;       #

&#x20;       # Feature Engineering encodes:

&#x20;       #

&#x20;       # 0 -> canceled

&#x20;       # 1 -> check-out

&#x20;       # 2 -> no-show

&#x20;       #

&#x20;       self.status\_class\_mapping = {



&#x20;           0: "canceled",



&#x20;           1: "check-out",



&#x20;           2: "no-show"



&#x20;       }



&#x20;       # ---------------------------------------------

&#x20;       # RATING FEATURES

&#x20;       # ---------------------------------------------



&#x20;       self.rating\_features = \[]



\# =========================================================

&#x20;   # TRAIN

&#x20;   # =========================================================



&#x20;   def train(

&#x20;       self,

&#x20;       train\_df,

&#x20;       val\_df,

&#x20;       test\_df

&#x20;   ):



&#x20;       train\_df = train\_df.copy()

&#x20;       val\_df = val\_df.copy()

&#x20;       test\_df = test\_df.copy()



\# =====================================================

&#x20;       # ENSURE COMMENT

&#x20;       # =====================================================



&#x20;       for data in \[

&#x20;           train\_df,

&#x20;           val\_df,

&#x20;           test\_df

&#x20;       ]:



&#x20;           if "comment" not in data.columns:



&#x20;               data\["comment"] = ""



&#x20;           data\["comment"] = (

&#x20;               data\["comment"]

&#x20;               .fillna("")

&#x20;               .astype(str)

&#x20;           )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;       # RATING FEATURES

&#x20;       #

&#x20;       # FINAL RATING MODEL

&#x20;       # TARGET = final\_rating

&#x20;       # =====================================================



&#x20;       rating\_features = \[



&#x20;           "hotel",

&#x20;           "meal",

&#x20;           "market\_segment",

&#x20;           "distribution\_channel",

&#x20;           "deposit\_type",

&#x20;           "customer\_type",

&#x20;           "season\_group",

&#x20;           "country\_group",

&#x20;           "adr\_group",

&#x20;           "previous\_cancellations\_group",

&#x20;           "days\_in\_waiting\_list\_group",

&#x20;           "guest\_group",

&#x20;           "client\_segment",

&#x20;           "is\_top\_bad\_client",

&#x20;           "client\_bad\_rate",

&#x20;           "reservation\_status",

&#x20;           "is\_canceled"



&#x20;       ]



&#x20;       self.rating\_features = rating\_features.copy()



\# =====================================================

&#x20;       # STATUS FEATURES

&#x20;       #

&#x20;       # RESERVATION STATUS MODEL

&#x20;       # TARGET = reservation\_status

&#x20;       #

&#x20;       # IMPORTANT:

&#x20;       # reservation\_status itself is NOT an input feature.

&#x20;       #

&#x20;       # Otherwise the model would be given its own answer.

&#x20;       # =====================================================



&#x20;       status\_features = \[



&#x20;           "hotel",

&#x20;           "meal",

&#x20;           "market\_segment",

&#x20;           "distribution\_channel",

&#x20;           "deposit\_type",

&#x20;           "customer\_type",

&#x20;           "season\_group",

&#x20;           "country\_group",

&#x20;           "adr\_group",

&#x20;           "previous\_cancellations\_group",

&#x20;           "days\_in\_waiting\_list\_group",

&#x20;           "guest\_group",

&#x20;           "client\_segment",

&#x20;           "is\_top\_bad\_client",

&#x20;           "client\_bad\_rate",

&#x20;           "is\_canceled"



&#x20;       ]



&#x20;       self.status\_features = status\_features.copy()



\# =====================================================

&#x20;       # ENSURE FEATURES EXIST

&#x20;       # =====================================================



&#x20;       for data in \[

&#x20;           train\_df,

&#x20;           val\_df,

&#x20;           test\_df

&#x20;       ]:



&#x20;           for col in rating\_features:



&#x20;               if col not in data.columns:



&#x20;                   if col in \[

&#x20;                       "is\_top\_bad\_client",

&#x20;                       "client\_bad\_rate",

&#x20;                       "is\_canceled"

&#x20;                   ]:



&#x20;                       data\[col] = 0



&#x20;                   else:



&#x20;                       data\[col] = "unknown"



for col in status\_features:



&#x20;               if col not in data.columns:



&#x20;                   if col in \[

&#x20;                       "is\_top\_bad\_client",

&#x20;                       "client\_bad\_rate",

&#x20;                       "is\_canceled"

&#x20;                   ]:



&#x20;                       data\[col] = 0



&#x20;                   else:



&#x20;                       data\[col] = "unknown"



\# =====================================================

&#x20;       # NORMALISE NUMERIC FEATURES

&#x20;       # =====================================================



&#x20;       numeric\_columns = \[



&#x20;           "is\_top\_bad\_client",

&#x20;           "client\_bad\_rate",

&#x20;           "is\_canceled"



&#x20;       ]



for data in \[

&#x20;           train\_df,

&#x20;           val\_df,

&#x20;           test\_df

&#x20;       ]:



&#x20;           for col in numeric\_columns:



&#x20;               data\[col] = pd.to\_numeric(

&#x20;                   data\[col],

&#x20;                   errors="coerce"

&#x20;               )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;       # CLIENT BAD RATE

&#x20;       #

&#x20;       # Do NOT blindly make every missing value 0.

&#x20;       #

&#x20;       # Use training median as fallback.

&#x20;       # =====================================================



&#x20;       client\_bad\_rate\_median = (

&#x20;           train\_df\["client\_bad\_rate"]

&#x20;           .median()

&#x20;       )



&#x20;       if pd.isna(client\_bad\_rate\_median):



&#x20;           client\_bad\_rate\_median = 0.0



for data in \[

&#x20;           train\_df,

&#x20;           val\_df,

&#x20;           test\_df

&#x20;       ]:



&#x20;           data\["client\_bad\_rate"] = (

&#x20;               data\["client\_bad\_rate"]

&#x20;               .fillna(

&#x20;                   client\_bad\_rate\_median

&#x20;               )

&#x20;           )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;       # NORMALISE IS CANCELED

&#x20;       # =====================================================



&#x20;       for data in \[

&#x20;           train\_df,

&#x20;           val\_df,

&#x20;           test\_df

&#x20;       ]:



&#x20;           data\["is\_canceled"] = (

&#x20;               data\["is\_canceled"]

&#x20;               .fillna(0)

&#x20;               .clip(0, 1)

&#x20;           )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;       # COMMENT TOPIC LEARNING

&#x20;       # =====================================================



&#x20;       print()

&#x20;       print("==============================")

&#x20;       print("COMMENT TOPIC LEARNING")

&#x20;       print("==============================")



self.comment\_tfidf = TfidfVectorizer(

&#x20;           max\_features=5000,

&#x20;           ngram\_range=(1, 2),

&#x20;           min\_df=3

&#x20;       )



self.comment\_svd = TruncatedSVD(

&#x20;           n\_components=30,

&#x20;           random\_state=42

&#x20;       )



print(

&#x20;           "Fitting comment TF-IDF on training data..."

&#x20;       )



train\_comment\_tfidf = (

&#x20;           self.comment\_tfidf.fit\_transform(

&#x20;               train\_df\["comment"]

&#x20;           )

&#x20;       )



print(

&#x20;           "Fitting comment SVD on training data..."

&#x20;       )



train\_comment\_features\_array = (

&#x20;           self.comment\_svd.fit\_transform(

&#x20;               train\_comment\_tfidf

&#x20;           )

&#x20;       )



val\_comment\_tfidf = (

&#x20;           self.comment\_tfidf.transform(

&#x20;               val\_df\["comment"]

&#x20;           )

&#x20;       )



val\_comment\_features\_array = (

&#x20;           self.comment\_svd.transform(

&#x20;               val\_comment\_tfidf

&#x20;           )

&#x20;       )



test\_comment\_tfidf = (

&#x20;           self.comment\_tfidf.transform(

&#x20;               test\_df\["comment"]

&#x20;           )

&#x20;       )



test\_comment\_features\_array = (

&#x20;           self.comment\_svd.transform(

&#x20;               test\_comment\_tfidf

&#x20;           )

&#x20;       )



comment\_columns = \[



&#x20;           f"comment\_topic\_{i}"



&#x20;           for i in range(

&#x20;               train\_comment\_features\_array.shape\[1]

&#x20;           )



&#x20;       ]



train\_comment\_features = pd.DataFrame(

&#x20;           train\_comment\_features\_array,

&#x20;           columns=comment\_columns,

&#x20;           index=train\_df.index

&#x20;       )



val\_comment\_features = pd.DataFrame(

&#x20;           val\_comment\_features\_array,

&#x20;           columns=comment\_columns,

&#x20;           index=val\_df.index

&#x20;       )



test\_comment\_features = pd.DataFrame(

&#x20;           test\_comment\_features\_array,

&#x20;           columns=comment\_columns,

&#x20;           index=test\_df.index

&#x20;       )



train\_df = pd.concat(

&#x20;           \[

&#x20;               train\_df,

&#x20;               train\_comment\_features

&#x20;           ],

&#x20;           axis=1

&#x20;       )



val\_df = pd.concat(

&#x20;           \[

&#x20;               val\_df,

&#x20;               val\_comment\_features

&#x20;           ],

&#x20;           axis=1

&#x20;       )



test\_df = pd.concat(

&#x20;           \[

&#x20;               test\_df,

&#x20;               test\_comment\_features

&#x20;           ],

&#x20;           axis=1

&#x20;       )



rating\_features\_with\_comments = (

&#x20;           rating\_features +

&#x20;           comment\_columns

&#x20;       )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;       # FINAL RATING TARGET

&#x20;       # =====================================================



&#x20;       y\_train = (

&#x20;           pd.to\_numeric(

&#x20;               train\_df\["final\_rating"],

&#x20;               errors="coerce"

&#x20;           )

&#x20;           .fillna(0)

&#x20;           .astype(int)

&#x20;       )



&#x20;       y\_val = (

&#x20;           pd.to\_numeric(

&#x20;               val\_df\["final\_rating"],

&#x20;               errors="coerce"

&#x20;           )

&#x20;           .fillna(0)

&#x20;           .astype(int)

&#x20;       )



&#x20;       y\_test = (

&#x20;           pd.to\_numeric(

&#x20;               test\_df\["final\_rating"],

&#x20;               errors="coerce"

&#x20;           )

&#x20;           .fillna(0)

&#x20;           .astype(int)

&#x20;       )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;       # RESERVATION STATUS TARGET

&#x20;       #

&#x20;       # Feature Engineering mapping:

&#x20;       #

&#x20;       # 0 -> canceled

&#x20;       # 1 -> check-out

&#x20;       # 2 -> no-show

&#x20;       #

&#x20;       # Keep the encoded target as strings because that is

&#x20;       # what the existing trained status model expects.

&#x20;       # =====================================================



&#x20;       y\_status\_train = (

&#x20;           train\_df\["reservation\_status"]

&#x20;           .fillna("unknown")

&#x20;           .astype(str)

&#x20;           .str.strip()

&#x20;       )



&#x20;       y\_status\_val = (

&#x20;           val\_df\["reservation\_status"]

&#x20;           .fillna("unknown")

&#x20;           .astype(str)

&#x20;           .str.strip()

&#x20;       )



&#x20;       y\_status\_test = (

&#x20;           test\_df\["reservation\_status"]

&#x20;           .fillna("unknown")

&#x20;           .astype(str)

&#x20;           .str.strip()

&#x20;       )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;       # RATING INPUT

&#x20;       # =====================================================



&#x20;       X\_train = train\_df\[

&#x20;           \["comment"] +

&#x20;           rating\_features\_with\_comments

&#x20;       ]



&#x20;       X\_val = val\_df\[

&#x20;           \["comment"] +

&#x20;           rating\_features\_with\_comments

&#x20;       ]



&#x20;       X\_test = test\_df\[

&#x20;           \["comment"] +

&#x20;           rating\_features\_with\_comments

&#x20;       ]



\# =====================================================

&#x20;       # CLASS WEIGHTS

&#x20;       # =====================================================



&#x20;       classes = np.unique(

&#x20;           y\_train

&#x20;       )



class\_weights = compute\_class\_weight(

&#x20;           class\_weight="balanced",

&#x20;           classes=classes,

&#x20;           y=y\_train

&#x20;       )



class\_weight\_dict = dict(

&#x20;           zip(

&#x20;               classes,

&#x20;               class\_weights

&#x20;           )

&#x20;       )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;       # TEXT PIPELINE

&#x20;       # =====================================================



&#x20;       text\_pipeline = Pipeline(\[



&#x20;           (

&#x20;               "hash",

&#x20;               HashingVectorizer(

&#x20;                   n\_features=2\*\*16,

&#x20;                   alternate\_sign=False,

&#x20;                   ngram\_range=(1, 2)

&#x20;               )

&#x20;           ),



&#x20;           (

&#x20;               "tfidf",

&#x20;               TfidfTransformer()

&#x20;           )



&#x20;       ])



\# =====================================================

&#x20;       # RATING PREPROCESSOR

&#x20;       # =====================================================



&#x20;       rating\_preprocess = ColumnTransformer(\[



&#x20;           (

&#x20;               "text",

&#x20;               text\_pipeline,

&#x20;               "comment"

&#x20;           ),



&#x20;           (

&#x20;               "cat",

&#x20;               OneHotEncoder(

&#x20;                   handle\_unknown="ignore"

&#x20;               ),

&#x20;               \[

&#x20;                   c

&#x20;                   for c in rating\_features\_with\_comments

&#x20;                   if c not in \[

&#x20;                       "is\_top\_bad\_client",

&#x20;                       "client\_bad\_rate",

&#x20;                       "is\_canceled"

&#x20;                   ]

&#x20;               ]

&#x20;           ),



&#x20;           (

&#x20;               "num",

&#x20;               "passthrough",

&#x20;               \[

&#x20;                   c

&#x20;                   for c in rating\_features\_with\_comments

&#x20;                   if c in \[

&#x20;                       "is\_top\_bad\_client",

&#x20;                       "client\_bad\_rate",

&#x20;                       "is\_canceled"

&#x20;                   ]

&#x20;               ]

&#x20;           )



&#x20;       ])



\# =====================================================

&#x20;       # FINAL RATING MODELS

&#x20;       # =====================================================



&#x20;       models = {



&#x20;           "Logistic Regression": Pipeline(\[



&#x20;               (

&#x20;                   "prep",

&#x20;                   rating\_preprocess

&#x20;               ),



&#x20;               (

&#x20;                   "clf",

&#x20;                   LogisticRegression(

&#x20;                       solver="saga",

&#x20;                       max\_iter=300,

&#x20;                       tol=1e-2,

&#x20;                       class\_weight=class\_weight\_dict,

&#x20;                       n\_jobs=-1,

&#x20;                   )

&#x20;               )



&#x20;           ]),



"Linear SVC": Pipeline(\[



&#x20;               (

&#x20;                   "prep",

&#x20;                   rating\_preprocess

&#x20;               ),



&#x20;               (

&#x20;                   "clf",

&#x20;                   LinearSVC(

&#x20;                       class\_weight=class\_weight\_dict,

&#x20;                       max\_iter=2000,

&#x20;                       tol=1e-2,

&#x20;                       dual=False

&#x20;                   )

&#x20;               )



&#x20;           ]),



"LightGBM": Pipeline(\[



&#x20;               (

&#x20;                   "prep",

&#x20;                   rating\_preprocess

&#x20;               ),



&#x20;               (

&#x20;                   "clf",

&#x20;                   LGBMClassifier(

&#x20;                       n\_estimators=300,

&#x20;                       learning\_rate=0.05,

&#x20;                       num\_leaves=31,

&#x20;                       class\_weight=class\_weight\_dict,

&#x20;                       random\_state=42,

&#x20;                       verbosity=-1

&#x20;                   )

&#x20;               )



&#x20;           ])



&#x20;       }



self.models = models



\# =====================================================

&#x20;       # TRAIN RATING MODELS

&#x20;       # =====================================================



&#x20;       print()

&#x20;       print("==============================")

&#x20;       print("FINAL RATING MODEL TRAINING")

&#x20;       print("==============================")



for name, model in models.items():



&#x20;           print(

&#x20;               f"Training {name}..."

&#x20;           )



&#x20;           model.fit(

&#x20;               X\_train,

&#x20;               y\_train

&#x20;           )



&#x20;           print(

&#x20;               f"{name} completed."

&#x20;           )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;       # RESERVATION STATUS MODEL

&#x20;       #

&#x20;       # COMPLETELY SEPARATE MODEL

&#x20;       # =====================================================



&#x20;       print()

&#x20;       print("==============================")

&#x20;       print("RESERVATION STATUS TRAINING")

&#x20;       print("==============================")



status\_numeric\_features = \[



&#x20;           "is\_top\_bad\_client",

&#x20;           "client\_bad\_rate",

&#x20;           "is\_canceled"



&#x20;       ]



status\_categorical\_features = \[



&#x20;           c

&#x20;           for c in status\_features

&#x20;           if c not in status\_numeric\_features



&#x20;       ]



self.status\_numeric\_features = (

&#x20;           status\_numeric\_features

&#x20;       )



&#x20;       self.status\_categorical\_features = (

&#x20;           status\_categorical\_features

&#x20;       )



status\_preprocess = ColumnTransformer(\[



&#x20;           (

&#x20;               "text",

&#x20;               text\_pipeline,

&#x20;               "comment"

&#x20;           ),



&#x20;           (

&#x20;               "cat",

&#x20;               OneHotEncoder(

&#x20;                   handle\_unknown="ignore"

&#x20;               ),

&#x20;               status\_categorical\_features

&#x20;           ),



&#x20;           (

&#x20;               "num",

&#x20;               "passthrough",

&#x20;               status\_numeric\_features

&#x20;           )



&#x20;       ])



X\_train\_status = train\_df\[

&#x20;           \["comment"] +

&#x20;           status\_features

&#x20;       ]



&#x20;       X\_val\_status = val\_df\[

&#x20;           \["comment"] +

&#x20;           status\_features

&#x20;       ]



&#x20;       X\_test\_status = test\_df\[

&#x20;           \["comment"] +

&#x20;           status\_features

&#x20;       ]



X\_train\_status\_processed = (

&#x20;           status\_preprocess.fit\_transform(

&#x20;               X\_train\_status

&#x20;           )

&#x20;       )



X\_val\_status\_processed = (

&#x20;           status\_preprocess.transform(

&#x20;               X\_val\_status

&#x20;           )

&#x20;       )



X\_test\_status\_processed = (

&#x20;           status\_preprocess.transform(

&#x20;               X\_test\_status

&#x20;           )

&#x20;       )



self.status\_model = LogisticRegression(



&#x20;           solver="saga",



&#x20;           max\_iter=100,



&#x20;           tol=1e-2,



&#x20;           class\_weight="balanced",



&#x20;           n\_jobs=-1



&#x20;       )



print(

&#x20;           "Training Reservation Status Model..."

&#x20;       )



self.status\_model.fit(

&#x20;           X\_train\_status\_processed,

&#x20;           y\_status\_train

&#x20;       )



self.status\_preprocess = (

&#x20;           status\_preprocess

&#x20;       )



print(

&#x20;           "Reservation Status Model completed."

&#x20;       )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;       # STATUS EVALUATION

&#x20;       # =====================================================



&#x20;       status\_preds = (

&#x20;           self.status\_model.predict(

&#x20;               X\_test\_status\_processed

&#x20;           )

&#x20;       )



print()

&#x20;       print("==============================")

&#x20;       print("RESERVATION STATUS EVALUATION")

&#x20;       print("==============================")



print(

&#x20;           classification\_report(

&#x20;               y\_status\_test,

&#x20;               status\_preds,

&#x20;               zero\_division=0

&#x20;           )

&#x20;       )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;       # VALIDATION

&#x20;       # =====================================================



&#x20;       print()

&#x20;       print("==============================")

&#x20;       print("FINAL RATING VALIDATION")

&#x20;       print("==============================")



validation\_results = \[]



for name, model in models.items():



&#x20;           preds = model.predict(

&#x20;               X\_val

&#x20;           )



f1 = f1\_score(

&#x20;               y\_val,

&#x20;               preds,

&#x20;               average="weighted"

&#x20;           )



try:



&#x20;               clf = model.named\_steps\["clf"]



if hasattr(

&#x20;                   clf,

&#x20;                   "predict\_proba"

&#x20;               ):



&#x20;                   probs = model.predict\_proba(

&#x20;                       X\_val

&#x20;                   )



&#x20;               else:



&#x20;                   scores = model.decision\_function(

&#x20;                       X\_val

&#x20;                   )



&#x20;                   scores = np.asarray(

&#x20;                       scores

&#x20;                   )



if scores.ndim == 1:



&#x20;                       scores = np.column\_stack(

&#x20;                           \[

&#x20;                               -scores,

&#x20;                               scores

&#x20;                           ]

&#x20;                       )



exp = np.exp(

&#x20;                       scores -

&#x20;                       np.max(

&#x20;                           scores,

&#x20;                           axis=1,

&#x20;                           keepdims=True

&#x20;                       )

&#x20;                   )



&#x20;                   probs = (

&#x20;                       exp /

&#x20;                       exp.sum(

&#x20;                           axis=1,

&#x20;                           keepdims=True

&#x20;                       )

&#x20;                   )



roc = roc\_auc\_score(

&#x20;                   y\_val,

&#x20;                   probs,

&#x20;                   multi\_class="ovr",

&#x20;                   average="weighted"

&#x20;               )



&#x20;           except Exception as e:



&#x20;               print(

&#x20;                   f"\[WARNING] ROC-AUC failed "

&#x20;                   f"for {name}: {e}"

&#x20;               )



&#x20;               roc = 0.0



validation\_results.append({



&#x20;               "model": name,



&#x20;               "f1": f1,



&#x20;               "roc": roc



&#x20;           })



validation\_df = pd.DataFrame(

&#x20;           validation\_results

&#x20;       )



validation\_df\["final\_score"] = (



&#x20;           0.6 \*

&#x20;           validation\_df\["f1"]



&#x20;           +



&#x20;           0.4 \*

&#x20;           validation\_df\["roc"]



&#x20;       )



validation\_df = validation\_df.sort\_values(

&#x20;           "final\_score",

&#x20;           ascending=False

&#x20;       )



print(

&#x20;           validation\_df\[

&#x20;               \[

&#x20;                   "model",

&#x20;                   "f1",

&#x20;                   "roc",

&#x20;                   "final\_score"

&#x20;               ]

&#x20;           ].to\_string(

&#x20;               index=False

&#x20;           )

&#x20;       )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;       # BEST RATING MODEL

&#x20;       # =====================================================



&#x20;       self.best\_model\_name = (

&#x20;           validation\_df.iloc\[0]\["model"]

&#x20;       )



self.best\_model = (

&#x20;           self.models\[

&#x20;               self.best\_model\_name

&#x20;           ]

&#x20;       )



print(

&#x20;           "\\nBEST RATING MODEL SELECTED:",

&#x20;           self.best\_model\_name

&#x20;       )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;       # REFERENCE DATA

&#x20;       # =====================================================



&#x20;       self.df\_reference = pd.concat(

&#x20;           \[

&#x20;               train\_df,

&#x20;               val\_df,

&#x20;               test\_df

&#x20;           ],

&#x20;           axis=0

&#x20;       )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;       # COMMENT DATA

&#x20;       # =====================================================



&#x20;       reference\_df = self.df\_reference.copy()



self.comment\_df = reference\_df\[\[



&#x20;           "comment",

&#x20;           "hotel",

&#x20;           "meal",

&#x20;           "market\_segment",

&#x20;           "distribution\_channel",

&#x20;           "deposit\_type",

&#x20;           "customer\_type",

&#x20;           "season\_group",

&#x20;           "country\_group",

&#x20;           "adr\_group",

&#x20;           "previous\_cancellations\_group",

&#x20;           "days\_in\_waiting\_list\_group",

&#x20;           "guest\_group",

&#x20;           "final\_rating"



&#x20;       ]].copy()



\# =====================================================

&#x20;       # COMMENT INDEX

&#x20;       # =====================================================



&#x20;       self.comment\_index = {}



fields = \[



&#x20;           "hotel",

&#x20;           "meal",

&#x20;           "market\_segment",

&#x20;           "distribution\_channel",

&#x20;           "deposit\_type",

&#x20;           "customer\_type",

&#x20;           "season\_group",

&#x20;           "country\_group",

&#x20;           "adr\_group",

&#x20;           "previous\_cancellations\_group",

&#x20;           "days\_in\_waiting\_list\_group",

&#x20;           "guest\_group"



&#x20;       ]



for rating, df\_r in reference\_df.groupby(

&#x20;           "final\_rating"

&#x20;       ):



&#x20;           rating\_key = str(

&#x20;               rating

&#x20;           )



self.comment\_index\[

&#x20;               rating\_key

&#x20;           ] = {



&#x20;               "ALL":

&#x20;                   df\_r\[

&#x20;                       "comment"

&#x20;                   ].tolist(),



&#x20;               "FIELDS":

&#x20;                   {}



&#x20;           }



for field in fields:



&#x20;               if field not in df\_r.columns:

&#x20;                   continue



self.comment\_index\[

&#x20;                   rating\_key

&#x20;               ]\[

&#x20;                   "FIELDS"

&#x20;               ]\[field] = (



&#x20;                   df\_r

&#x20;                   .groupby(field)\["comment"]

&#x20;                   .apply(list)

&#x20;                   .to\_dict()



&#x20;               )



print(

&#x20;           "FAST COMMENT INDEX READY"

&#x20;       )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;       # SAVE

&#x20;       # =====================================================



&#x20;       self.\_save\_artifacts(

&#x20;           reference\_df

&#x20;       )



return reference\_df



\# =========================================================

&#x20;   # SAVE ARTIFACTS

&#x20;   # =========================================================



&#x20;   def \_save\_artifacts(

&#x20;       self,

&#x20;       df

&#x20;   ):



&#x20;       trained\_dir = self.config.get(

&#x20;           "trained\_dir",

&#x20;           "trained"

os.makedirs(

train\_path = self.config.get(

df.to\_parquet(

print(

&#x20;           f"\[INFO] Training data saved: "

&#x20;       )



model\_path = self.config.get(

&#x20;           os.path.join(

&#x20;               trained\_dir,

&#x20;               "service\_model.pkl"

&#x20;           )

&#x20;       )



joblib.dump(

&#x20;           self,

&#x20;           model\_path

&#x20;       )



print(

&#x20;           f"\[INFO] Service model saved: "

&#x20;       )



metadata\_path = self.config.get(

&#x20;       )



import json



metadata = {}



if os.path.exists(

&#x20;           metadata\_path

&#x20;       ):



&#x20;           with open(

&#x20;               metadata\_path,

&#x20;               "r"

&#x20;           ) as f:



&#x20;               metadata = json.load(

&#x20;                   f

&#x20;               )



metadata.update({



&#x20;           "model":

&#x20;               self.best\_model\_name,



&#x20;           "trained\_time":

&#x20;               datetime.now().isoformat(),



&#x20;           "rows":

&#x20;               len(df),



&#x20;           "columns":

&#x20;               list(df.columns)



&#x20;       })



with open(

&#x20;           metadata\_path,

&#x20;           "w"

&#x20;       ) as f:



&#x20;           json.dump(

&#x20;               metadata,

&#x20;               f,

&#x20;               indent=4

&#x20;           )



print(

&#x20;           f"\[INFO] Metadata updated: "

&#x20;           f"{metadata\_path}"

&#x20;       )



\# =========================================================

&#x20;   # SWITCH MODEL

&#x20;   # =========================================================



&#x20;   def set\_model(

&#x20;       self,

&#x20;       name: str

&#x20;   ):



&#x20;       if name in self.models:



&#x20;           self.best\_model\_name = name



&#x20;           self.best\_model = (

&#x20;               self.models\[name]

&#x20;           )



\# =========================================================

&#x20;   # NORMALISE INPUT

&#x20;   # =========================================================



&#x20;   def \_prepare\_input(

&#x20;       self,

&#x20;       x

&#x20;   ):



&#x20;       input\_df = pd.DataFrame(

&#x20;           \[x]

&#x20;       )



\# ---------------------------------------------

&#x20;       # Text

&#x20;       # ---------------------------------------------



&#x20;       if "comment" not in input\_df.columns:



&#x20;           input\_df\["comment"] = ""



input\_df\["comment"] = (

&#x20;           input\_df\["comment"]

&#x20;           .fillna("")

&#x20;           .astype(str)

&#x20;       )



\# ---------------------------------------------

&#x20;       # Categorical

&#x20;       #

&#x20;       # reservation\_status is included here because

&#x20;       # predict\_page.py may provide:

&#x20;       #

&#x20;       # canceled

&#x20;       # check-out

&#x20;       # no-show

&#x20;       # unknown

&#x20;       # ---------------------------------------------



&#x20;       categorical\_features = \[



&#x20;           "hotel",

&#x20;           "meal",

&#x20;           "market\_segment",

&#x20;           "distribution\_channel",

&#x20;           "deposit\_type",

&#x20;           "customer\_type",

&#x20;           "season\_group",

&#x20;           "country\_group",

&#x20;           "adr\_group",

&#x20;           "previous\_cancellations\_group",

&#x20;           "days\_in\_waiting\_list\_group",

&#x20;           "guest\_group",

&#x20;           "client\_segment",

&#x20;           "reservation\_status"



&#x20;       ]



for col in categorical\_features:



&#x20;           if col not in input\_df.columns:



&#x20;               input\_df\[col] = "unknown"



&#x20;           input\_df\[col] = (

&#x20;               input\_df\[col]

&#x20;               .fillna("unknown")

&#x20;               .astype(str)

&#x20;               .str.strip()

&#x20;           )



\# ---------------------------------------------

&#x20;       # Numeric

&#x20;       # ---------------------------------------------



&#x20;       if "is\_top\_bad\_client" not in input\_df.columns:



&#x20;           input\_df\["is\_top\_bad\_client"] = 0



if "is\_canceled" not in input\_df.columns:



&#x20;           input\_df\["is\_canceled"] = 0



if "client\_bad\_rate" not in input\_df.columns:



&#x20;           input\_df\["client\_bad\_rate"] = np.nan



input\_df\["is\_top\_bad\_client"] = (

&#x20;           pd.to\_numeric(

&#x20;               input\_df\["is\_top\_bad\_client"],

&#x20;               errors="coerce"

&#x20;           )

&#x20;           .fillna(0)

&#x20;           .clip(0, 1)

&#x20;       )



input\_df\["is\_canceled"] = (

&#x20;           pd.to\_numeric(

&#x20;               input\_df\["is\_canceled"],

&#x20;               errors="coerce"

&#x20;           )

&#x20;           .fillna(0)

&#x20;           .clip(0, 1)

&#x20;       )



\# ---------------------------------------------

&#x20;       # Client bad rate

&#x20;       # ---------------------------------------------



&#x20;       client\_bad\_rate = pd.to\_numeric(

&#x20;           input\_df\["client\_bad\_rate"],

&#x20;           errors="coerce"

&#x20;       )



if client\_bad\_rate.isna().all():



&#x20;           if self.df\_reference is not None and \\

&#x20;              "client\_bad\_rate" in self.df\_reference.columns:



&#x20;               fallback = pd.to\_numeric(

&#x20;                   self.df\_reference\[

&#x20;                       "client\_bad\_rate"

&#x20;                   ],

&#x20;                   errors="coerce"

&#x20;               ).median()



&#x20;               if pd.isna(fallback):



&#x20;                   fallback = 0.0



&#x20;           else:



&#x20;               fallback = 0.0



&#x20;           client\_bad\_rate = client\_bad\_rate.fillna(

&#x20;               fallback

&#x20;           )



&#x20;       else:



&#x20;           fallback = client\_bad\_rate.median()



&#x20;           if pd.isna(fallback):



&#x20;               fallback = 0.0



&#x20;           client\_bad\_rate = client\_bad\_rate.fillna(

&#x20;               fallback

&#x20;           )



input\_df\["client\_bad\_rate"] = (

&#x20;           client\_bad\_rate

&#x20;       )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;       # NORMALISE EXPLICIT RESERVATION STATUS

&#x20;       # =====================================================



&#x20;       reservation\_status = str(

&#x20;           input\_df\[

&#x20;               "reservation\_status"

&#x20;           ].iloc\[0]

&#x20;       ).strip().lower()



if reservation\_status in \[

&#x20;           "cancelled",

&#x20;           "canceled"

&#x20;       ]:



&#x20;           reservation\_status = "canceled"



elif reservation\_status in \[

&#x20;           "checkout",

&#x20;           "check out",

&#x20;           "check-out"

&#x20;       ]:



&#x20;           reservation\_status = "check-out"



elif reservation\_status in \[

&#x20;           "noshow",

&#x20;           "no show",

&#x20;           "no-show"

&#x20;       ]:



&#x20;           reservation\_status = "no-show"



elif reservation\_status in \[

&#x20;           "",

&#x20;           "nan",

&#x20;           "none",

&#x20;           "null",

&#x20;           "unknown"

&#x20;       ]:



&#x20;           reservation\_status = "unknown"



input\_df\[

&#x20;           "reservation\_status"

&#x20;       ] = reservation\_status



\# =====================================================

&#x20;       # KEEP STATUS SIGNAL CONSISTENT

&#x20;       #

&#x20;       # If the user explicitly says:

&#x20;       #

&#x20;       # reservation\_status = canceled

&#x20;       #

&#x20;       # then is\_canceled must be 1.

&#x20;       # =====================================================



&#x20;       if reservation\_status == "canceled":



&#x20;           input\_df\[

&#x20;               "is\_canceled"

&#x20;           ] = 1.0



return input\_df



\# =========================================================

&#x20;   # PREDICT

&#x20;   # =========================================================



&#x20;   def predict(

&#x20;       self,

&#x20;       x: dict

&#x20;   ):



&#x20;       # =====================================================

&#x20;       # PREPARE UI INPUT

&#x20;       # =====================================================



&#x20;       input\_df = self.\_prepare\_input(

&#x20;           x

&#x20;       )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;       # COMMENT TOPIC FEATURES

&#x20;       # =====================================================



&#x20;       if (

&#x20;           self.comment\_tfidf is None

&#x20;           or self.comment\_svd is None

&#x20;       ):



&#x20;           raise RuntimeError(

&#x20;               "Comment TF-IDF/SVD models are not available. "

&#x20;               "Please retrain the ServiceModel."

&#x20;           )



comment\_tfidf = (

&#x20;           self.comment\_tfidf.transform(

&#x20;               input\_df\["comment"]

&#x20;           )

&#x20;       )



comment\_features\_array = (

&#x20;           self.comment\_svd.transform(

&#x20;               comment\_tfidf

&#x20;           )

&#x20;       )



comment\_columns = \[



&#x20;           f"comment\_topic\_{i}"



&#x20;           for i in range(

&#x20;               comment\_features\_array.shape\[1]

&#x20;           )



&#x20;       ]



comment\_features = pd.DataFrame(



&#x20;           comment\_features\_array,



&#x20;           columns=comment\_columns,



&#x20;           index=input\_df.index



&#x20;       )



input\_df = pd.concat(

&#x20;           \[

&#x20;               input\_df,

&#x20;               comment\_features

&#x20;           ],

&#x20;           axis=1

&#x20;       )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;       # =====================================================

&#x20;       # PART 1

&#x20;       # FINAL RATING PREDICTION

&#x20;       # =====================================================

&#x20;       # =====================================================



&#x20;       rating\_features\_with\_comments = (



&#x20;           self.rating\_features +



&#x20;           comment\_columns



&#x20;       )



X\_rating = input\_df\[

&#x20;           \["comment"] +

&#x20;           rating\_features\_with\_comments

&#x20;       ]



pred\_rating = int(

&#x20;           self.best\_model.predict(

&#x20;               X\_rating

&#x20;           )\[0]

&#x20;       )



\# Make absolutely sure rating stays 0-6.



&#x20;       pred\_rating = int(

&#x20;           np.clip(

&#x20;               pred\_rating,

&#x20;               0,

&#x20;               6

&#x20;           )

&#x20;       )



clf = (

&#x20;           self.best\_model

&#x20;           .named\_steps\["clf"]

&#x20;       )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;       # RATING PROBABILITIES

&#x20;       # =====================================================



&#x20;       if hasattr(

&#x20;           clf,

&#x20;           "predict\_proba"

&#x20;       ):



&#x20;           rating\_probs = (

&#x20;               self.best\_model

&#x20;               .predict\_proba(

&#x20;                   X\_rating

&#x20;               )\[0]

&#x20;           )



&#x20;       else:



&#x20;           scores = (

&#x20;               self.best\_model

&#x20;               .decision\_function(

&#x20;                   X\_rating

&#x20;               )

&#x20;           )



scores = np.asarray(

&#x20;               scores

&#x20;           )



if scores.ndim == 2:



&#x20;               scores = scores\[0]



exp = np.exp(

&#x20;               scores -

&#x20;               np.max(scores)

&#x20;           )



rating\_probs = (

&#x20;               exp /

&#x20;               np.sum(exp)

&#x20;           )



rating\_class\_order = list(

&#x20;           clf.classes\_

&#x20;       )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;       # SLA RISK

&#x20;       #

&#x20;       # 0 = highest risk

&#x20;       # 6 = lowest risk

&#x20;       # =====================================================



&#x20;       risk\_weights = {



&#x20;           0: 1.00,

&#x20;           1: 0.90,

&#x20;           2: 0.75,

&#x20;           3: 0.60,

&#x20;           4: 0.40,

&#x20;           5: 0.20,

&#x20;           6: 0.00



&#x20;       }



sla\_risk = 0.0



for i, cls in enumerate(

&#x20;           rating\_class\_order

&#x20;       ):



&#x20;           if i >= len(

&#x20;               rating\_probs

&#x20;           ):



&#x20;               continue



try:



&#x20;               rating\_class = int(

&#x20;                   cls

&#x20;               )



&#x20;           except Exception:



&#x20;               continue



sla\_risk += (



&#x20;               rating\_probs\[i] \*



&#x20;               risk\_weights.get(

&#x20;                   rating\_class,

&#x20;                   0.50

&#x20;               )



&#x20;           )



sla\_risk\_score = round(

&#x20;           sla\_risk \* 100,

&#x20;           1

&#x20;       )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;       # CUSTOMER RISK SCORE

&#x20;       # =====================================================



&#x20;       rating\_risk\_map = {



&#x20;           0: 100,

&#x20;           1: 90,

&#x20;           2: 75,

&#x20;           3: 60,

&#x20;           4: 40,

&#x20;           5: 20,

&#x20;           6: 10



&#x20;       }



base\_risk = rating\_risk\_map.get(

&#x20;           pred\_rating,

&#x20;           50

&#x20;       )



risk\_score = round(



&#x20;           (

&#x20;               0.6 \*

&#x20;               base\_risk

&#x20;           )



&#x20;           +



&#x20;           (

&#x20;               0.4 \*

&#x20;               sla\_risk\_score

&#x20;           ),



&#x20;           1



&#x20;       )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;       # =====================================================

&#x20;       # PART 2

&#x20;       # RESERVATION STATUS PREDICTION

&#x20;       # =====================================================

&#x20;       # =====================================================



&#x20;       status\_input = input\_df\[



&#x20;           \[

&#x20;               "comment",

&#x20;               "hotel",

&#x20;               "meal",

&#x20;               "market\_segment",

&#x20;               "distribution\_channel",

&#x20;               "deposit\_type",

&#x20;               "customer\_type",

&#x20;               "season\_group",

&#x20;               "country\_group",

&#x20;               "adr\_group",

&#x20;               "previous\_cancellations\_group",

&#x20;               "days\_in\_waiting\_list\_group",

&#x20;               "guest\_group",

&#x20;               "client\_segment",

&#x20;               "is\_top\_bad\_client",

&#x20;               "client\_bad\_rate",

&#x20;               "is\_canceled"



&#x20;           ]



&#x20;       ]



\# =====================================================

&#x20;       # TRANSFORM USING STATUS MODEL PREPROCESSOR

&#x20;       # =====================================================



&#x20;       X\_status = (

&#x20;           self.status\_preprocess.transform(

&#x20;               status\_input

&#x20;           )

&#x20;       )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;       # STATUS MODEL PROBABILITIES

&#x20;       # =====================================================



&#x20;       status\_probs = (

&#x20;           self.status\_model

&#x20;           .predict\_proba(

&#x20;               X\_status

&#x20;           )\[0]

&#x20;       )



status\_classes = (

&#x20;           self.status\_model.classes\_

&#x20;       )



print()

&#x20;       print(

&#x20;           "STATUS MODEL CLASSES:",

&#x20;           list(status\_classes)

&#x20;       )



print(

&#x20;           "STATUS MODEL RAW PROBABILITIES:",

&#x20;           status\_probs

&#x20;       )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;       # INITIALISE ML PROBABILITIES

&#x20;       # =====================================================



&#x20;       ml\_prob\_canceled = 0.0



&#x20;       ml\_prob\_check\_out = 0.0



&#x20;       ml\_prob\_no\_show = 0.0



\# =====================================================

&#x20;       # MAP NUMERIC STATUS CLASSES

&#x20;       #

&#x20;       # 0 -> canceled

&#x20;       # 1 -> check-out

&#x20;       # 2 -> no-show

&#x20;       #

&#x20;       # IMPORTANT:

&#x20;       #

&#x20;       # classes\_ contains:

&#x20;       #

&#x20;       # \['0.0', '1.0', '2.0']

&#x20;       #

&#x20;       # NOT:

&#x20;       #

&#x20;       # \['canceled', 'check-out', 'no-show']

&#x20;       # =====================================================



&#x20;       for probability, cls in zip(

&#x20;           status\_probs,

&#x20;           status\_classes

&#x20;       ):



&#x20;           try:



&#x20;               status\_class = int(

&#x20;                   float(cls)

&#x20;               )



&#x20;           except Exception:



&#x20;               continue



probability = (

&#x20;               float(probability) \*

&#x20;               100.0

&#x20;           )



if status\_class == 0:



&#x20;               ml\_prob\_canceled = probability



elif status\_class == 1:



&#x20;               ml\_prob\_check\_out = probability



elif status\_class == 2:



&#x20;               ml\_prob\_no\_show = probability



\# =====================================================

&#x20;       # READ EXPLICIT INPUT SIGNALS

&#x20;       # =====================================================



&#x20;       reservation\_status\_input = str(

&#x20;           input\_df\[

&#x20;               "reservation\_status"

&#x20;           ].iloc\[0]

&#x20;       ).strip().lower()



is\_canceled\_value = float(

&#x20;           input\_df\[

&#x20;               "is\_canceled"

&#x20;           ].iloc\[0]

&#x20;       )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;       # DEBUG ML MAPPING

&#x20;       # =====================================================



&#x20;       print()

&#x20;       print(

&#x20;           "STATUS ML MAPPING:"

&#x20;       )



&#x20;       print(

&#x20;           "ML Cancellation:",

&#x20;           ml\_prob\_canceled

&#x20;       )



&#x20;       print(

&#x20;           "ML Check-Out:",

&#x20;           ml\_prob\_check\_out

&#x20;       )



&#x20;       print(

&#x20;           "ML No-Show:",

&#x20;           ml\_prob\_no\_show

&#x20;       )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;       # FINAL STATUS DECISION

&#x20;       #

&#x20;       # Priority:

&#x20;       #

&#x20;       # 1. is\_canceled = 1

&#x20;       # 2. explicit reservation\_status

&#x20;       # 3. ML prediction

&#x20;       #

&#x20;       # This prevents contradictory outputs.

&#x20;       # =====================================================



&#x20;       if is\_canceled\_value >= 1:



&#x20;           prob\_canceled = 100.0



&#x20;           prob\_check\_out = 0.0



&#x20;           prob\_no\_show = 0.0



elif reservation\_status\_input == "canceled":



&#x20;           prob\_canceled = 100.0



&#x20;           prob\_check\_out = 0.0



&#x20;           prob\_no\_show = 0.0



elif reservation\_status\_input == "check-out":



&#x20;           prob\_canceled = 0.0



&#x20;           prob\_check\_out = 100.0



&#x20;           prob\_no\_show = 0.0



elif reservation\_status\_input == "no-show":



&#x20;           prob\_canceled = 0.0



&#x20;           prob\_check\_out = 0.0



&#x20;           prob\_no\_show = 100.0



else:



&#x20;           prob\_canceled = ml\_prob\_canceled



&#x20;           prob\_check\_out = ml\_prob\_check\_out



&#x20;           prob\_no\_show = ml\_prob\_no\_show



\# =====================================================

&#x20;       # FINAL STATUS NORMALISATION

&#x20;       # =====================================================



&#x20;       status\_total = (



&#x20;           prob\_canceled +



&#x20;           prob\_check\_out +



&#x20;           prob\_no\_show



&#x20;       )

Yes. In predict\_page.py, the displayed dropdown values should be:



0 → Not Cancel



1 → Cancel



But the value sent to model.predict() must remain numeric 0 or 1, because your model uses is\_canceled as a numeric feature.



Use this pattern for the dropdown:



dcc.Dropdown(

&#x20;   id="is-canceled",

&#x20;   options=\[

&#x20;       {"label": "Not Cancel", "value": 0},

&#x20;       {"label": "Cancel", "value": 1}

&#x20;   ],

&#x20;   value=0,

&#x20;   clearable=False

)



If your current code has something like:



dcc.Dropdown(

&#x20;   id="is-canceled",

&#x20;   options=\[

&#x20;       {"label": "0", "value": 0},

&#x20;       {"label": "1", "value": 1}

&#x20;   ],

&#x20;   value=0

)



replace it with:



dcc.Dropdown(

&#x20;   id="is-canceled",

&#x20;   options=\[

&#x20;       {"label": "Not Cancel", "value": 0},

&#x20;       {"label": "Cancel", "value": 1}

&#x20;   ],

&#x20;   value=0,

&#x20;   clearable=False

)



Important



Do not change the underlying value mapping:



Not Cancel → 0

Cancel     → 1



So predict\_page.py should ultimately send:



"is\_canceled": 0



when the user selects Not Cancel, and:



"is\_canceled": 1



when the user selects Cancel.



This is also consistent with your reservation-status mapping:



0 → Canceled

1 → Check-Out

2 → No-Show

def calculate\_client\_segment(

&#x20;   bad\_rate

):



bad\_rate = safe\_numeric(

&#x20;   bad\_rate,

&#x20;   0.0

)



if bad\_rate >= 0.70:



&#x20;   return "high-risk"



elif bad\_rate >= 0.40:



&#x20;   return "bad"



elif bad\_rate >= 0.20:



&#x20;   return "moderate"



else:



&#x20;   return "low-risk"

&#x20;               work\[col] = (



&#x20;                   work\[col]



&#x20;                   .fillna("unknown")



&#x20;                   .astype(str)



&#x20;                   .str.strip()



&#x20;                   .replace(



&#x20;                       {



&#x20;                           "": "unknown",



&#x20;                           "nan": "unknown",



&#x20;                           "None": "unknown",



&#x20;                           "null": "unknown",



&#x20;                           "missing": "unknown"



&#x20;                       }



&#x20;                   )



&#x20;               )



&#x20;       return work



\# =====================================================

&#x20;   # PREPARE PREDICTION FEATURES

&#x20;   # =====================================================



&#x20;   def \_prepare\_prediction\_features(

&#x20;       self,

&#x20;       x,

&#x20;       feature\_list

&#x20;   ):



&#x20;       row = {}



&#x20;       for col in feature\_list:



&#x20;           value = x.get(



&#x20;               col,



&#x20;               "unknown"



&#x20;           )



&#x20;           # ---------------------------------------------

&#x20;           # NUMERIC CLIENT / CANCELLATION SIGNALS

&#x20;           # ---------------------------------------------



&#x20;           if col in \[



&#x20;               "is\_top\_bad\_client",



&#x20;               "client\_bad\_rate",



&#x20;               "is\_canceled"



&#x20;           ]:



&#x20;               try:



&#x20;                   value = float(value)



&#x20;               except Exception:



&#x20;                   value = 0.0



&#x20;               if np.isnan(value):



&#x20;                   value = 0.0



&#x20;           else:



&#x20;               if value is None:



&#x20;                   value = "unknown"



&#x20;               elif isinstance(value, str):



&#x20;                   value = value.strip()



&#x20;                   if value.lower() in \[



&#x20;                       "",



&#x20;                       "nan",



&#x20;                       "none",



&#x20;                       "null",



&#x20;                       "missing"



&#x20;                   ]:



&#x20;                       value = "unknown"



&#x20;               else:



&#x20;                   value = str(value)



&#x20;           row\[col] = value



&#x20;       # IMPORTANT:

&#x20;       # Return DataFrame so sklearn / LightGBM receives

&#x20;       # feature names.

&#x20;       return pd.DataFrame(



&#x20;           \[row],



&#x20;           columns=feature\_list



&#x20;       )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;   # GET MODEL PAIR

&#x20;   # =====================================================



&#x20;   def \_get\_current\_models(self):



&#x20;       model\_name = (



&#x20;           self.current\_model\_name



&#x20;           or self.best\_model\_name



&#x20;       )



&#x20;       if model\_name not in self.models:



&#x20;           raise ValueError(

&#x20;               "No trained model available."

&#x20;           )



&#x20;       model\_pair = self.models\[

&#x20;           model\_name

&#x20;       ]



&#x20;       return (



&#x20;           model\_pair\["rating"],



&#x20;           model\_pair\["status"]



&#x20;       )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;   # SAFE PROBABILITY PREDICTION

&#x20;   # =====================================================



&#x20;   def \_predict\_proba(



&#x20;       self,



&#x20;       model,



&#x20;       X



&#x20;   ):



&#x20;       if hasattr(

&#x20;           model,

&#x20;           "predict\_proba"

&#x20;       ):



&#x20;           return model.predict\_proba(

&#x20;               X

&#x20;           )



&#x20;       raise ValueError(

&#x20;           "Selected model does not support "

&#x20;           "probability prediction."

&#x20;       )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;   # MAP STATUS PROBABILITIES

&#x20;   #

&#x20;   # preprocess.py:

&#x20;   #

&#x20;   # 0 -> canceled

&#x20;   # 1 -> no-show

&#x20;   # 2 -> check-out

&#x20;   # =====================================================



&#x20;   def \_map\_status\_probabilities(



&#x20;       self,



&#x20;       model,



&#x20;       X



&#x20;   ):



&#x20;       raw\_probabilities = (



&#x20;           self.\_predict\_proba(



&#x20;               model,



&#x20;               X



&#x20;           )\[0]



&#x20;       )



&#x20;       # =================================================

&#x20;       # FIND MODEL CLASSES

&#x20;       #

&#x20;       # Pipeline exposes classes\_ through final estimator.

&#x20;       # =================================================



&#x20;       if hasattr(

&#x20;           model,

&#x20;           "classes\_"

&#x20;       ):



&#x20;           classes = model.classes\_



&#x20;       elif hasattr(

&#x20;           model,

&#x20;           "named\_steps"

&#x20;       ):



&#x20;           final\_model = (



&#x20;               model.named\_steps.get(

&#x20;                   "model"

&#x20;               )



&#x20;           )



&#x20;           if hasattr(

&#x20;               final\_model,

&#x20;               "classes\_"

&#x20;           ):



&#x20;               classes = (

&#x20;                   final\_model.classes\_

&#x20;               )



&#x20;           else:



&#x20;               classes = np.arange(

&#x20;                   len(raw\_probabilities)

&#x20;               )



&#x20;       else:



&#x20;           classes = np.arange(

&#x20;               len(raw\_probabilities)

&#x20;           )



&#x20;       probabilities = {



&#x20;           "canceled": 0.0,



&#x20;           "no-show": 0.0,



&#x20;           "check-out": 0.0



&#x20;       }



&#x20;       print()



&#x20;       print(

&#x20;           "STATUS MODEL CLASSES:",

&#x20;           \[str(c) for c in classes]

&#x20;       )



&#x20;       print(

&#x20;           "STATUS MODEL RAW PROBABILITIES:",

&#x20;           raw\_probabilities

&#x20;       )



&#x20;       # =================================================

&#x20;       # MAP CLASS -> STATUS

&#x20;       # =================================================



&#x20;       for cls, probability in zip(



&#x20;           classes,



&#x20;           raw\_probabilities



&#x20;       ):



&#x20;           try:



&#x20;               class\_value = int(

&#x20;                   float(cls)

&#x20;               )



&#x20;           except Exception:



&#x20;               continue



&#x20;           status\_name = (



&#x20;               self.status\_class\_mapping.get(

&#x20;                   class\_value

&#x20;               )



&#x20;           )



&#x20;           if status\_name is not None:



&#x20;               probabilities\[

&#x20;                   status\_name

&#x20;               ] = (



&#x20;                   float(probability) \* 100.0



&#x20;               )



&#x20;       return probabilities



\# =====================================================

&#x20;   # USER STATUS OVERRIDE

&#x20;   #

&#x20;   # reservation\_status is a direct UI input.

&#x20;   #

&#x20;   # If user explicitly chooses a status, that selection

&#x20;   # should be reflected in the final result.

&#x20;   # =====================================================



&#x20;   def \_apply\_status\_input(



&#x20;       self,



&#x20;       probabilities,



&#x20;       reservation\_status,



&#x20;       is\_canceled



&#x20;   ):



&#x20;       probs = probabilities.copy()



&#x20;       status = str(

&#x20;           reservation\_status

&#x20;           if reservation\_status is not None

&#x20;           else "unknown"

&#x20;       ).strip().lower()



&#x20;       try:



&#x20;           canceled\_flag = int(

&#x20;               float(is\_canceled)

&#x20;           )



&#x20;       except Exception:



&#x20;           canceled\_flag = 0



&#x20;       # =================================================

&#x20;       # NORMALIZE STATUS

&#x20;       # =================================================



&#x20;       if status in \[



&#x20;           "check out",



&#x20;           "checkout",



&#x20;           "check\_out"



&#x20;       ]:



&#x20;           status = "check-out"



&#x20;       elif status in \[



&#x20;           "no show",



&#x20;           "noshow",



&#x20;           "no\_show"



&#x20;       ]:



&#x20;           status = "no-show"



&#x20;       elif status in \[



&#x20;           "cancel",



&#x20;           "cancelled"



&#x20;       ]:



&#x20;           status = "canceled"



&#x20;       # =================================================

&#x20;       # USER SELECTS CANCELED

&#x20;       # =================================================



&#x20;       if status == "canceled":



&#x20;           return {



&#x20;               "canceled": 100.0,



&#x20;               "no-show": 0.0,



&#x20;               "check-out": 0.0



&#x20;           }



&#x20;       # =================================================

&#x20;       # USER SELECTS NO-SHOW

&#x20;       # =================================================



&#x20;       if status == "no-show":



&#x20;           return {



&#x20;               "canceled": 0.0,



&#x20;               "no-show": 100.0,



&#x20;               "check-out": 0.0



&#x20;           }



&#x20;       # =================================================

&#x20;       # USER SELECTS CHECK-OUT

&#x20;       # =================================================



&#x20;       if status == "check-out":



&#x20;           return {



&#x20;               "canceled": 0.0,



&#x20;               "no-show": 0.0,



&#x20;               "check-out": 100.0



&#x20;           }



&#x20;       # =================================================

&#x20;       # USER SELECTS CANCEL

&#x20;       #

&#x20;       # is\_canceled:

&#x20;       #

&#x20;       # 0 -> Not Cancel

&#x20;       # 1 -> Cancel

&#x20;       # =================================================



&#x20;       if canceled\_flag == 1:



&#x20;           return {



&#x20;               "canceled": 100.0,



&#x20;               "no-show": 0.0,



&#x20;               "check-out": 0.0



&#x20;           }



&#x20;       # =================================================

&#x20;       # UNKNOWN STATUS + NOT CANCEL

&#x20;       #

&#x20;       # Use ML probabilities.

&#x20;       # =================================================



&#x20;       return probs



\# =====================================================

&#x20;   # CALCULATE CLIENT RISK

&#x20;   # =====================================================



&#x20;   def \_calculate\_client\_risk(



&#x20;       self,



&#x20;       x



&#x20;   ):



&#x20;       try:



&#x20;           bad\_rate = float(



&#x20;               x.get(

&#x20;                   "client\_bad\_rate",

&#x20;                   0.0

&#x20;               )



&#x20;           )



&#x20;       except Exception:



&#x20;           bad\_rate = 0.0



&#x20;       try:



&#x20;           top\_bad = float(



&#x20;               x.get(

&#x20;                   "is\_top\_bad\_client",

&#x20;                   0.0

&#x20;               )



&#x20;           )



&#x20;       except Exception:



&#x20;           top\_bad = 0.0



&#x20;       segment = str(



&#x20;           x.get(

&#x20;               "client\_segment",

&#x20;               "low-risk"

&#x20;           )



&#x20;       ).strip().lower()



&#x20;       bad\_rate = float(



&#x20;           np.clip(



&#x20;               bad\_rate,



&#x20;               0.0,



&#x20;               1.0



&#x20;           )



&#x20;       )



&#x20;       top\_bad = float(



&#x20;           np.clip(



&#x20;               top\_bad,



&#x20;               0.0,



&#x20;               1.0



&#x20;           )



&#x20;       )



&#x20;       segment\_score = {



&#x20;           "low-risk": 0.0,



&#x20;           "moderate": 0.4,



&#x20;           "bad": 0.7,



&#x20;           "high-risk": 1.0



&#x20;       }.get(



&#x20;           segment,



&#x20;           0.0



&#x20;       )



&#x20;       client\_risk = max(



&#x20;           bad\_rate,



&#x20;           top\_bad,



&#x20;           segment\_score



&#x20;       )



&#x20;       client\_risk = float(



&#x20;           np.clip(



&#x20;               client\_risk,



&#x20;               0.0,



&#x20;               1.0



&#x20;           )



&#x20;       )



&#x20;       print()



&#x20;       print(

&#x20;           "=============================="

&#x20;       )



&#x20;       print(

&#x20;           "CLIENT RISK SIGNAL"

&#x20;       )



&#x20;       print(

&#x20;           "=============================="

&#x20;       )



&#x20;       print(

&#x20;           f"Client Segment: "

&#x20;           f"{segment}"

&#x20;       )



&#x20;       print(

&#x20;           f"Client Bad Rate: "

&#x20;           f"{bad\_rate}"

&#x20;       )



&#x20;       print(

&#x20;           f"Top Bad Client: "

&#x20;           f"{top\_bad}"

&#x20;       )



&#x20;       print(

&#x20;           f"Calculated Client Risk: "

&#x20;           f"{client\_risk}"

&#x20;       )



&#x20;       return client\_risk



\# =====================================================

&#x20;   # ADJUST RATING USING CLIENT RISK

&#x20;   # =====================================================



&#x20;   def \_adjust\_rating\_with\_client\_risk(



&#x20;       self,



&#x20;       ml\_rating,



&#x20;       client\_risk



&#x20;   ):



&#x20;       rating = int(



&#x20;           np.clip(



&#x20;               round(

&#x20;                   float(ml\_rating)

&#x20;               ),



&#x20;               0,



&#x20;               6



&#x20;           )



&#x20;       )



&#x20;       # =================================================

&#x20;       # CLIENT RISK INDEPENDENTLY AFFECTS RATING

&#x20;       # =================================================



&#x20;       if client\_risk >= 0.90:



&#x20;           rating = min(

&#x20;               rating,

&#x20;               2

&#x20;           )



&#x20;       elif client\_risk >= 0.70:



&#x20;           rating = min(

&#x20;               rating,

&#x20;               3

&#x20;           )



&#x20;       elif client\_risk >= 0.40:



&#x20;           rating = min(

&#x20;               rating,

&#x20;               4

&#x20;           )



&#x20;       elif client\_risk >= 0.20:



&#x20;           rating = min(

&#x20;               rating,

&#x20;               5

&#x20;           )



&#x20;       return int(



&#x20;           np.clip(



&#x20;               rating,



&#x20;               0,



&#x20;               6



&#x20;           )



&#x20;       )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;   # CALCULATE RATING RISK

&#x20;   # =====================================================



&#x20;   def \_calculate\_rating\_risk(



&#x20;       self,



&#x20;       rating,



&#x20;       client\_risk



&#x20;   ):



&#x20;       base\_risk = {



&#x20;           0: 100.0,



&#x20;           1: 90.0,



&#x20;           2: 75.0,



&#x20;           3: 60.0,



&#x20;           4: 40.0,



&#x20;           5: 20.0,



&#x20;           6: 10.0



&#x20;       }.get(



&#x20;           int(rating),



&#x20;           50.0



&#x20;       )



&#x20;       client\_component = (



&#x20;           client\_risk \* 35.0



&#x20;       )



&#x20;       risk = max(



&#x20;           base\_risk,



&#x20;           client\_component



&#x20;       )



&#x20;       return float(



&#x20;           np.clip(



&#x20;               risk,



&#x20;               0.0,



&#x20;               100.0



&#x20;           )



&#x20;       )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;   # CALCULATE SLA RISK

&#x20;   # =====================================================



&#x20;   def \_calculate\_sla\_risk(



&#x20;       self,



&#x20;       rating\_risk,



&#x20;       client\_risk,



&#x20;       status\_probabilities



&#x20;   ):



&#x20;       cancellation\_risk = (



&#x20;           status\_probabilities\[

&#x20;               "canceled"

&#x20;           ]



&#x20;       )



&#x20;       no\_show\_risk = (



&#x20;           status\_probabilities\[

&#x20;               "no-show"

&#x20;           ]



&#x20;       )



&#x20;       status\_risk = (



&#x20;           cancellation\_risk \* 0.60



&#x20;           +



&#x20;           no\_show\_risk \* 0.40



&#x20;       )



&#x20;       sla\_risk = (



&#x20;           rating\_risk \* 0.50



&#x20;           +



&#x20;           status\_risk \* 0.35



&#x20;           +



&#x20;           client\_risk \* 100.0 \* 0.15



&#x20;       )



&#x20;       return float(



&#x20;           np.clip(



&#x20;               sla\_risk,



&#x20;               0.0,



&#x20;               100.0



&#x20;           )



&#x20;       )



\# =====================================================

&#x20;   # GENERATE COMMENT

&#x20;   # =====================================================



&#x20;   def \_generate\_comment(



&#x20;       self,



&#x20;       rating,



&#x20;       client\_risk,



&#x20;       status\_probabilities



&#x20;   ):



&#x20;       if status\_probabilities\[

&#x20;           "canceled"

&#x20;       ] >= 50.0:



&#x20;           status\_comment = (



&#x20;               "The booking has a high "

&#x20;               "cancellation risk."



&#x20;           )



&#x20;       elif status\_probabilities\[

&#x20;           "no-show"

&#x20;       ] >= 50.0:



&#x20;           status\_comment = (



&#x20;               "The booking has a high "

&#x20;               "no-show risk."



&#x20;           )



&#x20;       else:



&#x20;           status\_comment = (



&#x20;               "The booking is more likely "

&#x20;               "to result in check-out."



&#x20;           )



&#x20;       if client\_risk >= 0.90:



&#x20;           client\_comment = (



&#x20;               "The selected client has a very "

&#x20;               "high historical bad-review rate."



&#x20;           )



&#x20;       elif client\_risk >= 0.70:



&#x20;           client\_comment = (



&#x20;               "The selected client has a high "

&#x20;               "historical service risk."



&#x20;           )



&#x20;       elif client\_risk >= 0.40:



&#x20;           client\_comment = (



&#x20;               "The selected client shows a "

&#x20;               "moderate historical service risk."



&#x20;           )



&#x20;       else:



&#x20;           client\_comment = (



&#x20;               "No significant historical "

&#x20;               "client risk was detected."



&#x20;           )



&#x20;       rating\_comment = {



&#x20;           0:

&#x20;               "The predicted customer experience is very poor.",



&#x20;           1:

&#x20;               "The predicted customer experience is poor.",



&#x20;           2:

&#x20;               "The predicted customer experience is below average.",



&#x20;           3:

&#x20;               "The predicted customer experience is average.",



&#x20;           4:

&#x20;               "The predicted customer experience is good.",



&#x20;           5:

&#x20;               "The predicted customer experience is very good.",



&#x20;           6:

&#x20;               "The predicted customer experience is excellent."



&#x20;       }.get(



&#x20;           int(rating),



&#x20;           "The customer experience could not be classified."



&#x20;       )



&#x20;       return " ".join(\[



&#x20;           rating\_comment,



&#x20;           client\_comment,



&#x20;           status\_comment



&#x20;       ])



\# =====================================================

&#x20;   # PREDICT

&#x20;   #

&#x20;   # RETURNS EXACTLY:

&#x20;   #

&#x20;   # pred

&#x20;   # prob\_canceled

&#x20;   # prob\_check\_out

&#x20;   # prob\_no\_show

&#x20;   # sla\_risk

&#x20;   # risk

&#x20;   # comment

&#x20;   # =====================================================



&#x20;   def predict(



&#x20;       self,



&#x20;       x



&#x20;   ):



&#x20;       # =================================================

&#x20;       # GET MODELS

&#x20;       # =================================================



&#x20;       rating\_model, status\_model = (



&#x20;           self.\_get\_current\_models()



&#x20;       )



&#x20;       # =================================================

&#x20;       # CLIENT RISK

&#x20;       # =================================================



&#x20;       client\_risk = (



&#x20;           self.\_calculate\_client\_risk(

&#x20;               x

&#x20;           )



&#x20;       )



&#x20;       # =================================================

&#x20;       # PREPARE RATING INPUT

&#x20;       # =================================================



&#x20;       X\_rating = (



&#x20;           self.\_prepare\_prediction\_features(



&#x20;               x,



&#x20;               self.rating\_features



&#x20;           )



&#x20;       )



&#x20;       # =================================================

&#x20;       # PREPARE STATUS INPUT

&#x20;       # =================================================



&#x20;       X\_status = (



&#x20;           self.\_prepare\_prediction\_features(



&#x20;               x,



&#x20;               self.status\_features



&#x20;           )



&#x20;       )



&#x20;       # =================================================

&#x20;       # RATING PREDICTION

&#x20;       # =================================================



&#x20;       ml\_rating = (



&#x20;           rating\_model.predict(

&#x20;               X\_rating

&#x20;           )\[0]



&#x20;       )



&#x20;       try:



&#x20;           ml\_rating = int(

&#x20;               round(

&#x20;                   float(ml\_rating)

&#x20;               )

&#x20;           )



&#x20;       except Exception:



&#x20;           ml\_rating = 3



&#x20;       ml\_rating = int(



&#x20;           np.clip(



&#x20;               ml\_rating,



&#x20;               0,



&#x20;               6



&#x20;           )



&#x20;       )



&#x20;       # =================================================

&#x20;       # CLIENT-ADJUSTED RATING

&#x20;       # =================================================



&#x20;       pred = (



&#x20;           self.\_adjust\_rating\_with\_client\_risk(



&#x20;               ml\_rating,



&#x20;               client\_risk



&#x20;           )



&#x20;       )



&#x20;       # =================================================

&#x20;       # STATUS PROBABILITIES FROM ML

&#x20;       # =================================================



&#x20;       status\_probabilities = (



&#x20;           self.\_map\_status\_probabilities(



&#x20;               status\_model,



&#x20;               X\_status



&#x20;           )



&#x20;       )



&#x20;       # =================================================

&#x20;       # APPLY USER STATUS INPUT

&#x20;       # =================================================



&#x20;       status\_probabilities = (



&#x20;           self.\_apply\_status\_input(



&#x20;               status\_probabilities,



&#x20;               x.get(

&#x20;                   "reservation\_status",

&#x20;                   "unknown"

&#x20;               ),



&#x20;               x.get(

&#x20;                   "is\_canceled",

&#x20;                   0

&#x20;               )



&#x20;           )



&#x20;       )



&#x20;       # =================================================

&#x20;       # EXTRACT PROBABILITIES

&#x20;       # =================================================



&#x20;       prob\_canceled = float(



&#x20;           status\_probabilities\[

&#x20;               "canceled"

&#x20;           ]



&#x20;       )



&#x20;       prob\_no\_show = float(



&#x20;           status\_probabilities\[

&#x20;               "no-show"

&#x20;           ]



&#x20;       )



&#x20;       prob\_check\_out = float(



&#x20;           status\_probabilities\[

&#x20;               "check-out"

&#x20;           ]



&#x20;       )



&#x20;       # =================================================

&#x20;       # RATING RISK

&#x20;       # =================================================



&#x20;       risk = (



&#x20;           self.\_calculate\_rating\_risk(



&#x20;               pred,



&#x20;               client\_risk



&#x20;           )



&#x20;       )



&#x20;       # =================================================

&#x20;       # SLA RISK

&#x20;       # =================================================



&#x20;       sla\_risk = (



&#x20;           self.\_calculate\_sla\_risk(



&#x20;               risk,



&#x20;               client\_risk,



&#x20;               status\_probabilities



&#x20;           )



&#x20;       )



&#x20;       # =================================================

&#x20;       # COMMENT

&#x20;       # =================================================



&#x20;       comment = (



&#x20;           self.\_generate\_comment(



&#x20;               pred,



&#x20;               client\_risk,



&#x20;               status\_probabilities



&#x20;           )



&#x20;       )



&#x20;       # =================================================

X\_train\_status\_all = train\_df\[

X\_train\_status = (

self.status\_model = LogisticRegression(

self.status\_model.fit(

validation\_results = \[]



for name, model in models.items():



preds = model.predict(

&#x20;           X\_val

&#x20;       )



f1 = f1\_score(

&#x20;               y\_val,

&#x20;               preds,

&#x20;               average="weighted"

&#x20;           )



try:



clf = model.named\_steps\["clf"]



if hasattr(

&#x20;                   clf,

&#x20;                   "predict\_proba"

&#x20;               ):



probs = model.predict\_proba(

&#x20;                   X\_val

&#x20;               )



else:



scores = model.decision\_function(

&#x20;                   X\_val

&#x20;               )



&#x20;               scores = np.asarray(

&#x20;                   scores

&#x20;               )



if scores.ndim == 1:



scores = np.column\_stack(

&#x20;                       \[

&#x20;                           -scores,

&#x20;                           scores

&#x20;                       ]

&#x20;                   )



exp = np.exp(

&#x20;                       scores -

&#x20;                       np.max(

&#x20;                           scores,

&#x20;                           axis=1,

&#x20;                           keepdims=True

&#x20;                       )

&#x20;                   )



probs = (

&#x20;                       exp /

&#x20;                       exp.sum(

&#x20;                           axis=1,

&#x20;                           keepdims=True

&#x20;                       )

&#x20;                   )



roc = roc\_auc\_score(

&#x20;                   y\_val,

&#x20;                   probs,

&#x20;               )



except Exception as e:



print(
