&#x20;           )



&#x20;           roc = 0.0



validation\_results.append({

&#x20;           "f1": f1,



&#x20;           "roc": roc



&#x20;       })

validation\_df\["final\_score"] = (

validation\_df = (

joblib.dump(

"model":

with open(

=========================================================



\# NORMALISE INPUT

def \_prepare\_input(

&#x20;   self,

&#x20;   x

):



&#x20;   input\_df = pd.DataFrame(

&#x20;       \[x]

&#x20;   )



\---------------------------------------------



\# Text

&#x20;   # ---------------------------------------------



&#x20;   if "comment" not in input\_df.columns:

&#x20;       input\_df\["comment"] = ""



input\_df\["comment"] = (

&#x20;           input\_df\["comment"]

&#x20;           .fillna("")

&#x20;           .astype(str)

&#x20;       )



\---------------------------------------------



\# Categorical

&#x20;   # ---------------------------------------------



&#x20;   categorical\_features = \[



&#x20;       "hotel",

&#x20;       "meal",

&#x20;       "market\_segment",

&#x20;       "distribution\_channel",

&#x20;       "deposit\_type",

&#x20;       "customer\_type",

&#x20;       "season\_group",

&#x20;       "country\_group",

&#x20;       "adr\_group",

&#x20;       "previous\_cancellations\_group",

&#x20;       "days\_in\_waiting\_list\_group",

&#x20;       "guest\_group",

&#x20;       "client\_segment",

&#x20;       "reservation\_status"



&#x20;   ]



for col in categorical\_features:



if col not in input\_df.columns:

&#x20;           input\_df\[col] = "unknown"



input\_df\[col] = (

&#x20;               input\_df\[col]

&#x20;               .fillna("unknown")

&#x20;               .astype(str)

&#x20;               .str.strip()

&#x20;           )



\---------------------------------------------



\# Numeric

&#x20;   # ---------------------------------------------



&#x20;   if "is\_top\_bad\_client" not in input\_df.columns:

&#x20;       input\_df\["is\_top\_bad\_client"] = 0



if "is\_canceled" not in input\_df.columns:

&#x20;           input\_df\["is\_canceled"] = 0



if "client\_bad\_rate" not in input\_df.columns:

&#x20;           input\_df\["client\_bad\_rate"] = np.nan



input\_df\["is\_top\_bad\_client"] = (



pd.to\_numeric(

&#x20;           input\_df\["is\_top\_bad\_client"],

&#x20;           errors="coerce"

&#x20;       )



&#x20;       .fillna(0)



&#x20;       .clip(0, 1)



&#x20;   )



input\_df\["is\_canceled"] = (



pd.to\_numeric(

&#x20;           input\_df\["is\_canceled"],

&#x20;           errors="coerce"

&#x20;       )



&#x20;       .fillna(0)



&#x20;       .clip(0, 1)



&#x20;   )



\---------------------------------------------



\# Client bad rate

&#x20;   # ---------------------------------------------



&#x20;   client\_bad\_rate = pd.to\_numeric(



&#x20;       input\_df\["client\_bad\_rate"],



&#x20;       errors="coerce"



&#x20;   )



if client\_bad\_rate.isna().all():



if (

&#x20;           self.df\_reference is not None

&#x20;           and

&#x20;           "client\_bad\_rate"

&#x20;           in self.df\_reference.columns

&#x20;       ):



&#x20;           fallback = pd.to\_numeric(



&#x20;               self.df\_reference\[

&#x20;                   "client\_bad\_rate"

&#x20;               ],



&#x20;               errors="coerce"



&#x20;           ).median()



if pd.isna(

&#x20;                   fallback

&#x20;               ):



fallback = 0.0



&#x20;       else:



&#x20;           fallback = 0.0



client\_bad\_rate = (

&#x20;               client\_bad\_rate.fillna(

&#x20;                   fallback

&#x20;               )

&#x20;           )



else:



fallback = (

&#x20;           client\_bad\_rate.median()

&#x20;       )



if pd.isna(

&#x20;               fallback

&#x20;           ):



fallback = 0.0



client\_bad\_rate = (

&#x20;               client\_bad\_rate.fillna(

&#x20;                   fallback

&#x20;               )

&#x20;           )



input\_df\["client\_bad\_rate"] = (

&#x20;           client\_bad\_rate.clip(0, 1)

&#x20;       )



=====================================================



\# NORMALISE RESERVATION STATUS

&#x20;   # =====================================================



&#x20;   reservation\_status = str(



&#x20;       input\_df\[

&#x20;           "reservation\_status"

&#x20;       ].iloc\[0]



&#x20;   ).strip().lower()



if reservation\_status in \[

&#x20;           "cancelled",

&#x20;           "canceled"

&#x20;       ]:



reservation\_status = "canceled"



elif reservation\_status in \[

&#x20;           "checkout",

&#x20;           "check out",

&#x20;           "check-out"

&#x20;       ]:



reservation\_status = "check-out"



elif reservation\_status in \[

&#x20;           "noshow",

&#x20;           "no show",

&#x20;           "no-show"

&#x20;       ]:



reservation\_status = "no-show"



elif reservation\_status in \[

&#x20;           "",

&#x20;           "nan",

&#x20;           "none",

&#x20;           "null",

&#x20;           "unknown"

&#x20;       ]:



reservation\_status = "unknown"



input\_df\[

&#x20;           "reservation\_status"

&#x20;       ] = reservation\_status



=====================================================



\# KEEP EXPLICIT CANCELLATION SIGNAL CONSISTENT

&#x20;   #

&#x20;   # If reservation\_status is explicitly canceled,

&#x20;   # is\_canceled must be 1.

&#x20;   #

&#x20;   # If reservation\_status is no-show or check-out,

&#x20;   # is\_canceled must be 0.

&#x20;   # =====================================================



&#x20;   if reservation\_status == "canceled":



&#x20;       input\_df\[

&#x20;           "is\_canceled"

&#x20;       ] = 1.0



elif reservation\_status in \[

&#x20;           "no-show",

&#x20;           "check-out"

&#x20;       ]:



input\_df\[

&#x20;           "is\_canceled"

&#x20;       ] = 0.0



return input\_df



=========================================================



\# PREDICT

\# =========================================================



def predict(

&#x20;   self,

&#x20;   x: dict

):



&#x20;   # =====================================================

&#x20;   # PREPARE UI INPUT

&#x20;   # =====================================================



&#x20;   input\_df = self.\_prepare\_input(

&#x20;       x

&#x20;   )



=====================================================



\# COMMENT TOPIC FEATURES

&#x20;   # =====================================================



&#x20;   if (

&#x20;       self.comment\_tfidf is None

&#x20;       or

&#x20;       self.comment\_svd is None

&#x20;   ):



&#x20;       raise RuntimeError(



&#x20;           "Comment TF-IDF/SVD models are not available. "

&#x20;           "Please retrain the ServiceModel."



&#x20;       )



comment\_tfidf = (

&#x20;           self.comment\_tfidf.transform(

&#x20;               input\_df\["comment"]

&#x20;           )

&#x20;       )



comment\_features\_array = (

&#x20;           self.comment\_svd.transform(

&#x20;               comment\_tfidf

&#x20;           )

&#x20;       )



comment\_columns = \[



f"comment\_topic\_{i}"



&#x20;       for i in range(

&#x20;           comment\_features\_array.shape\[1]

&#x20;       )



&#x20;   ]



comment\_features = pd.DataFrame(



comment\_features\_array,



&#x20;       columns=comment\_columns,



&#x20;       index=input\_df.index



&#x20;   )



input\_df = pd.concat(



\[

&#x20;           input\_df,

&#x20;           comment\_features

&#x20;       ],



&#x20;       axis=1



&#x20;   )



=====================================================



\# PART 1

&#x20;   # FINAL RATING PREDICTION

&#x20;   # =====================================================



&#x20;   rating\_features\_with\_comments = (



&#x20;       self.rating\_features +



&#x20;       comment\_columns



&#x20;   )



X\_rating = input\_df\[



\["comment"] +



&#x20;       rating\_features\_with\_comments



&#x20;   ]



pred\_rating = int(



self.best\_model.predict(

&#x20;           X\_rating

&#x20;       )\[0]



&#x20;   )



pred\_rating = int(



np.clip(

&#x20;           pred\_rating,

&#x20;           0,

&#x20;           6

&#x20;       )



&#x20;   )



clf = (

&#x20;           self.best\_model

&#x20;           .named\_steps\["clf"]

&#x20;       )



=====================================================



\# RATING PROBABILITIES

&#x20;   # =====================================================



&#x20;   if hasattr(

&#x20;       clf,

&#x20;       "predict\_proba"

&#x20;   ):



&#x20;       rating\_probs = (



&#x20;           self.best\_model

&#x20;           .predict\_proba(

&#x20;               X\_rating

&#x20;           )\[0]



&#x20;       )



else:



scores = (



&#x20;           self.best\_model

&#x20;           .decision\_function(

&#x20;               X\_rating

&#x20;           )



&#x20;       )



scores = np.asarray(

&#x20;               scores

&#x20;           )



if scores.ndim == 2:

&#x20;               scores = scores\[0]



exp = np.exp(



scores -

&#x20;           np.max(scores)



&#x20;       )



rating\_probs = (



exp /

&#x20;           np.sum(exp)



&#x20;       )



rating\_class\_order = list(

&#x20;           clf.classes\_

&#x20;       )



=====================================================



\# SLA RISK

&#x20;   # =====================================================



&#x20;   risk\_weights = {



&#x20;       0: 1.00,

&#x20;       1: 0.90,

&#x20;       2: 0.75,

&#x20;       3: 0.60,

&#x20;       4: 0.40,

&#x20;       5: 0.20,

&#x20;       6: 0.00



&#x20;   }



sla\_risk = 0.0



for i, cls in enumerate(

&#x20;           rating\_class\_order

&#x20;       ):



if i >= len(

&#x20;           rating\_probs

&#x20;       ):



&#x20;           continue



try:



rating\_class = int(

&#x20;               cls

&#x20;           )



&#x20;       except Exception:



&#x20;           continue



sla\_risk += (



rating\_probs\[i]



&#x20;           \*



&#x20;           risk\_weights.get(

&#x20;               rating\_class,

&#x20;               0.50

&#x20;           )



&#x20;       )



sla\_risk\_score = round(



sla\_risk \* 100,



&#x20;       1



&#x20;   )



=====================================================



\# CUSTOMER RISK SCORE

&#x20;   # =====================================================



&#x20;   rating\_risk\_map = {



&#x20;       0: 100,

&#x20;       1: 90,

&#x20;       2: 75,

&#x20;       3: 60,

&#x20;       4: 40,

&#x20;       5: 20,

&#x20;       6: 10



&#x20;   }



base\_risk = rating\_risk\_map.get(



pred\_rating,



&#x20;       50



&#x20;   )



risk\_score = round(



(



&#x20;           0.6 \*

&#x20;           base\_risk



&#x20;       )



&#x20;       +



&#x20;       (



&#x20;           0.4 \*

&#x20;           sla\_risk\_score



&#x20;       ),



&#x20;       1



&#x20;   )



=====================================================



\# PART 2

&#x20;   # RESERVATION STATUS PREDICTION

&#x20;   #

&#x20;   # CORRECT:

&#x20;   #

&#x20;   # 0 -> CANCELED

&#x20;   # 1 -> NO-SHOW

&#x20;   # 2 -> CHECK-OUT

&#x20;   #

&#x20;   # =====================================================



&#x20;   status\_input = input\_df\[



&#x20;       \[

&#x20;           "comment",

&#x20;           "hotel",

&#x20;           "meal",

&#x20;           "market\_segment",

&#x20;           "distribution\_channel",

&#x20;           "deposit\_type",

&#x20;           "customer\_type",
